statements.text: I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 8:30 AM on my way to the office. Traffic was quite heavy, stop-and-go as usual. Suddenly, the driver ahead of me braked hard for a turning vehicle. I tried to press my brakes firmly, but I just couldn't stop in time on the damp road. My front bumper hit the rear of their Peugeot. It was a low-speed impact, but now I have a noticeable dent on my hood. I am really stressed about how this will impact my premiums, as I have never had an accident before.

I was circulating the roundabout near the airport, staying in the middle lane, when I tried to exit toward the highway. A silver car to my right didn't see me and drifted into my lane. I swerved slightly to the left, but we still managed to scrape against each other. It was just a minor scratch on the passenger side door. Man, this is honestly so frustrating, I was just trying to get to the terminal to pick up my cousin who was flying in from London, you know?

I was exiting the roundabout and honestly didn't check my mirror well enough. I drifted into the middle lane while the Seat Ibiza was still beside me. I heard the scraping sound immediately and we both pulled over safely to the side to exchange details. There is a superficial scratch on my rear bumper.

I was parking in front of the local bakery this afternoon, trying to squeeze into a tight spot. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar near the curb and accidentally backed into it. It was quite a clumsy move on my part, I suppose I was distracted by looking for my wallet. The impact caused a dent and a long scratch on the rear bumper. I feel terrible about the car, it is almost new and I really should have been more careful while reversing.

I was heading down Avenida Luísa Todi when a delivery van suddenly pulled out from a side street without looking. I had to veer to the left to avoid a full T-bone collision. As I passed, my side mirror brushed against the van, which broke my lamp cover and left a deep scratch along the side panel. It was a very close call, and I am still shaking from the adrenaline of the moment. I hope the van driver realizes that he really shouldn't have pulled out like that so abruptly.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when I saw the Peugeot driver forced to swerve. The delivery van entered the lane way too fast. I clearly saw the Peugeot's passenger side mirror strike the van, causing the lamp to break and scratching the car's paint. The driver of the Peugeot stayed in control, which was quite impressive given the circumstances.

Driving on the EN125 is always a chore during the summer season with all the tourists. I was coming to a complete stop for a pedestrian crossing near the village when the car behind me didn't notice I had slowed down. They hit me quite firmly from behind. The impact was significant enough that it caused a large dent on my trunk and the glass shatter of my rear window. I was worried someone might be hurt, but thankfully we both seemed okay, just very rattled by the noise and the mess.

I was crossing the intersection on a green light when another driver ran their red light from the side street. I slammed on the brakes but there was no time to stop completely. Their front end collided with my side, causing a deep dent in the door and smashing the side indicator lamp. I am very frustrated because I was driving safely, but I suppose these things happen in the city. I am just glad it wasn't a head-on collision, as that would have been far worse for everyone involved.

I am so sorry, I completely missed the traffic light change. I was thinking about my work meeting and didn't see the light turn red. I hit the side of the Citroën as I entered the intersection. I accept full responsibility for the accident and the damage to the other vehicle's door and lamp. I feel terrible about this whole situation.

It was a very narrow street, and I was trying to maneuver around a delivery truck that was double-parked. As I was inching forward at maybe 5 km/h, I misjudged the position of a metal bollard on the corner. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had run my passenger side along it. There is a long scratch now. I really hate how narrow the streets are in this part of Porto, it makes driving a nightmare sometimes. I should have asked my passenger to step out and guide me.

I was traveling in the right lane and decided to merge into the middle lane to prepare for an upcoming turn. I checked my mirrors, or so I thought, but there was a vehicle in my blind spot. We made contact, which resulted in a dent and scratch on my rear door. My daughter in the passenger seat was quite frightened by the noise, but luckily we were only going at about 30 km/h. It was a really honest mistake and I am quite embarrassed by it.

I was driving in the middle lane when the Nissan began to merge into my path. I tried to accelerate to get out of the way, but they caught my front bumper and moved into my side. The impact caused a dent and scratch on their door. It all happened so fast, there was really no time to avoid the contact completely.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I have been driving for over forty years, and I usually take great pride in my clean record. Today, while navigating the roundabout at Rotunda da Boavista, the sun was shining so brightly that it created a terrible glare. I didn't see the car to my left as I was exiting, and I bumped into their rear corner. My headlight lamp is now broken from the contact. It's just one of those days where everything seemed to go wrong, and I apologize for the inconvenience to the other driver.

I was pulling away from the curb and didn't see the cyclist approaching quickly. I turned the wheel to exit the spot just as they were passing. It wasn't a high-speed collision, but the bike hit the side of my car. This caused a small dent, a scratch, and unfortunately, it shattered the small window glass on the rear door. I feel absolutely terrible about the whole situation. I checked my mirrors, but they must have been in the blind spot during that brief second of movement.

I was walking down the street and saw the Mini pull out from the parking space. The cyclist was moving fast and couldn't stop. They crashed into the passenger side. I saw the glass shatter and noticed the dent and scratch on the car. It seemed like a genuine accident where neither party had enough time to react properly to the other's movement.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front of me braked suddenly, but the driver behind me didn't react in time. My car was pushed forward, resulting in a noticeable dent on my trunk and several deep scratches along the bumper. I am honestly quite shaken by the whole event, you know, it just happened so fast, and I'm really worried about how long the repairs might take.

The traffic was stop-and-go, and I simply misjudged the distance between my car and the Golf ahead of me. I tried to apply the brakes, but the road was a bit slick from the earlier rain. I apologize for the impact and the damage caused to their bumper.

I was trying to park my car in a tight spot near the shopping center on Rua de Santa Catarina. The street is very narrow, and I must have misjudged the proximity to the concrete bollard on the corner. I heard a dull thud, and when I got out, I realized there was a small but clear dent on the rear wing panel. It was a silly mistake on my part, and I feel embarrassed about it, but I suppose these things happen in busy city centers.

I was driving down Almirante Reis when a motorcycle swerved abruptly to avoid a cyclist. I tried to move over to give him space, but I didn't see the car in my right-hand blind spot. We made contact at about 30 km/h. My front side lamp is broken, and there are several scratches along the wheel arch. It was such a confusing situation with so many things happening at once, I just wanted to make sure everyone was safe.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the metro entrance when I saw the cars collide. The driver of the Megane tried to avoid a reckless motorcyclist, but clipped the other vehicle in the lane next to him. It looked like a genuine attempt to avoid a more serious crash.

Back in my day, people drove with much more care, but today on the Estrada Monumental, things were quite chaotic. I was simply heading to pick up my grandson when a large SUV squeezed past me, scraping against my side. It resulted in a deep scratch and a dent on my driver-side door. I suppose I should have been watching closer, but it all occurred while I was maintaining my speed in the lane. It’s just such a bother to deal with repairs at my age.

Traffic was dense heading towards Almada on the bridge. I had come to a complete stop due to the congestion, but the driver behind me clearly wasn't paying attention. The impact was strong enough to shatter my rear windshield and break one of the tail lamps. I’m really worried about the cost of the glass repair, as I need the car for my commute every single day. I was quite anxious and upset, but the other driver was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the whole ordeal.

I was distracted by the radio for just a split second, and by the time I looked back at the road, the traffic had stopped completely. I could not stop in time, despite hitting the brakes hard. I am fully responsible for the damage to the Audi.

I was driving in the right lane heading north when a vehicle in the left lane suddenly pulled into my space without signaling. I tried to swerve, but there was a significant impact to the side of my car, resulting in a large dent. It was very sudden and I didn't have much time to react. I’m just trying to follow the insurance procedures correctly to get this resolved as efficiently as possible, because my schedule is extremely tight this week.

I admit I changed lanes without checking my side mirror properly. I was in a rush to reach the next exit and didn't notice the BMW was already alongside me. The contact was unintentional, and I take full responsibility for the dent in their side panel.

I was enjoying the coastal drive towards Cascais when traffic ahead suddenly slowed for a speed camera. I braked smoothly, but the car behind me didn't. The impact was quite jarring; it left a dent on my trunk, deep scratches on the bumper, and shattered the rear glass. I am honestly still feeling a bit rattled, it was such a peaceful afternoon until that happened. I’ve never been in a crash like this before, so I’m just trying to make sure I’m doing everything the insurers require.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5 PM during the heavy evening traffic. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because a pedestrian started crossing the road unexpectedly. Even though I hit my brakes, the road was slightly damp from earlier rain and I just couldn't stop in time. I bumped into his rear bumper at a very low speed. I feel terrible about it, man, I'm just really worried about how much this will cost and if my insurance rates are going to skyrocket because of this.

I was forced to perform an emergency stop due to a pedestrian hazard. The driver behind me was unable to stop in time on the wet pavement and made contact with my rear bumper. There is a visible dent on the bumper section.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport when I misjudged the distance while trying to exit toward the highway. I was moving at maybe 20 km/h, just keeping with the flow. I tried to change lanes, but I didn't see the other car in my blind spot. I ended up scraping against his side panel. I am so sorry, I feel so embarrassed. It was totally my mistake, I was just distracted for a second, you know? I hope everything can be fixed quickly without too much trouble.

It was a busy afternoon, and I was trying to parallel park near the local shops. I honestly thought I had enough clearance while reversing, but I miscalculated the angle against the parked vehicle beside me. I heard a scraping sound and realized immediately that I had made contact. I checked the damage and there is a noticeable scratch and a small dent on the rear quarter panel of their car. I feel awful about damaging someone else's property like this; it was just a simple, stupid mistake.

I was walking past the street when I saw the Toyota attempting to park. It seemed the driver misjudged the maneuver and made contact with the stationary vehicle, causing a scratch and a dent on the rear side.

I was driving in the right lane heading towards Cais do Sodré. The traffic was moving slowly, about 30 km/h. As I began to merge into the left lane to prepare for my turn, I did not notice the car coming up fast in that lane. We made contact, and it seems my side mirror hit his lamp. I feel quite shaken by the whole incident as I have never had a collision before. I am just hoping the insurance process is straightforward and that the other driver is okay.

I was driving straight in the left lane when the Mercedes suddenly pulled out into my path while attempting to change lanes. There was no time to react and our vehicles collided. The impact resulted in my rear lamp being broken.

It was early in the morning, the sun was quite low, and I suppose I was temporarily blinded by the glare. I was behind another car that stopped for the traffic light, and I didn't see it until the very last second. I hit the back of his vehicle at a low speed, but it was enough to cause the glass on his rear light to shatter. My goodness, I am so worried. I have a long day of work ahead and this is the last thing I need right now.

I was pulling out of a parking space very slowly. I was checking my mirrors, but perhaps I turned the steering wheel too sharply. I bumped into the car that was waiting for the parking space to open up. I feel very guilty as I should have been more careful with my spacing. It is only a small dent on their bumper, but I feel terrible that I have caused this inconvenience for the other driver today. I am happy to cooperate with the insurance report.
I was waiting for a space in the parking area when the driver of the Ford reversed out and hit my front bumper. It was a low-speed impact that resulted in a visible dent.

I was approaching the intersection when the traffic light turned yellow. I decided to proceed, but the vehicle coming from the side street didn't seem to stop. I swerved to avoid a full impact, but we still caught each other's corners. There is a nasty crack on the front bumper area where we hit. I have been driving for forty years and honestly, I am a bit shaken by the events, though luckily nobody was hurt. We moved the vehicles out of the way to not block traffic.

I was looking for a parking spot on this very narrow street. I thought I had cleared the wall and the parked car, but I was wrong. My side rubbed against the door of the parked vehicle, creating a long scratch. I feel so stressed out about this because I am quite busy with my exams this week and this just adds so much pressure. I have already contacted the owner, and we are just waiting for the insurance details to be filed properly so we can resolve this.
I witnessed the Hyundai attempting to navigate the narrow street. It did not leave enough room and scraped against the side of a parked car, causing a clearly visible scratch on the paintwork.

Driving along the coastal road, I was in the right lane. There was a car in the left lane that started drifting into my lane while trying to get around a cyclist. I had nowhere to go, so we ended up side-swiping. My lamp is broken and there is a dent on the side panel. It was a frightening moment, and I am quite anxious about the damage. I hope my insurance will cover the repairs because this was clearly an unavoidable situation for me.

I was passing a cyclist and accidentally drifted slightly into the right lane. The driver behind was in my blind spot, and we collided. There is damage to the lamp and a dent on the side of their vehicle.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was heading home from work, listening to the radio, and I suppose my mind wandered for a split second. The car in front slowed down for the roundabout, and I did not notice it until I saw the brake lights. I applied the brakes firmly but still slid into the rear of his car. It caused a dent and some glass shatter from his rear light housing. I am terribly sorry for this. I just want to make sure everything is handled correctly through the insurance process so we can put this behind us.

I was driving around the Boavista roundabout, signaling to exit toward Avenida da Boavista, when the car in the inner lane tried to cut across to exit too. I was honestly just trying to stay in my lane, and I think he misjudged how close I was. My car ended up with a dent on the rear passenger door. It all happened so fast, and I am quite worried about how long the repairs will take because I need this car for my commute to work every single day.

The traffic was incredibly heavy near the Cais do Sodré area this afternoon. I was completely stopped for a red light, just minding my own business, when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The other driver apologized immediately, stating he didn't see me stop in time because the sun was reflecting off his windshield. My rear lamp is broken and there are several deep scratches on the bumper. It is quite frustrating, but at least the other driver was very cooperative and we exchanged insurance details immediately without any issues.

I admit I was at fault here. The light changed and I was briefly distracted checking my GPS for a route to Alfama. By the time I looked up, the Peugeot ahead had already stopped. I tried to brake, but I couldn't stop in time. I hit the back of his car, causing damage to his lamp and paint. I take full responsibility for the accident.

I was carefully trying to parallel park near the center of Coimbra. It was raining slightly and the roads were quite slippery. As I was turning the wheel to tuck the back end in, I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar near the curb. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had put a scratch along the side panel. It was a very silly mistake on my part, and I feel terrible about damaging the vehicle, but I wanted to report it honestly as soon as it happened today.

I was cruising at about 30 km/h along the Avenida dos Aliados. A delivery van in the right lane started drifting into my lane without checking his blind spot. I tried to honk and swerve, but we still made contact. It left a significant dent and a long scratch down the side of my car. I am just really stressed about this, man. It is my first accident and I'm really worried about how this is going to affect my insurance premiums, you know? It really ruined my whole day.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when I saw the van drift into the Seat's lane. The driver of the Seat definitely tried to move over to avoid him, but the van driver just kept coming over. The impact was unavoidable. I saw the damage to the side of the Seat clearly afterwards.

We were stuck in the usual heavy traffic on the bridge during the evening rush. It was slow-moving, maybe 10 km/h, and then suddenly the car in front slammed on their brakes. I hit my brakes, but the car behind me didn't react fast enough and hit my rear end with quite a bit of force. The impact caused the rear glass to shatter completely. It was quite a shock, but thankfully no one was injured during the collision on the bridge today.

It was just a typical Tuesday morning, I was driving my granddaughter to school. I was proceeding through the green light at the intersection when suddenly a car came out from the side street, completely ignoring their red light. I tried to steer away, but he hit the front corner of my car. There is a nasty dent and the lamp is broken. I've been driving for forty years and honestly, it’s just frightening to see how some people drive nowadays in such a hurry.

I have to be honest, I was looking at my watch and I thought I had time to cross the junction before the light changed. I completely miscalculated the speed of the other vehicle. I am truly sorry for the trouble caused; I hit his front bumper, causing the lamp to break and a dent in the frame.

I was pulling out of a very narrow parking spot on Rua de Cedofeita. The streets are so tight here, you know? I was checking my mirror, but I guess I didn't see the bollard behind me clearly enough because the sun was right in my eyes. I hit it at a very low speed, maybe like 2 or 3 km/h. It didn't do much, just a noticeable scratch on the rear bumper. I feel so dumb for doing that, but I wanted to make sure it was documented properly.

I was moving into the middle lane on Avenida de Roma to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but there was a blind spot issue, I suppose. Another driver was accelerating into that same gap at the exact same time. We clipped sides, which resulted in a dent on my door and a long scratch across the trim. It was a very unfortunate coincidence of two drivers making a maneuver simultaneously. We both pulled over immediately to inspect the damage and exchange all the necessary paperwork.

I was changing lanes to the left to avoid a bus that was pulling over. I didn't notice the Citroën was already occupying the space I was aiming for. We scraped against each other. My car has some paint transfer, and his car has a dent and a scratch. It was clearly a mutual misunderstanding.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was approaching the roundabout at the Marquês de Pombal. The traffic lights were flickering, and people were confused about whether to stop or go. I slowed down cautiously, and the person behind me just didn't see me braking. They hit my rear bumper directly, causing the right lamp to break into pieces. I'm just so anxious about the cost, you know? This car is my pride and joy, and seeing the broken lamp just breaks my heart. I really hope this gets sorted out quickly.

I was parked on the side of Rua da Prata while I went inside a shop for ten minutes. When I returned to my car, I noticed that another vehicle must have misjudged their exit from the parking spot in front of mine. There was a dent and a fresh scratch on my driver-side fender. There was a note left on my windshield with a phone number, which was very kind. We have been in touch, and I am filing this report now to start the formal process.

I am the one who left the note. I was pulling out of my spot and I turned the steering wheel too early. I clipped the Fiat parked behind me. I feel terrible about it and I have already provided all my insurance details to the owner. I admit I caused the dent and the scratch.

I was driving along Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour when the traffic suddenly came to a complete halt. I tried to brake firmly, but I just couldn't stop in time, you know? It's all such a blur, but I think I tapped the bumper of the car in front of me at about 10 km/h. I am honestly just so worried about how much this is going to cost. I feel terrible about the dent on their rear bumper, man. It was a stupid mistake and I feel awful.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio to take the exit toward the airport. I was in the outer lane, and I suppose I didn't check my blind spot carefully enough before merging. I felt a slight scrape as I made contact with the side of a black van. I pulled over immediately to check the damage. There is a noticeable scratch on my passenger side door panel. I am quite embarrassed by my lack of attention, as I pride myself on being a safe driver.

I was driving through the roundabout properly when the driver of the Seat Ibiza drifted into my lane without signaling. I slammed on the brakes but there was no time to avoid the contact. The scratch on my side panel confirms where their bumper grazed my vehicle. The other driver stopped right away and was very apologetic about the incident.

I was heading home after visiting my sister when a car pulled out from a side street unexpectedly. I was going about 30 km/h, but I couldn't dodge them in time. The impact shattered my headlight assembly. There is glass shatter everywhere on the tarmac, and the lamp is clearly broken. It happened so fast that my heart is still racing. I am just grateful that nobody was hurt, as the intersection was quite busy for a Sunday evening.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the Peugeot hit the other vehicle. The Peugeot driver definitely had the right of way, but they simply couldn't stop when the other car pulled out. I saw the lamp break on the Peugeot instantly upon impact. It was a clear accident caused by the other driver's failure to yield at the junction.

I was distracted for a split second by a pedestrian crossing the street, and I failed to notice that the car ahead of me had stopped at the light. I was crawling at maybe 5 km/h, but I still made contact. There is a small dent on my hood from where I hit their bumper. I feel absolutely foolish for not keeping my eyes on the road. The other driver was very understanding, but I know I am at fault for this collision.

I had come to a complete stop at the red signal when I felt a tap from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the Ford Fiesta had hit me. They got out right away and were very worried. There is a minor dent on my bumper, but thankfully no one was injured during the incident. We exchanged our contact information and insurance details right there on the Avenida.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: It was a very busy morning at the Praça do Marquês de Pombal. I signaled to change lanes to the left, but I didn't see the car in my blind spot. We made contact, and I heard a grinding noise immediately. I stopped as soon as it was safe. There is a long scratch and a shallow dent on my rear fender. I am so sorry for the inconvenience, as I know I should have checked the mirrors at least twice before moving over.

I was driving home from work along the riverfront. It was getting dark and I was tired after a long shift. When the vehicle in front of me braked for the tram, I hit them. My headlight lamp is broken from the impact. I am quite worried because this is my first accident. The other driver was very nice and we filled out the accident form together while waiting for the police to pass by so we could clear the lane.

I was driving normally when I had to brake for the tram tracks. The driver behind me didn't stop in time. I felt the jolt of the collision and saw that their headlight lamp was broken. It was an honest mistake, as it was getting quite dark and the visibility was poor. We both got out and verified the damage before moving our vehicles to prevent blocking the traffic.

I was driving around the roundabout near the city garden. Another driver entered the roundabout too fast and hit my side window. There is a crack in the glass and shards of glass shatter on the upholstery. I am shaken up, dude, like my hands are still shaking while I type this. I didn't expect that to happen at all. I just want to make sure my insurance covers this so I can get back to work tomorrow without any issues.

I entered the roundabout, but I miscalculated the distance of the Volvo approaching from my right. It was a lapse in judgment on my part. I hit their passenger side, causing their window to shatter. I immediately stopped to provide my information. The driver of the Volvo was understandably upset, but we managed to exchange details calmly once the police arrived to assist with the traffic flow.

I was driving around the Boavista roundabout in Porto during the mid-morning rush. The traffic was quite heavy as usual, and I was in the middle lane. Suddenly, a car merged into my lane too quickly from the inside, and I couldn't react in time to avoid contact. My front passenger door suffered a noticeable dent and several deep scratches when our vehicles made side-to-side impact. I am quite worried about how this will affect my insurance premium, as this is my first incident in years. I really tried my best to brake, but there just wasn't enough space.

I was navigating the roundabout and honestly misjudged the distance of the car in the lane next to me. I moved to exit towards the center of the city and heard a scraping sound. I stopped immediately to inspect the damage and saw a dent and some scratches on the other driver's passenger door. I take full responsibility for the lane change error.

I was pulling into a parallel parking spot along Avenida 24 de Julho near the riverside. I thought I had judged the angle correctly, but I underestimated the proximity to the car behind me. As I maneuvered back, I heard a sickening scraping noise. Upon checking, I realized I had left a horizontal scratch along the rear bumper of the parked vehicle. I feel terrible about this mistake, man, like, I am usually a super careful driver. I have already left my contact details under their windshield wiper so we can sort this out properly.

It was a bright afternoon on the EN125 when traffic slowed down abruptly near a turnoff. I was following at a safe distance, but the driver ahead of me braked very hard unexpectedly. I slammed on my brakes, but my car slid slightly on the dusty road surface, resulting in a low-speed impact. The collision caused my front right lamp to be broken and there is a significant dent in my hood. I am honestly quite shaken up by the whole situation, as I was only going about 30 km/h at the time.

I had to stop suddenly because a delivery truck pulled out in front of me without signaling. The driver behind me didn't have enough time to stop completely. It was just a classic rear-end accident. I noticed his lamp was broken and the hood of his car was dented when I got out to check.

I was parked on the side of Rua de Santa Catarina while running a quick errand. When I returned to my car, I noticed that another vehicle had clearly bumped into my front bumper while trying to park or maneuver. The impact resulted in a spiderweb-like crack on the plastic trim of my bumper cover. I did not see the incident happen, but a local shopkeeper mentioned a delivery van had clipped my car. I am really annoyed because I take such good care of this vehicle, and now I have this crack to deal with.

Driving across the 25 de Abril bridge is always stressful during the morning commute. I was maintaining my lane when a vehicle to my left suddenly moved into my space, likely due to a blind spot error. We made contact, resulting in a long scratch along the side panel of my driver-side door. I managed to maintain control and moved to the emergency lane immediately. I am just relieved nobody was hurt, though the side of my car definitely sustained a deep scratch that will require professional attention at the body shop.

I was driving over the bridge and honestly, the sun was reflecting quite harshly off the water, obscuring my vision for a split second. I moved over to the right and heard a scraping noise. I realized I had scraped the side of the car next to me. I stopped in the safety lane as soon as possible to exchange details.

I was driving home from my granddaughter's house on a rainy Tuesday evening. The streets of Porto can be so tricky when they are wet like that, you know. I was approaching the intersection on Avenida da Boavista when the traffic light turned amber, and the car in front of me stopped much faster than I anticipated. I skidded a bit and ended up hitting their rear bumper. My front left lamp is broken, and there is a dent on my bumper. I feel so embarrassed at my age to cause such a bother, but it really was unavoidable.

I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing near the intersection when the collision occurred. The road was indeed quite slippery due to the light rain. The Opel Corsa clearly tried to brake, but the distance was too short. I saw the lamp break on impact and the front bumper sustain a dent. The driver was quite distressed.

The traffic around Praça de Espanha is always chaotic, but today was particularly bad. I was proceeding through the roundabout when a vehicle coming from the internal lane cut across me to take an exit. I steered sharply to the right to avoid a full collision, but we still made contact. My rear passenger door has a dent and a large scratch from the other vehicle's bumper. I am quite frustrated because I was driving at a very low speed, probably 15 km/h, but the other driver just didn't look before changing lanes.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was heading down Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, moving in the second lane from the right. A car to my right initiated a lane change without checking their mirror properly. I tried to sound my horn, but they didn't hear it in time. We scraped against each other, leaving a very clear, long scratch along my entire front fender and driver-side door. I am really annoyed because I have a clean driving record and I don't want this to impact my insurance score, man. It's just a scratch, but it's a deep one that goes through the paint.

I admit I was distracted by my GPS navigation and didn't check the lane properly before moving over. I felt a bump and heard the sound of metal scraping. I stopped the car immediately to check the damage. I can see a significant scratch on the other car's side panels. It was completely my fault for not checking my blind spot.

I was attempting to park on Rua Garrett in the Chiado district. It is a very tight spot, and I was focusing hard on the distance to the curb. Unfortunately, I didn't see the glass light fixture protruding from a nearby shop facade that hung slightly over the parking area. I reversed into it, and it shattered against my rear window glass. The glass shatter is quite extensive across the rear hatch. I am really upset as this is my first car and I try to keep it perfect. I am very worried about the repair costs for the back window.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista when the car in front of me suddenly stopped for a pedestrian crossing. I didn't react quickly enough, and I tapped the back of their vehicle. My front bumper has a visible dent and my passenger-side front lamp is broken. I feel really stupid because I know I should have been paying closer attention to the crossing, but the traffic was so dense. I have already exchanged details with the other driver and apologized profusely for the inconvenience I have caused them this afternoon.

I was slowing down for the pedestrian crossing and the car behind me didn't stop in time, hitting my rear bumper. I got out to see if everyone was okay. The other driver's front lamp was broken and there was a dent on their bumper. We agreed to exchange insurance information and file the report immediately.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving at maybe 20 km/h when the traffic suddenly stopped. I tried to brake, but my foot slipped slightly on the pedal, and I gently bumped into the car in front of me. I felt terrible immediately. When I got out to check, I saw a noticeable dent on their rear bumper. I am so worried about my insurance premiums going up, but I really just want to make sure everything is handled correctly and fairly.

I was at a complete stop in the lane waiting for the light to change. Out of nowhere, I felt a solid impact from behind. My car pushed forward a few meters. When I stepped out, I saw that my bumper had a clear dent from the other driver's plate area.

It was pouring rain this morning near the Saldanha square. I was trying to merge into the right lane to turn, but the visibility was just awful. I checked my mirror, but I must have misjudged the distance of the car already in that lane. We made side-to-side contact while moving at slow speeds. It was a really stressful moment for me, being a new driver. I pulled over immediately to talk to the other driver. I could see a long scratch along the side panel of their vehicle, but thankfully nobody was hurt.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the middle lane and intended to exit towards the airport, but I think I didn't signal early enough or perhaps the other driver didn't see me. As I moved to exit, the side of my car hit the front of a van that was also exiting. I was honestly so confused because everything happened in a split second. The impact broke my side indicator lamp. I am just really rattled by the whole ordeal and hope the repair process isn't too complicated.

The Fiat suddenly cut across my lane while we were both navigating the roundabout. I had no time to react and swerved, but we still collided. My front bumper made contact with their side, shattering their lamp. It was quite chaotic.

I was parking near the river in Coimbra. I thought I had plenty of space to back into the spot, but I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar behind me. It was a very low-speed mistake, but I heard a sickening scraping noise. When I inspected the damage, there was a visible scratch and a small dent on the rear quarter panel. I feel very embarrassed as I have been driving for years and rarely have these kinds of mishaps. I just want to get it fixed through my policy as soon as possible.

I was heading down the Estrada Monumental on my way to visit my daughter. The sun was quite low, and it was shining right into my eyes as I approached the green light. A car coming from the cross-street entered the intersection. I braked hard, but we still clipped each other. My side window was shattered from the impact and the flying debris. I am seventy-two, so this really shook me up. I sat in my car for a while until the police arrived to help us fill out the paperwork.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus. The driver of the BMW definitely seemed to be struggling with the sun glare. They both entered the intersection at the same time and hit the side of each other. I saw the BMW's glass shatter across the road.

I was driving along the riverfront, trying to keep up with the flow of traffic. I checked my blind spot before moving into the left lane, but I didn't see the motorcycle coming up quickly. We didn't hit hard, just a light graze while both vehicles were in motion. It caused a long, ugly scratch on my passenger door. I felt horrible for the motorcyclist, even though they were fine. It's just one of those things that happens in city traffic when everyone is in a hurry, I suppose.

The streets in Porto are so narrow and tight, aren't they? I was trying to pull into a tight space and I must have been distracted by my kids shouting in the back. I reversed too far and hit a parked delivery van. It was a stupid mistake, really. I hit the corner of the van with my rear bumper, which caused a dent and broke my tail lamp. I am just really stressed about the cost of the repairs and the paperwork involved. I should have been much more careful in such a narrow street.

I was driving down Avenida da Liberdade around 3:00 PM. Traffic was moving steadily, but then the car in front of me braked very abruptly for a pedestrian. I applied the brakes as fast as I could, but the road was a bit slick, and I ended up bumping into them. It was a low-speed impact, but it left a clear dent on the center of their trunk. It was a really unfortunate situation. I've been driving for twenty years and rarely get into accidents, so this is quite distressing for me.

I had to stop suddenly because someone walked into the road without looking. The car behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper. I got out to check and there is a definite dent on the metal surface. Thankfully, it's just cosmetic.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was heading towards the city center, and it was quite busy. I was changing lanes to prepare for a turn and caught the edge of a taxi that was driving in my blind spot. I immediately heard a grinding sound as our panels rubbed together. It left a series of nasty scratches on the passenger side door. I am a professional driver myself, so I am very annoyed with my own lapse in concentration. The taxi driver was calm, which helped me stay composed while we exchanged our insurance details.

I was at the supermarket parking lot near the bridge. When I was pulling out of my parking bay, I didn't see the bollard behind me clearly because of the low light. I reversed slowly, but I ended up hitting the plastic covering on the bollard. It caused a significant crack in my rear bumper cover. I felt so silly! It's not a major accident, but it's annoying and I want to get it taken care of so it doesn't get worse. I hope this process is quick.

I was walking to my car in the same row. I saw the driver reverse into the yellow bollard at the end of the space. It was a simple accident, happened quite slowly. I saw the bumper crack when it hit the concrete pillar.

I was driving home from work in the afternoon traffic on Avenida da Boavista. The car ahead of me stopped very suddenly because of a pedestrian crossing the road. I tried to brake, but I wasn't fast enough on the pedal and I ended up bumping into the back of his vehicle. I feel terrible about it because I was distracted for just a second. There is a noticeable dent on my front bumper and a long scratch along the paint where the plastic caught the other car's metallic frame.

I had to stop abruptly at the crosswalk to let a student pass safely. I was already at a full stop when I felt a significant impact from behind. The driver behind me apologized immediately and was very cooperative. My car has a dent on the rear bumper and some scratch marks from the impact.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal and attempting to change into the outer lane to exit toward Avenida da Liberdade. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the white van clearly enough in my blind spot. I steered right and we made side-to-side contact. It was really stressful, like, I was just trying to follow the signs but the traffic was moving so fast. There is just a thin, deep scratch running along my driver-side door panel now.

It was such a rainy Tuesday morning and I was just trying to park near the city center to grab a coffee. I misjudged the distance between my car and the bollard on the curb while reversing into the parking space. I was going very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but the angle was wrong and I hit the metal post. It left a clear dent on my rear quarter panel. I am so upset with myself for being so clumsy today, but I wanted to report it right away.

I was cruising along Avenida dos Aliados when the vehicle in the adjacent lane began to merge into my path without signaling. I attempted to veer to the left to avoid him, but we still made contact. It was all very sudden. My front indicator lamp is broken and there is a significant scratch on the side wing. I'm just relieved nobody was hurt, but I'm quite worried about the repair costs since this is a relatively new car for me.

I apologize, as I genuinely did not see the other car in my peripheral vision when I moved lanes. I feel responsible for the mishap. The impact caused a scratch on their fender and their turn signal lamp is broken. We exchanged insurance details on the side of the road immediately.

My wife and I were driving out to Loulé for a doctor's appointment. The sun was quite bright and reflected off the asphalt at the intersection. I didn't see the red light in time and entered the junction, colliding with a car crossing from the right. It was a terrifying moment. My headlight glass shatter is everywhere, and there is a massive dent on the passenger side door. I am truly sorry for the trouble this has caused everyone involved in this unfortunate accident.

I was waiting at the traffic light on the cross street and saw the whole thing. The light turned red for the Yaris driver, but he didn't seem to notice until it was too late. The impact was quite loud, shattering the glass of the headlights and causing a visible dent on the door.

I was queuing in the heavy traffic near the river. The car ahead of me rolled back slightly while trying to park, and because I was already quite close, I wasn't able to react in time to put my car in reverse. We tapped each other. It was barely moving, but it caused a crack in my front bumper trim. I really hope this doesn't take too long to fix, as I need my car to get to my family home in Cascais every weekend.

It was rush hour and I was trying to merge into the lane for the A1 exit. I was moving at about 20 km/h. I looked over my shoulder and signaled, but the driver behind me accelerated as I was already half-way in. We made contact along the side of the cars. There is a deep scratch and a noticeable dent on my passenger door now. It is quite frustrating, but I suppose these things happen in busy Lisbon traffic all the time.

I was moving straight in my lane when the Audi merged into me suddenly. I hit the brakes, but couldn't avoid the collision. It resulted in a scratch on their door and a small dent. We are both safe, which is the most important thing.

I was entering the roundabout near the stadium. A motorbike rider came up too fast on the inside lane and clipped my bumper while I was exiting. It caused a significant scratch and a crack in the plastic molding. I stopped immediately, but the rider also stopped. It was a very tense situation, you know, because I didn't want the rider to be hurt. Luckily everyone is okay, but my car definitely needs some repair work after this incident.

I was riding my bike and moving through the roundabout. I tried to squeeze past the SUV but miscalculated the driver's exit path. I brushed against the bumper, causing a scratch and a crack to the car's trim. I admit I was riding a bit too aggressively for the conditions.

I was driving home after work around 6:00 PM when traffic on Avenida da Boavista suddenly halted. I applied my brakes, but the car behind me didn't stop in time. It was honestly such a shock because everything was moving so slowly, maybe 20 km/h. I felt a solid jolt from behind, and when I got out to check, I saw a clear dent on my rear bumper. I am really worried about the repair costs, to be honest. The other driver was very apologetic and admitted he was looking at his GPS for a second.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música when another driver attempted to exit from the inner lane while I was clearly in the outer lane. It all happened in a split second, man. I tried to steer away but I couldn't avoid the side-swipe. There is a long scratch running along my passenger side door. I was just trying to head toward the bridge, you know, and now I'm stuck dealing with all this paperwork. It's super stressful because I have an exam tomorrow and I really didn't need this right now.

I was in the middle of navigating the busy traffic at the roundabout. I signaled to exit, but I clearly misjudged the proximity of the Seat Ibiza in the outer lane. I take full responsibility for the miscalculation during the merge. The contact was light, leaving just a surface scratch on the other driver's side panel.

It was a busy afternoon, and I was trying to parallel park near the main square. I was moving at maybe 5 km/h, very slowly. I misjudged the distance to the stone pillar behind me. I heard a scraping sound and immediately knew I had hit something. Upon inspection, there is a visible dent and a deep scratch on the rear corner of the bumper. I feel quite embarrassed as I have been driving for years without incident, but the visibility here is tricky with all the pedestrians crossing the street simultaneously.

I was cruising along the Marginal toward Estoril, keeping to the speed limit of 50 km/h. It was a beautiful day, actually, but then this van tried to squeeze into my lane without checking his blind spot. He clipped my front left corner. The impact caused a scratch on the wheel arch and my headlight assembly is completely broken. I am absolutely livid because I take such good care of this car. It really ruins the whole weekend plans, having to deal with this insurance nonsense on a Saturday morning.

The sun was quite blinding as I approached the junction. I intended to change lanes to make my upcoming turn. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the BMW was caught in my blind spot. I hit the brakes, but it was too late to avoid contact. I have already agreed to cover the damages to his lamp and paint.

I was waiting at the traffic light on Avenida da República. When the light turned green, I proceeded cautiously, but a motorcyclist coming from the cross-street tried to beat the red light. He couldn't stop in time and collided with my driver-side mirror, causing the glass to shatter. It was terrifying, honestly. I was just heading home to my family. Thankfully, no one was hurt, but I'm just so shaken up by how quickly things can go wrong when you're just following the rules of the road.

I was walking my dog near the intersection. I clearly saw the Toyota driver move forward when the light turned green for them. The motorcyclist entered the junction way too fast, clearly ignoring the red light signal. The collision was inevitable at that point, resulting in the Toyota's side mirror glass shattering instantly.

I was pulling out of a parking spot on this very narrow street in Porto. I didn't see a car coming because of the delivery trucks blocking the view. We were both going very slow, probably 10 km/h, but the contact was enough to leave a nasty dent on my front fender and break the side indicator lamp. I feel terrible about the accident. I've been driving for forty years and I rarely have issues, but these city streets are getting impossible to navigate with all these obstacles.

I was driving along the avenue, keeping a steady pace of 40 km/h. The road was quite wet from the light rain earlier. The car next to me suddenly swerved to avoid a puddle and clipped my left side. It’s just a superficial scratch, but it's annoying because the car is relatively new. I'm worried about whether this will affect my insurance premium next year. The other driver stopped immediately, which I suppose is a good thing, though the whole situation is just incredibly frustrating and time-consuming.

The road conditions were slippery after the brief shower. I noticed a large puddle in my lane and instinctively swerved to the left to avoid hydroplaning. I failed to check my side mirror carefully enough, resulting in contact with the Renault. I fully accept the fault for the scratch caused to the other vehicle.

I had just finished shopping at a bookstore and was stopped in traffic on Rua Garrett. The car behind me, a young man who looked very nervous, just rolled into me. It wasn't a hard hit, but my bumper has a dent and the right tail lamp is broken. I'm just so tired; I had a long day at the office. I just want this sorted out quickly. He was very polite and gave me all his information without any fuss, which I appreciate.

I was cruising near the docks when a delivery scooter cut between lanes way too fast. I swerved slightly to avoid him, but then I scraped against the side railing of a parked truck. It left a long, ugly scratch down my rear door. Honestly, the scooter driver just sped off. It’s not fair, but I have to report this as my own accident since there's no one else to blame. I'm really anxious about how much this will cost, honestly, money is tight right now.

I was entering the roundabout when a vehicle coming from the internal lane cut across my path to exit. I slammed on my brakes, but the angle was impossible. We collided, and there's a significant dent on my passenger door and the mirror glass is shattered from the impact. I was on my way to visit my granddaughter, and this has really ruined my afternoon. It's a shame, but these things happen. I just hope the repairs can be done by next week as I have a trip planned.

I misjudged the roundabout lanes, I admit that. I was in the wrong lane to exit and tried to correct it, which caused me to drift into the Volvo's path. I am deeply sorry for the damage to his door and mirror. I will cooperate fully with the insurance process to ensure he gets his repairs sorted.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM heading towards the Foz area. The traffic was quite heavy as usual, and the car in front of me stopped suddenly because of the traffic light turning red. I tried to brake, but I didn't leave enough distance and ended up tapping his rear bumper at a very low speed. My front bumper has a noticeable dent and some scratches on the plastic finish. It was completely my fault, and I feel terrible about the inconvenience caused to the other driver.

I was waiting at the red light near the park when I felt a sudden bump from behind. It wasn't a violent crash, but enough to move my car slightly forward. Upon checking, there is a clear dent on my bumper and a few scratches where the other vehicle made contact. The gentleman behind me was very apologetic and admitted he misjudged the stopping distance.

It was raining this morning and visibility was not great near Martim Moniz. I was trying to merge into the right lane, checking my mirrors, but I honestly didn't see the van in my blind spot until it was too late. I heard a scraping sound as our side panels made contact. I pulled over immediately to check the damage. There are long scratches along my passenger door and the rear quarter panel. I am just really stressed out, man, this is my first accident and I'm super worried about the repair costs.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música to take the second exit. A car to my left was also exiting, and we both drifted slightly toward the center line. I tried to correct, but we made contact. My front corner hit his side. Now I have a broken headlight lamp and a dent in my fender. I've been driving for forty years, you know, and this is the first time something like this happens in this busy roundabout. It's just very upsetting for everyone involved.

We were both circling the roundabout when the other driver seemed to lose his lane position. He drifted into my side, causing damage to his own headlamp. I have a dent on my door as well. We pulled over just past the roundabout to exchange insurance details. The driver was very polite and cooperative throughout the process.

I was reversing out of a tight parking spot at the shopping center. I was looking behind me, but I miscalculated the angle of the pillar behind me and ended up grazing the side of a parked car. I feel awful because the car was parked perfectly. There are just some ugly scratches on my rear bumper now. I am worried about how my insurance premium will be affected, but I know I must report this properly. It was just a silly, careless mistake on my part.

I was proceeding through the intersection at green, but I think the other driver might have jumped the yellow. We collided right in the middle. The impact shattered my side mirror glass and caused a deep dent in my passenger door. I was quite shaken up, but luckily no one was hurt. My memory is a bit of a blur because it happened so fast, like in a split second, you know? I'm just grateful that my seatbelt held me in place and prevented any real physical injury.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus. I saw the Ford entering the intersection when the other car came from the side street. It looked like the second car tried to beat the light. The impact was quite loud, and I saw glass shattering onto the asphalt. Both drivers stepped out of their vehicles and were checking for injuries immediately after.

I was traveling along the EN125 when traffic came to a sudden halt near the construction works. I pressed the brakes, but my car slid slightly on some loose gravel on the road surface, causing me to hit the car in front. The impact was enough to break my front lamp and leave a dent in the bumper. I am quite worried about the repair time, as I need this vehicle for my daily commute to work. It was a very unfortunate situation for everyone.

I was driving straight in the middle lane when a taxi suddenly swerved to avoid a cyclist. I had nowhere to go and ended up catching the back of the taxi with my side. There is a long scratch running along my driver's side door and a small dent near the handle. It all happened so fast, I didn't really have time to react. I'm just glad nobody got hit, especially the cyclist, though it was a very stressful moment for all of us involved in the traffic.

I was forced to shift quickly to avoid a cyclist who crossed into the lane without looking. I felt a scrape and heard a bang. The Nissan driver caught my rear bumper. There is a dent and several scratches on the side of my car. I stopped as soon as it was safe to do so to exchange details with the insured driver.

I was stopped at the red light on Avenida da Liberdade. The car behind me didn't stop in time and pushed me into the car ahead. The impact wasn't huge, but there is a clear dent on my rear trunk lid and some scratches from the license plate frame of the car behind. I'm very concerned because this is a newer car and I want it to be perfect. The other driver apologized immediately, he was very distressed about the whole incident.

I was distracted for a split second by the GPS, and by the time I looked up, the traffic had stopped. I couldn't stop in time and tapped the car in front. I feel terrible about it. I have some scratches on my front bumper, and I know I caused damage to the BMW in front of me. I am fully taking responsibility for the incident.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving up the avenue and started signaling to change lanes. I looked in my mirror, but there was a blind spot, and I didn't see the motorcycle passing on my right. We just brushed against each other. It was a light impact, but it left a few visible scratches on my side door. I stopped immediately to make sure the rider was okay. Thankfully, he stayed upright and wasn't hurt, which is the most important thing. I am definitely more aware of blind spots now.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was extremely heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front of me braked suddenly for a pedestrian. I managed to stop safely, but the driver behind me clearly didn't react in time. I felt a firm jolt from the back, and when I got out to check, I saw a clear dent on my rear bumper. I am honestly quite shaken by the whole incident and just hope the repair process doesn't take too long.

It was my fault completely. I got distracted for a split second by a notification on my phone and failed to notice the traffic had come to a standstill. I hit the back of the gentleman's car at a very low speed, maybe 10 km/h. I am very sorry for the trouble caused.

I was parking my car in a tight spot near Rua Augusta this morning around 10:00 AM. I thought I had cleared the concrete pillar, but I miscalculated the angle while reversing at a very low speed. I heard a scraping noise and immediately stopped. Upon inspection, there is a visible scratch along the rear passenger side panel. I feel really embarrassed about this, it was just a silly mistake on my part while trying to get into the space. I have taken photos of the area and the scratch for your review.

Oh man, I am so stressed out right now. I was navigating the Rotunda da Boavista, you know how crazy that place gets. I was in the middle lane, and suddenly this delivery van decided to switch lanes without checking his blind spot. He clipped my front wing. I am pretty sure he didn't even see me there. Now I have this big dent and a long scratch on the side of my car. I really need this fixed quickly as I use this car for my university commute every single day, dude.

I was walking near the roundabout waiting to cross the street when I saw the silver van change lanes abruptly. The smaller Toyota driver did not have time to react, and the van hit the passenger side of the car. It was clearly a misjudgment by the van driver.

I was traveling along Avenida 24 de Julho heading toward Cais do Sodré. The weather was a bit rainy, and the road was slick. A vehicle in the left lane lost traction slightly and slid into my lane, swiping the side of my vehicle. The impact was enough to break my indicator lamp and leave a deep scratch across the driver's side door. It happened so fast that I couldn't avoid it. I've been driving for years and have never had to file a claim like this, so I am just following the protocol.

I was driving down the N125 near Faro when a dog ran across the road. I stepped on the brakes to avoid hitting it, and the person behind me just plowed straight into my rear. It was quite a loud impact, and it caused the glass in my rear light cluster to shatter and left a very large dent in the boot lid. I am just relieved nobody was hurt, but I am quite concerned about the extent of the bodywork damage. My back is feeling a bit sore, but I suspect it is just nerves.

I admit I was following too closely for the conditions. When the Mercedes stopped, I didn't have enough distance to come to a halt in time. I hit them with enough force that my own bumper is also damaged. I apologize for the inconvenience.

Back when I was a young man, traffic wasn't this chaotic, but today in Porto, it is quite something. I was entering the intersection carefully, adhering to the lights, but a driver coming from the side didn't respect the stop sign. They hit the corner of my car, which resulted in a broken front lamp and a significant dent in the fender. I am just glad my wife was not with me today, as it might have frightened her. I am reporting this as required by the insurance policy I have held for forty years.

I was driving northbound on Avenida da República during the lunch hour rush. I was maintaining a steady speed in the middle lane when an SUV attempted to merge into my lane without noticing I was already alongside him. His vehicle scraped against my passenger side, leaving a long, deep scratch. We both pulled over immediately to exchange details. He was quite apologetic and admitted he didn't check his side mirror properly before moving over. It is a frustrating situation, but thankfully it was just superficial cosmetic damage to the paintwork.

I was pulling out of a parking garage on Rua do Alecrim when a delivery rider clipped my front corner. It was a very low-speed event, but because my car is quite compact, it seems to have taken the brunt of the impact. I have a dent on the bumper and the side turn signal lamp is broken. I am worried about how much this is going to cost to repair, dude, especially since I am just trying to get through the semester. I hope the insurance covers the repairs properly.

I was stationary at a red light at Praça Marquês de Pombal. The light turned green, but the car in front of me didn't move immediately because of a cyclist. I stopped, but the driver behind me failed to stop. My rear trunk has a substantial dent, and the rear light assembly glass has shattered. I am very frustrated as this is a new vehicle and I have always been a very careful driver. I am currently awaiting the police report to finalize the documentation for this claim.

I misjudged the distance between us while we were starting to move. I thought the Volvo was going to accelerate faster than they did. I accept full responsibility for the collision. I have provided my insurance details to the other driver.

I was driving on Avenida da Liberdade, enjoying the sunny weather, when traffic suddenly started merging to the left due to road construction ahead. A truck tried to push into my lane before I could clear the space. The metal side of the truck trailer swiped my passenger side door, resulting in a series of deep scratches along the paint. It happened quite slowly, but the damage is certainly noticeable. I have contacted the company that owns the truck, and we have agreed to coordinate with our respective insurers to get this resolved professionally.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving at about 20 km/h when the traffic light ahead turned amber, and the car in front of me braked suddenly. I tried to react quickly, but I didn't stop in time and tapped his rear bumper. It was such a silly, low-speed mistake, man, I'm honestly so stressed about the repair costs because my bumper has a visible dent now. I really hope this doesn't make my premiums skyrocket.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't brake early enough in the stop-and-go traffic. My rear bumper sustained a dent from the impact. We exchanged details calmly.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, you know the one, the Rotunda do Relógio. It was quite chaotic with all the tourists and airport traffic. I was in the outer lane trying to exit toward the highway when another vehicle drifted into my path. I swerved to avoid a bigger hit but ended up brushing against their side. It left a long, ugly scratch along my passenger-side door. I feel so bad about it, I should have been more careful with all the lane changes around that busy intersection.

I was trying to park in a very tight spot on Rua da Prata this morning. It was raining slightly, and the streets were slick with those old cobblestones. I miscalculated the distance to the concrete bollard on the corner while reversing. I heard a sickening scraping sound and felt the car stop abruptly. Upon checking, I noticed a deep scratch and a noticeable dent on my rear fender. It's my first incident in years, and I'm just so frustrated with myself for being so clumsy today.

I was driving down Avenida dos Aliados when I attempted to make a right turn. Another driver was pulling out of a side street, and we both misread the timing of the intersection. We hit at a very low speed, maybe 10 km/h. My front right lamp is broken, which is quite annoying as it's a new vehicle. I'm worried about the paperwork, but the other driver was very understanding throughout the whole exchange of information.

I was exiting the side street slowly when the insured driver made a turn into my front quarter panel. I had stopped but perhaps not far enough back. The impact broke their lamp. It was a simple accident caused by poor visibility at the corner.

I was cruising along the Marginal road in Cascais, enjoying the view of the Atlantic, which might have been a mistake because I wasn't fully focused on the lane marking. A van was passing me, and I drifted a bit to the left. We made contact, just a glancing blow, but it left a significant white scratch across my driver's side door panel. I am quite embarrassed to admit this, but the sun was reflecting off the water right into my eyes. I will definitely be more attentive next time.

Oh, what a morning. I was picking up some bread on Rua de Santa Catarina, which is always so busy with pedestrians and delivery vans. As I was pulling out of the narrow space, I didn't see the post behind me. I backed right into it. The sound was terrible, and the glass of my rear tail light is completely shattered now. I feel just awful, my husband told me to be careful in these narrow Porto streets, and here I am, having to report this to you.

I was walking by the bakery and saw the small Fiat backing into the concrete post. The driver was clearly trying to be careful, but the space was just too narrow. The rear light glass shattered instantly upon impact with the corner of the post.

I was waiting in traffic on Avenida da República during the afternoon rush. The vehicle ahead of me began to move, and I released my brake, but then they slammed on theirs again because of a pedestrian crossing. I bumped into them at very low speed. It resulted in a small dent on my hood. This is a very stressful situation for me, and I apologize for the inconvenience to the other driver. I am currently awaiting the repair quote for the insurance adjustment process.

I was driving toward Cais do Sodré and needed to merge into the right lane to exit. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. As I started to move over, I heard a loud screeching sound. We both stopped immediately. It caused a long scratch along the side of my car. I feel terrible, dude, I've been driving for five years and never hit anyone before. I just hope the other person is okay and not too angry about the paint damage.

I was traveling in the right lane near the train station when the driver in the middle lane moved over without seeing me. I honked, but it was too late. My front fender and their side panel both have scratches from the contact.

I was attempting to navigate a delivery zone near Rua Augusta. It was mid-morning, and there were many tourists walking around. I was distracted by a delivery truck that was blocking half the lane. While trying to bypass it, I clipped a decorative stone planter on the curb. The force was enough to cause a visible crack in my front bumper cover. I am so embarrassed by this event; I was just trying to get to my appointment on time and made a very poor judgment call.

Back in my day, drivers were more patient, but today at Praça da Batalha, it was absolute chaos with the construction. I was braking for a taxi, and the young man behind me simply didn't stop in time. He hit my rear end quite hard. My rear lamp is broken and there is a significant dent in the metal boot lid. I've lived in Porto for forty years, and I've never seen such reckless driving as I do these days. I'm just lucky nobody was walking behind the car at that moment.

I was behind the Dacia and misjudged the distance when traffic suddenly slowed down due to the construction work in the square. I hit the rear of their vehicle, causing damage to their lamp and bumper. I accept full responsibility for the accident.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly came to a complete halt near the park. I tried to brake, but I didn't stop in time and tapped the car in front of me. I'm honestly so worried about my insurance premiums going up, you know? It was just a stupid lapse in concentration for a second. When I got out, I could clearly see a nasty dent on my bumper and some deep scratches along the paintwork. I feel terrible about the whole situation, man, it's just a total nightmare for me.

It was raining quite hard this morning as I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio. I was in the outer lane and another driver tried to exit from the inner lane without checking their blind spot. We made contact just as I was passing. My front left lamp is broken and there is a long, ugly scratch across the passenger door. I am really stressed out because I rely on this car for work every single day, and the insurance process feels so incredibly daunting to me right now.

I was attempting to exit the roundabout to head toward the airport. I admit I might have misjudged the distance of the car in the outer lane due to the heavy rain. We collided as I veered to the exit. I noticed my rear light was broken during the incident. I am ready to cooperate fully with the insurance company regarding the damage.

I was parking my car on Rua de Santa Catarina around 10:00 AM. I thought I had enough clearance while reversing into the tight space between two parked vans, but I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar on the sidewalk. There is a visible scratch on the rear right panel now. I have been driving for years and I feel so foolish for making such a basic mistake. I really hope this repair doesn't cost me an arm and a leg, I'm just so anxious about the whole claim.

I was driving home along Avenida Luísa Todi in the evening. The traffic was dense and a truck in the lane to my right started merging into my lane without signaling properly. I tried to steer left, but there wasn't enough room, so he side-swiped my door. There is a very clear dent in the center of the door and multiple scratches along the frame. It all happened so fast, and I am still shaking from the impact. I am just hoping the repairs are straightforward.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the truck drift into the lane of the Toyota. It appeared to be a simple error by the truck driver who likely didn't see the smaller car. The contact resulted in visible damage to the side of the Toyota, specifically a dent and some scratches. It was an unfortunate accident, definitely no malice involved.

Back in my day, we were taught to keep a safe distance, but clearly, the driver behind me forgot that lesson today on the Estrada da Circunvalação. I was slowing down for a yellow light when I felt a massive jolt from behind. When I checked the back, I saw that my rear glass had shattered completely and the brake lamp was broken into pieces. It was quite a shock, and my poor car looks like a real mess, goodness me.

I am terribly sorry for the incident. I was looking at my GPS for a split second and didn't notice the car ahead had braked for the lights. I hit the rear of the Fiesta, causing damage to their rear light and the glass. I take full responsibility for my lack of attention on the road.

I was approaching the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal in the right lane. Another vehicle, which was positioned to my left, suddenly decided to merge into my lane right as I was accelerating. We collided side-on. There is a long scratch along my entire front fender. This is incredibly frustrating because I maintain my car perfectly. I am waiting for the insurance company to guide me through the next steps, but I am quite worried about how long the car will be in the repair shop.

It was just a small urban accident, really. I was maneuvering slowly through the traffic near Avenida dos Aliados when a delivery scooter bumped into my corner. I heard a loud pop and realized my front lamp was broken and there was a dent on the plastic bumper cover. I am a very careful driver, but this was simply unavoidable in such crowded city streets. I really hope the insurance handles this efficiently because I need my vehicle for my daily commute.

I was weaving through the traffic and misjudged the gap between the Smart car and the bus. I accidentally hit the front of the car, which caused a dent and broke the light. I apologize for the inconvenience caused, it was a momentary lapse in judgment while trying to navigate the city center traffic.

I was pulling into a parking spot on Rua Augusta. As I was turning the wheel, I failed to notice a concrete bollard that was slightly obscured by a delivery sign. I hit it at a very low speed, but it left a dent and a large scratch on my front bumper. I feel so embarrassed reporting this, but I know it's the correct thing to do. Everything is so busy here, and I suppose I just wasn't paying enough attention for a second.

I was stuck in the usual morning congestion crossing the 25 de Abril bridge towards Lisbon. The traffic flow was very stop-and-go. The driver behind me didn't stop in time when the car ahead of me braked suddenly. The impact pushed me forward into the vehicle in front, which caused the glass of my rear window to shatter and a major dent in the rear hatch. I was honestly quite shaken by the loud noise of the glass breaking and the force of the collision.

I was in the vehicle directly behind the one that caused the collision. It was clear that the driver was not maintaining a sufficient gap. When traffic slowed down, he didn't brake in time and hit the Volkswagen, creating a chain reaction. I saw the rear glass shatter immediately upon impact. It was definitely a rear-end collision caused by lack of distance.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving in the center lane of Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo when a taxi merged without warning. The front of his vehicle hit my side, resulting in a deep scratch and a broken indicator lamp. My car is relatively new and I am quite upset about this damage. The taxi driver seemed in a hurry, but he stayed to exchange details. I am documenting everything now to ensure the claim proceeds as smoothly as possible, as I am quite worried about repair times.

I was driving home after a long shift at the office, heading down Avenida da Boavista around 6:30 PM. The traffic was quite heavy as usual, and suddenly the car ahead of me braked hard for a yellow light. I tried to press the brake, but I just couldn't stop in time on the damp road surface. My front bumper hit their rear bumper directly. I feel terrible about it, honestly, and I’m so worried about the repair costs since it’s my main car. There is a noticeable dent on the hood now.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the other driver had hit me. I got out to check and noticed a clear dent on my rear bumper. We exchanged details calmly.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the outer lane trying to take the second exit, and I suppose I didn't check my blind spot well enough before moving. The car in the inner lane was faster than I anticipated, and we made side contact. It was completely my fault, man, I'm just so stressed because this is a rental and I don't know how the insurance works. I can see a long scratch along the passenger side door.

I was parking near the University area this afternoon, trying to squeeze into a tight space on the side of the road. I misjudged the distance to the bollard near the curb, and as I turned the wheel to straighten out, I scraped the rear quarter panel. I am so embarrassed about it, it was such a silly mistake to make while I was rushing to meet my professor. There is a deep scratch and a small dent in the metal panel right above the rear wheel.

I was sitting at the cafe terrace nearby when I saw the driver trying to park. It was a very narrow spot and the driver miscalculated the turn, hitting the side of the vehicle against the metal bollard on the sidewalk. I saw the scratch and dent immediately.

I was driving down from the Town Hall when the traffic lights turned yellow. I was distracted for a split second by a pedestrian on the crosswalk and didn't notice the car ahead had stopped abruptly. I slammed on the brakes at about 20 km/h, but I still slid forward into them. The impact caused a hairline crack in my headlight lens. I am just really shaken up, I’ve been driving for years and this is the first time I've ever hit someone like this.

It was a beautiful sunny afternoon and I was enjoying the view along the coast. I was cruising at about 40 km/h when the vehicle in front of me slowed down to turn into a beach parking lot. I didn't notice their turn signal until it was too late. I applied the brakes, but I still made contact. There is a distinct dent on the center of my front bumper. I feel so foolish for being distracted by the ocean view instead of paying attention to the road.
