I was slowing down to enter the parking lot near the beach. I used my blinker well in advance, but the driver behind me didn't seem to notice. They bumped into my rear at low speed. We pulled over and verified the dent on their bumper.

I was heading toward Almada, and the traffic was moving at a slow pace. I tried to change into the right lane to exit the bridge, but there was a blind spot issue. My side mirror clipped the side mirror of a truck that was moving alongside me. It was a very loud noise, like glass shattering, and sure enough, my side mirror glass is completely shattered. I am quite worried about the repair costs because the part is electronic and probably expensive to replace.

I was maintaining my lane on the bridge when the car next to me suddenly moved over. They hit my mirror, which caused their mirror glass to shatter on impact. We stopped at the first available safety bay to check the damage.

It was early morning and I was on my way to drop the kids at school. I was pulling out of a side street onto Rua da Constituição and failed to yield to the car coming from my left. I misjudged their speed, which was probably higher than I thought. I scraped the side of their front bumper. I feel terrible for the delay this caused everyone, and I’m really anxious about the insurance premium going up because of this minor incident.

I was driving down the main street when the Dacia pulled out from a side road without stopping. I tried to brake, but we still touched, leaving a long scratch on my front bumper. The other driver apologized immediately.

I was driving home after a long shift, probably around 6 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to press the brake pedal, but I was just a bit too late given the wet road conditions and the distance. My front bumper hit their rear bumper, causing a small dent. I feel terrible about it, honestly, and I'm just worried about how much this will affect my insurance premiums moving forward.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música to head towards Matosinhos. I was in the outer lane when a van suddenly cut across me to exit. I didn't have enough time to react, so our sides clipped. It resulted in a scratch and a dent on my passenger door. I am just so anxious about the repair costs, man, I really hope the insurance covers this without too much hassle, you know? It happened so fast that I barely had time to process it.

I was merging into the exit lane of the roundabout. I checked my mirrors, but I believe the other driver was in my blind spot. We made contact, causing some damage to his side panel. I take responsibility for misjudging the lane change.

I was attempting to parallel park on Rua Augusta. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I miscalculated the distance to the vehicle parked behind me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed the rear bumper of the car. It left a noticeable scratch on their bumper. I am quite embarrassed by the incident, as I have been driving for many years and rarely have these kinds of mishaps. I have already left my contact details for the owner of the other car.

It was raining quite heavily this morning near the Cais do Sodré station. Traffic was crawling at about 20 km/h. I attempted to change lanes to avoid a stationary bus, but I didn't see the car in the lane next to me quickly enough. We made contact, and my front corner dented his panel and hit his light, causing the lamp to be broken. I am really stressed about this because the car is relatively new and I have never filed a claim before.

I was driving normally in the middle lane when the driver in the left lane veered into me. It seems like the rain affected his visibility. The impact caused a dent on my wheel arch and shattered my indicator lamp.

Traffic on the bridge was stop-and-go as it usually is on a Tuesday morning. I was looking for a playlist on my phone for a split second, and in that moment, the car ahead stopped completely. I slammed on my brakes, but I still rolled into his bumper at low speed, leaving a small dent. It was entirely my fault for being distracted, and I accept full responsibility for the accident. I am just thankful that nobody was hurt, as the speed was quite low.

I was driving down the Estrada Monumental, and as I reached the intersection, the traffic lights turned yellow. The car in front of me decided to stop, but I thought I could make it through, so I braked late. I tapped his bumper, which resulted in a dent, and unfortunately, my headlight hit his bumper in a way that caused my glass to shatter. I feel so bad about this, the road was slippery from the earlier drizzle and I just couldn't stop in time.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus. I saw the Fiat accelerate when the light was changing. The driver behind him couldn't stop in time on the slick road and bumped into him. It was definitely a low-speed impact.

I was driving along Avenida da República, planning to turn right at the next junction. I checked my mirrors, or so I thought, and started to merge into the right lane. I didn't see the taxi already occupying that lane. We made contact, resulting in a long scratch along the side of my vehicle. I am really annoyed with myself for not being more careful. My work schedule has been so intense lately that I think I just lost focus for a few seconds.

I was cruising in the right lane when the Tesla suddenly moved over. I tried to honk, but there wasn't enough time to evade. He scraped the entire side of my passenger door. It's a professional vehicle, so this is quite an inconvenience.

I was trying to park in one of the tight spots near the Praça do Comércio. I turned the wheel too sharply while reversing. I ended up hitting a concrete pillar. It caused a dent in my rear quarter panel and the impact also resulted in my tail lamp being broken. I am quite shaken up because I am not used to driving in such tight urban spaces. I'll need to get the car fixed soon as I rely on it for my daily commute to the office.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: My grandson was in the back seat, and we were chatting about his school day, so I suppose I wasn't paying full attention to the traffic ahead of me. The light turned red at the junction, and the car in front stopped suddenly. I hit them from behind, which left a dent and a scratch on both our bumpers. It was a very quiet afternoon, and the sun was quite low, which made it hard to see clearly. I've been driving for forty years and I'm very sorry for this mistake.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me clearly didn't see me stop. It caused some minor damage to my bumper, just a dent and some paint damage. I am mostly concerned about the delay.

I was driving slowly on Rua de Santa Catarina, looking for a parking space. I turned my head to look at a shop window and didn't notice the bollard near the curb. I clipped it at a very low speed. Unfortunately, my wing mirror hit the edge, which caused the glass to shatter completely. I feel like such an amateur, dude, I was just distracted by the scenery and totally lost track of where the curb was. I hope this is a quick fix, man.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front of me stopped suddenly, but the driver behind me didn't react in time. He hit my rear bumper quite hard. I am really worried about the repair costs, man. It’s just a dent in the bumper, but it looks ugly and I’m afraid it might be expensive to fix. I don't know how I'm going to get around without my car while it's in the shop.

The traffic was stop-and-go. I was distracted for a split second by the GPS, and when I looked up, the Golf in front of me had already braked. I hit the brakes, but I still slid forward and bumped into his rear end. There is a noticeable dent on his bumper.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, keeping to the outer lane. I intended to exit toward Avenida da Liberdade, but another vehicle tried to merge into my lane too quickly. There wasn't enough space, and he scraped against my passenger side door. I feel so stressed about this entire ordeal because I’ve never had an accident before. The paint has a long, deep scratch running across the side. I hope the insurance covers the bodywork properly without me having to pay a fortune out of pocket.

I was parking my car on Rua da Prata this morning to grab a coffee. It was raining slightly, and the cobbles were quite slippery. As I was reversing into a tight spot, I misjudged the distance to the bollard on the curb. My rear wing made contact with it. I feel quite silly about it, honestly. There is a visible dent and a long scratch on the rear panel. I’ve been driving for years and this is the first time I've done something like this. It is just such a frustrating start to my Tuesday.

I was heading down Avenida 24 de Julho at about 40 km/h when a delivery van to my left started drifting into my lane. I tried to swerve, but he still caught my front quarter panel. It left a nasty horizontal scratch. I’m a professional, so I’ve documented everything clearly for the records. This is an unnecessary inconvenience for my schedule, but it is a simple matter of liability. The van driver apologized immediately, acknowledging that he had drifted while checking his manifest. We exchanged details and left the scene quickly to avoid blocking the transit.

I was distracted checking an address for a delivery on Avenida 24 de Julho. I didn't realize I was moving out of my lane until I heard the contact. It resulted in a scratch on the side of the BMW. I take full responsibility for the error in judgment.

I was stopped at a red light on the Circunvalação when, suddenly, I felt a massive jolt from behind. The impact was strong enough to shatter my rear windshield and break my right tail lamp. I am an older gentleman, you know, and this really shook me up quite a bit. It was a perfectly sunny afternoon, I was just on my way to visit my daughter in Matosinhos. I’m just thankful that no one was walking nearby, as the glass shards scattered quite far across the asphalt. It really is a terrible mess.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the pedestrian crossing to clear. The Toyota was waiting at the lights, and the car behind just failed to stop. It was a loud impact, and I saw the glass shatter from the rear window and the lamp housing break into pieces on the road.

It was during the morning rush hour near the metro station. Traffic was crawling, maybe 15 km/h. I was maintaining my lane, but the vehicle next to me, a black SUV, tried to force a gap that didn't exist. He ended up scraping along my driver's side door. I was quite anxious because I was already late for an important meeting, and the whole situation was just stressful. The scratch is right down the middle of the door panel. I’ve already taken photos as instructed by the insurance guidelines, so hopefully, the repair process is straightforward.

The traffic heading south over the bridge was heavy and moving very slowly. The car in front slowed down, so I slowed down too, but the vehicle behind me didn't stop in time. He hit me quite hard. It caused a significant dent in the bumper and the left tail lamp is broken. I feel quite worried about the damage, man, because I need this car for my daily commute. I'm hoping it's just a simple repair and not something that will keep me waiting for weeks. The whole thing was just a bad luck situation.

I misjudged the braking distance on the bridge. When the traffic slowed to a crawl, I wasn't quick enough to stop and tapped the back of the Nissan. My front bumper hit his tail lamp and caused a dent. I’ve accepted my fault for this.

I was attempting to park in a very narrow street in downtown Porto. The car behind me was getting impatient, which made me feel quite rushed and nervous, you know? While trying to pull in, I scraped against the corner of a parked delivery vehicle. It’s just a long surface scratch on my front bumper, but it looks really obvious on the white paint. I am so worried about how much this is going to affect my insurance premiums, dude. I should have just waited for them to pass before trying to maneuver into that tight spot.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was moving from the middle to the left lane. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the car approaching in my blind spot. We made contact, and it caused a dent in my wheel arch and a crack in the plastic trim. It’s quite embarrassing, to be honest. I pride myself on being a careful driver, but this shows how easily a simple oversight can cause damage. The other driver was very understanding, which helped keep my nerves down, but I am still anxious about the repair timeline and the cost of the parts.

I was driving in the left lane when the Audi started moving over. I sounded my horn, but he kept coming. We collided at the wheel arch. I have a dent and the trim is cracked. It was a low-speed impact, but the damage is clear to see.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I was circulating around the Rotunda da Boavista, intending to take the exit toward Avenida da França. As I was exiting, a taxi tried to cut across my path from the inner lane. He swiped the front of my car, causing a scratch and breaking my front left lamp. I am an older driver, and these modern roundabouts with so many lanes can be quite confusing at times. I remember the weather was perfectly clear, but the taxi driver seemed to be in a great rush. I stopped immediately to ensure he also pulled over to discuss the incident.

I saw the Volvo in the outer lane of the roundabout. The taxi driver took the exit from the middle lane and didn't check his blind spot. The taxi's rear side hit the Volvo's front. It broke the lamp and left a large scratch on the bumper.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 8:30 AM when the traffic suddenly stopped for the light. I pressed my brakes, but I guess I didn't leave enough distance because I nudged the back of the car in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. It was really raining hard and the road was quite slippery, which made stopping much more difficult than usual. I feel terrible about it, honestly, as I was distracted by the heavy traffic. My car has a visible dent on the bumper where it hit their tow bar.

I was trying to park in that tight space near the Rossio station. It was my first time visiting this area and the cobblestone streets are honestly so confusing. I misjudged the distance while reversing into the spot and clipped the side of the car parked next to me. I heard a scraping noise and immediately stopped. I am so worried about the repair costs, you know? I checked the damage and there is definitely a scratch along the passenger door panel. I am just a student and this is my first car, man.

I was sitting in my car when I felt a sudden bump from the side. I looked out and saw the driver of the Peugeot getting out, clearly upset and apologizing profusely. It was clearly a mistake while parking. There is a long scratch on my rear door panel, right above the wheel arch. I have the insurance details of the other driver now.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música at noon today. As I was exiting the circle, the driver in the adjacent lane tried to squeeze in without signaling properly. I couldn't move over because of the traffic divider, so we ended up sideswiping each other at low speed. It happened so fast, honestly. I think my headlight housing got caught and now the lamp is broken. I am just really stressed about the whole claims process because I need my vehicle for my job as a courier.

I was driving home along the river after a long day at the office. I was maintaining a steady speed in the middle lane when the vehicle to my left suddenly swerved to avoid a taxi that had pulled over abruptly. We collided along the side panels. It was completely unexpected and I didn't have enough time to react or move out of the way. Both my doors have a deep dent and a nasty scratch where we made contact during the swerve. It was an extremely stressful experience for me.

I panicked when the taxi in front of me slammed its brakes. I swerved to the right to avoid hitting it, and unfortunately, I clipped the small car driving alongside me. I accept full responsibility for the incident. I stopped immediately and we exchanged information. I feel very bad for the damage caused to the other driver's car doors.

Well, my grandson had told me to be careful, as the streets in downtown Porto are quite narrow on a Saturday morning with all the tourists walking about. I was pulling out of a small delivery bay near the church, and I didn't see the cyclist coming from behind me. I heard a bang and saw the cyclist stumble. My side window glass shatter happened when their handle bar swung into the door frame. I am quite shaken up by this, as I have been driving for forty-five years without any issues.

I was standing on the corner waiting for my friend to finish shopping. I saw the Mini pulling out very slowly, but the cyclist was coming quite fast through the blind spot. The collision was minor, but the cyclist's handlebar hit the driver's window directly, causing the glass to shatter immediately. Neither party was going fast, it was just a very unfortunate coincidence of timing and positioning.

I was commuting during the heavy morning rush hour on Avenida da República. I signaled to change into the right lane to prepare for my turn. I checked my mirrors, but there was a significant blind spot, and as I moved, I made contact with a van that was also accelerating. We were both moving at about 30 km/h. It was a stupid mistake and I feel quite embarrassed. There is a long scratch running along the rear quarter panel of my vehicle. The other driver was very polite about it.

I was heading toward the hotel zone when traffic slowed down. The driver behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a significant jolt as they hit my bumper. It was quite a shock, and my passengers were a bit worried, but thankfully no one was hurt. My car sustained a dented trunk and the tail lamp is broken. I've already taken photos as requested by the insurance protocol. It’s such a nuisance to deal with this, but I am just glad it was only a minor physical impact.

I was distracted for a split second by the GPS, and when I looked up, the car in front had stopped. I slammed on the brakes, but I still slid into them. I apologize to the other driver. I clearly caused the dent and broke their tail lamp. I am ready to cooperate with the insurance company to resolve this as quickly as possible.

I was searching for a parking spot near the river and found a space that looked sufficient. While maneuvering into the narrow gap, I accidentally cut the turn too sharply. I hit a concrete pillar that wasn't properly marked with reflective tape. It caused a dent in the side panel and a significant scratch along the passenger door. I am feeling very frustrated because I have been very careful with this car since I bought it last year. It’s just one of those bad days, I suppose.

I was crossing the intersection when another car entered from a side street without observing the stop sign. I tried to swerve, but we still collided at the front corner. The impact caused my headlight to shatter—that is, the lamp is broken now—and there is a scratch on the bumper. I'm quite anxious about the car repair time, as I need it for my family. The weather was clear, so I don't know how they didn't see me coming.

I honestly thought I had enough time to pull out, but I miscalculated the speed of the approaching Renault. I take full responsibility for the collision at the intersection. My front bumper made contact with their headlight and side panel. I am deeply sorry for the damage to their lamp and the bodywork.

I was driving along the Alameda when a motorcycle rider attempted to pass between the lanes of traffic. It was a very tight squeeze and he lost his balance, brushing against my driver-side door. I stopped the car immediately to check if he was okay. He was fine, thankfully, but his handlebars put a distinct dent in my door panel. I am just so worried about how this will affect my insurance premium. Dealing with this kind of stuff is always so stressful and time-consuming for someone with my busy schedule.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was keeping a safe distance, but the car ahead of me stopped very suddenly to avoid a pedestrian who stepped off the curb unexpectedly. I applied my brakes as firmly as I could, but I still tapped the rear bumper of the vehicle in front of me at very low speed. It was a complete lapse in reaction time on my part, and I feel terrible about the dent I caused to their trunk.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música, trying to take the third exit towards Foz. It was raining quite heavily, and the visibility was poor. As I moved to the outer lane, I misjudged the proximity of the silver sedan coming up beside me. I tried to pull back, but the side of my car grazed against their rear door panel. It left a noticeable scratch along my passenger side, and I am very worried about the repair costs for both vehicles.

The driver of the Fiat 500 attempted a lane change inside the roundabout without noticing I was already established in the lane. We were both moving at a slow pace because of the rain, but the contact was unavoidable. I have a long scratch across my back door now, but thankfully neither of us was injured in the incident.

I was trying to parallel park near the Arch on Rua Augusta during a busy Saturday morning. There were tourists everywhere, and I was quite distracted trying to maneuver into a very tight space. I miscalculated my turning angle and backed into the parked van behind me. I heard a crunching sound and immediately stopped. Upon inspection, I could see a dent and some deep scratches on the bumper where I made contact. I left my details on the van's windshield as soon as I realized what had happened.

I was heading down Avenida 24 de Julho towards Belém. The traffic was flowing at about 40 km/h. I signaled to move into the left lane, and I honestly thought the other driver was leaving me space. However, they accelerated slightly, and I ended up clipping their front fender. My rear lamp is broken and there is a deep scratch on the quarter panel. I am so sorry for this, man, I just didn't check my blind spot well enough before pulling over.

I was driving steadily in the left lane when the Peugeot suddenly steered into my path. I tried to brake, but there was no time to avoid the collision. It shattered my headlight cover and left a scrape on my bumper. It was an honest mistake, but very frustrating during rush hour.

It was a bright Tuesday morning and I was crossing the intersection near the City Hall. I thought I had the green light, but I might have misread the signal in my haste to get to my grandson's school. A delivery van came from the side, and we collided at the corner. The impact caused the side window glass to shatter completely. I am quite shaken up by the whole experience, and I hope the other driver is doing alright as well.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when the BMW entered the intersection while the light was clearly turning red. The collision wasn't high speed, but it was loud. I saw the glass shatter on the side of the BMW. I stayed to make sure everyone was safe before continuing to work.

I was driving along the Estrada Monumental, moving slowly due to the heavy tourist traffic. I was looking for a parking spot for a restaurant. I got distracted for a split second by a sign and didn't notice the car in front of me had come to a complete stop. I hit the rear of the car at probably 10 km/h. There is a small dent on my hood and a corresponding dent on their bumper. I feel really foolish for being so distracted while driving.

I was sitting in traffic on Avenida da República. The driver behind me didn't seem to notice that we were stopped. I felt a significant bump from behind, which pushed my car forward slightly. When I got out, I saw that my rear light assembly was broken and there was a significant dent on the trunk lid. It was a very sudden impact and I am still trying to process the paperwork with the other driver.

I was behind the Mercedes and I admit I was looking at my GPS for a moment. By the time I looked back at the road, I realized everyone was stopped. I braked hard, but the road was dry and my tires just couldn't stop in time. I caused a dent to their trunk and broke their light, and I take full responsibility for the accident.

I was trying to pull out of a very tight parking space on Rua de Santa Catarina. It is a narrow street, and there were many pedestrians walking by. I was nervous about hitting a person, so I was focusing all my attention on the sidewalk. As I backed out, I scraped the side of the car parked next to me. I feel so bad about the scratch I left on their paintwork. It was a genuine error in judgment while trying to be careful with the pedestrians.

I was driving toward the ferry terminal when a driver in the adjacent lane tried to merge into my lane without checking. I tried to swerve to the right, but there was a bollard there, so I couldn't move much. We ended up side-swiping each other. There is a long scratch and a dent along my driver's side door. The whole thing happened so fast, and I am still worried about the repair schedule since I need my car for work every day.

I was riding my bicycle on the path next to the road when I saw the two cars merge into the same lane. The Hyundai driver definitely tried to avoid the other car by swerving toward the side, but the collision was unavoidable. Both vehicles ended up with visible dents and scratches on their side panels. I stayed until the police arrived.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM. Traffic on Avenida da Boavista was extremely heavy as usual. I was trailing a silver sedan and when the traffic light at the intersection turned yellow, the driver in front hit their brakes quite hard. I tried to react quickly, but I was not fast enough and hit their bumper at a very low speed. My front bumper has a noticeable dent now. I am really worried about how this will affect my insurance premium as I have never had an accident before.

I was stopped at the signal when the car behind me failed to brake in time. It was a low-speed impact, but it was enough to cause a dent on my rear bumper. The other driver was apologetic and we exchanged insurance details immediately after the incident.

It was raining quite heavily this morning near the airport roundabout. I was in the outer lane of the roundabout trying to take the exit towards the highway. I suppose I misjudged the distance of the vehicle in the inner lane, and as I turned, the side of my car grazed their side panel. It was just a minor scratch on the passenger side door. I feel terrible about it because I was rushing to get to an important meeting at the office and was clearly distracted.

I was attempting to parallel park in a very tight spot near the university. I thought I had enough clearance, but I underestimated the angle of my rear wheel as I reversed. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had hit the car parked behind me. There is a small dent and a scratch on my rear quarter panel. I immediately left a note with my contact information on the other driver's windshield because I know how frustrating it is to return to a damaged car.

I was sitting at a nearby cafe terrace and watched the whole thing. The driver was trying to park, they clearly miscalculated the space and ended up backing into the parked vehicle. The impact was slow and caused a minor dent and scratch on the car's body.

I was driving down the Avenida Luísa Todi and intended to change to the left lane to make a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I must have had a blind spot because I didn't see the motorcycle passing. As I steered into the lane, I clipped the handlebar. The impact caused my side turn signal lamp to be broken. I am just so shaken up by the whole experience. I truly hope the motorcyclist is alright; that is my main concern right now.

I was driving slowly along the Avenida dos Aliados. A heavy delivery truck was pulling out from a side street and its rear tail gate swung out wider than I anticipated. The metal corner of the truck struck my driver-side mirror, causing the glass to shatter completely. It was quite loud and really startled me. I wasn't going fast, maybe 20 km/h, but the proximity to the truck made it impossible for me to avoid the collision once I saw it moving.

I was performing a delivery and pulling out of the side street. I didn't realize how much the back of the truck would swing out in this narrow space. I heard the glass shatter and stopped immediately. I take full responsibility for the accident.

I was navigating through the narrow cobblestone streets near Praca do Comercio. There was a delivery van parked partially in the road, forcing me to maneuver around it. In my attempt to clear the van, I miscalculated the distance to the adjacent stone wall, and my rear passenger door scraped against a sharp masonry corner. There is a deep scratch along the panel. I am quite embarrassed because I have lived in this city for years and I should have known the street was that tight.

I was pulling away from the curb on a busy shopping street when a cyclist suddenly appeared from behind a parked delivery vehicle. I swerved slightly to avoid them and hit a concrete bollard on the sidewalk. This caused a crack in my front bumper fascia. It all happened in a split second, and I am honestly just relieved that I didn't hit the cyclist. The car damage is a nuisance, but the safety of the person on the bike is definitely the most important thing today.

I saw the driver trying to leave the parking space. A cyclist darted out from between parked vans, causing the driver to panic and swerve into the bollard. The car's front bumper has a visible crack from the impact with the concrete.

The traffic light turned red at the intersection, and I had to stop abruptly. The driver behind me didn't notice the change in time and struck my rear end. The impact caused a significant dent to my trunk and unfortunately, my right tail lamp is broken. I am stressed because I rely on this car to pick up my grandchildren from school every day. The other driver was very cooperative and we were able to clear the lane quickly so we didn't block the tram lines.

I looked down at my GPS for a split second to check the route. By the time I looked back up, the traffic had stopped. I tried to brake, but I couldn't avoid hitting the car in front. I damaged their tail lamp and rear bumper.

I was circling the roundabout and intending to take the third exit. Another vehicle, which was in the outer lane, tried to exit simultaneously without looking. Our cars made contact as we both navigated the curve. It resulted in a long scratch along my front fender and a crack in the corner of the bumper. Man, this is such a bummer because I just had the car detailed last week. I really don't have the time to deal with all this paperwork, you know?

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was trailing a small hatchback when the driver suddenly slammed on the brakes because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried my best to stop in time, but the roads were a bit damp from the earlier rain, and I ended up bumping into the rear of his car. I have a dent on my front bumper and a noticeable scratch near the grille. I feel terrible about the whole situation, honestly.

Traffic stopped abruptly near the intersection. I managed to brake safely, but the gentleman behind me clearly didn't have enough distance. He collided with my rear bumper. I inspected the damage and found a dent and some scratches on the plastic trim. We were both going quite slowly, probably under 15 km/h, but the impact was definitely felt.

I was attempting to parallel park in a very tight spot near Rua Augusta. There was a lot of noise and pedestrians walking around, which made it hard to concentrate. I thought I had enough clearance from the car behind me, but as I turned the wheel to pull in, I misjudged the distance and grazed my rear side panel against their front bumper. There is a visible scratch on the paintwork now. I am so embarrassed; I should have just asked someone to help me guide the car into the space.

I was sitting at a cafe table on the sidewalk nearby. I watched the driver of the white Fiat trying to park. It was a very tight squeeze and they were moving very slowly, but they eventually miscalculated the angle and hit the car parked behind them. I saw a scratch appear on the side of the Fiat. It was clearly an honest mistake during a parking maneuver.

I was traveling eastbound on Avenida 24 de Julho at about 40 km/h. I indicated to move into the right lane to prepare for a turn, but as I began the maneuver, a delivery van sped up in my blind spot. I didn't see him, and he didn't slow down, so our doors made contact. It caused a significant dent in my passenger door. I've been driving for years and this has never happened to me before, I am feeling really anxious about the insurance claim process and the repair costs.

My wife and I were driving down to the coast for lunch on a lovely sunny day. As we reached a junction on Estrada Monumental, the traffic lights were changing quite rapidly. I thought I had enough time to clear the intersection, but a small truck coming from the side street misjudged the timing and hit the side of my car. It shattered my passenger side window and broke the front headlight lamp. It was quite a shock, we had our groceries in the back and everything went flying. Very distressing for my wife.

I was coming from the side road and saw the light turning yellow. I thought the Renault driver would stop, but they accelerated. We ended up colliding at the intersection corner. I regret the incident deeply. I caused damage to their window glass and their lamp. My speed was approximately 25 km/h at the time of the impact.

It was a busy afternoon near the city hall. I was waiting in a line of cars when the vehicle in front decided to reverse suddenly to take a parking spot that opened up behind them. I honked, but they didn't stop in time and backed directly into my front end. It caused a dent in my hood and smashed one of my headlight lamps. I'm really worried about my insurance premium increasing after this, even though it wasn't my fault at all, you know?

Crossing the bridge toward Almada, the wind was quite strong, and the traffic was moving at a steady 60 km/h. A heavy truck in the left lane seemed to drift slightly into my lane while trying to compensate for a gust. I tried to pull over to the shoulder, but there wasn't enough space. The side of the trailer grazed my vehicle, leaving a very long, deep scratch along my entire passenger side. I am just glad it wasn't worse, but the paint damage is quite extensive.

The wind on the bridge was exceptionally strong today. I felt my trailer sway, and I believe I might have crossed the lane marking for a split second. I heard a scraping sound and pulled over immediately to check. I noticed a scratch on the Seat next to me. I apologize for the incident, the weather conditions were very difficult to manage at that moment.

I was pulling out of a side street onto Rua da Prata. The visibility was blocked by a large delivery truck parked illegally on the corner. I inched forward slowly, but I still didn't see a cyclist and a moped coming around. The moped rider had to brake suddenly and tipped over, hitting my front bumper. It left a dent in the metal and broke my indicator lamp. I am really anxious about the rider, but he seems okay. It was a very narrow street and I just couldn't see around the van.

I was driving down Avenida da Liberdade when a taxi in front of me made a sudden U-turn without signaling early enough. I slammed on my brakes, but the car behind me, a large SUV, couldn't stop and hit me from behind. The impact pushed me into the back of the taxi. My trunk has a huge dent, and the rear window glass shattered from the force. It's a real mess, and I am quite shaken up by the whole experience. I was only doing about 30 km/h.

I was following the Audi closely. When the taxi ahead initiated an illegal U-turn, the Audi driver reacted quickly, but I simply lacked the reaction time to halt my heavy vehicle completely. I impacted their rear end. I saw the trunk sustain a dent and the rear glass shatter upon impact. It was a very unfortunate chain reaction caused by the taxi.

I was at the beach in Costa da Caparica and found a spot in the sand-covered parking lot. While trying to back out, I didn't notice a concrete bollard hidden behind some tall weeds. I reversed slowly, but the bumper hit it directly. There is a deep crack in the plastic bumper and a long scratch where it rubbed against the concrete. I feel like such a fool for not checking the area behind me more carefully. It's really frustrating because I just had the car cleaned yesterday, man.

I was driving slowly along Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, just heading home after a long shift. Traffic was quite heavy, stop-and-go. Suddenly, the car in front of me braked hard because a pedestrian started crossing. I hit my brakes, but I didn't stop in time and tapped their bumper. It was just a small bump, honestly, but I feel terrible about it. I have a dent on my front hood now. I’m just really stressed because I’ve never had an accident before and I don't know how the insurance process works here.

I had to stop abruptly because of someone crossing the road unexpectedly. The driver behind me didn't react quickly enough and hit my car. It was a low-speed impact, but clearly, I have a dent on my rear bumper now. I am glad no one was hurt.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: It was raining, and the roundabout was quite chaotic as always. I was trying to exit toward the city center when the other car, which was in the outer lane, just drifted into my lane without checking. I tried to steer away but felt the side of my car scrape against their fender. There is a visible scratch along my passenger side door. I’m really worried about the repair costs, man. It all happened so fast, like, I didn't even have time to honk properly.

I parked my car on the side of the street near the university earlier this morning. When I returned around 2:00 PM, I noticed someone had clearly hit the side of my car while trying to reverse park. There is a deep scratch and a noticeable dent on my rear driver-side panel. It’s frustrating because I take good care of my vehicle, and now I have to deal with the paperwork and repair scheduling.

I was sitting at the nearby cafe and saw a delivery van trying to park in the space behind this Nissan. The driver miscalculated the distance and scraped the side of the parked car. He got out, looked at the damage, then just left without leaving a note. I saw the whole thing.

I was crossing the intersection on a green light when another driver failed to stop at their red light. They hit my front corner. My headlamp is broken, and there is a significant dent on the wheel arch. I am quite shaken up by the whole experience. The other driver apologized immediately, but the damage to my car is quite extensive. I’m just trying to make sure I fill out these forms correctly so I don't lose any coverage due to an error.

I am so terribly sorry, I was distracted by my GPS and didn't see the light turn red. I hit the side of the Toyota as I entered the junction. I accept full responsibility for the accident and the broken lamp and dent I caused.

Well, you see, I was just coming back from the market with my groceries, moving quite slowly as the street was packed with tourists. My foot must have slipped a bit, or perhaps I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar in the parking garage. I made a slight turn and heard a horrible scraping noise. When I got out, I saw a long, ugly scratch along the rear bumper. My granddaughter told me I should report it, even if it looks minor to some people.

I was heading home from work on the Eixo Norte-Sul, and traffic was moving at about 40 km/h. Suddenly, the car ahead of me swerved to avoid a piece of debris on the road and stopped dead. I slammed on my brakes, but the road was a bit slick, and I slid right into their bumper. My headlight is broken, and there is a bad dent in my grille. I am extremely worried about the cost of these repairs, as it’s a modern car with many sensors.

I had to brake hard to avoid an object on the road. The driver behind me followed at a safe distance but simply couldn't stop in time due to the rain. They hit my rear, which caused damage to their front headlight and bumper. It was an unfortunate accident.

It was very tight on this street with all the construction vehicles parked on the side. I was trying to pass a delivery truck when a taxi tried to overtake me at the same time. He didn't see me and swiped my side mirror and door. It’s just a nasty scratch, thankfully nothing worse, but it’s still annoying. I’m quite anxious about whether the insurance will cover this fully because the road was so narrow, and I’m afraid they might blame me for not stopping sooner.

I was pulling out of a parking spot in the square. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the cyclist or the other driver behind me. It was a very low-speed maneuver, but I ended up clipping the corner of a parked car. My own tail lamp is broken and there is a scratch on the bumper. It’s embarrassing, honestly, I’ve been driving for years and never made such a silly mistake. I’m just notifying you so we can handle the repair for both vehicles.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, traffic was quite heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front suddenly hit their brakes at the pedestrian crossing. I tried to stop in time, but the road surface was a bit damp and my car skidded forward a few meters, resulting in a low-speed impact. I hit the rear of the car in front, which left a noticeable dent on their bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just a lapse in concentration during the evening commute, but I am fully taking responsibility.

I was stopped at the red light near the roundabout when suddenly I felt a significant jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror just before the impact and saw the Golf approaching too fast. My rear bumper definitely has a new dent now. The driver was very cooperative and apologized immediately.

I am so worried about this, I was trying to park my Fiat in a very tight spot near the plaza this morning. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was turning the wheel to tuck the back in, I misjudged the distance to the adjacent parked car. I heard a slight scraping noise and immediately pulled back. I got out to check and saw a long scratch along the side panel of the other vehicle. I feel like such an idiot, I have been stressed all day about how to report this properly.

It was just a normal Tuesday morning, I was navigating the large roundabout near the hotel. The traffic was merging into the center lane, and as I moved to follow the flow, a van in my blind spot moved over at the same time. We both tried to brake, but there was a metallic contact. It caused a deep scratch and a small dent on my passenger door. I am really shaken up, you know, it just happened so fast and I am really not sure how I didn't see the van coming.

I was changing lanes to take the exit, checking my mirrors as required. Suddenly I felt the side of my van scrape against the car beside me. It was a genuine accident, neither of us saw the other. There is a visible scratch and a small dent on the side of their Peugeot as well.

I was looking for a parking spot near the town hall. I started reversing slowly, thinking the way was clear behind me. I didn't see the post or the sign, and I backed into a concrete pillar on the sidewalk. It wasn't very fast, maybe 5 km/h, but it was enough to smash my rear lamp. I feel so bad because it's a rental car and I didn't want to cause any damage. I am just really stressed about the repair costs and the insurance paperwork process now.

My wife and I were driving towards Estoril to enjoy the nice weather by the sea. I was following a car at a safe distance, but the sun was quite low in the sky, which blinded me for a second when they slowed down abruptly. I slammed on the brakes, but I still made contact with their rear end. It was quite a shock, hearing the glass shatter from their rear light and seeing the dent on their trunk. We are both very upset that this happened during our weekend outing.

I was just cruising along the Marginal at normal speed when I had to brake for a cyclist crossing the road. I felt the impact from behind immediately. The gentleman was very polite and admitted he didn't see me braking because of the sun. My rear light glass shattered and the bumper has a dent.

I was driving down this busy avenue, checking the traffic flow. I intended to change lanes to turn right at the next intersection. I signaled and began to move, but I miscalculated the speed of the car in the lane I was joining. I heard a scrape as our mirrors brushed against each other. It caused a light scratch on the paintwork. I stopped immediately to ensure everything was handled correctly. It was entirely my mistake as I failed to double-check the blind spot carefully before maneuvering.

I was waiting to cross the street at the pedestrian lights when I saw the Mercedes start to change lanes. The driver of the other car was already there, and they didn't have much room to react. There was a clear sound of contact, leaving a visible scratch on the side of the car.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was going through the roundabout, keeping to my lane. Suddenly, a car came from the outer lane trying to take the exit directly across from me. I couldn't move out of the way fast enough, and we sideswiped each other at the exit. The impact caused a scratch along my side and broke my front lamp. I am just so anxious right now because I use this car to get to university every day and I don't know how long it will take to fix this.

I was in the roundabout, intending to exit. I thought I had space to maneuver but evidently, I misjudged the trajectory of the Corsa. We scraped against each other. My car has a scratch, and theirs seems to have a broken lamp.

I was driving through the narrow streets of the city center. A delivery truck was parked with its tail sticking out, and as I tried to pass carefully, a cyclist swerved into the middle of the road. I had to pull away to the left to avoid him and I ended up scraping the side of a parked vehicle. It left a bad scratch and a dent on the passenger side door of the other car. I am really shaken, it was a very sudden situation involving the cyclist and the parked truck.

The traffic was moving at a moderate speed of around 30 km/h. Everyone suddenly braked because a motorbike fell over ahead. I pressed my brakes hard, but the road was quite slippery from the earlier rain. I couldn't stop in time and hit the back of the car in front. It caused a dent in their bumper and broke one of my lamps. It all happened within seconds and I feel quite overwhelmed by the whole experience. I have exchanged all the details with the other driver as required.

I stopped normally when the traffic ahead stalled. A moment later, I felt a heavy impact from the Qashqai. My bumper has a new dent, and I saw their front lamp was broken from the collision. We both stayed calm and filled out the accident report correctly.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, and the traffic was quite heavy as usual. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to react quickly, but I couldn't stop in time and ended up bumping into the back of his vehicle. I am really sorry about this, it was just a lapse in concentration, and now I see there is a noticeable dent on my front bumper. I have already exchanged details with the other driver to sort out the repairs through the insurance.

I had to stop abruptly because someone stepped into the road unexpectedly. The driver behind me didn't have enough distance and hit my rear bumper. There is a clear dent on my car now. We were both going quite slow, maybe 20 km/h, but the contact was enough to cause this damage.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, trying to exit towards Avenida da Liberdade. I was in the middle lane, and I think I misjudged the position of the van next to me. As I turned, I heard a scraping sound. I immediately pulled over to check. It turns out there is a long scratch along my passenger side door. I feel so stressed about this, I've never been in an accident before, and I'm really worried about how much this is going to cost to get painted and fixed up.

I was trying to park in a tight spot near the university. I was moving very slowly, maybe at 5 km/h, but I underestimated the distance to the concrete pillar in the garage. I scraped against the side, and then my bumper hit the base of the pillar. There is a visible scratch and a small dent now. I am so embarrassed; I was just trying to get to my appointment on time and I wasn't paying enough attention to my surroundings. It was completely my fault and I just want to handle the repairs properly.

I was driving along the avenue when the car to my left suddenly decided to change lanes without checking if the lane was clear. They clipped my side, and the impact shattered my side indicator lamp. I tried to steer away, but there was nowhere to go due to the traffic. I am quite shaken up by the whole experience. The other driver stopped immediately, and we are both just trying to get the documentation sorted for the claim. The damage is strictly limited to the broken lamp unit on my passenger side.

I was in the middle lane and thought I had enough space to merge right. I didn't see the Nissan in my blind spot. I hit their side and broke their indicator light. I feel terrible about it, it was a genuine mistake on my part due to the sun glare.

I was driving along the Marginal road heading towards Cascais. A large truck in front of me drove over a loose stone on the asphalt, which was then flung directly into my windshield. It happened so fast that I barely had time to react before the glass shattered into a spiderweb pattern. It was a terrifying moment, but I managed to pull over safely to the side of the road. I am not hurt, but the windshield definitely needs to be replaced as it is now completely compromised.

Oh dear, I had such a terrible afternoon. I was parking my car in the narrow street near the Cathedral. I am 72 years old and my depth perception isn't what it used to be. I miscalculated the turn and scraped the rear fender against a stone wall. It makes me feel quite sad, as I have kept this car in pristine condition for years. I have a long, visible scratch now. I have already contacted my insurer to see how we can proceed with the repairs as soon as possible.

I was sitting at a nearby cafe terrace and saw the whole thing. The driver was trying to maneuver into a parking space and just misjudged the distance to the wall. It was a slow impact, resulting in a noticeable scratch along the side of the car.

location: Almada, near the 25 de Abril Bridge

statements.text: I was driving towards the bridge when the traffic suddenly came to a complete halt. I applied my brakes firmly, but the road was a bit damp and I slid a few meters before hitting the vehicle in front of me. The impact caused a dent in my bumper and broke the right-side tail lamp. I am very worried about the repair costs, dude. It was just one of those unlucky days where the road conditions and my timing didn't align. I have already exchanged insurance information with the driver I hit.

I was stopped completely because of the bridge traffic. The driver behind me came in too fast and couldn't stop. They hit my car from behind, causing damage to my bumper and breaking one of their lights. It was an honest mistake given the wet road surface.

I was traveling at about 40 km/h in the lane closest to the center line. Another vehicle was in the adjacent lane and began merging into my lane without noticing that I was still partially alongside them. I swerved to the right, but the side of their car still scraped against my left door panel. There is a clear, long scratch on the paintwork. I am frustrated, but the other driver was very apologetic and admitted they simply didn't check their side mirror before changing lanes.

I was exiting the roundabout when a motorcycle came up quickly on my left side, attempting to overtake while I was already committed to the exit. I turned the wheel to avoid him, but the side of my car grazed his footrest and the frame. This resulted in a dent and a scratch on my rear door. I am so worried because the motorcyclist fell over, though he is okay. I have called the police to make a formal report and have my insurance details ready for the claim process.

I was riding my motorcycle and thought I had space to pass on the inside of the roundabout. The car driver didn't see me and pulled into my path. We collided, causing some cosmetic damage to their car. I was moving at about 15 km/h.

I was pulling into a parking space near the canal. I didn't see that there was a decorative stone planter placed right on the edge of the curb. I moved forward just a bit too much and my front bumper made contact with the stone edge. It caused a significant crack in the plastic bumper fascia. I feel absolutely terrible about it, honestly. I've only had this car for six months and I'm quite attached to it. I have already contacted the workshop to see if it can be repaired.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy, and the vehicle in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to press my brake pedal, but I was just too close and ended up bumping into his rear bumper at a very low speed. I feel terrible about it, honestly. My front bumper has a noticeable dent and some deep scratches from the impact. I am so worried about the repair costs, you know, it has just been such a stressful morning.

I was moving slowly in the middle lane when I had to stop abruptly for a person crossing the street. I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The other driver apologized immediately and was very cooperative. We pulled over to the side to exchange information. My rear bumper clearly shows a dent and some paint scratches where his car hit me.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, which is always chaotic. I was in the outer lane, trying to exit towards the A1, when a van to my left suddenly merged into my lane without checking. I tried to steer away but we made contact along the side of my car. I was honestly so shaken up by the maneuver. The passenger side door has a long, visible scratch now. I really hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, man, I've never dealt with this before.

I was trying to park my car in a narrow space near the university. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar in the garage. As I was turning the wheel, I heard a terrible scraping sound. It was my fault for not checking the sensors carefully enough. Now there is a bad dent and a scratch on my rear quarter panel. I am just so embarrassed to be calling this in, but I need to get it fixed as soon as possible because it looks really awful.

It was raining quite heavily while I was driving towards Cais do Sodré. The roads were slick and visibility was limited. I was attempting to change lanes when the car in the blind spot sped up unexpectedly. We sideswiped each other at about 30 km/h. It was a jarring experience and I am still feeling a bit anxious about the whole event. My front right side now has a dent and the headlight lamp is broken. I hope the other driver is alright, it was such a wet and dark afternoon.

I was traveling straight in the right lane when I suddenly felt a hit on my driver-side door. The insured driver was moving into my lane and didn't see me. The impact was strong enough to shatter my indicator lamp and dent the door panel. We both pulled over safely to assess the damage.

I was backing out of a parking spot near the hotel. I was going very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but I didn't notice the low bollard behind me. I heard a loud crack and the rear tail light glass shattered completely. I've lived here for forty years and I usually know these streets like the back of my hand, but I was distracted by the heavy tourist traffic today. It’s a real shame about the light, as I pride myself on keeping my car in perfect condition for my weekly trips.

I was heading through the green light at the intersection. Another driver came from the side street, seemingly failing to notice the red light. I hit the brakes, but I still clipped their rear bumper. It was quite a shock, man, really unexpected. My front bumper took most of the force, leaving a large dent and a long, jagged scratch across the paint. I am just really glad that nobody was hurt, but I am super stressed about how long the car will be in the repair shop.

I was waiting to cross the street when I saw the silver Ford enter the intersection correctly. The other car definitely ran the red light and clipped the Ford. It happened in seconds. The Ford had a dent and scratches on the front bumper. I am happy to provide my contact details as a witness.

I was stopped at a red light on a very steep street in downtown Lisbon. When the light changed, my car slipped back slightly while I was releasing the clutch, and I tapped the car behind me. It was a mistake on my part, I suppose I wasn't used to the manual gearbox on such a slope. I felt terrible. My rear bumper has a dent and the brake lamp is broken. I'm just hoping the other driver isn't too upset about this minor accident.

I was parked behind the Audi at the red light. When the light turned green, the Audi started to roll back. I honked, but it wasn't enough to prevent the contact. The impact broke my lamp and caused a dent on my front bumper. It was an honest mistake by the other driver, and we have agreed on the details.

Driving along the coast road, the wind was quite strong. A truck in the opposite lane passed by very closely, and the air displacement caused my car to sway slightly. I brushed against the side barrier on the road. It caused a long, deep scratch along my driver-side doors. It's a real shame because I keep the car immaculate for my weekend trips with the grandkids. I'm quite concerned about the paint matching, given the color of the vehicle, so I hope the body shop is high quality.

I was entering the roundabout and was hit by someone failing to yield. It all happened so fast, like, I didn't even have time to react, you know? It was just a thud and then my car was dented on the side. The impact also caused a crack on my plastic side trim. I'm really worried about the repair costs, dude. This is like, the first time I've been in an accident, and I'm just super nervous about dealing with all the paperwork.

I entered the roundabout without noticing the vehicle already in the lane. It was a lapse in concentration on my part. I hit the Skoda on its side. There is a dent and a crack on the trim of the other car. I take full responsibility for the collision.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Boavista junction around 8:30 AM when traffic suddenly slowed down. I pressed the brakes, but the car behind me didn't stop in time. He nudged my rear bumper quite hard. I am really worried about the repair costs, man, it is my first accident and I am stressed out. When I checked, there is a clear dent on the trunk lid and a long scratch along the plastic trim. It feels like such a nightmare to deal with all this paperwork this early in the morning.

I was following the Volkswagen through the roundabout. When he braked, I reacted, but the road was a bit damp and I slid forward, causing a minor collision. I am sorry for the trouble. I can confirm the impact caused a dent and a scratch on his vehicle, and I accept full responsibility for the accident.

I was parking my car near the Avenida dos Aliados late yesterday evening. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar in the parking garage. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed the side of the car against the wall. It is just a surface scratch, honestly, but I want to get it fixed properly. I have been driving for over forty years, and you know, sometimes even at my age, you just have a momentary lapse in spatial awareness. It is really frustrating.

I was driving along the Marginal towards Cascais in the right lane. A van tried to merge into my lane without checking his blind spot properly. I tried to swerve, but we still made contact near the headlight area. It was very sudden and quite loud. The impact resulted in a dent on my front fender and my left lamp is broken. I am so upset because this is my only car for work, and now it looks like I have to go through the whole repair process, which is just exhausting.

I admit I was looking at my GPS and moved into the lane prematurely. I did not see the Peugeot until it was too late. I heard the impact immediately. My van only has a minor scuff, but I saw that the Peugeot sustained a dent and had a broken lamp. I am ready to file the claim.

I was stopped at a pedestrian crossing on Rua Augusta. A delivery driver behind me was distracted and rolled forward into my bumper. It wasn't a high-speed collision, but it was enough to cause a crack in my rear bumper panel. I am quite worried about the insurance premiums going up, you know? It is like, I was just waiting for the people to cross, and suddenly, bam. The guy was nice about it, but it's still such a headache to get these things sorted out with the company.

Traffic on the bridge was crawling at about 20 km/h due to the typical afternoon congestion. I was focused on the brake lights ahead of me when the driver behind me failed to stop. The impact was significant. My trunk has a large dent now, and the glass shatter on the rear windshield is quite extensive. My back hurts a little, but I am more concerned about the car. It is a reliable vehicle and I really need it for my daily commute to the office. I am just hoping the repairs are fast.

I was in the car behind the two involved in the accident. The Toyota stopped normally for traffic, but the car behind it did not brake until the last second. It was definitely a rear-end collision. I saw the Toyota sustain a dent on the rear and the rear window had glass shatter everywhere. I stopped to ensure everyone was okay before continuing.

I was driving straight on Avenida da Boavista, sticking to my lane. Suddenly, a car from the adjacent lane veered too far to the left while turning. They ended up side-swiping my passenger door. It was honestly a very quick movement, and I couldn't avoid it entirely. There is a very long, deep scratch running along the side of my car. I’ve been maintaining this car perfectly for years, so seeing this damage is truly disheartening. I hope the insurance covers the paint job properly without too much back and forth.

While I was maneuvering to turn onto the main square area, the lighting conditions were a bit difficult with the sun reflection. I underestimated how close the bollard was and turned slightly too wide. I ended up hitting the corner of my vehicle against the stationary stone fixture. The impact caused a dent in the bumper and my right turn signal lamp is broken. I feel quite foolish about it, honestly, as I have driven this route many times. My main concern now is the cost of the lamp replacement and body shop work.

I parked my car on the side of the road to go visit a friend at the university. When I returned about two hours later, I noticed a fresh, long scratch on my rear bumper. There was no note left by the other driver, but looking at the paint transfer, it seems like a metallic blue car grazed me while trying to squeeze into the spot behind me. It is incredibly frustrating to find this when you come back. I just want to get it fixed so the car stays in good condition.

I was sitting at the cafe across the street and saw a blue car try to park behind the Golf. The driver misjudged the space and scraped the bumper of the Golf. They got out, looked at the damage, then just got back in and drove away quickly. I didn't get their license plate, but I clearly saw the scratch being made.

I was heading down the avenue when the light turned yellow. I decided to brake gently, but the driver behind me didn't anticipate the stop. My car was pushed forward, and the rear sustained a significant dent. Unfortunately, the force also caused some glass shatter in the trunk area from some items I had stored there. It was quite a shock, dude. My neck is fine, but I'm just worried about the resale value of the car now that it's been in an accident. I need to get this estimated as soon as possible.

I admit I was following a bit too closely. When the driver in front hit the brakes, I couldn't stop in time on the wet asphalt. I hit the back of his car. I am very sorry for the trouble. I saw the dent and the glass shatter on his vehicle. I have provided my insurance details for the claim.

I was driving around the roundabout, and as I was exiting, another vehicle tried to push through from the inside lane. It was a very clumsy maneuver on their part. The side of their car caught my bumper, causing a long scratch and a broken lamp on the side. I am feeling quite anxious about the whole process, you know? It is my daily driver for the kids, and having it broken makes life difficult. I really hope the insurance company handles this efficiently so I can get back on the road.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic was really backed up near the roundabout. I came to a complete stop because the car in front of me halted suddenly, but the gentleman behind me didn't react quickly enough. He ended up bumping into my rear bumper at a very low speed. It was a really stressful moment for me, you know, being in such heavy traffic and dealing with this, but luckily the damage is just a noticeable dent on the bumper. I'm honestly just glad no one was hurt during the impact.

I admit I was distracted for a split second by my GPS. When I looked back up at the road, the traffic had stopped and I couldn't brake in time. I hit the back of the Volkswagen gently. I feel terrible about the dent I caused on his vehicle; I am happy to cooperate with the insurance details.

I was trying to park my car in a very narrow spot in downtown Lisbon. I misjudged the distance between my car and the parked van next to me while backing up. It was so tight, and I think I panicked a bit when I heard a faint scraping sound. I got out immediately to check and realized there is a long scratch along the rear passenger door. It was purely an honest mistake on my part because I didn't see how close the van really was. I am just so frustrated with myself.

I was navigating the roundabout near the riverfront when another driver attempted to merge into my lane without checking their blind spot properly. I tried to swerve to avoid them, but we ended up making contact with our side panels. My front lamp is broken, and there is a significant dent where we collided. I've been driving for years and this is honestly the first time anything like this has happened to me, it's quite upsetting especially on such a sunny afternoon.

I was definitely in the wrong lane and attempted to exit the roundabout too quickly. I didn't see the Peugeot coming up beside me until it was too late. I clipped their side and unfortunately broke their lamp and caused a dent. I accept full responsibility for the error.

I was driving along the coast road, maintaining a steady speed of about 40 km/h. Suddenly, a vehicle in the lane to my left veered sharply into my path, perhaps trying to avoid a pedestrian. There wasn't enough room to react and we side-swiped each other. The impact resulted in a nasty scratch and a dent on my front fender. It was all so sudden, I didn't even have time to blink, but thank goodness it wasn't a head-on collision or anything more serious.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when I saw the two cars collide. The driver in the left lane clearly drifted into the right lane without looking. It resulted in a clear scratch and dent on the Toyota's side. It happened quite fast.

It was raining quite heavily this morning in Coimbra, and the roads were very slick. I was stopped at a red light on Avenida da República when the car behind me failed to stop in time due to the wet conditions. They hit my rear bumper quite hard, and the force caused a major crack in my rear light assembly. I am extremely worried about the repair costs because I'm a student and money is really tight right now, but at least the other driver stopped to help.

I was maneuvering slowly out of a parking garage near the docks. There was a delivery truck backing up at the same time, and our blind spots must have aligned perfectly. He didn't see me and his rear corner made contact with my side window, causing the glass to shatter immediately. It was quite loud and really shocking. I am still shaking a bit from the surprise of the noise. I hope the insurance can cover this quickly so I can get back to my work.

I am terribly sorry about this. I was checking my mirrors but didn't see the car exiting the garage until I heard the glass shatter. It was a low-speed maneuver but clearly my visibility was compromised. I am ready to file the paperwork immediately.

I was visiting my niece for the weekend and needed to park on this very narrow street. I thought I had left enough clearance from the bollard, but as I turned the wheel to straighten the car, the rear bumper grazed against the metal post. It left a rather deep scratch along the paintwork. I feel so embarrassed because it was completely my fault for miscalculating the turn in such a tight space. I just want to get it fixed before I drive back home.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: The traffic was moving at about 30 km/h during rush hour. I put on my turn signal to move into the left lane. I checked my mirrors, but there was a motorcycle approaching quickly, and I suppose I misjudged his speed. We made contact, causing a minor dent and a scratch on the side door. I feel terrible about it because I'm usually a very careful driver. I've been driving in Lisbon for over 40 years, and one just never gets used to these stressful situations.

I was moving through the traffic and the car in the right lane signaled and pulled over quite quickly. I didn't have enough room to pass safely. The contact caused a dent and scratch on their door. I am just relieved I didn't fall off my bike.

It was getting dark, and the traffic on the bridge was quite heavy. The vehicle in front of me slowed down suddenly for a patch of debris, and although I slammed on my brakes, I just couldn't stop in time. My front lamp collided with their rear bumper and is now broken. It was a very jarring experience, especially on the bridge where there's nowhere to pull over easily. I am just so glad that no one was seriously injured in the crash today.

I was driving around the roundabout near the city center when another driver tried to exit from the inner lane, cutting right across my path. There was no way I could avoid them. They hit the front of my car, which resulted in a broken lamp, a significant dent, and multiple scratches. Like, I was literally just driving to the store and now this happens. It's super frustrating and I am really worried about how much these repairs are going to cost me, man. It's just a bad day.

I made a bad call trying to exit from the inner lane. I was in a hurry and didn't see the Audi coming. I hit their front end, causing the broken lamp, dent, and scratches. I am fully responsible and will handle the insurance claim with them.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio around 2 PM. I was in the outer lane, planning to exit toward the airport. A delivery van suddenly swerved from the inner lane to exit, and I had to steer sharply to the right. We made contact while moving at about 20 km/h. There is a long, clear scratch on my passenger side door panel. I am quite shaken by the incident, but I am glad no one was hurt in the process.

I was inside the roundabout and misjudged the exit sequence. I didn't see the Seat Ibiza in my blind spot as I moved to the outer lane. We touched sides. My van is fine, but the other driver's car clearly has a long scratch along the side panel. I admit I was at fault for the lane change maneuver.

I was trying to park my car near the university in Coimbra. It was raining quite heavily and the street was narrow, so I was trying to be extra careful. Unfortunately, I miscalculated the distance to the bollard while reversing. I hit it at a very low speed. There is a noticeable dent and a deep scratch on the rear quarter panel. I feel terrible about being so clumsy, and I am quite worried about how much these bodywork repairs are going to cost me.

I was driving down Avenida Luísa Todi when a car next to me signaled to change lanes. I thought there was enough space, but as they moved over, our bumpers clipped. It was such a surprise, like, one second everything was fine and the next we were scraping. My rear lamp is broken after the contact. I've only had this car for a few months, so I'm honestly really upset about the damage to the light assembly.

I signaled to change lanes because I needed to reach the turn-off ahead. I looked in my mirrors but somehow missed the Peugeot. When I moved over, we made contact. It was a low-speed incident, but it was enough to break the other driver's rear lamp. I take full responsibility for the miscalculation.

It was a sunny afternoon, and I was crossing the intersection on Estrada Monumental. Another vehicle came out from a side street and failed to stop at the yield sign. They hit the side of my car. My side window glass shattered immediately from the impact. I am still shaking from the shock of the collision, and I am just hoping the insurance process goes smoothly. The other driver was very apologetic and stayed on the scene until the authorities arrived to document everything.

I was walking my dog near the intersection. The Nissan was going through the green light, and the silver car just pulled out without stopping. It was a sharp collision. The window glass of the Nissan shattered into the road. It was clearly the fault of the silver car driver.

I parked my car on Rua de Santa Catarina to go pick up some pastries at the local bakery. When I returned, I noticed a long, fresh scratch along the passenger door. There was no note left, but a shop owner told me that a truck had grazed it while trying to turn into the narrow street. It's really frustrating to come back to this, you know? The car was pristine before this happened. I just want to get it fixed as soon as possible.

My goodness, I was just driving along the Avenida on my way to visit my granddaughter, and the traffic light turned yellow. I slowed down quite gradually, as one should, but the gentleman behind me clearly didn't anticipate it. He ran right into my rear bumper. It caused a significant dent and smashed my rear lamp. I am quite shaken by the whole ordeal, and my hip is a bit sore from the sudden movement, but I am more worried about my poor car.

I was behind the BMW and got distracted by my GPS for a split second. By the time I looked back at the road, the driver had stopped for the yellow light. I slammed on the brakes but still tapped the back of her car. I am very sorry for the damage to her bumper and the lamp. It was entirely my mistake.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating around the Praça, intending to take the third exit. A vehicle coming from the inside lane suddenly moved across to take the same exit. There was no time to react and we collided. The impact caused a large dent on my rear quarter panel and smashed the tail lamp on that side. I am very frustrated because I was following the lanes correctly. I have photographs of the positions of both cars after the impact for your records.

I am new to driving in central Lisbon and found the roundabout layout quite confusing. I thought I was in the correct lane to exit, but I realized too late that I was cutting off the Audi. We made contact. I hit the back corner of his car, causing a dent and breaking his tail lamp. I accept full responsibility for the accident.

I was picking up my dry cleaning on Rua das Flores. I parked my car, and when I came back out, a delivery van was pulling away from the curb next to me. I noticed a new dent on my front fender immediately. I managed to stop the driver, and he admitted he had misjudged the turn while leaving the space. It's a small dent, but it's very visible. I'm really worried about the repair costs, as the bodywork on these Minis can be quite expensive.

I was driving home after work along Avenida da Boavista when traffic suddenly stopped. It was raining quite hard, and the roads were slick. I pressed my brakes, but my car slid a bit and I ended up hitting the bumper of the car in front of me at very low speed. I feel terrible about this, but it was just an honest mistake because of the weather conditions. My front bumper has a visible dent now from the impact. I am just really worried about the repair costs, to be honest.

The traffic was heavy as usual near the roundabout. I was completely stopped for several seconds when I felt a significant jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the insured vehicle had touched my bumper. My car only sustained a small dent on the rear plastic trim. It was clearly an accident caused by the slippery road conditions.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was changing lanes to take the exit near Saldanha. I checked my mirrors, but I honestly misjudged the distance of the car in the adjacent lane. It was a stressful morning with lots of traffic, and I think I was just a bit distracted by my GPS. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had brushed against the side of a black sedan. There is a long, noticeable scratch on my passenger door now. I am truly sorry for my lack of attention.

I had gone into the city center to pick up some items for my sister's birthday, and I was trying to park in a very tight spot on Rua de Santa Catarina.
