I was going slow, maybe 5 km/h, but I turned the wheel too early and miscalculated the angle against the car parked next to me. It was such a silly mistake. Now my front corner has a scratch and a small dent. I feel really embarrassed about the whole situation because it was entirely my fault.

I was walking by the shop when I saw the Toyota attempting to parallel park. The driver seemed to be struggling with the space and unfortunately, they misjudged the turning radius. They lightly scraped the side of the parked vehicle. Both the Toyota and the other car ended up with some visible cosmetic damage, specifically a dent and a scratch.

I was driving around the roundabout near the port. It was early, the sun was quite low and reflecting off the windows of the nearby buildings, which made it hard to see clearly. As I was exiting the roundabout, another driver merged too quickly and we ended up hitting each other. It was so confusing! My front indicator lamp is broken now. I am very anxious about how the insurance process works and whether my premium will go up because of this unfortunate event.

I was entering the roundabout and thought I had enough space to merge. The other driver must have been blinded by the sun because they didn't see me until it was too late. We collided at the exit. My bumper is fine, but the other driver's front lamp is definitely broken from the impact.

I was driving along the beautiful road near the coast in Cascais. It was a lovely day, but the traffic was surprisingly dense for a Tuesday. I looked down at my phone for just a split second to check a message, and when I looked back, the car in front had stopped dead. I slammed on the brakes, but I hit them anyway. There is a noticeable dent on my hood. I am so worried because this car is my pride and joy, and I really hope it can be fixed easily.

We were moving quite slowly along the Marginal. Suddenly, I felt a heavy impact from behind. I checked my rear mirror and realized the BMW had hit me. We both pulled over to the side immediately. The driver of the BMW was very apologetic and admitted they were distracted. The hood of their car is visibly dented.

The streets in the city center are always so narrow, and today was particularly chaotic. I was trying to navigate around a delivery van, and I didn't see the post I was driving past. My side mirror brushed against it, which then caused the body of the car to scrape against the concrete bollard. It left a long, deep scratch along my rear quarter panel. I am just so frustrated with myself, and I honestly don't know how I didn't see that post while I was turning.

I was driving down 24 de Julho heading toward the bridge. I signaled to switch lanes because I needed to make a turn soon. I didn't see the motorbike in my blind spot, and as I started moving over, we collided. It was a very low-speed interaction, thankfully, but my front lamp is broken and there is a dent where the impact occurred. I'm just so thankful that the other driver is okay, as I was really worried about their safety during the whole thing.

I was riding in the lane next to the Mercedes. I think the driver didn't check their blind spot properly before changing lanes. I tried to swerve, but they hit my leg guard and the side of my bike before the car's front corner impacted mine. Their lamp is broken, and there's a dent on their panel.

My wife and I were out for a walk after having a coffee on Rua Augusta. When we came back to where I had parked my Mini, I saw that another car had clearly rubbed against my driver's side while trying to squeeze into the space in front of me. There is a nasty scratch along the side. It is really disappointing, especially since I try to be so careful about where I park the car. I have no idea who did it, as they didn't leave a note.

I was sitting at the café terrace and saw a large delivery truck trying to maneuver around the parked Mini. The driver clearly misjudged the gap and the side of the truck scraped the side of the car, creating a visible scratch. The truck driver just kept going, which was quite shocking to watch.

I was driving near the city hall and it was a bit confusing with the tram lines. A car pulled out from a side street without checking properly. I swerved to avoid a direct T-bone, but I still clipped them. My side window glass shattered from the impact and there is a significant dent on the passenger door. I am just exhausted by this whole incident and I hope the insurance company can handle the repairs quickly so I can get back to my normal routine.

I was driving around the Boavista roundabout in Porto during the morning rush hour. I was in the middle lane when the driver to my left suddenly attempted to exit without checking their blind spot. I tried to brake, but there was a significant impact on my passenger side door. I am honestly quite shaken up because I have never been in an accident before, and I am worried about the repair costs for the dent. I just hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, man, I really don't need this right now.

I was attempting to reverse park my Peugeot on Avenida dos Aliados yesterday afternoon. I was being careful, but I misjudged the distance to the vehicle behind me, which was a dark grey sedan. I felt a very slight contact, and when I stepped out, I noticed a visible scratch on my rear bumper. I feel terrible about the carelessness, as it was entirely my fault. I have contacted the other driver, and we exchanged our insurance details properly while we were waiting for the local authorities to finish their patrol.

It was raining, and the cobblestones were incredibly slippery near the city center. I was pulling away from the curb at a very low speed, perhaps 5 km/h, when my front light housing clipped a delivery van that had stopped illegally. I heard a crunch, and my lamp is broken now. I am so frustrated with myself, and I feel quite anxious about how this will affect my insurance premium. The delivery driver was quite patient, thank goodness, but I am still very upset about the damage to my car.

I was making a quick delivery and had parked for just a minute. I saw the Fiat driver trying to pull out in the rain, but they didn't account for the slick road conditions. Their front lamp hit my rear panel. It was clearly an accident caused by the weather, and there was no malice involved.

I was heading home along the coast road in Cascais. The traffic suddenly came to a complete halt because of some roadwork ahead. I managed to stop, but the driver behind me clearly didn't see the traffic stopped, as they slammed into the back of my car. My trunk has a large dent and a deep scratch from the impact. It was quite a shock, and I have been feeling a bit stressed ever since, wondering how long the car will be in the garage for repairs.

I was driving along the Marginal and I admit I was distracted for a split second by the ocean view. By the time I looked back at the road, the traffic had stopped. I tried to slam on the brakes, but I couldn't stop in time to avoid the rear-end collision.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the heavy traffic near Marquês de Pombal. I was in the right lane, and a bus was in the left. As the bus moved forward, it didn't leave enough space for my vehicle while trying to change lanes, resulting in a side-swipe along my passenger doors. There is a long scratch visible now. I am a bit worried about the insurance process, and the whole situation has me quite anxious. I hope the company can handle the repair quickly as I need my car for work next week.

I parked my car on this street to visit a bakery. When I returned, I noticed that another vehicle must have backed into my parked car. My front bumper has a significant dent, and the indicator lamp is broken. I am quite distressed, as I really cherish this vehicle and keep it in good condition. I have asked around the local shops to see if anyone saw the incident, but unfortunately, no one seems to have witnessed the collision occur. I am hoping CCTV might help identify the responsible party.

I was walking by when I heard a loud metallic sound. I saw a large white van reversing away from the Citroën quickly. It seemed like the driver didn't even stop to check for damage to the bumper or the lamp. I didn't get the license plate, sadly.

I was driving along Avenida da Boavista around 11:00 AM. I checked my mirror and signaled to change lanes to avoid a stopped taxi. Just as I started to merge, another car accelerated in the adjacent lane. We made contact, which resulted in a scratch on my rear quarter panel. It was a very confusing situation because both of us thought we had the right of way. I am just glad no one was hurt in the process, as the roads were quite busy and it could have been much worse.

I was driving towards Faro on the EN125. The sun was very bright, and when the car in front slowed down for a turning vehicle, I was momentarily blinded. I applied the brakes, but it was too late to come to a complete stop, and I tapped their rear bumper. The impact caused a large dent on my bonnet, and unfortunately, my windshield had some glass shatter from the force. It was a very foolish mistake on my part, and I am quite upset that I was not paying enough attention to the road conditions.

I was approaching the intersection near São Bento. The lights were changing, and I misjudged the timing while another driver was pulling out from the side street. We collided at low speed. My passenger side lamp is broken, and there is a visible dent on the wing. I am terribly worried about the repair costs, as I know parts for this model are not cheap. I feel so stressed about the whole ordeal, and I just want to make sure everything is settled through the proper insurance channels as soon as possible.

I was cautiously entering the intersection. The traffic was slow, and I thought I had a clear path, but the BMW appeared suddenly from the main road. We made contact, and it was a genuine misunderstanding of the signal timing. We are both cooperating fully with the insurance details.

Dear sir or madam, I am writing to formally report an accident that occurred this morning while I was traveling along the Avenida 24 de Julho. A large commercial vehicle in the lane next to mine veered slightly to avoid a cyclist and clipped my side mirror and door, causing a deep scratch and a noticeable crack on the plastic trim. I am quite concerned about the maintenance of my vehicle, as it is relatively new. I would appreciate it if you could advise me on the next steps for repairs as soon as you are able.

I was navigating the roundabout at a very low speed, maybe 15 km/h, when I misjudged the distance to the car entering the lane to my right. It was quite chaotic with the morning traffic and the rain starting to fall. I felt the impact on my rear passenger door. When I checked, there was a visible dent and some noticeable paint scratch marks on the panel. I feel terrible about this, as I have been driving for years without a single mishap, and the whole situation just feels like a clumsy error on my part.

The driver of the Golf cut into my lane quite suddenly while we were circling the rotunda. I didn't have enough room to brake completely. My front bumper made contact with their side door, which caused a dent and some scratches on their vehicle. It was a minor collision but enough to stop us both in the middle of the flow.

Honestly, I was trying to park in a tight spot near the town hall, and I was being super careful, or so I thought. I guess I turned the wheel just a bit too soon, you know? I heard a scraping sound against the concrete pillar of the underground garage. It left a long scratch on the rear wing. I am really stressed out because I just got this car painted last month. Do you think this is going to be covered? I am just a student and this is a total nightmare for my bank account.

I was slowly maneuvering through the narrow street when a delivery truck suddenly reversed without signaling. I tried to sound my horn, but it happened too quickly. They backed into the front corner of my Fiat. My left front lamp is broken, and there is a deep scratch running along the bumper area. It was very loud and startling. I was just trying to head home after shopping, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork which is really quite a nuisance for my afternoon.

I was reversing to reach a delivery point and did not see the small car behind me due to my blind spot. I hit their front bumper, which broke their lamp and caused some surface scratches. I accept full responsibility for the accident as it was my error in judgment while navigating this narrow street.

The traffic was moving at around 30 km/h, and the driver in front of me suddenly hit their brakes because a pedestrian stepped out. I did my best to stop in time, but the distance was insufficient. My car made a solid impact with their rear bumper. It resulted in a visible dent right in the center of my hood near the grill. I have been very careful with this vehicle, and I am quite disappointed that I allowed myself to follow at an unsafe distance during this afternoon commute.

Back in my day, people checked their mirrors much more often, but nowadays it seems everyone is in a rush. I was driving along the side lane when this younger gentleman decided to switch lanes without looking. He clipped the side of my car. It caused a nasty dent and a long scratch along the passenger side doors. It was quite a shock, really. I was just heading out to see my grandkids, and this really ruined the whole afternoon. I suppose these things happen when people are in such a hurry all the time.

I was walking nearby on the sidewalk and saw the Volvo being hit. The driver in the other vehicle clearly merged without looking, and the impact caused a dent and scratch on the Volvo's side. It was a clear-cut case of an unsafe lane change in moderate traffic.

The traffic was quite heavy near the train station, and I was creeping forward at about 20 km/h. The vehicle to my left attempted to merge into my lane while I was already alongside him. It caused a side-swipe that left a significant dent on my rear door and a deep scratch that goes down to the primer. I am very frustrated because I signaled my presence, but he just did not seem to notice me at all in his blind spot during the merge.

I admit I was at fault for the side-swipe. I was trying to exit the main road and didn't see the Renault coming up beside me. My front corner scraped their door, causing a dent and scratch. I am very sorry for the trouble this has caused and will cooperate with the insurance details.

I had parked my car on the street while I went to pick up some bread at the local bakery. When I returned, I noticed a fresh, long scratch along my rear bumper. There was a note left on the windshield, so I know it was the van parked behind me. I am quite upset, as the car was in perfect condition this morning. It is just a minor scratch, but still, I have to take time out of my day to get this sorted out.

I was waiting at a red light on Avenida da Boavista when I felt a sudden impact from behind. My foot was on the brake, but the force pushed my car slightly forward. The collision broke my rear lamp and left a nasty dent in the boot lid. I was really worried about the damage, as this is a newer model and parts can be expensive. The other driver apologized immediately, but it is still a huge hassle to deal with the repair shop and the insurance claim process.

I was momentarily distracted by my phone and didn't realize the Audi in front had stopped for the red light. I tried to brake, but I hit the rear of their vehicle, causing damage to their lamp and a dent in the boot. I take full responsibility for the accident.

I was pulling out of a parking space very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, and I failed to notice a bollard that was slightly obscured by the evening shadows. I heard a loud crunch as I backed into it. The glass on my rear light assembly is completely shattered. It is quite annoying to have done this myself, especially because I consider myself a very cautious driver. I am just hoping the repairs are straightforward and that I can get the car back on the road by the end of the week.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving at maybe 10 km/h when the car in front of me suddenly braked hard. I tried to react quickly, but I just couldn't stop in time on the damp asphalt. My front bumper hit their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it, man. I got out immediately to check, and there is a noticeable dent on my hood from the impact. I am so worried about the repair costs, honestly.

I was stopped at the red light near the roundabout. Without any warning, the driver behind me failed to stop and ran into the back of my car. I exited the vehicle to exchange insurance details immediately. It was clearly a momentary lapse in attention due to the heavy evening congestion.

I was trying to parallel park near the riverfront in the late morning. I miscalculated the distance while turning the wheel and grazed the side of the parked car next to me. It was honestly a stupid mistake on my part, I was distracted by a phone notification. There is a long, visible scratch running across my rear passenger door. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident, but I want to make sure everything is handled correctly through my insurance. I apologize for the inconvenience caused to the owner of the other vehicle.

I was driving down Rua Augusta around 2 PM today. Another driver attempted to merge into my lane without checking their blind spot properly. I swerved to avoid a direct collision, but the side of our vehicles made contact. It happened so fast, and I was quite shaken up. Now there is a dent and a deep scratch on my driver-side door. I’ve lived in this city for forty years and I have never seen such reckless driving on this street, it's just getting busier every single year.

I moved into the left lane to prepare for my turn, but I misjudged the position of the car beside me. We made contact while I was changing lanes. I accept that I did not see the insured driver in time.

It was raining this morning, and the roundabout was very slippery. I was exiting when a van cut across my path. I tried to brake, but I hit the curb and then bumped into the side of the van. The impact broke my front lamp and there is a nasty crack on the bumper cover. I am so stressed out because this is my only car for work. Do you think the repair will take long? I just want to get back to my normal routine as soon as possible, you know?

I was pulling out of a parking spot near the shopping center. It was very crowded, and as I turned the wheel to exit, I didn't see the car passing by in the narrow lane. We hit each other at a very low speed. My front bumper now has a dent and a visible scratch from the metal trim of the other vehicle. I feel terrible about it; I really thought the path was clear, but clearly, I was wrong. I've already exchanged contact details with the other driver.

I was walking on the sidewalk nearby when I heard the collision. The Fiat 500 was moving slowly out of the parking spot, and the driver of the other vehicle didn't have enough time to stop. It was clearly an unfortunate accident due to the poor visibility in that spot.

I was driving slowly because of the tourists everywhere. The car ahead stopped abruptly for a pedestrian, and I couldn't stop my vehicle in time on the cobblestones. My front lamp is broken, and there is glass shatter all over the pavement from the headlight unit. It was a very quiet afternoon, and the loud noise of the glass breaking really startled me. I feel quite shaken by the whole experience. I am currently waiting for the tow truck to arrive, as I am worried about driving it further.

While driving on the main avenue, the vehicle in the adjacent lane drifted into mine. I had nowhere to go because of the concrete median on my left, so our side mirrors and doors scraped against each other. There is a long scratch along my passenger side now. I maintained a steady speed of 40 km/h, but the other driver was clearly not paying attention to the lane markings. It's frustrating because I had just washed the car this morning, and now this happens.

I was checking my navigation system and drifted slightly to the right without realizing it. By the time I corrected, the side of my car had already grazed the Hyundai. I am fully responsible for this lane departure error.

The traffic heading towards Cascais was stop-and-go. I was distracted for a split second by the beautiful sea view, and when I looked back, the car in front had stopped. I slammed on the brakes, but I still made contact with their rear. My front lamp is broken and there is a significant dent in the bumper. I feel really foolish for looking away; I know better than to lose focus like that. It's a lesson learned the hard way for sure.

I was navigating the roundabout, following the flow of traffic. Another car entered the circle too fast and hit the side of my rear bumper. The impact caused a dent and a long scratch on the rear panel. I've been driving in Lisbon for years, and this intersection is always a bit of a nightmare during rush hour. I am just glad no one was hurt, honestly. The car is still drivable, but the damage is definitely visible and needs professional attention.

I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing nearby. The Audi was clearly already in the roundabout when the other vehicle entered without yielding. The collision was inevitable at that speed. I saw the whole thing happen while I was waiting for the green light.

I was attempting to maneuver into a very tight space on this narrow street. The road is quite uneven with the stones, and I misjudged the angle as I reversed. I ended up scraping the side of a parked delivery van. There is a noticeable scratch on my rear bumper. My hands were shaking a bit because I was running late to pick up my grandson from school, and I suppose I was rushing. I feel quite bad about hitting the van, as it was just parked there minding its own business.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving at maybe 10 km/h when the car in front of me suddenly hit their brakes hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to react, but I didn't have enough distance, so I tapped the rear bumper of the car ahead. It was just a low-speed impact, but now there is a visible dent on my hood. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just one of those bad moments.

It was raining heavily near the airport, and the roundabout was quite slippery this morning. I was in the outer lane, and I think the other driver miscalculated their exit. They veered into my lane while trying to take the third exit, and their side panel scraped against my door. I tried to brake, but there was nowhere to go. I have a long, deep scratch running across the passenger door now. I am really stressed about the repair costs, I really hope this is handled quickly.

The visibility was poor due to the rain. I was exiting the roundabout and realized I was in the wrong lane, so I drifted over. I didn't see the Peugeot until it was too late. I accept that I was the one who shifted lanes improperly.

I was attempting to parallel park outside the shopping area on Rua de Santa Catarina. The space was quite tight, and I thought I had judged the distance correctly, but as I was backing in, I misjudged the angle. I heard a loud crunch against the parked car behind me. I stopped immediately. I am so embarrassed, man, this is my first accident and I'm really worried about the insurance hike. There is a nasty dent and a long scratch on the corner of my rear bumper now.

I was driving down the avenue at roughly 40 km/h, looking for my hotel. I signaled to change into the right lane, and I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. As I moved over, there was contact between my rear quarter panel and their front bumper. My side lamp is broken and there is a deep scratch near the wheel arch. It happened so fast, I didn't even see them coming up beside me until the impact occurred.

I was maintaining my speed in the right lane, and the driver of the Seat suddenly moved into my space. There wasn't enough time for me to avoid the collision. It caused damage to my front bumper and their side light.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I was entering the intersection at the roundabout when the lights changed. I think I might have been a bit distracted checking my GPS for the exact turn, and I didn't notice the van entering from the cross-street. It was a low-speed impact, but the point of contact was right on my side window, causing the glass to shatter completely. I am honestly shaken up by the whole experience. I feel like such an idiot for not paying full attention to the traffic light change.

I was standing on the corner waiting to cross. The BMW clearly entered the intersection when the signal was turning yellow, and the delivery van was already moving. They collided in the center of the junction, causing the side glass of the car to break.

My wife and I were driving toward Cascais for the weekend, it was a beautiful sunny day. We were cruising along the coastal road when the traffic ahead of us suddenly stopped. It was quite a shock, really. I hit the brakes, but the road was a bit dusty, and I just couldn't stop in time to avoid the car in front. It was a gentle nudge, but the metal is clearly indented now. I have been driving for forty years and I feel awful about this simple mistake.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving in the center lane and there was a heavy truck in the left lane. It was a very busy morning with lots of commuters. As the road started to curve, the truck seemed to drift slightly toward me. I moved to the right to avoid it, but I clipped the median barrier. It resulted in a long scratch and a dent along the side of my car. I’m quite frustrated because I was trying to avoid a bigger collision with the truck itself.

I was navigating through the narrow streets near the university area. I was going very slowly, maybe 15 km/h, but the road is quite narrow and cobbled. I turned the wheel too early while exiting a tight corner and the corner of my car hit a concrete post. My rear signal lamp is broken now. It is such a silly, minor thing, but it’s still annoying to deal with the insurance paperwork. I should have been much more careful in these old, narrow streets.

Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it usually is during rush hour. I was at a complete standstill when I felt a sudden impact from behind. The car behind me didn't stop in time and pushed into me. It wasn't a huge hit, but it caused a dent in my trunk and the brake lamp is broken. I am really worried about the cost of these parts. I was perfectly stationary, so I don't see how this could be my fault.

I looked down for a second to change the radio station and failed to notice that the traffic had stopped abruptly on the bridge. By the time I looked up and applied the brakes, I hit the Audi. I am fully responsible.

I was heading to the city center and I thought I had checked my blind spot before merging into the lane. I suppose I missed the motorbike coming up. I heard a scrape against my side panel and pulled over immediately. There is a noticeable scratch along the passenger door. I am so incredibly worried, man, I really hope the rider is okay. It’s a huge relief that they didn't fall off their bike, but I feel really guilty about my lack of awareness.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly stopped. I tried to brake, but the road was damp from the earlier drizzle and I just couldn't stop in time. I bumped into the back of the car in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. It was such a silly mistake, I feel terrible about it. My front bumper has a visible dent and some paint scratch damage now, you know? I really just want to get this sorted out as soon as possible, man.

I was stopped at the red light near the roundabout when I suddenly felt a jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the driver had slid into my rear bumper. We both pulled over immediately to exchange our insurance details. It was a minor impact, but there is definitely a dent on my rear fender.

I was trying to parallel park on Rua da Prata this morning, which is always a nightmare with the narrow streets and the cobblestones. I thought I had enough clearance, but I must have misjudged the distance while turning the wheel. I heard a scraping sound against the side of the parked van next to me. I stopped immediately and checked the damage. There is a long scratch on the side door panel of my Fiat. I'm so worried about the repair costs, this is honestly the first time I have ever hit another vehicle.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: It was really chaotic at the Marquês de Pombal roundabout. I was in the middle lane attempting to exit toward the avenue, and another car came up quickly from the right side, not giving me enough space. I tried to swerve, but we made contact side-to-side. It happened so fast, and the noise was quite loud. My passenger door has a noticeable dent and a deep scratch running across it. I am truly shaken up by the whole experience and just hope the insurance process goes smoothly for everyone involved today.

I was navigating the roundabout when the Peugeot in the middle lane suddenly drifted toward my vehicle. I tried to steer away, but the space was limited. We ended up rubbing sides. It was quite a stressful moment during the rush hour traffic. My side panel now has a clear scratch and a small dent.

I was turning left at the intersection on Avenida Luísa Todi. I thought I had a clear window because the light was yellow, but the other driver entered the intersection faster than I anticipated. We hit each other at a very low speed, probably 15 km/h. My front right indicator lamp is broken, which is quite annoying because I need the car for work tomorrow. I am just really stressed about the paperwork and whether this will increase my monthly premiums, you know? It's been a very long day for me.

Back in my day, people were much more careful in parking lots! I was doing my weekly grocery shopping at the center here in Funchal. When I returned to my Citroën, I noticed a fresh scratch along the rear quarter panel. I suspect someone scraped it while reversing out of the adjacent spot. It is very disheartening to find your vehicle damaged like that when you weren't even present. I am reporting it so I can get it polished out by a professional, as I take great pride in keeping my car clean and tidy.

I was walking to my own car nearby when I saw a delivery truck trying to exit the spot next to this Citroën. The driver of the truck misjudged the turn and I heard the sound of metal scraping. The truck driver didn't stop, but I saw the scratch left on the Citroën.

I was driving slowly on Rua de Santa Catarina, looking for a place to turn around. Suddenly, a cyclist swerved in front of me, and I had to brake really hard. The car behind me didn't react quickly enough and tapped my rear bumper. It wasn't a heavy impact, but it caused a crack in the plastic trim. I am not really sure how to handle this since it's my first accident, but the other driver was very polite and we agreed to document everything properly for our respective insurance companies.

I was heading home after a long meeting in the city center. While driving on Avenida da República, I moved to change lanes into the left lane. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other vehicle was in my blind spot. I heard a crunch as we made contact. It was completely my fault for not checking twice, and I feel quite bad about it. There is a noticeable dent on my passenger door and some paint scratch marks. I have contacted my broker to start the formal claim process immediately.

I was driving steadily in the left lane when the driver in the adjacent lane began merging into my space. I honked, but there was no time to avoid the collision. We hit at the side. My vehicle sustained a dent and a scratch on the driver's side panel.

The traffic on Avenida de Roma was incredibly heavy due to the construction work nearby. I was distracted for a split second by the GPS, and when I looked up, the car ahead of me had stopped for a pedestrian. I pressed the brakes, but I still made contact with their bumper. The rear lamp of the other vehicle is broken, and there is a dent in their trunk. I am really anxious about the insurance consequences because I have been a careful driver for years. I just hope this can be repaired quickly.

I was maneuvering in a tight spot near the cafe on Rua Garrett. The street is quite narrow and there was a delivery van unloading. While I was trying to reverse, I clipped a concrete bollard that I hadn't seen in my parking sensors. It resulted in the glass shatter of my rear passenger window. It was just a stupid accident during a routine day, you know? I am feeling a bit stressed about how long it will take to replace the glass because I use the car every single day for my commute.

Driving along the coast on Avenida Marginal, the wind was very strong today, which made steering feel a bit different. I was overtaking a slower car, and as I pulled back into the lane, I misjudged the position of the other vehicle coming up from behind. We side-swiped each other. My front light lamp is broken, and there is a dent and scratch on the fender. I am quite shaken, but everyone is physically fine, which is the most important thing. I am now waiting for the tow truck to arrive.

I was traveling at about 50 km/h on the Marginal road when the Hyundai suddenly swerved back into my lane while overtaking. I didn't have enough room to maneuver to the shoulder. The contact caused a dent and a deep scratch on my rear door, and broke the tail lamp housing.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM. Traffic on Avenida da Boavista was quite heavy as usual. I was trailing a silver car at a low speed, probably around 20 km/h. Suddenly, the driver ahead braked hard to avoid a pedestrian near the crossing. I tried to press the brake pedal firmly, but I just couldn't stop in time. I bumped into the back of his bumper. It was really stressful and I am worried about the cost of the repair. My front bumper has a noticeable dent now.

I was driving calmly when I saw a pedestrian step onto the road near the crossing. I applied my brakes immediately to avoid a collision. Unfortunately, the driver behind me was a bit too close and could not stop in time, hitting my rear bumper. We exchanged details on the side of the road.

The sun was quite low today, creating a glare as I drove along the coast on Avenida Marginal. I was driving at 50 km/h, and for a split second, the brightness blinded me. When I looked back at the road, the car in front had stopped for a signal. I braked hard, but the road surface was damp from the sea mist. I hit the back of the car. It resulted in a deep dent on my hood.

I had stopped at the traffic light near the beach when I felt a sudden impact from behind. I checked my mirror just before it happened, but there was nothing I could do. The driver behind me apologized immediately, saying the sun glare had prevented him from seeing that I was stopped.

Navigating the Marquês de Pombal is always a bit tricky for me, even after all these years of driving. I was carefully entering the roundabout, but perhaps I was a bit too hesitant. The driver in the adjacent lane seemed to be in a rush and misjudged the gap. He veered into my lane and hit my side. My lamp is broken and I have a dent on the wheel arch. It has been quite a stressful morning for me.

I was exiting the roundabout and thought the other driver was staying in their lane. I moved over to take my exit, but realized too late that our paths were crossing. I hit his side as I pulled ahead. I apologized to the other driver for the contact.

I was attempting to park in a tight space on Avenida da República to run a quick errand. I was relying on the sensors, but I think I didn't notice a low-hanging metal fence post near the curb. As I turned, the side of my car grazed against the post. There is a noticeable scratch running along the rear quarter panel. I am quite frustrated about it as I try to keep my car in perfect condition.

I was walking by when I saw the Tesla trying to park. The space was really tight, and the driver was trying to avoid the cars in front and back. I saw him graze the fence post near the curb. I heard a sharp scratching sound and saw the damage immediately.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM heading toward the city center. Traffic was quite heavy, stop-and-go as usual. I was keeping a safe distance, but the driver in front of me suddenly braked hard because a pedestrian stepped out. I hit my brakes immediately but didn't have enough space to stop completely. I tapped their rear bumper at very low speed, probably under 10 km/h. It was really a minor incident, but there is a visible dent on my hood where I hit their bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, trying to exit toward the Avenida da Liberdade. I was in the middle lane and checking my mirrors to move to the outer lane. I suppose I misjudged the distance to the car on my right side. As I started to veer over, I heard a scraping sound. We both stopped immediately in the exit lane. There is a long scratch on the passenger side door of my car. I am so sorry, man, I was just really focused on the traffic flow and didn't see him there.

The insured driver was clearly trying to change lanes to exit the roundabout. They didn't see me in the outer lane as they began their maneuver. I tried to brake, but there was nowhere to go. Their side mirror brushed against my quarter panel, resulting in a scratch on their vehicle. It was an honest mistake in the chaos of Lisbon traffic.

I was parking my car on the side of the street near the old university district. It was getting dark and the street lighting in that area is quite poor. I miscalculated the turn while backing into the parking space and my rear corner clipped a parked car. I feel so embarrassed. The impact caused a noticeable dent and a deep scratch on my bumper. I immediately left a note on the other windshield since the owner wasn't around. I am very worried about the repair costs, to be perfectly honest.

I was driving along the Avenida 24 de Julho, heading toward Cais do Sodré. It was around 2:00 PM. I decided to change lanes to the left to avoid a bus that was slowing down. I checked my mirror, but somehow I didn't see the car in my blind spot. I pulled over and heard the sound of plastic breaking. My indicator lamp is broken now. I am incredibly anxious about the insurance process because I really pride myself on being a safe driver, you know?

I was walking on the sidewalk near the tram stop. I saw the Seat Ibiza attempt a lane change without noticing the car already in that lane. The front of the Seat hit the other car's rear panel. It was a low-speed impact, but it was enough to break the lamp on the Seat's side. Both drivers acted very calmly and pulled over to exchange details.

It was a lovely, sunny morning on the Marginal road. I was on my way to visit my granddaughter, just driving at a steady pace. Suddenly, the traffic ahead slowed down very quickly, perhaps because of some road work further ahead. I tried to brake, but I was a bit distracted by the beautiful view of the sea and didn't react fast enough. I ended up rear-ending the vehicle in front of me. The collision caused a dent on my front bumper and, unfortunately, some glass shatter from the other car's rear light cluster.

I was pulling out of a tight parking garage in the city center. I had to make a very sharp turn to exit onto the main road. The angle was tighter than I realized, and I scraped the side of my car against the concrete pillar of the entrance. It was a pure misjudgment of the vehicle's turning radius in such a cramped space. The result is just a long, ugly scratch along the side panel. It is quite frustrating, but luckily no one else was involved in the incident.

I was trying to squeeze into a very small parking spot in downtown Lisbon. I thought I had just enough room, but I misjudged the distance between my bumper and the car behind me. I heard a slight noise as I backed in. When I checked, I noticed a superficial scratch on the bumper of the car behind me and one on my own. I feel really bad, man, I just didn't see how close I was. The traffic was loud and I was a bit rushed, I guess.

I was entering the roundabout from the inner lane and intending to take the third exit. As I was about to maneuver out, another car entered from the outer lane and cut across my path. I had to brake suddenly and we sideswiped. The impact was enough to leave a dent on my front wheel arch and a long scratch along the side. It was a very confusing situation with so many exits on that roundabout. I am just glad no one was hurt in the process.

The driver of the BMW was already in the roundabout. I was entering and miscalculated the exit timing. I moved too quickly into the path of the BMW. We collided as they were trying to exit. There is a dent and scratch on their passenger side. I take full responsibility for the misjudgment of the distance.

I was traveling north on Avenida Almirante Reis during the evening rush hour. It was raining quite heavily, which made visibility really difficult. The car in front of me stopped abruptly for a pedestrian crossing. I slammed on my brakes, but the road was slippery and I slid forward, hitting the rear of their vehicle. The impact was sharp. My front indicator lamp is broken and there is evidence of glass shatter from the other car's taillight on the pavement. I am deeply concerned about the damage to both vehicles.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Boavista junction around 6:00 PM in heavy traffic. I was moving at maybe 20 km/h when the car to my right drifted into my lane without signaling. I slammed on the brakes, but we still made contact. There is a noticeable dent on my front right fender and some deep scratch marks along the panel. I feel terrible about the whole situation, honestly, I am quite anxious because this is my first accident and I am really worried about the repair costs and my insurance premiums going up.

It was a busy afternoon and I was trying to parallel park near the main shopping street. I misjudged the distance between my car and the white van parked behind me. As I reversed slowly, probably at 3 km/h, I heard a sound and realized I had clipped the rear bumper. There is a long scratch on the paintwork of my back bumper. I am so embarrassed by this; I was just trying to get a quick errand done, you know, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork.

I was sitting in my van waiting for a delivery when I felt a small jolt from the back. I stepped out and saw the driver of the Peugeot looking quite worried. The bumper of her car had scraped against mine, resulting in a visible scratch. We exchanged details calmly.

I was driving home from work along the avenue when the light turned yellow. The vehicle in the adjacent lane tried to merge suddenly to catch the exit. I couldn't move further left because of the concrete divider. The impact damaged my passenger side door with a large dent and my front side lamp is completely broken now. This whole experience is honestly super stressful, dude. I was just minding my own business and driving at a steady 40 km/h, but these things happen so fast in this city traffic.

I was driving on the EN125 towards Faro when traffic suddenly slowed down ahead due to a tractor entering the road. I pressed the brakes firmly, but the driver behind me failed to stop in time. He hit my rear bumper. There is a very obvious dent on the center of the bumper. My back hurts a bit, and I am quite shaken. I have been driving for years and never had a situation like this where the person simply didn't notice the traffic flow had halted.

I admit I was distracted for a split second by the GPS. When I looked up, the Toyota in front of me was already stopped. I tried to brake, but I still made contact. There is a clear dent on their rear bumper from my front grille.

I was turning into a narrow street near the city center. I did not realize there was a low stone pillar partially obscured by some street decor. I turned the wheel a bit too sharply and the back quarter glass shattered against the edge of the stone. I feel like such an idiot, I was going maybe 5 km/h, but it happened in a blink of an eye. I am just really stressed about the repair, as I need the car for my job tomorrow.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I heard a distinct sound of glass shattering. I turned around and saw the driver pulling away from a stone pillar at the corner. The rear side window of the car was completely broken. It was clearly a low-speed maneuver that went wrong.

Traffic was crawling toward the bridge. The car in front of me slammed on their brakes, and I managed to stop, but the driver behind me rear-ended me, pushing me into the vehicle in front. My rear bumper has a major dent and my tail lamp is broken. I've been driving since I was eighteen, and I've always been very careful, but this morning there was nothing I could do. The weather was damp and visibility was a bit poor, making everything much more difficult.

I was crossing the intersection when the lights turned yellow. A taxi coming from the cross street tried to speed through as well and hit my side door. It left a significant dent and a deep scratch across the metal. I am really anxious because I'm not sure who had the right of way, though I am fairly certain I entered the intersection before the light turned red. The driver of the taxi seems just as confused as I am about how it all happened so quickly.

I was heading down the cross street and saw the light changing. I thought I could clear the junction, but the other driver entered at the same time. We collided at low speed. There is a scratch and a dent on his door from my front bumper area.

I was leaving the parking lot after a nice Sunday brunch. As I was turning to exit, I cut the corner a bit too close to a concrete bollard. It scraped the side of my car and smashed the indicator lamp. I feel so embarrassed. I was just thinking about my kids in the back seat and didn't pay enough attention to the curb. It is a minor thing, but it is quite annoying to have to explain this to my insurance agent tomorrow morning.

I was navigating through the narrow cobblestone streets when I had to swerve slightly to avoid a pedestrian who stepped out unexpectedly. My side mirror clipped the edge of a shop display window frame. The side mirror housing glass shattered and there is a dent on the passenger door where the frame made contact. I am really worried about the shop owner being upset, though I have already apologized. It was a very unfortunate maneuver, but I had to avoid hitting that person at all costs.

I saw the whole thing from across the street. The driver tried to avoid a tourist who walked into the street without looking. The car hit the corner of a store frame. I saw the glass from the mirror shatter and a dent appeared on the side of the door. The driver was clearly trying to be careful.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Rotunda da Boavista, trying to exit toward Avenida de França, when the traffic suddenly stopped. I hit my brakes, but the road was damp from the morning drizzle and I slid forward, tapping the back of the car in front of me. I felt terrible immediately because I know I should have kept more distance. There is a noticeable dent on my front bumper and some deep scratches near the grille. I am really worried about how much these repairs will cost and how long the car will be in the shop.

I was slowing down to exit the roundabout when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the Volkswagen had slid into me. The driver was very apologetic and visibly shaken. We pulled over just past the exit to exchange our insurance details. My rear bumper has some damage, but thankfully everyone is okay.

It was late in the afternoon and I was trying to parallel park near a cafe on Rua Augusta. The street is quite narrow and there were many tourists walking around, which made me really nervous. While I was turning the wheel to back into the space, I misjudged the distance to the parked car behind me and scraped against their side panel. I feel so stupid for being distracted by the crowd. There is a long scratch on the rear passenger door. I hope the other owner is understanding about this little mistake.

I was driving home from my granddaughter's house near Avenida dos Aliados. I remember it was getting dark and the lights were reflecting off the wet cobblestones. I entered the intersection cautiously, but a vehicle coming from the side didn't stop in time. It was all a bit sudden, I must admit. My headlight is broken and there is a nasty dent on the front fender. I am just glad I wasn't going fast, otherwise, it could have been much worse for both of us, really.

I was waiting to cross at the pedestrian signal. The traffic light for the cross-street was already turning red, but the driver of the black sedan didn't seem to notice. The Toyota entered the intersection lawfully and was struck on the front side. The impact caused the headlight of the Toyota to shatter instantly. I stayed behind to ensure the elderly driver was alright until the police arrived.

I was driving along the EN125 heading toward the airport. Traffic was heavy and moving quite slowly. I saw a gap in the right lane and started to change lanes, but I didn't see the van in my blind spot. I heard a loud scraping noise immediately and pulled back into my lane. There is a long scratch running along the side of my driver-side door. I feel like such an idiot for not checking the mirror twice before moving. It was a really simple error, but the damage is definitely annoying to look at.

Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it often is during the morning commute. I was at a complete standstill when a car behind me failed to stop. The impact was quite strong; it pushed my car forward a meter. The rear glass is shattered into pieces and the bumper has a massive dent. I am incredibly anxious because this is my only car for work. I have never had an accident before, so I'm not really sure what documents I need to provide to the insurance agency right now.

I was looking down for a second to adjust the air conditioning and when I looked up, the traffic had stopped. I couldn't stop in time on the bridge deck. I hit the Fiat from behind. The impact definitely damaged the rear end of their car, including the window glass. I accept full responsibility for this incident. It was entirely my lapse in concentration while driving in the queue.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista when a cyclist suddenly swerved out from between parked cars. To avoid hitting them, I steered slightly to the left, which brought me too close to the car in the adjacent lane. Our side mirrors clipped each other, and the side of my vehicle rubbed against theirs. There is a persistent scratch mark along the paintwork now. It was a split-second decision between the cyclist and the car, and I think I made the right choice, but it is a real headache dealing with the insurance paperwork.

It was a busy Saturday afternoon on Rua de Santa Catarina. I was trying to pull into a tight parking spot near the shopping area. My visibility was limited because of a large delivery truck parked nearby. As I was maneuvering, I miscalculated the angle and the front corner of my car hit a metal pole. There is a significant dent in the bumper. I am quite worried about the repair costs, as I am currently on a very strict student budget and this wasn't really a great day to begin with.

I was driving along the river toward the city center. The car in front of me signaled to turn right but then hesitated and stopped unexpectedly. I tried to swerve, but I caught the corner of their bumper with my headlight. The light assembly is broken. I am so stressed out by this because I've only owned this car for six months. I've been very careful, but these things just happen when you least expect them, don't they? I just want to get it fixed as quickly as possible.

I was looking for a parking spot near the waterfront and slowed down abruptly when I thought I saw an empty space. The driver behind me couldn't avoid the collision. It caused damage to their front light. It was clearly my fault for stopping so suddenly without checking the traffic flow behind me first. I apologized to the driver and we filled out the declaration form right there on the sidewalk.

I was driving along the coastal road in Cascais enjoying the sunset. It was a beautiful day, though the sun was shining right into my eyes. I was merging into the center lane when I failed to notice a car driving alongside me. I veered into their lane and we scraped sides. My paint is damaged with a long scratch. I have been driving for over 40 years, and I must say it is quite embarrassing to have such a minor lapse, but the sun really was blindingly bright at that specific moment.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was proceeding through a green light at the intersection when a taxi suddenly crossed my path from the left. I slammed on the brakes, but I still clipped their rear corner. My headlight is broken and there is a dent on my wing. It happened so fast that I barely had time to react. I'm honestly just shaking right now because I've never been involved in a collision before. Everything seems fine with me, but I really need to get my car inspected by the insurance assessor soon.

I was standing at the corner waiting for the light to change. The Nissan clearly had the green signal to proceed. The taxi driver seemed to be in a rush and tried to beat the yellow light but didn't make it. The collision was inevitable at that point. I saw the headlight of the Nissan break upon impact and noticed a dent on their side panel. I gave my contact information to both drivers.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Boavista junction, moving at about 20 km/h, when I started to change lanes to exit towards Avenida da Boavista. I checked my mirrors, but I honestly didn't see the black sedan already positioned to my right. There was a loud scraping noise as our sides touched. I am so worried about the repair costs, I really should have been more careful with the blind spot. There is a visible dent on my rear door and a long scratch along the side panel.

I was holding my lane in the roundabout when the driver of the Polo moved into my path suddenly. I tried to brake, but we made contact. It was just a low-speed impact, but there is clearly a dent and a scratch on the side of their car now.

It was pouring rain in downtown Lisbon today, and the visibility on Rua do Ouro was quite poor. I was trying to reverse into a tight parallel parking spot near the Santa Justa Lift. I thought I had enough clearance, but I misjudged the angle and my bumper grazed the pole on the sidewalk. I felt a slight jolt and stopped immediately. I am quite embarrassed because I usually pride myself on my parking skills, but the rain really made it difficult to see the curb properly. There is a deep scratch on the rear bumper.

I was driving home from my shift at the port, just cruising along Avenida Luísa Todi. Traffic was quite heavy for a Tuesday afternoon. The car in front of me slammed on their brakes because a pedestrian stepped into the road, and despite my best efforts, I couldn't stop in time. I bumped into their rear bumper at about 15 km/h. My front left lamp is broken now and there is a noticeable dent on the hood. I feel terrible about the accident; I just wasn't fast enough to react to their sudden stop.

I had to stop abruptly to avoid a person walking across the street. The car behind me hit my rear end. My vehicle only has minor damage, but the other driver's lamp is broken and there is a dent on their Peugeot.

I was driving along the coastal road in Funchal when a delivery van coming from the opposite direction seemed to veer slightly over the center line. It happened so fast. My driver-side door took the brunt of the contact as we passed each other. My car has a long scratch and a dent now. I was quite shaken up, man, because it was a narrow road and there wasn't much space to pull over or dodge the van. It's really stressful dealing with this insurance paperwork on top of everything else.
I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the delivery van drift. The Seat Ibiza driver tried to move, but they still swiped each other. I saw a dent and a scratch on the side of the Seat.

I was looking for a spot to drop off my grandchildren near the shopping district. It was very crowded, lots of people everywhere. As I was turning into a side street, I misjudged the distance between my car and a concrete bollard. I heard a thud and realized I had hit it. My rear quarter panel has a nasty dent now. My grandchildren were a bit startled, poor things, but thankfully no one was hurt. It was just a simple driving error on my part while navigating these tight Porto streets.

I was driving back from the office along Avenida 24 de Julho. A taxi in front of me stopped suddenly to let a passenger out in an area where they shouldn't have been stopping. I braked hard, but my car slid on the damp pavement, hitting the back of the taxi. My front lamp is broken and there is a significant dent on the bonnet. It was a very stressful afternoon. I am currently working with the other driver to provide all the necessary insurance details for the report.

Man, this has been such a bad day. I was cruising down the avenue and this dude in a delivery truck just drifted into my lane without looking. I tried to honk, but he didn't hear me, and he scraped the whole side of my car. There's a long scratch running from the front fender to the back door. I’m really worried about what the garage is going to charge to fix this. Do you think the insurance will cover the full repair cost? I really need my car for work.

I was trying to navigate the lane change, but I completely missed seeing the Toyota in my blind spot. I hit them while shifting over. There is a scratch on their side panel. I am happy to cooperate with the insurance claim.

Back in my day, people paid much more attention at these small intersections. I was driving slowly, perhaps 20 km/h, near Rua de Cedofeita when a younger driver exited a side street way too quickly. They hit my front quarter panel, which caused a dent and shattered my side-view mirror glass. It was quite a shock, really. I had my groceries in the back and just wanted to get home for lunch. It is a shame about the car, it was in such pristine condition before this happened today.
I was sitting at the cafe terrace when I saw the Nissan hit. The other car didn't stop at the yield sign. There is a dent and shattered mirror glass on the Nissan.

I was driving home after work on the Avenida da Boavista when the traffic suddenly stopped. It was raining quite heavily, and the roads were very slick. I tried to brake, but I just could not stop in time and ended up hitting the bumper of the car in front of me at low speed. It was such a stupid mistake on my part, man. I feel terrible about it, and I am really worried about how much this is going to cost to fix the dent on my hood.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música when another driver attempted to merge into my lane without checking their blind spot. I tried to swerve to avoid them, but they made contact with my headlight. The traffic was incredibly dense, and I think they simply didn't see me while changing lanes. My front lamp is broken now. It was all very stressful, and I just hope the repair process is straightforward because I rely on this car every single day.

I apologize, but I did not check my side mirror properly before moving into the outer lane of the roundabout. I am very sorry for the confusion caused. I definitely hit the other driver's lamp in the process, which is my mistake. I am happy to cooperate with the insurance details.

I was driving along Avenida 24 de Julho heading towards Cais do Sodré. The car in the adjacent lane drifted into my lane while trying to avoid a delivery truck. I had no room to move over because of the parked cars, so we side-swiped. There is a deep dent and a nasty scratch along my rear door now. You know, I was just trying to get to my meeting on time, and this really ruined my whole morning, man.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the tram when I saw the two cars collide. The driver in the right lane definitely drifted into the other car's path. It happened quite fast, resulting in a visible dent and scratch on the BMW. Neither driver seemed to be speeding at the time.

I was passing through the intersection at Avenida da República when the traffic light turned yellow. I slowed down, but the car behind me didn't notice and bumped into my rear. The impact was strong enough to shatter my rear glass and break one of the brake lamps. I have been driving for thirty years, and I must say that the traffic in this city has become quite unpredictable lately. It was quite a shock, really, and my back is a bit stiff now.

I parked my car on Rua de Cedofeita this afternoon to run some errands. When I returned about an hour later, I noticed a long scratch along the driver's side door. It seems like someone must have hit my car while trying to pull out of the space ahead of mine. I checked the area, and there was no note left, but I did manage to talk to a local shop owner who confirmed a car had brushed against mine earlier.

I own the small shop nearby and I witnessed a silver sedan scraping the Mini parked on the street. They didn't stop to check the damage, they just drove off immediately. It left a visible scratch on the side of the car. I saw the whole thing from my front window.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was moving from the middle lane to the right lane on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo. I signaled, but the other driver was accelerating in my blind spot. We made contact, which caused my side lamp to break and left a dent on my front quarter panel. I am extremely frustrated with myself because I thought I had checked everywhere, but clearly, I missed him. I am trying to follow the correct procedures for the insurance report.

I was driving in the right lane when the Audi started moving over. I didn't have time to brake before we made contact. It caused damage to his lamp and a dent on his car, while my own bumper was also affected. It was a simple accident caused by poor timing.

It was pouring rain on Rua da Prata today. I was at a complete stop at the stop line, waiting for pedestrians to cross. A van behind me hydroplaned or just didn't brake in time and hit the rear of my car. I have a dent and some scratches on the trunk lid now. I was quite shaken up because the impact was sudden. My husband told me to make sure I document everything properly for the claim, so here I am.

The road was very slippery due to the rain. When the driver ahead stopped for the pedestrians, I pressed the brakes but the van slid forward. I hit the back of the Ford Focus, leaving a dent and a scratch. I take full responsibility for the accident.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was quite heavy as usual. I was trailing a silver sedan when they suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to react, but I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit their rear, leaving a noticeable dent and several deep scratches. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just a lapse in concentration during the rush hour. I am really worried about the repair costs, but I have my insurance details ready.

I was stopped at the zebra crossing to let a group of tourists pass. Suddenly, I felt a solid impact from behind. I checked my rearview mirror just before the hit, so I knew there was no time for the driver behind me to stop. The rear bumper of my car has a clear dent and some paint scratches from the collision.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música, attempting to take the second exit. It was raining lightly and the road surface was quite slippery. I was maintaining a slow speed, maybe 20 km/h, but I misjudged the distance to the car on my right as I merged into the outer lane. We scraped against each other, causing a long horizontal scratch along my passenger side door. I was so nervous and confused in the moment, I just hope everything gets sorted out quickly by the insurance agency.

I was trying to park my car in a very tight spot near the river. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was reversing, I accidentally clipped the bumper of the car already parked next to me. It was a stupid mistake, and I feel embarrassed about it. There is a small dent on the corner of the other vehicle's rear fender. I left a note with my details immediately, as I want to handle this professionally and ensure the damage is repaired correctly.

I was driving down Avenida dos Aliados when the vehicle to my left suddenly decided to change lanes without signaling properly. I tried to swerve, but it was too late to avoid the contact. Our sides collided at low speed. The impact resulted in a nasty scratch across my rear quarter panel and my side indicator lamp is completely broken now. The other driver stopped immediately, and we both agreed to fill out the European Accident Report form right there on the sidewalk.

I didn't see the other car in my blind spot when I initiated the lane change. I moved over slightly, and then I heard the grinding sound of metal. We both pulled over to the side of the road. I can see the broken lamp housing on their car and several long scratches.

It was a busy afternoon near the bridge approach. I was following a van when traffic came to an absolute standstill. I slammed on the brakes but unfortunately slid on the wet pavement, hitting the van's rear. The impact caused a significant dent in their tailgate and the glass shatter of their rear tail light. I am really shaken up by the whole experience. I've never been in an accident before and the sound of the glass breaking was really distressing to me.

Back in my day, people were more careful, but today, I was just coming back from the pharmacy. I was turning into a narrow street when a delivery scooter cut the corner too sharply. I had to brake suddenly and nudged the curb, but then a taxi coming from the other direction grazed my front bumper. It caused a dent and a scratch on the side. I am quite upset as I always try to drive very slowly in these old city centers.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the Fiat turn into the street. The taxi driver was definitely going a bit too fast for the narrow road. The cars grazed each other quite visibly. The Fiat definitely sustained a dent and some scratches from that contact.

I was driving along the coastal road in Cascais, enjoying the afternoon sun. I went to overtake a slower vehicle, and as I was pulling back into the lane, I didn't see the car in my side mirror that was accelerating. We ended up with a light scratch along the doors. It was entirely my fault for not checking the mirror a second time. I've already spoken to the other driver, and they were very understanding about the whole situation. It's a shame about the paint.

I was approaching the intersection near the university. The light turned amber, and I made a split-second decision to go through, but another car was already crossing from the perpendicular street. We collided at a very low speed. My front left corner hit their side, which broke my indicator lamp and left a dent on their door. I know I shouldn't have risked the amber light. I feel terrible for the inconvenience caused to the other driver who was just trying to get to their destination.

I had the green light and was proceeding through the intersection when the Ford tried to beat the red light. They clipped my side. It's frustrating because I had to be somewhere important. I can clearly see a dent in my side panel and the broken plastic from their lamp on the ground.

I was driving through the city center of Braga. It was quite busy with students everywhere. I was looking at my GPS to find the correct parking garage and didn't notice that the traffic ahead had come to a halt. I bumped into the car in front. The impact was enough to cause a crack in their plastic bumper cover and a dent in my hood. I am really stressed out by this. I was being careful, but clearly not careful enough. I've already provided my insurance documentation.

I was trying to park in the historic center near the temple. The streets are extremely narrow here. I miscalculated the angle while reversing into the space and caught the pillar of a nearby building with my rear bumper, then slid into the car parked next to me. It caused a long scratch and a dent on the neighboring car's side panel. I am so upset with myself; I should have asked my passenger to guide me. I want to make sure the owner gets their car fixed properly.

I saw the whole thing from the cafe terrace across the street. The driver was trying to squeeze into a space that was clearly too small. They hit the stone wall first and then scraped against the parked car. There is a visible dent and a long scratch on the rear of that parked vehicle.

I was driving home from work around 6:00 PM and traffic was quite heavy near the intersection. I was doing about 20 km/h when the car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to stop, but I just couldn't manage to pull up in time and tapped their bumper. It was a complete mistake on my part, I just got distracted for a second. There is a visible dent on my hood and a long scratch along the plastic trim, so I am very worried about the repair costs.

It was raining quite heavily this morning near the airport and the roads were slick. I was navigating the roundabout when another vehicle entered from the inner lane and swung wide, clipping my front corner. Honestly, man, I'm just so stressed about this whole insurance situation because I need my car for university. My front passenger-side lamp is broken and there is a deep scratch right over the wheel arch. I feel like it wasn't my fault, but the whole thing is just a massive headache for me right now.

The rain made visibility very poor at the roundabout. I did not realize the other driver was in my blind spot as I moved to exit. I apologize for the contact; it was a simple error of judgment due to the weather conditions. My vehicle also sustained some minor contact, but I have already assessed the lamp and the scratch on the bumper.

I was attempting to park in a tight spot near the university area and I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar next to the bay. I was moving very slowly, probably under 5 km/h, but I still made contact with the rear quarter panel. It is just a minor dent, but it looks quite ugly. I have been driving for years and I am embarrassed, but I want to make sure I report it correctly so my insurance covers the repair properly. It was completely my own error.

I was driving down the EN125 and reached an intersection. The light was yellow and I thought I could clear it, but a car coming from the side street miscalculated and hit my front corner. The impact was loud, and suddenly my headlamp was broken and there was glass shattered everywhere on the asphalt. I was so shaken up, you know? I didn't know what to do, my hands were shaking. I just hope this is a quick process because I need to get back to work for my shift.

I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing when the collision occurred. The driver of the Ford attempted to cross the junction as the lights were changing, and the other driver failed to stop in time, striking the front of the vehicle. I witnessed the lamp break and the glass shatter upon impact. Both drivers were clearly stressed but remained calm throughout the exchange of information.

I was pulling away from the curb after buying some bread at the local bakery. I didn't see the cyclist who was riding past, and as I turned the wheel, I scraped his bike frame with my front bumper. It left a noticeable scratch on the plastic, though thankfully the paint didn't peel much. I stopped immediately to ensure he was okay; he was fine, just a bit annoyed. I feel terrible about it because I should have looked over my shoulder one more time before pulling out into the narrow street.

It was early, about 8:30 AM, and the bridge was packed with commuters. Everyone was impatient. I was keeping to my lane when a van beside me started to drift over, trying to get ahead in the queue. He caught the rear quarter of my car, causing a nasty dent and a long, jagged scratch along the panel. I tried to honk to alert him, but he didn't stop until we got to the other side of the bridge. It is just such a shame for my car to be damaged like this in morning traffic.

I was distracted for a moment adjusting my radio. When I looked back at the road, I had drifted slightly into the next lane. I heard the scrape and immediately realized I had hit the car next to me. I pulled over as soon as it was safe on the bridge. I caused a dent and a scratch on the side of the other vehicle. I accept full responsibility for the incident as it was my error.

I was driving to pick up my granddaughter from school today, the sun was quite low in the sky, which made it difficult to see the brake lights of the car ahead clearly. They stopped for a cyclist, and I tapped the back of their vehicle. My front lamp is broken, which is very unfortunate as I just had it serviced. I am an older driver and I find the modern traffic around here a bit overwhelming at times, especially with the sun glare. I apologize for the incident and wish to settle the claim quickly.

So, I was trying to back out of a parking spot in the city center. It was super crowded and I was trying to be careful, but I didn't see the metal bollard behind me until I heard the scrape. It just left a scratch on the back bumper. Man, I feel so stupid. I should have asked my friend to guide me out because the visibility in that spot is terrible. Anyway, I just wanted to report it immediately so I don't have issues later when I try to get it fixed.

I was sitting at the outdoor cafe right next to where the incident happened. The driver was reversing slowly but did not see the bollard behind the vehicle. The car made contact, resulting in a scratch on the rear bumper. The driver was very visibly upset with themselves but remained at the scene to inspect the damage. It was clearly a genuine mistake made in a very tight parking area.

I was approaching the junction at a moderate speed. The other vehicle didn't yield at the stop sign, and our sides collided in the middle of the intersection. My side window glass shattered from the impact and there is a deep dent on the driver's door. It happened so fast I didn't even have time to react. I am just really concerned about the glass and the door repair, as I have an important business trip next week. It's just bad luck, but I'm glad that neither of us was seriously injured in the crash.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, moving slowly in the heavy traffic on Avenida da Boavista. Suddenly, the car in front stopped abruptly for a pedestrian, and I couldn't react in time despite pressing the brakes hard. My front bumper hit their rear bumper. I am really stressed because this is my only car for work, and I hope the insurance covers it. It was just a small lapse in concentration, and I feel terrible about the dent and the scratch on my bumper.

I was circulating in the outer lane of the Rotunda do Relógio trying to exit towards the airport. I was signaling properly, but perhaps the driver in the inner lane didn't see me as they were also moving to exit. We made side-to-side contact at a very low speed, maybe 10 km/h. It’s just a visible scratch along the side panel. I’m quite anxious about this whole process since I’ve never had an accident before, you know? Man, this is really not the start of the week I wanted.

I was in the second lane of the roundabout and intended to exit as well. The insured driver seemed to be in my blind spot as I began to move out of the circle. We bumped sides gently. It was an honest mistake by both parties, and there is just a minor scratch on the passenger door.

I was driving northbound on Avenida dos Aliados. There was a delivery van in the right lane that suddenly moved into my path without signaling. I swerved slightly to avoid a full collision, but my front passenger door clipped the rear of the van. There is a deep scratch and a small dent in the metal panel. I’m quite shaken up by the maneuver, but I managed to stop safely. I’ve been very careful on the roads, so this unexpected lane change caught me completely off guard.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the corner. I saw the BMW driving in the left lane when the delivery van made a sudden, sharp turn to the left without using an indicator. The BMW tried to brake and steer away, but they still made contact. It was definitely a surprise for everyone involved.

I was heading home after visiting my daughter in the afternoon. The sun was quite low, and it was shining directly into my eyes as I approached the intersection. I didn't see the light change in time, and I ended up bumping into the car waiting ahead of me at low speed. The impact shattered the rear light glass of their car and broke one of my front lamps. I feel just terrible about it, as I always try to be a very responsible and cautious driver.

I was stopped at the red light on Estrada Monumental. I felt a sudden impact from behind. When I got out, I saw that my rear light glass had shattered from the hit. The other driver was very apologetic and admitted they didn't see me because of the bright sunlight.

I was navigating the narrow streets of Porto. A courier motorcycle came around the corner very fast, and I had to brake hard and nudge to the side. I ended up brushing against a metal street pole. It resulted in a dent on my front fender. Man, this street is so tight, and you know how it is with these delivery riders appearing out of nowhere. I am worried about the repair costs, so I wanted to report this officially as soon as I got home.

I was driving along the riverside road. The traffic was stop-and-go. The driver ahead of me hit their brakes suddenly for no apparent reason, and I couldn't stop in time. My front right lamp is broken and there is a scratch on the bumper. It’s quite frustrating because I was maintaining a safe distance, but the suddenness of their stop made it impossible to avoid.
