I am reporting this now so we can sort out the insurance documentation efficiently and get the vehicle fixed.

I braked because I saw a plastic bag blow across the road and thought it was an animal. The driver behind me tapped my bumper. My car only has a small scratch, but the other car definitely suffered a broken lamp during the impact.

It was late afternoon on a busy day. I was inside the roundabout and a white vehicle entered from the right without checking, forcing me to turn the wheel quickly. I side-swiped the curb, which caused a dent and a large scratch on my front passenger side door and fender area. I’m really anxious about the insurance premium, but I didn't have another choice to avoid a bigger accident with the other vehicle. The process is a bit overwhelming for me right now, to be honest.

I was attempting to parallel park on Rua do Ouro. I miscalculated the swing of my rear bumper and tapped the car behind me. It wasn't a hard hit, but enough to cause a scratch and a small dent on their bumper. I feel terrible about it. I waited for the owner to return so we could exchange details properly. It was purely my error in spatial judgment during the parking maneuver. I hope this can be resolved smoothly through the standard insurance claim procedure.

I returned to my car to find the other driver waiting for me. They explained they had accidentally scratched and dented my bumper while parking. They were very polite and honest about the mistake. We agreed to exchange insurance information right there on the street.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving home from my weekly errands, it was about 4 PM. I was changing lanes to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. We made contact at about 30 km/h. It resulted in a scratch on my door and the glass of the side mirror shattered completely. I have been driving for thirty years and it is quite embarrassing, but these things happen when you are tired. I just want to handle this legally and correctly.

I was driving slowly towards the traffic lights near the Serralves Museum when the car ahead stopped quite suddenly. I tried to brake, but I didn't have enough time given the distance, and I ended up hitting his rear bumper at a very low speed. I feel terrible about it, honestly. My car has a visible dent on the hood now, right near the grill. I'm just so worried about how much the repairs will cost, as I really didn't mean for this to happen. It was just a lapse in my concentration.

I was attempting to park in a tight spot near the Praça do Comércio. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I miscalculated the turn and scraped the side of a parked vehicle. It was really frustrating because I was just trying to get to my lunch appointment on time. There is a clear scratch on my passenger door now, and I have already apologized to the owner who arrived shortly after. I am fully prepared to handle the insurance paperwork to cover the damage I caused to their car.

I returned to my car after running a few errands to find this person had scratched my driver-side panel while parking. They were very polite and admitted fault immediately, which was appreciated. It is just a minor surface scratch, but it is annoying to deal with the repair logistics.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Casa da Música, trying to exit towards the north. The traffic was quite heavy this afternoon. I attempted to switch lanes to make my exit, and I just didn't see the other car in my blind spot. There was a sudden bump, and we both pulled over immediately. My car has a noticeable dent and a scratch on the rear quarter panel. I am quite shaken up by the whole experience, as I have been driving for years without any incidents.

It was raining quite heavily while I was driving along the river. I put my signal on to change lanes, but the car in the next lane accelerated, and we made contact. My indicator lamp is broken now as a result of the collision. It was such a busy stretch of road, and I think the poor visibility made it very difficult to judge the speed of the other vehicle. I am just hoping the insurance process goes smoothly as I rely on my car for my daily commute to work.

I was maintaining my speed in the middle lane when the BMW tried to cut in front of me. I had nowhere to go due to the traffic. Their wing mirror hit my car, and I saw their lamp glass shatter onto the road. It was a stressful situation.

I was driving along the coastal road heading towards Cascais when a cyclist suddenly swerved out from the shoulder, forcing me to veer slightly into the lane to my left. In doing so, I side-swiped a passing delivery van. It was a split-second decision and unfortunately, it led to this accident. There is a long scratch and a shallow dent along the side of my car. I feel terrible about the whole situation, as everything happened so fast and I am still trying to process what exactly occurred.

I was walking my dog on the promenade and saw the whole thing. The Mercedes driver clearly tried to avoid the cyclist who entered the road unexpectedly. It was an unfortunate reaction, but the swipe against the delivery van was definitely caused by that sudden swerve.

I was coming home from my granddaughter's birthday party in Almada. I honestly thought I had the green arrow at the traffic light, but as I moved through the intersection, another vehicle appeared from the side. There was a loud impact, and the glass from my passenger side window shattered everywhere. I am physically fine, thank goodness, but I am very upset about the state of the car. It was such a nice day, and this accident really put a damper on the evening. My memory is a bit blurry on the exact timing, but it happened so fast.

I was looking for a parking space on this busy avenue. I was driving at maybe 10 km/h, looking at the street signs, and I failed to notice that the traffic had come to a complete standstill. I bumped into the car in front of me. It's embarrassing, really. The impact broke my front lamp and caused a dent on the bumper. I'm just so stressed about dealing with this, you know? I consider myself a careful driver, but this was just a total brain fade on my part today.

I was waiting in the queue of traffic on Aliados. A taxi driver behind me didn't notice I had stopped and lightly nudged my bumper. It wasn't a major hit, but it left a deep scratch across the rear panel. We both got out to inspect the damage and exchanged insurance details right there on the street. He was very apologetic about the distraction. I just need to get the estimate for the repair so I can move on with my week, as I have a very busy work schedule.

I was distracted for a moment checking my GPS for the next pickup. By the time I looked up, the Toyota had stopped. I tapped their bumper. I accept full responsibility for the scratch on their vehicle. I have already contacted my fleet manager to initiate the insurance claim process.

I was backing out of my residential parking spot this morning in a bit of a rush to get the kids to school. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar next to the exit. It happened so quickly, and I heard the sound of the metal scraping. My bumper now has a nasty dent and a significant scratch. I feel like such an idiot for not checking my rearview camera more carefully. This will be a real hassle to sort out before our trip this weekend. I am quite anxious about the repair timeline.

I was driving through a green light near the port area when another driver didn't stop at their red light. They clipped the front of my car, causing my headlight to shatter and the lamp to break into pieces. It was quite a shock, and the sound of the glass shattering was very loud. I am just thankful that nobody was injured. It has been a very long day, and I am not looking forward to the garage repairs. I am just a bit shaken up by the whole ordeal, man.

I misjudged the light cycle at the intersection. I am deeply sorry for the accident. I hit the Audi on the side. I saw their headlamp break and glass go everywhere. I have admitted my fault to the driver and am ready to cooperate with the insurance company.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour. Traffic was really heavy, and everyone was stop-and-go. Suddenly, the car in front of me slammed on the brakes because of a turning vehicle. I tried to stop, but the road was a bit slick from the morning mist. I couldn't stop in time and tapped the back of the car ahead of me. It was honestly such a stressful moment, man. I got out immediately to check, and there is a visible dent on my front bumper. I feel terrible about it, really.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio near the airport, attempting to exit towards the second lane. It was quite chaotic with taxis moving everywhere. I misjudged the distance of the vehicle in the inner lane as I was pulling out. There was a slight graze between our side panels. I pulled over to the side immediately to exchange details. I am a professional driver and I take full responsibility for this incident. There is a noticeable scratch running along the rear passenger door of my vehicle.

I was proceeding correctly around the roundabout when the Volkswagen merged into my path without checking his blind spot. I tried to veer slightly to the right, but we made contact. It was just a minor scrape on the paintwork of my side door. I was quite shaken, but we managed to pull over safely to clear the roundabout traffic.

It was getting dark and I was trying to parallel park near the Rua de Santa Catarina. The space looked big enough, but I miscalculated the angle of the curb and the proximity of the parked car behind me. I backed up just a bit too far and hit the front bumper of the car parked behind. I feel so embarrassed about it. I checked the damage and there is a dent and a deep scratch on the rear corner of my bumper. I have already contacted the owner to apologize.

I was driving along the Avenida 24 de Julho heading toward Cais do Sodré. The traffic was flowing at about 40 km/h. I signaled to change lanes to my left because I needed to turn soon. I suppose I didn't check my mirror thoroughly enough because a motorcycle was coming up fast. We made contact, and it caused his handlebar to hit my rear light assembly. The glass on the lamp is broken now. I am just really worried about the motorcyclist, though he seems fine, just shocked.

I was riding in the left lane when the car just moved over without looking. I tried to honk, but he didn't hear me over the city noise. I clipped his rear light, breaking the plastic cover. I didn't fall off, but it was a close call. The driver was very cooperative and stopped right away to check on me.

I was driving home along the Marginal near Cascais with the beautiful ocean view on my left, thinking about my grandson's birthday. The traffic ahead slowed down quite suddenly because of a tourist crossing the street. I pressed the brake, but I think I was a bit distracted by the sunset, and my foot didn't engage firmly enough. I bumped into the car in front. The force was enough to shatter the glass on the rear light and leave a dent in my hood. I am quite distraught as this has never happened in my years of driving.

I entered the intersection at Praça Marquês de Pombal on the green light, or at least I thought it was green. The car coming from the perpendicular road moved forward too early. We collided at a low speed. It was really chaotic with all the tourists and pedestrians around. There is a long scratch along my driver-side door where we made contact. I am just so anxious about how this will affect my insurance premiums, you know? It happened so fast I can barely remember the exact timing of the traffic signal.

I was walking near the metro station entrance and saw the incident. The Ford driver entered the intersection just as the light was turning yellow. The other vehicle didn't wait for the clear signal and pulled out. They hit each other's side panels. It wasn't high speed, but they definitely scratched each other's paint quite badly. It was just an unfortunate mistake by both parties.

It was raining quite hard on Rua da Constituição this afternoon. The streets were slippery and visibility was poor. I was slowing down behind a van that had stopped to make a delivery. Because of the slippery surface, my tires lost grip when I braked. I slid gently into the rear of the van. The impact wasn't heavy, but my front bumper pushed against their frame, and I noticed a crack in my headlight plastic. It's really frustrating, but at least nobody was injured in the incident.

I was driving northbound on the Avenida da República in the middle lane. I needed to move to the right lane to prepare for a turn. I signaled and checked my mirrors, but there was a blind spot issue with the SUV next to me. As I began to merge, we made contact. It caused a dent and some deep scratches on my front fender. It was a very brief moment of confusion. I am strictly following the formal reporting procedure as per your requirements for this type of collision.

I was driving in the right lane when the Mercedes attempted to merge. I didn't see his signal in time to adjust my speed. We made contact, resulting in a dent on my door and some paint damage on his fender. It was clearly a mutual misunderstanding of lane positioning in the heavy traffic flow.

I was trying to maneuver into a very tight parking space on Rua do Ouro. I know this street is notoriously narrow, but I thought I had enough clearance. I miscalculated the turn and grazed the metal bollard on the edge of the sidewalk. There is a long scratch on the side panel of the car now. It's just a silly mistake on my part, but I wanted to report it honestly so I can get it repaired through the policy. I was feeling a bit rushed because of the traffic behind me.

location: Alameda das Linhas de Torres, Lisbon

statements.text: I was approaching the roundabout on Alameda das Linhas de Torres. I looked to my right, but I failed to notice the small car already in the roundabout. I accelerated to enter and hit the side of his vehicle. I am quite panicked about the cost of the repair. My front bumper has a large dent and the signal lamp is broken. I have been driving for over forty years, and I really do not know how I missed seeing him there. I am terribly sorry for the disruption I caused.

I was already inside the roundabout when the Citroën entered without stopping. He struck the side of my car. My door has a significant dent, and the trim is damaged. It was a stressful experience, but the other driver was very apologetic and admitted his mistake immediately after the collision occurred.

I was driving around the roundabout at the Boavista square during the morning rush. The traffic was crawling, maybe 15 km/h. Suddenly, the driver ahead stopped abruptly because someone cut in front of them. I braked as hard as I could, but my car still rolled forward and tapped their bumper. It was an honest mistake and I feel terrible about it. My front bumper has a visible dent now from the impact. I am just really stressed about the insurance process, you know? I hope it is not too much trouble to fix.

I was trying to parallel park near a café on Rua de Santa Catarina around 3:00 PM. I misjudged the distance between my rear quarter panel and the car behind me. I was moving very slowly, just a few km/h, when I felt a light graze against the other car. There is a visible scratch on my paintwork now. It was completely my fault, I was a bit distracted by my phone navigation. I have already exchanged contact details with the other driver and everything is documented properly.

I was sitting in my car finishing an email when I felt a nudge from behind. The other driver apologized immediately. She had been trying to park and just didn't see how close she was to my rear bumper. There is a small scratch on my bumper trim. We were both calm and agreed to exchange information for the insurance report.

It was pouring rain on Avenida 24 de Julho. I was in the middle lane, moving at about 30 km/h, and I signaled to change to the left lane. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the visibility was poor due to the weather. I didn't see the van in my blind spot. We made contact, and now there is a noticeable dent and a long scratch down the side of my passenger door. I am quite shaken up by the whole situation, as I really didn't intend to cut anyone off.

I was driving down the avenue when the Peugeot suddenly swerved into my lane without checking properly. Given the heavy rain, I tried to brake, but we still sideswiped each other. My side panel is scratched and dented as well. It was clearly just an unfortunate accident caused by the terrible weather conditions this afternoon.

I was driving over the bridge in slow-moving traffic. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard. I tried to keep a safe distance, but I was distracted for a split second by the GPS. My front left lamp is broken from the impact with their rear bumper. I'm really anxious about the cost of the repair. I've lived here for forty years and have never had an accident like this before, so I'm feeling quite flustered. I have the insurance documents ready for review.

I was approaching the intersection when the traffic light turned yellow. I decided to stop, but the road was quite slippery. The driver behind me didn't react in time and slid into the rear of my car. The impact was strong enough that my rear window glass shattered upon collision. It was very loud and scary. I am just a student, and I am very worried about how this will affect my insurance premiums. I have never dealt with something like this before.

I was following the Citroën closely and when the light turned, she braked quite suddenly. I stepped on my brakes, but the road was slick from the rain. I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper made contact with her rear, causing her glass to shatter. I feel terrible, but it was just a genuine case of not being able to stop on wet pavement.

I was reversing out of a parking spot near the downtown area, moving at maybe 5 km/h. I thought the path was clear, but I didn't notice the post right behind me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had backed into it. There is a deep scratch on the rear bumper. I am quite embarrassed by this, it was a lapse in my concentration. I should have checked my sensors more carefully. I'm reporting this to get it repaired quickly as the car is fairly new.

I was sitting on the terrace of a nearby restaurant and saw the whole thing. The driver was backing up slowly and simply didn't see the bollard behind the car. It was just a minor accident, no one else was hurt, and the driver seemed very upset and apologetic about the damage caused to their own vehicle.

I was driving down the avenue during the lunch hour. Another driver was attempting a U-turn and did not notice me in the right lane. We sideswiped each other as they pulled out. There is a long scratch along the side of my driver-side door. The other driver stopped immediately, and we agreed that it was just a misunderstanding of the road signals. I'm documenting this to ensure both our cars are repaired correctly, as it was a confusing intersection.

I was turning, and I admit I misjudged the speed of the approaching traffic. It was a hectic moment with a lot of cars. I sideswiped the Renault as I was moving into the lane. I have a scratch on my side panel. I am fully taking responsibility for the incident. It was not intentional, just a bad judgment call.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout when a vehicle coming from the second exit merged too early. I was already in the outer lane, and they just clipped my rear fender, leaving a noticeable dent. I have been driving for over forty years, and this is the first time I have been involved in such an incident. It was quite a shock, to be honest. The other driver was very cooperative, and we settled the paperwork right there on the side of the road.

I miscalculated the gap while exiting the roundabout. The Kia was closer than I initially realized. I felt the contact and stopped immediately to inspect the damage. I caused a dent to their rear side. It was clearly my fault, and I apologize for the inconvenience this caused the driver.

I was pulling into a parking space near the stadium. I was going very slowly, but I didn't see the concrete pillar because of the shadows. I hit it with my front left corner. My lamp is broken and there is a deep scratch on the bumper. It’s super frustrating because I am always so careful, you know? Being a young driver, this really stresses me out. I just want to get this fixed through my insurance as quickly as possible without any further hassle.

I was driving home from work, just moving at about 20 km/h in slow traffic, when the car in front of me suddenly stopped for a pedestrian. I hit the brakes, but I didn't have enough distance to stop completely and tapped their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly. My bumper has a significant dent now, and I am quite worried about how this is going to affect my insurance premiums moving forward. I hope they are okay, man, this whole situation is just really stressful for me right now.

I was proceeding normally when the traffic ahead signaled to stop. I came to a full halt, and moments later, I felt a heavy impact from behind. It was quite sudden. When I stepped out, I saw that the driver behind had impacted my rear bumper, causing a noticeable dent. We exchanged details calmly.

I was trying to park in a tight space near the square this morning. I miscalculated the angle while reversing and accidentally scraped the side of the parked car next to me. I feel so clumsy; I have been driving for years and never had an incident like this. There is a long, visible scratch along my rear door panel where I made contact. I stayed by the vehicle until the owner arrived so we could sort out the insurance papers properly. It was an honest mistake and I feel bad.

I was navigating the roundabout, moving to the second exit, when another vehicle merged unexpectedly from the inner lane. I tried to steer away, but their front fender hit my side, causing a scratch and shattering my indicator lamp. The other driver seemed just as surprised as I was. It all happened in a split second at about 30 km/h. I am really anxious about the repair costs, as the lamp assembly is quite expensive, and I am not entirely sure how the liability will be shared here.

I was in the roundabout and thought the lane was clear to move over, but I failed to check my blind spot thoroughly enough. I made contact with the BMW as I shifted lanes. It was definitely my fault. I caused a scratch on their side and broke their indicator light. I apologized immediately to the driver.

It was raining, and visibility was quite poor around the city center. I was maintaining a steady speed of 40 km/h in the right lane when a van pulled out from a side street without looking. I swerved slightly to avoid a direct hit, but the van still clipped my front quarter panel. There is a deep dent and a scratch where the metal was pushed in. I have been driving in Porto for forty years, and the rain today made everything so much worse, you know how the cobblestones get.

I was walking to the nearby cafe when I saw the Toyota driving at a normal speed. The van just pulled out abruptly from the side street, giving the Toyota driver no room. I watched as the van scraped the side of the car, leaving a dent and a scratch. The Toyota driver was clearly doing his best to avoid the collision.

I was approaching the intersection with the green light. I think the other driver might have misjudged the timing of the yellow signal. As I crossed, they entered the junction and struck my front bumper, which broke my headlamp. It all happened so fast, man, I was just heading to the grocery store, you know? Now I have this broken lamp and I am worried about whether the car is safe to drive until the shop opens on Monday. It is just super frustrating and I am really stressed about the paperwork.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was transitioning lanes to get ready for the upcoming turn. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the car in the lane to my right. As I started to move, I felt a slight resistance and heard a scraping noise. I immediately pulled over to assess the damage. There is a significant scratch on my passenger door. I am a very careful driver usually, so this is quite embarrassing for me. I have already contacted my insurance agent to see how we handle this according to Portuguese law.

I was driving in the right lane when the Mercedes ahead started merging into me. I honked, but it was too late to avoid the contact. We both pulled over safely. My vehicle has some minor paint transfer, and the Mercedes has a long scratch on its door. We exchanged phone numbers and details.

I was navigating the underground parking facility here at the venue. It was quite busy and the lighting was dim. While attempting a three-point turn, I didn't see the concrete pillar behind me and reversed into it at a very low speed. My rear bumper sustained a visible dent. It is a bit disappointing as I take very good care of this car. My grandson was in the car with me, and he was quite startled by the noise, but thankfully no one was hurt in the minor impact.

I was stopped in traffic on this very busy street. The traffic was bumper-to-bumper, moving at maybe 5 km/h. Suddenly, the van behind me didn't stop in time and rear-ended me. The impact was quite jarring, and it shattered my rear glass window. It was so unexpected, man, I was just sitting there waiting for the traffic to clear. I am really worried about the shards of glass everywhere, it is a huge mess. I have to get this cleaned up and the window replaced as soon as possible.

I was driving behind the Ford when I looked down for a second to adjust my GPS. By the time I looked up, the traffic had stopped and I couldn't stop in time. I hit the rear of the Ford. My front bumper is slightly bent, and their back window glass shattered from the impact. I feel terrible.

I was proceeding through the intersection when another car failed to respect the stop sign. It happened so quickly. They clipped my side, which caused my side lamp to break and left a noticeable crack in my side mirror housing. I was quite shaken up, but I managed to keep my cool and exchange details with the other driver. I am professional about these things, so I made sure we took photos of everything before moving our vehicles. It is unfortunate, but accidents do happen in city traffic.

I was waiting to cross the street when I saw the whole thing. The black car didn't stop at the intersection sign and hit the side of the Audi. I saw the lamp break and the mirror housing crack. The Audi driver was very composed, and I offered my contact information as I saw exactly who was responsible.

I was driving along the main road near the river when another vehicle attempted to overtake me on a very narrow stretch. They didn't leave enough space and side-swiped my rear quarter panel. It caused a deep dent and a crack in the plastic trim. I have been doing this commute for fifteen years and never had such a situation. The driver stopped, and we discussed the incident. I have all the documentation ready. I just want to get the vehicle repaired properly so I can get back to my normal routine.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy, as usual. I was moving at maybe 20 km/h when the car in front of me suddenly hit their brakes because a pedestrian stepped out unexpectedly. I tried my best to stop in time, but my foot slipped on the pedal, and I gently bumped into their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it because I was distracted for a split second, and now there is a noticeable dent on my hood from the impact. I hope the other driver is okay.

I was stopped completely because of the traffic light turning red at the intersection. Suddenly, I felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me tapped my bumper, causing a small dent on my rear trim. They seemed very apologetic and shaken up by the whole situation.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, trying to take the third exit towards the airport. I honestly thought the lane next to me was clear, but as I started to merge, I heard a horrible scraping sound. It turns out I misjudged the distance of the vehicle in the outer lane. I stopped immediately to check, and there is a deep scratch along my passenger side door. It was a stupid mistake on my part, and I'm really stressed about the insurance paperwork, honestly, dude, this is my first accident and I'm just so worried.

I was trying to parallel park on the side of Rua Augusta this afternoon. The spot was quite tight, and while I was reversing, I turned the wheel a bit too early. I scraped the parked car next to me. I feel so embarrassed about it. There is a small dent on the rear panel of my car and a noticeable scratch near the wheel arch. I have left my contact details on their windshield and called my insurance company right away to report the damage correctly.

I was sitting at the cafe terrace nearby. I saw the Toyota trying to park and they just miscalculated the angle, hitting the stationary vehicle beside them. It was a very low-speed impact, just enough to leave a mark and a dent on both cars.

I was traveling along the EN125 near Faro at about 70 km/h. It was a bright day, but I was blinded by the sun for a second as I was checking my mirror to change lanes. I moved into the lane before the car coming up behind me had fully passed. We clipped each other near the taillights. My rear lamp is broken and completely shattered on the housing. I am just relieved nobody was hurt, but I'm worried about the repair costs because my car is fairly new.

I was heading through the intersection at Avenida da República when another driver entered from the side street, seemingly failing to notice the stop sign. It happened so fast. There was a loud crunch and I felt the impact on my side. Now there is a massive dent on my door and the window glass shattered completely. I'm shaking a little bit from the shock, and I have to get my glasses fixed too because they fell off during the sudden stop.

I honestly thought I had the right of way as I pulled out. It was a moment of complete confusion and I failed to see the car coming from my left. I accept full responsibility for the collision. The impact caused damage to their door and broke their side window.

My wife and I were driving down the Avenida 24 de Julho heading towards the waterfront for lunch. It was a beautiful, clear day. The driver in the adjacent lane suddenly swerved to avoid a delivery truck that had stopped illegally. In the process, they swiped the entire length of my passenger side. It left a very deep scratch along the doors. We managed to pull over safely afterward, but the traffic was absolute chaos. I’m just glad we didn't end up swerving into the tram tracks, that would have been a disaster.

I was navigating the narrow streets in Cedofeita when I had to reverse to let a bus pass. In my rush to move out of the way, I didn't see the concrete post behind me. I backed right into it at low speed. It caused a significant dent on the trunk lid and one of my rear lamps is completely broken. It was a foolish mistake caused by the pressure of the narrow road and the bus driver honking. I just want to get this fixed so I can drive normally again.

I was commuting along the Eixo Norte-Sul during peak hour, traveling at about 40 km/h. Everything was stop-and-go. The vehicle in front of me braked very hard for a debris item on the road, and despite my best efforts, I bumped their bumper. It was definitely my fault for not keeping enough distance. There is a visible dent on my front bumper. I feel terrible for the other driver, as they were just minding their own business in the middle lane.

I had to brake abruptly because someone had dropped a box on the highway. The driver behind me couldn't stop in time and hit me. It was a minor bump, just a dent on my bumper, but it was quite a shock during the morning rush.

I was entering the roundabout on Avenida da Liberdade. I was looking for my exit, and in the confusion, I didn't realize the car in the inner lane was also turning. We both tried to exit at the same time, and our mirrors and side panels clipped. There is a long scratch down my door and my indicator lamp is broken. I feel quite stressed about this because I've been driving for years without a single accident, and now this happens.

I was walking on the sidewalk nearby and saw the two cars try to occupy the same space while exiting the roundabout. It was a slow-speed collision, but the impact was enough to break the light on the BMW and leave a long mark on the side.

I was finishing up my grocery shopping on Rua dos Combatentes. I was reversing out of my parking space, and I was so focused on the children running nearby that I failed to check my blind spot properly. I backed into a stationary van parked behind me. It left a clear dent on my rear bumper. I immediately checked to see if anyone was in the van, but it was empty, so I contacted the local police to report the incident and get the owner's information.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5 PM during the peak traffic hour. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because a taxi pulled out into our lane without signaling. I slammed on my brakes, but the road was slightly damp, and I couldn't stop in time, making contact with his bumper. It was just a small bump, honestly, but I feel terrible about it. I have a dent on my front hood now, and I really hope this isn't going to be too expensive to fix, man. I'm just so stressed out by all this paperwork.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio trying to exit towards the airport. A blue van was in the outer lane and simply didn't see me as I was attempting to pull ahead to my exit. The driver swerved slightly and clipped the passenger side of my car. I stopped immediately, and luckily we were going very slow, maybe 15 km/h. There is just a long scratch along the passenger door panel. I am quite worried about how this affects my premium, as I really try to be a careful driver on these busy roundabouts.

I was in the outer lane of the roundabout and honestly didn't check my mirror correctly before pulling toward the exit lane. The driver of the Seat was right there in my blind spot. I heard a small scrape as our panels touched. It was completely my fault for not being more vigilant in such heavy traffic.

I was trying to park in a very tight spot near the square. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar on my left while reversing. I wasn't going fast, maybe 5 km/h, but I heard a crunch and realized I had hit the pillar. I have a nasty dent and a long scratch on the rear quarter panel. It's so frustrating because I'm usually very careful when parking in these old city centers. I am worried about the repair costs, as the damage looks quite deep on the metal frame.

I was driving slowly up the narrow Rua de Santa Catarina. A delivery truck was parked on the side, and as I tried to pass, another car came down the street heading towards me. I moved slightly to the right to give him space but miscalculated the distance to a nearby utility pole. My side mirror hit the pole, which caused the lamp to break and left a scratch along the side. It was just a stupid mistake on my part, and I feel quite foolish for not stopping to wait for the other car.

I was walking down the street and saw the whole thing. The Citroën driver was trying to be polite by moving over to let the oncoming car pass. Unfortunately, he misjudged the proximity to the post on the sidewalk and clipped it. It was a very low-speed impact, but the lamp definitely shattered immediately.

I was crossing the intersection at Avenida da República after the light turned green. A cyclist suddenly swerved across the intersection from my right, likely to catch the sidewalk. I braked instinctively, but he clipped the side of my front door. The impact was enough that it caused the passenger side window to shatter completely into pieces. It was a terrifying moment, and I hope the cyclist is okay. My car is full of glass now, and I just don't know how to handle this clean-up properly.

I was heading home on the EN125 when traffic just stopped dead. It was a sunny afternoon, but there was a lot of glare coming off the road. I pressed the brakes, but I think I was a bit slow to react because of the sun in my eyes. I tapped the back of a van ahead of me. There is a clear dent on my hood and my right headlight lamp is broken. I've already exchanged insurance details with the other driver. Honestly, I'm just shaken up more than anything else.

Traffic was stop-and-go as usual on the 125. The lady behind me just didn't stop in time. She hit my rear bumper. My vehicle didn't suffer much, but she clearly had some damage to her front end, including a broken light and a dented bonnet.

Well, my grandson told me to be careful, but I suppose these modern cars are just too wide for these narrow streets. I was coming back from the market near the center and tried to make a turn. I suppose I hugged the corner a bit too close and grazed the stone wall of the building. It left a rather long scratch on my driver's side door. I feel quite embarrassed by the whole thing, honestly. I've been driving for forty years and never had a scratch like this happen before.

I was driving along the Avenida 24 de Julho in the middle lane. I checked my mirror and signaled to move into the left lane. I thought the lane was clear, but as I started to merge, a car in that lane accelerated. We made contact side-to-side. There is a visible dent on the rear panel and a deep scratch where the paint was rubbed off. It’s annoying because it’s a new car, but it was just a blind spot issue and I take full responsibility for the merger.

I was cruising in the left lane when the Nissan started moving into my space. I honked, but he kept coming over. We sideswiped at about 30 km/h. His rear bumper caught my side panel. It was a simple accident, nothing too dramatic, but we both have some cosmetic damage on the sides.

It was raining quite hard, and the streets were slick. I was waiting at the junction to turn right, and as I moved forward, a scooter skidded on the wet pavement. I panicked and steered sharply left, hitting a parked delivery bike and a post. My headlight lamp is broken and there is a significant dent on the front fender. I am just a student, you know, and I'm really worried about what the insurance company will say. I was driving under the speed limit, I swear, but the road was just treacherous.

I had just finished a client meeting and was pulling out of a parallel parking spot on Rua da Prata. I thought I had cleared the car parked behind me, but as I turned the wheel, I heard a terrible scraping sound. It turns out I didn't pull far enough forward before turning. I have a long scratch across my back bumper. It is quite annoying as I really pride myself on my driving, and I am already late for my next appointment. I will call the shop later today to get an estimate.

I was sitting at the cafe terrace right next to the parking spot. I saw the Mini trying to leave. The driver started turning the steering wheel way too early while pulling out, and I heard the plastic scratching against the other car's bumper. It was definitely just a minor parking error.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving slowly, maybe 15 km/h, when the car in front of me suddenly hit their brakes because a cyclist cut across. I reacted as fast as I could, but my foot slipped slightly on the pedal and I gently bumped into their rear bumper. There is a noticeable dent on my hood where the impact happened. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just such a distracted moment in the middle of a stressful commute.

I was trying to park in a very tight spot near the Baixa district. I thought I had enough clearance while turning the wheel to back into the space, but I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed the side of my passenger door against the wall. It’s definitely a long, visible scratch running along the paintwork. I am really upset with myself because I take such good care of this car, but the space was just poorly marked and really narrow.

I was navigating the roundabout, moving at about 20 km/h, intending to take the third exit. Another vehicle suddenly merged from the inner lane without checking their blind spot properly. I tried to steer away, but their back fender clipped my front corner. The impact caused my headlight to shatter and there is a deep scratch on the bumper. It happened so fast, like, I didn't even have time to honk, man. I’m just really stressed about the repair costs and how long the car will be in the workshop.

I was circling the roundabout and honestly, I thought I had enough space to move to the outer lane. I didn't see the Seat Leon in my blind spot. I hit their corner with my rear quarter panel. I stopped immediately to exchange details. It was a complete misjudgment on my part during a busy afternoon in Porto.

It was raining quite hard this morning. I was in the middle lane, and I checked my mirrors to change into the right lane to turn. I clearly missed the van coming up fast in that lane. As I moved over, the side of my car hit their front panel. We both pulled over safely. There is a significant dent and a long scratch on my driver-side door. I feel so bad; I usually check my mirrors twice, but the visibility with the rain was just really, really poor today.

I was stopping at the pedestrian crossing near the square. The driver behind me, a young man, wasn't paying attention and didn't stop in time. He tapped my rear bumper at a very low speed, but it was enough to cause my rear windshield glass to shatter completely. I was quite shaken because I had my groceries in the back. I just hope the glass doesn't get everywhere inside the upholstery while I wait for the tow truck to arrive.

I was walking my dog across the street when I saw the Toyota stop for the pedestrians. The car behind it, a silver hatchback, simply didn't brake in time. The impact was slow but strong enough to break the rear window of the Toyota. It was clearly just a lapse in concentration by the driver behind.

I was driving along Estrada Monumental heading towards the hotel district. The road is quite narrow and parked cars make it tricky. A delivery truck was coming in the opposite direction and didn't pull over enough. He swiped the side of my car as we passed each other. There is a long, ugly scratch along the passenger side. I am retired, so I was just out to buy some bread, and this happens. It really ruined my morning, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork.

I was stuck in traffic on Avenida da Liberdade. The car behind me just didn't see that I had come to a full stop. They rear-ended me at about 10 km/h. My rear bumper has a major dent and the left taillight is completely broken. I'm just so frustrated because this car is my pride and joy, and now I have to worry about the repair being perfect. The other driver was very apologetic, but that doesn't fix my bumper, does it?

I was looking at my GPS to find a parking garage and I looked up too late. I saw the Mercedes stopped, but I couldn't stop in time on the wet pavement. I hit them square in the back. I feel awful about the damage to their lamp and the dent. I've already shared my insurance details.

I was maneuvering out of a parallel parking spot. I looked in my rearview mirror but I think I had a blind spot because I didn't see the pole near the sidewalk edge. I turned too sharply and scraped the entire rear door against the metal pole. There is a deep scratch now. I’m really annoyed with myself. I’ve been driving for twenty years and never had a silly incident like this. It's just one of those bad days where nothing seems to go right, you know?

I had a green light at the intersection. I entered the crossing cautiously, but another car tried to speed through the yellow light from the cross street. They hit my front side. My headlight is broken and there's a dent on the wheel arch. It happened so fast, I was quite shaken up. I'm just glad no one was hurt, but my car is in a bad state. It was clearly my right of way, and I don't understand why they decided to accelerate like that.

I was exiting the roundabout when a delivery van tried to squeeze into the same lane. They didn't see me and drove right into my passenger side. The impact was quite loud. My window glass shattered, and there is a large dent and scratch along the door panel. It was a very confusing situation because there was so much traffic. I’ve lived here for forty years and these roundabouts are always a nightmare during the morning rush. I'm just happy my grandson wasn't in the passenger seat today.

I was in the middle of the roundabout, trying to find my exit. I moved to the outer lane, not realizing the Skoda was already there. I hit their passenger door. I felt terrible immediately. I stopped right away to check on them and exchange information. It was entirely my mistake, I just didn't check the mirror carefully enough.

I was driving home from work along Avenida da Boavista, and the traffic was quite heavy as it usually is around 6:00 PM. I was slowing down because the car in front of me braked suddenly for a pedestrian crossing. I tried to stop in time, but the roads were a bit damp from earlier rain, and I bumped into the back of the car ahead. It wasn't a hard hit, but I got out and saw there is a dent and some scratch marks on my front bumper.

I was stopped at the red light near the roundabout when suddenly I felt a jolt from behind. It was a clear rear-end collision. The driver behind me apologized immediately and was very cooperative. We checked my rear bumper and confirmed a small dent and a long scratch on the paintwork.

I was trying to park in a very tight spot near Rua Augusta this afternoon. I thought I had enough clearance while reversing, but I miscalculated the angle against the car parked next to me. It was a very low-speed maneuver, man, I feel so bad about it. I got out and noticed I left a long, deep scratch on the side panel of the other car. I've already left my contact details on their windshield because I didn't want to just drive away, you know?

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the middle lane and intended to exit towards the airport, but I think I might have drifted slightly. The other car was coming up on my right side and we made contact. It happened so fast. My front side panel now has a noticeable dent and my turn signal lamp is completely broken. I am really stressed about the insurance paperwork, as this is the first time I have ever been involved in an accident like this.

The driver of the Peugeot seemed to lose track of their lane while exiting the roundabout. I was staying in my lane, but they clipped my front fender. My lamp is broken and there is a visible dent on the metal bodywork. The driver was very polite despite being clearly shaken by the whole incident.

It was midday and the sun was reflecting quite strongly off the asphalt on Avenida 24 de Julho. I was changing lanes to prepare for a turn and didn't notice the motorcycle coming up in my blind spot. I swerved back quickly but caught the side of their handlebar, which resulted in a long, ugly scratch along my passenger door. I am truly sorry, I should have checked the mirrors twice. I feel like such an idiot, I hope the rider is alright, they seemed shaken but okay.

I was leaving my granddaughter's school in Coimbra and moving quite slowly through the parking zone. I misjudged the height of a concrete post near the exit, which I didn't see because of the glare. I hit it at maybe 5 km/h. My front bumper suffered a nasty dent and the headlight lamp is broken. I am seventy-two years old and I have been driving for over fifty years, so this is quite embarrassing for me. My husband will surely have a lot to say about this when I get home.

I was walking past the school exit when I saw the silver Yaris tap the concrete pillar. The driver was moving at a very slow speed, but the impact was direct. I saw the front lamp break immediately, and there is a deep dent on the bumper. The driver seemed very upset and was looking at the damage when I walked by.

Traffic on Rua de Santa Catarina was stop-and-go. I was looking at my GPS to find a parking garage and didn't realize the driver in front of me had come to a complete halt. I braked as hard as I could, but I still slid into their bumper. The impact caused a significant dent on the rear of their vehicle. I am so worried about how much this will cost, man, I really should have been paying closer attention to the road instead of the screen.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving north on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo during the morning commute. The traffic was extremely dense. Another vehicle attempted to merge into my lane without signaling properly. I tried to accelerate to avoid a collision, but they clipped my side panel. I ended up with a deep scratch and a noticeable dent. It is very frustrating because I take excellent care of my car, and now I have to deal with this repair process. The other driver admitted fault immediately, which made things easier.

I was in the wrong lane and tried to move over. I didn't see the BMW in my blind spot. We made contact while shifting lanes. It resulted in a scratch and a dent on their side door. I take full responsibility for the mistake and am ready to provide all necessary details for the insurance claim.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was circling the Marquês de Pombal roundabout. A large delivery van was on my left side and didn't see me while taking the exit. They swiped the side of my car. My side mirror glass shattered completely. It was quite scary, honestly, because I thought they were going to push me into the central island. I am just relieved there was no major collision, but the shattered glass is everywhere and I'm worried about driving safely back home. I have all the van's information ready.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was traveling on Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa. The car ahead suddenly stopped for a dog running across the street. I managed to stop, but the person behind me didn't. They crashed into my rear. My rear lamp is broken and there is a large dent in the tailgate. I've lived in this neighborhood for forty years, and I've never seen such a sudden stop. It was a perfectly sunny day, but things like this just happen when you least expect them, don't they?

I was waiting at the bus stop and saw the dog run out. The first car stopped, the second one stopped, but the third vehicle failed to stop in time. It was a standard rear-end impact. The Citroën suffered damage to the rear, specifically a broken lamp and a dent. The police were not called, but the drivers exchanged information on the side of the road.

I was parallel parking on Rua da Prata. The streets in downtown Lisbon are so narrow, you know? I was being careful, but I accidentally brushed against the metal pole of a street sign. I heard a scraping noise and immediately knew I had caused a scratch on my rear bumper. I'm really anxious about the insurance premium increasing, but I know I have to report it correctly. It's just a small scratch, but it's annoying to look at every single day.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, just heading home after work. Traffic was quite heavy, and as the car ahead of me braked suddenly for the light, I tried to stop in time, but I misjudged the distance on the wet pavement. My front bumper hit the rear of the other car. It was quite a shock, honestly. I got out immediately to check, and I can see a clear dent and a deep scratch on the lower part of my hood where it met their bumper.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música when another driver attempted to exit from the inner lane while I was still proceeding forward in the outer lane. I tried to steer away, but there was no space. The contact happened right against my passenger side. It’s my first accident and I'm really worried about the repair costs, you know? The front passenger lamp is broken and there is a long scratch running along the side panel. It happened so fast, I didn't even have time to honk.

I was in the inner lane of the roundabout and perhaps miscalculated the exit. I turned towards the exit and did not realize the Seat was still there. I am sorry for the trouble caused; I accept full responsibility for the collision. My car also sustained some damage in the process.

I was parking near the luxury shops on Avenida da Liberdade this morning. The spot was quite narrow, and as I was reversing into the space, I misjudged the angle and scraped the rear quarter panel against a parked delivery van. It was a stupid mistake, and I feel terrible about it. I checked the area, and there is a visible scratch on the paintwork. I have already contacted the van owner to exchange insurance details since it was clearly my fault for not checking the side mirror properly.

It was a beautiful sunny afternoon in Baixa, and I was looking for a parking spot. I didn't see the concrete bollard at the edge of the pedestrian zone when I was turning sharply. I heard a loud crunch and realized I had hit it. I’m quite anxious about the whole process, man, this car is my pride and joy. The front headlight lamp is broken and there is a significant dent in the bumper. I really hope it's not too expensive to fix, everything is so stressful these days.

I was driving along the coast road toward Cascais when the driver in the lane next to me drifted into my path while trying to avoid a cyclist. I had to swerve, but we still ended up clipping each other's mirrors. It was a scary moment given the speed. Thankfully we both stopped safely on the shoulder. My car has a long scratch on the passenger side door. The other driver was very apologetic and admitted he didn't check his blind spot before moving over to the right.

I moved to the right because I saw a cyclist and got nervous. I didn't see the BMW beside me. I take full responsibility for the scratch on their door. I am just glad no one was hurt on the road today.

I was waiting at the traffic lights near the river in Praça do Comércio. The taxi behind me didn't stop in time, and he bumped into the back of my car. It wasn't a high-speed collision, but it definitely left a noticeable dent on my trunk lid. I’ve lived in Lisbon for forty years, and this is the first time such a thing happens to me right in the center. I am quite shaken up by the sudden impact, but the taxi driver was a gentleman and we sorted the paperwork quickly.

The traffic light turned red suddenly. I was distracted for a split second by the GPS, and I failed to brake in time. I hit the rear of the vehicle in front of me at about 10 km/h. I am fully at fault for this accident.

I was driving in the right lane on the Avenida and needed to change into the left lane to turn. I signaled and checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. We made contact, and it caused a nasty scratch on the side and a small crack on the plastic trim of my side mirror housing. I feel like such an idiot, man, I really should have checked twice. It's really bothering me because I just got the car detailed last week.

I was walking on the sidewalk and saw the whole thing. The Audi was changing lanes and didn't see the silver car coming up quickly from behind. They hit each other's sides at a very low speed. It was clearly a simple mistake during the lane change.

I was reversing out of a parking space in front of the town hall. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but there was a concrete flower pot that I hadn't noticed. My rear window hit the edge of it and the glass shattered completely. It was really loud and gave me such a fright. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident, honestly. I've already called a glass repair service to come and sweep away the debris and replace the window as soon as possible.

Traffic on the bridge was stop-and-go as usual during the morning rush. The person in front of me braked very hard, and despite my best efforts, I couldn't stop in time and collided with their bumper. I feel terrible about it; the impact caused a dent in my hood and the left headlight lamp is broken. I was just on my way to a business meeting, and this has really ruined my day. I have provided my insurance information to the other driver to settle the claim.

Traffic stopped suddenly because of a stalled truck further ahead on the bridge. I managed to stop, but the driver behind me could not. They hit me from behind. My rear bumper is damaged, and I agree with their account of the accident.

I was maneuvering into a tight spot on a very busy Rua de Santa Catarina. The street is so narrow and full of pedestrians that I got distracted. I didn't see the metal post on the sidewalk and clipped it with my front passenger door. It resulted in a deep scratch and a dent in the bodywork. I'm sixty-seven years old, and I suppose my reflexes aren't what they used to be. It is just a very inconvenient situation, but I am glad nobody was walking there at that moment.

I was driving home from work along Avenida da Boavista during the evening rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy and moving in stops and starts. Suddenly, the car in front of me braked very hard because a delivery van had stopped abruptly. I tried to brake, but I didn't have enough distance and I bumped into the back of a silver Peugeot. It wasn't a high-speed impact, maybe 15 km/h, but I can see a visible dent on my bumper and a few noticeable scratches on the paintwork near the trunk lid.

It was raining quite heavily this morning near the airport. I was navigating the roundabout, moving from the inside lane to exit, when another driver attempted to merge into my path too early. We collided at low speed as I was turning. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it's just so stressful. My front right indicator lamp is broken from the impact against their side door. I think I was following the rules, but I'm just really worried about how much this is going to cost to fix, man.

The road was very slippery due to the rain. I was exiting the roundabout and did not see the other car approaching in the outer lane. We made contact at the point of the indicator. My door has a scrape, and I noticed his lamp was broken during the incident.

I was attempting to park my Fiat 500 in a rather tight spot on Rua Augusta. I had just finished my morning errands and was trying to reverse into a space near the café. I suppose I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar near the curb. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed the rear passenger door against a low wall. There is a long, deep scratch running across the panel. It is quite frustrating, as I usually pride myself on my careful driving.

Traffic on Avenida 24 de Julho was moving along at about 40 km/h. I signaled to move into the right lane to prepare for my turn. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the blind spot, and there was a small city car right there. We sideswiped each other as I moved over. There is a dent in my rear quarter panel and a long scratch along the door. It was an honest mistake and I feel quite bad about causing this trouble for the other driver today.

I was walking on the sidewalk and saw the BMW attempt to change lanes. The driver of the small city car was already partially alongside. They bumped, causing a dent and scratch to the BMW. It was clearly an accidental collision caused by the BMW driver failing to see the other car.

I was crossing the intersection on the EN125 when the traffic light turned amber. A van coming from the perpendicular road started moving too early and clipped my front bumper. It was such a sudden shock. My front headlamp is shattered and there is glass shatters all over the asphalt. I am just really shaken up by the whole experience. I was trying to be safe, but everything happened so fast and I didn't have time to maneuver out of the way before the impact occurred.

I had parked my car near the market in downtown Faro while I went to buy some fresh produce. When I returned, I noticed a significant dent on the rear bumper. I suspect someone hit me while parking or reversing. I asked a nearby shopkeeper, and he mentioned seeing a delivery truck maneuvering earlier. It is very disheartening to find damage on your car when you have parked legally, but I suppose these things happen in busy areas like this. I have photos of the dent for the report.

I was driving down Avenida da República at about 30 km/h. The traffic light ahead turned red, and the car in front of me stopped suddenly. I applied my brakes, but I was distracted for a split second by the GPS, and I tapped the back of their vehicle. There is a small crack in the plastic trim of my front bumper. I am quite embarrassed by my lack of attention, but I want to ensure the damage is assessed correctly and the third party is compensated.

I had stopped completely at the red light when I felt a jolt from behind. The Audi driver was very apologetic. The impact resulted in a crack on their front bumper cover, while my vehicle luckily only sustained minor paint damage which I am not claiming for.

I was navigating the narrow streets of Cedofeita to find a pharmacy. The road is very tight, and a large bus was coming from the opposite direction. I tried to pull over as much as I could to the right, but the curb was high and I ended up scraping the side of my car against a stone boundary wall of an old house. I really regret not being more careful with the positioning, as there is a long, ugly scratch across the passenger side doors.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: My son and I were headed toward the center of Lisbon around midday. The traffic was dense. A motorcycle zipped between the lanes, and the car in front of me had to slam on their brakes to avoid them. I was too close and ended up hitting the rear bumper of the vehicle ahead. My front lamp is broken and there is a visible dent on the hood. I am quite worried about the insurance premiums, and I just hope the repair process is straightforward.

I stopped abruptly because a motorcyclist cut me off. The Mercedes behind me couldn't stop in time. I saw that his lamp was broken and the hood had a dent. It was an unfortunate accident caused by the erratic motorcycle driver who fled the scene.

I was parking near the square early this morning. The sun was very bright and reflecting off the pavement, making it difficult to see the low bollards placed at the edge of the pedestrian zone. I miscalculated my turn and hit a bollard with my front bumper. It caused a significant crack in the plastic and a deep scratch on the paint. I feel quite silly about it, honestly, as I have parked here many times before without any issues. It was just a momentary lapse in my judgment.

I was driving around the Boavista roundabout during the evening rush hour, moving at maybe 20 km/h. Everything was quite chaotic, and I was trying to exit toward Avenida da Boavista. Suddenly, the car on my right side tried to cut into my lane without checking the blind spot properly. I slammed on the brakes, but I still felt a bump on my side panel. I pulled over safely immediately. It's just a dent, but honestly, I'm really worried about the repair costs since I need the car for my daily commute to work every single morning, you know?

The traffic was moving very slowly near the train station. I was keeping a safe distance, but the driver behind me failed to react when the cars in front stopped abruptly. I felt a firm impact on my rear bumper. When I checked, I could see that my tail lamp was broken and there were some deep scratches on the bumper paint. It was quite a stressful situation for me, and I honestly didn't expect someone to be so distracted while driving in such heavy city traffic, but these things happen, I suppose.

I was driving behind the Peugeot when the traffic flow stopped suddenly. I tried to apply my brakes in time, but the road was a bit slippery due to the afternoon drizzle, and I slid forward. I hit the back of the Peugeot gently. I accept full responsibility for the broken lamp and the surface scratches on the bumper. It was an honest mistake on my part, and I have already provided my insurance details to the other driver.

I was parking my car in a standard spot near the university area. It was mid-morning and the light was quite bright. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar slightly while reversing at a very low speed. I felt a scraping sound and immediately stopped. Upon inspection, I noticed a long scratch along the side of the rear door. I am quite embarrassed by this, as I have been driving for many years without any issues, but I must report it correctly to ensure the insurance process is handled professionally and promptly.

I was traveling at about 60 km/h on the EN125 when the car in the lane next to me started merging without signaling. I tried to swerve slightly into the shoulder to avoid a direct hit, but the sides of our cars still made contact. It left a clear dent and some ugly scratches down the passenger side. I am just so shaken up because I have my kids in the car usually, though thankfully they weren't with me today. It was just a really scary moment on such a busy road.

I was driving along the EN125 and I misread the lane markings. I thought I had enough space to move over, but I didn't see the Nissan in my peripheral vision until it was too late. I heard the scraping sound and we both pulled over onto the shoulder. I apologize for the dent and the paint damage caused to the other vehicle. I will cooperate fully with the insurance company regarding this incident.

It was just a normal Tuesday morning, and I was passing through the intersection when another car came through a bit too fast from the side street. They didn't stop at the yield sign properly. The impact hit the side door quite hard, causing the window glass to shatter into pieces. I was really surprised by how quickly it happened. I am lucky I was wearing my seatbelt. I am quite upset about the broken glass everywhere inside the cabin, but at least nobody was injured in the incident.

I was waiting to cross the street when I saw the whole thing happen. The Volvo had the right of way, and the other vehicle definitely failed to yield at the intersection. The sound of the glass shattering was quite loud. It was clearly an accidental collision caused by a lack of attention from the driver of the other car. I stayed to make sure the Volvo driver had my contact details for their insurance claim.

Driving down Rua de Cedofeita is always difficult because the streets are narrow and people often park poorly. I was navigating around a delivery van, and while turning, I miscalculated the swing of my car and tapped the corner of a parked vehicle. It was a very minor impact, but it was enough to break the rear lamp of the other car. I feel terrible about it. I have already left my information on their windshield and I am calling the insurance company now to handle the claim properly.

I was cruising along the Marginal toward Cascais, enjoying the coastal view, when the car to my left decided to change lanes suddenly. I was maintaining about 50 km/h. They didn't see me and drifted into my space. We made contact, resulting in a long, nasty scratch along my door. I was quite frustrated at the moment, but we both pulled over into a lay-by immediately. I have been very careful with this car, and it is disappointing to see this damage, but I want to ensure the claim is documented correctly.

I am so sorry about the accident. I was distracted by the GPS for a split second and I moved into the right lane without checking my mirrors properly. I felt the contact immediately and knew I had made a mistake. I have confirmed that I am responsible for the scratch on the side of the Mercedes. I have provided my policy number and details to the driver so that we can resolve this matter through our respective insurers without any issues.

I was entering the roundabout near Praça de Espanha, moving quite slowly as the traffic was heavy. A vehicle exiting the roundabout didn't look and clipped my front bumper area. It caused a noticeable dent in the metal and shattered the plastic of my front lamp. I've been driving for fifty years now, and I must say, the way people drive these days is quite stressful. I just want this settled fairly so I can have the repairs done and get back to my usual errands.

I had stopped at a pedestrian crossing to let some people pass, and the driver behind me didn't notice I had stopped. It was a clear, sunny day, so I think they were just looking at their phone or something. They hit me right in the rear. It created a significant dent in my tailgate. I am really worried about the insurance process because this car is my only way to get to my kids' school. I just need it fixed as soon as possible, man.

I was walking on the sidewalk and witnessed the Ford Focus stop for the pedestrians. The driver behind them didn't stop in time and rear-ended them. It was a clear case of not paying attention to the road ahead. I saw the dent on the Ford's rear end immediately after the collision. Both drivers seemed shaken but were civil to each other while exchanging information.

I was attempting to reverse into a parking space on Avenida da Boavista, but I didn't see the concrete bollard behind me until it was too late. I was going very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but the contact was enough to cause both a dent and a scratch on my rear bumper. I feel quite foolish about the whole incident, to be honest. I am reporting this now so that my insurance company can guide me on which authorized workshop I should take the car to for the necessary repairs.

I was driving around the roundabout near the airport, and honestly, the traffic was super heavy, man. I was moving at maybe 20 km/h, just trying to exit toward the A1. I didn't see the guy in the next lane clearly because the sun was reflecting off his windshield. I drifted a bit, and I felt a scrape. When I pulled over, I saw a long scratch along my rear passenger door. I am just really stressed about how much this is going to cost me to repair, you know?

It was raining quite heavily this morning on my way to work. I stopped for the red light near the Casa da Música. The driver behind me didn't stop in time and slid into the back of my car. I got out and saw the impact. There is a noticeable dent on my trunk lid and my left rear lamp is completely broken into pieces. It was a very unfortunate accident, but the other driver was apologetic and stayed on site to exchange the insurance details with me.

I was following the car in front, but the road was extremely slick from the rain. I braked when I saw the light turn red, but my tires lost grip on the wet pavement. I bumped into the back of the Peugeot at about 10 km/h. I feel terrible about it, but I could not avoid the collision.

I was trying to park my car in a tight spot near the city center. I misjudged the distance from the stone pillar on the sidewalk. As I was turning the wheel to tuck the back in, I heard a horrible scraping sound. I panicked and reversed, which only made it worse. I stopped and saw a deep scratch and a dent on my front bumper. I am quite embarrassed by this, but it was just a silly mistake on my part while trying to fit into a very narrow space.

I was driving along the coast road, enjoying the view of the ocean, when a van attempted to overtake me on a very narrow section of the street. I felt a sudden jolt as our mirrors clipped each other. I pulled over as soon as I could. Upon inspection, I found a horizontal scratch running along the length of my driver-side door. I have been driving for thirty years and I always try to be cautious, so this was a bit of a shock to my nerves today.

I was passing the small Fiat but I clearly underestimated the narrowness of the lane. I clipped the side of their car with the side of my van. I apologize for my lack of caution; I was in a rush to make a delivery, but I acknowledge the mistake was entirely on my part.

I was heading home from the market, driving slowly, maybe 30 km/h. I reached the intersection and thought the way was clear, but another driver appeared suddenly from the right. I tried to brake, but we made contact. There is a large dent on my side panel and the glass on my passenger window is completely shattered. It was a loud noise and honestly, I am still shaking a bit, dude. Everything happened so fast, and I'm really worried about the repair costs for the door.

I was trying to turn around in a narrow street downtown. I didn't see the bollard behind me. I was going very slow, probably less than 5 km/h, but I reversed right into it. The impact caused the rear tail lamp to shatter completely. I am quite upset as I usually pride myself on my driving, but the street was poorly lit and I just didn't see it until it was too late to hit the brakes. My granddaughter was with me, and we were both quite startled by the sound.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus. I saw the driver trying to navigate the turn and hit the bollard. It was a very low-speed impact, but the tail light definitely broke upon hitting the metal pole. The driver appeared to be moving quite cautiously, just a simple accident.

I was driving in the middle lane, heading towards Cais do Sodré. Traffic was moderate, around 40 km/h. I signaled to move to the left lane, and I checked my mirrors. However, another car was in my blind spot. As I started to change lanes, we made contact. It wasn't a major crash, but I noticed a long scratch on my front quarter panel after we stopped. I feel terrible, as I am a professional and pride myself on being a safe driver, but I definitely missed seeing them.

I was driving in the left lane when the BMW began to merge into my path. I tried to honk my horn, but there wasn't enough time to move over. We sideswiped at a low speed. It was a simple error in observation, and no one was hurt.

The traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it usually is during the morning commute. We were all moving at about 15 km/h, stop and go. The car in front of me suddenly braked for a reason I couldn't see, and I hit my brakes hard, but not hard enough. I rear-ended them. The impact caused a dent in my hood and my right front lamp is broken. I feel absolutely awful about it, man, I was just distracted for a second looking at the river view.

I parked my car on the avenue to attend a meeting. When I returned an hour later, I noticed a fresh, deep scratch on the rear bumper. Nobody left a note, but I assume someone scraped me while trying to pull out of the neighboring spot. It is very frustrating to find your car damaged like this when you weren't even there to prevent it. I have to get it fixed, so I am reporting it to the insurance as soon as possible.

I work in the building nearby. I saw a silver car pulling out of the spot around 10:30 AM and it definitely looked like they clipped the back of the parked Audi. They didn't stop to check. I saw the scratch on the bumper as soon as they drove away.

I was driving home after work around 18:30. Traffic was quite heavy near the roundabout, and I was stopped behind a silver car. Suddenly, I felt a sharp jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and realized a van had failed to stop in time and hit my bumper. I am really worried about the repair costs, man. It's just a big dent in the rear, but it looks terrible and I need this car for my commute every single day. I'm honestly so stressed out about dealing with all this paperwork, you know?

I was parking my car carefully in the designated spot near the pedestrian area. I thought I had enough room, but I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar. I heard a scraping noise and stopped immediately. When I got out to look, I saw a long scratch along the passenger door. I am truly embarrassed that I let this happen to my vehicle, but I wanted to be honest about the incident as soon as it occurred to ensure the insurance process goes smoothly.

I was sitting at a nearby café terrace when I saw the Fiat driver attempting to park. The maneuver seemed a bit tight for the space, and the driver hit the side of the vehicle against the pillar. It was clearly a low-speed accident and not malicious at all. I saw the driver get out immediately to inspect the scratch on the door paint.

I was driving along the EN125 when a vehicle in the left lane moved into my path without signaling. I tried to swerve, but we still made contact. There is a dent and a deep scratch on my driver-side quarter panel. It was a frightening experience, to be honest. I was just heading to pick up my kids from school, and suddenly this happened. The other driver was cooperative and we pulled over to exchange details right away. I am just hoping the repairs are handled quickly so I can return to my routine.

I admit I did not check my blind spot thoroughly before changing lanes. I didn't see the Peugeot until it was too late and we scraped each other. I take full responsibility for the collision. I can see the dent and scratch on the side of their car, and I am ready to provide all necessary documentation to the insurance company to settle this claim properly.

I was passing through the intersection when the traffic light turned yellow. A vehicle coming from the side street didn't stop in time and hit the front corner of my car. My headlight assembly was smashed, so I have a broken lamp. I am very upset because this is my only car. It happened so fast, and I'm still shaking a bit from the impact. I just want to make sure the claim is filed correctly so I can get back on the road.

My goodness, it was such a busy morning at the square. I was navigating the roundabout, moving at about 20 km/h, when I felt a sudden scrape along my rear bumper. I suspect the other driver didn't judge the rotation correctly. It is just a surface scratch, thank heavens, but it is certainly a nuisance to deal with at my age. I've been driving for over forty years, and you rarely see such impatience on the roads these days. We stopped safely and filled out the form right there on the sidewalk.

I misjudged the radius of the roundabout and unfortunately grazed the other car. It was a genuine error on my part during the morning rush. The contact was very light, just resulting in a minor scratch on their bumper. I apologized to the lady driving the Nissan and we exchanged our contact information to initiate the claim process immediately.
