They slammed into my rear, which pushed me into the car in front. The force of the impact caused a dent on my bumper, a deep scratch on the tailgate, and the rear glass shattered from the secondary impact. I'm just so stressed about this; it’s a long bridge, and being stuck there after an accident is a nightmare, you know?

I was trying to park my Golf on the street near the Bolhão market around 10:00 AM. I was reversing quite slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but I clearly misjudged the distance to the car behind me. I felt a slight scrape as I made contact with the other vehicle's rear bumper. I feel terrible about the whole thing because I know how annoying these minor parking mishaps are, but I immediately stopped and checked the paintwork, noticing a long scratch along my rear door panel.

It was pouring rain this morning on the way to the airport. While exiting the roundabout, the van in front of me braked suddenly because of a cyclist. I tried to brake, but I just slid a bit on the wet tarmac and bumped into their bumper. My headlight hit their tow bar. It’s definitely a dented hood and my right lamp is broken. I'm really sorry about this mess, I should have kept a larger distance given the weather conditions.

The insured driver hit me from behind while we were exiting the roundabout. The traffic was heavy and I had to stop abruptly due to a road obstacle. They couldn't stop in time on the wet road. My bumper is fine, but their car shows a clear dent on the front and a shattered light unit.

Driving on the EN125 is always stressful with all the tourists. I was moving to the right lane to exit and I guess I miscalculated the positioning of the vehicle already in that lane. We sideswiped each other at about 40 km/h. My rear quarter panel now has a long scratch and a shallow dent from where we made contact. It was a very unfortunate maneuver on my part, and I've already exchanged all my insurance details with the other driver.

I was driving straight in the exit lane when the BMW tried to merge without checking. They sideswiped the side of my car. I stopped immediately. Their car sustained damage to the quarter panel, showing both a scratch and a dent, while I unfortunately have similar paint damage on my side door.

Goodness me, I have been driving for forty-five years and never had an issue until today. I was just trying to pull into the tight spot near the cafe, and I suppose I turned the wheel a bit too early. I scraped the side of the car against the concrete pillar of the parking structure. It is just a surface scratch, but it really hurts to see my little car damaged like this. I was so careful, but the lighting in the garage was very dim.

The traffic was absolute chaos near the docks today, like always. I was stopped at the red light when the car behind me didn't stop in time. They hit me right in the rear. The force was enough to shatter my tail light glass and break the lamp housing completely. It was such a sudden jolt, you know? I’m really worried about the repair, it’s a brand new car and seeing that glass on the road is just so upsetting for me, man.

I entered the junction when the signal was green. A van crossed from the left, seemingly not seeing the red light. I swerved to avoid a direct T-bone, but we still clipped each other. My front bumper has a dent and a deep scratch. I am quite annoyed because I was driving very carefully, but accidents like these are so hard to avoid when others are not paying attention to the signals.

I admit I was distracted by my radio and I might have entered the junction late. I saw the Audi and tried to brake, but we clipped bumpers. The Audi has a dent and a scratch on the side of the front bumper. I am taking full responsibility for the error.

We were crossing the bridge in heavy traffic. The car in the next lane drifted into my path, and I didn't have enough room to swerve away because of the median. We sideswiped at about 60 km/h. It resulted in a long, nasty scratch along my driver-side door. I’m just glad it wasn't a worse accident, given the high speed and the narrow lanes on the bridge. I've got the photos of the damage and the other driver's details ready.

I was driving down the Avenida da Boavista around 5 PM, and the traffic was quite heavy as usual. The driver in front of me suddenly braked hard because a pedestrian stepped onto the crossing. I tried my best to stop, but I tapped the rear of their car. It was really stressful, and I felt so bad about the situation. There is a visible dent on my bumper from the contact. I am really worried about how this process will work with the insurance company since this is my first accident.

I was coming to a complete halt for a pedestrian crossing the road. The driver behind me did not stop in time and hit my rear bumper. My vehicle now has a clear dent where the other car made contact. Everything happened very quickly during the afternoon commute.

It was pouring rain this morning near the Rotunda da Boavista. While exiting the roundabout, I misjudged the distance and swiped the side of a van. I feel so embarrassed about it. There is a deep scratch on my side panel and my front indicator lamp is broken from the impact. The other driver was very patient, but I am quite shaken up by the whole ordeal. I just hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, man, because I'm just trying to get to work.

The other driver was exiting the roundabout and did not notice me in the lane. They scraped the side of my van. I noticed their indicator lamp was broken and there was a scratch on their door. It was just a simple miscalculation in the heavy rain.

I was attempting to park near the Avenida dos Aliados. I was trying to back into a spot, but I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar. My rear bumper made contact, resulting in a noticeable dent. I am so frustrated with myself; I have been driving for years and never hit anything like this. It’s just a small dent, but I want to get it fixed as soon as possible because the car is relatively new and I take good care of it.

I was walking by the parking area and saw the driver of the Fiat 500 hit the stone pillar while reversing. It was a slow-speed impact, but it clearly caused a dent to the rear bumper of the vehicle. The driver seemed very upset about the mistake.

I was driving down Rua Augusta at a very low speed. Another vehicle pulled out from a side street without looking properly. I couldn't stop in time to avoid them, and I clipped their rear wing. The impact caused the glass on my side mirror to shatter completely. I was shocked and confused when it happened, honestly, because I didn't expect anyone to pull out like that. I just want to ensure everything is documented correctly for the insurance so the glass repair can be authorized.

I was driving along the EN125 when the car in front suddenly slowed down for a turning vehicle. I slammed on the brakes, but unfortunately, I still hit them. It was a stressful morning, honestly, and I feel terrible because I was distracted by my GPS for a split second. My headlight lamp is broken and there is a dent on the hood. I am quite worried about the expenses here. I have all my documents ready, and I am waiting for the inspector's report.

I was slowing down to turn onto a side road when I was rear-ended. The driver hit me with enough force to break their lamp and dent their hood. I am fine, but it was quite a sudden shock to the system on such a busy stretch of road.

I was driving home on the Avenida da República after a long day at the office. The traffic was extremely dense. I attempted to move into the center lane, but I misjudged the gap between my vehicle and the taxi next to me. We made contact, which resulted in a long, visible scratch along my passenger side door. It was purely an error in judgment on my part. I am ready to provide all necessary details to resolve this claim as efficiently as possible for both parties.

I was navigating the narrow streets near Rua de Santa Catarina. It was quite chaotic with people walking everywhere. As I was turning a corner, I got too close to a parked car and scraped my side panel. I am so annoyed at myself, you know? There is a dent and a deep scratch on the side. I should have been much more careful in such a tight space. I just hope the repair isn't too costly because I am on a tight budget lately.

I saw the Opel Corsa trying to turn the corner on the narrow street. The driver misjudged the turn and sideswiped a parked car. I saw a dent and a scratch left on the Corsa's panel. It was clearly a mistake by the driver in the tight urban space.

Well, I was driving near the Praça do Comércio, just enjoying the view, really, and I suppose I wasn't paying enough attention to the vehicle stopped in front of me at the crossing. I tapped their bumper with mine. It was a very low-speed maneuver, but it was enough to break my front indicator lamp. I feel quite foolish, as I have been driving for forty years and haven't had a single issue until this afternoon. My hands were shaking a bit afterwards, but I am fine.

I was heading to the station on the Avenida 24 de Julho. The driver in front stopped unexpectedly, and I didn't have enough time to stop my vehicle fully. I nudged the back of their car. It resulted in a dent on their bumper and a few scratches on mine. I am really worried about this incident because I need my car for work, dude. I’m just waiting for the insurance assessment to see how long the repairs will take. I hope it’s a quick process.

I was stopped in traffic when I felt a jolt from behind. The other driver clearly didn't stop in time. My bumper has a dent and the other car clearly has a scratch from the impact. Everything seems straightforward regarding liability.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic came to a sudden halt near the intersection. I braked as hard as I could, but the road was a bit damp from earlier rain, and my Golf just didn't stop in time. I bumped into the car in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. When I got out to check, I saw a dent on my front bumper and some deep scratches along the edge. It was entirely my fault, I just didn't leave enough distance.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a significant jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror just as the other driver was pulling over. We both got out and inspected the damage, and it was clear that the impact had caused a visible dent and several scratches on their bumper. The driver was very cooperative and immediately admitted they had misjudged the braking distance on the wet pavement.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: Honestly, I feel so terrible about this. I was trying to merge into the middle lane on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, and man, the traffic was just super heavy. I checked my mirror, but I guess I missed the car coming up alongside me. I heard this awful scraping noise, like metal on metal, and knew I messed up. I pulled over immediately. My car has a long scratch running along the passenger side door now. I'm just so worried about how much this is going to cost to fix, dude.

I was navigating the Rotunda da Boavista during the morning rush, which is always quite a chaotic experience for everyone involved. I was moving from the inner lane to exit when I unfortunately misjudged the position of the van next to me. It happened so quickly that I didn't even have time to react. I pulled over just past the exit to inspect the damage and saw that my front indicator lamp was broken completely. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident, but I am glad no one was injured.

I was standing near the metro station entrance waiting for my bus when I saw the two vehicles collide at low speed while navigating the roundabout. It appeared to be a simple miscalculation of lanes. One vehicle clipped the other, and I could clearly see a lamp broken on the smaller car. Neither driver seemed aggressive, they both pulled over properly to exchange their insurance details in a calm manner.

I was trying to park my car on a narrow street in Coimbra. It was getting dark, and I didn't see the concrete bollard near the curb properly. I reversed slowly, thinking I had more space, and ended up hitting it. The impact caused a noticeable dent and a deep scratch on the rear bumper. I feel really foolish for not being more careful, but I was just exhausted after a long day at work. I have already contacted my insurance agent to see how we should proceed with the repairs.

It was midday, and the sun was really glaring off the road. I was entering the junction on Avenida da República when the car to my right didn't stop at the sign. I slammed on the brakes, but we still connected. My side window glass shatter was instantaneous from the impact of the side mirror hitting it. I'm shaken up, but thankfully okay. I just hope the other driver is alright too. It's been a very stressful day, and I'm not entirely sure how all the paperwork needs to be filled out.

The sunlight was blinding at the intersection, and I honestly didn't see the stop sign until it was too late. I moved into the lane, and we collided. I feel terrible about it. I saw that their window had glass shatter from the collision force. I am ready to accept full responsibility for the accident as it was clearly my oversight due to the poor visibility and my lack of attention at the stop line.

I was driving through the narrow streets of Cedofeita to get to my granddaughter's school. It's always busy there, you know. I was looking for a spot and, well, I miscalculated the distance to the parked van on my left while I was trying to turn the corner. It was only at about 5 km/h, but I still left a dent on my front wing. I've been driving for forty years and I'm usually much more careful, but I suppose everyone makes a mistake once in a while.

I was driving along the coast on Avenida Marginal. The traffic was moving at maybe 40 km/h. Suddenly, the car in front of me swerved and then braked hard. I tried to avoid them, but I clipped their rear corner. My headlight housing is now a lamp broken, and there is a significant dent on the hood. I am really worried because this is a new car. I've exchanged details with the other driver and we both agreed to file this through our respective insurance providers as soon as possible.

I saw a cyclist suddenly pull into the road, so I had to make an emergency maneuver. I came to a halt, and the BMW behind me couldn't stop in time. It was an unfortunate situation all around. When I checked the other vehicle, I saw their front lamp broken and a large dent. We are both cooperating fully with the police report to ensure everything is documented correctly for the insurance companies.

I was in the right lane on the Alameda, heading towards the stadium. I signaled to change lanes because I needed to take the next exit. I checked my blind spot, but the other car must have accelerated unexpectedly in that gap. We made contact, which resulted in a long scratch along the rear passenger door. It was just one of those things that happens in city traffic. I feel bad about the damage, but I'm thankful it was just cosmetic and not a more serious collision.

Traffic was crawling across the bridge at a snail's pace, maybe 10 km/h. I got distracted for just a split second looking at the river view, and I rolled forward into the back of a taxi. It was such a light tap, but the plastic bumper on my Smart car took a dent. I apologized profusely to the driver. We pulled onto the shoulder safely to exchange details. I've never been in an accident before, so I'm quite anxious about the whole process, man.

We were in stop-and-go traffic on the bridge when the driver behind me tapped my bumper. It wasn't a hard hit, but it did leave a dent on their own vehicle. I didn't see any major damage to my taxi, but we exchanged information regardless. The driver was very apologetic and clearly shaken by the event. I told them not to worry, as these things happen on the bridge all the time.

I was trying to maneuver into a very tight space near the square. I thought I had cleared the concrete pillar, but I heard a sharp sound. Upon inspection, I realized I had hit the pillar with my bumper, resulting in a visible crack in the plastic trim. I've only had this car for a few months, so I'm quite disappointed in myself. I've taken photos of the damage for the insurance claim and will be contacting a repair shop to get an estimate as soon as I get home.

I was driving home from work around 6:00 PM in heavy traffic on Avenida da Boavista. The car ahead of me stopped suddenly because of a delivery van double-parked on the side, and even though I pressed the brakes, I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit their rear bumper. I feel terrible about this, I was just tired and distracted for a second, but I did hit them. There is a noticeable dent on my hood and some deep scratch marks on the trim.

Traffic was crawling along at about 20 km/h. I had to brake quite hard when the vehicle in front of me slowed down unexpectedly. The gentleman behind me clearly didn't react fast enough, and he tapped the rear of my car. I got out to check and saw the dent and scratches on his bumper. It was clearly an honest mistake, just a standard low-speed incident during rush hour.

I was trying to park in a very narrow spot in Coimbra near the university. I thought I had enough room, but I was so nervous because there were cars waiting behind me, and I turned the wheel too early. I scraped against the side of the car already parked in the space. I'm so embarrassed, it's just a long scratch on the rear door, but it looks quite ugly. I hope the owner doesn't mind too much, I've already left my contact details on their windshield.

It was early morning and the streets were still a bit damp. I was driving along the avenue when the driver next to me tried to merge into my lane without checking their mirrors. I tried to swerve, but we still made contact. It was all very quick, like a blur, man. My door has a large dent now and there is a nasty scratch running along the passenger side panel. I am just really stressed about how long the repairs will take.

I was in the right lane and honestly, I didn't see the BMW coming up from behind. I checked my mirror, saw nothing, and started to move over. We side-swiped each other at about 30 km/h. It was a complete miscalculation on my part. We both pulled over immediately to exchange insurance details. My own door is damaged as well, so I understand the frustration.

Oh dear, I was driving along the coast road, enjoying the view of the Atlantic, and perhaps I wasn't paying enough attention to the car in front of me slowing down for the speed camera. It was a beautiful day, bright sun, but the glare made it hard to see the brake lights. I hit the rear bumper of the car ahead. The impact was quite loud; my front lamp is broken and my windshield suffered a glass shatter from the vibration and the minor jolt.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was moving through the intersection after the light turned green. A driver coming from the cross-street didn't stop at their red light and clipped my front bumper. It happened so fast, like I couldn't even react. I am just really worried about the damage, as I only got this car last month. There is a significant dent on the fender where they hit me. I am quite shaken up by the whole situation, honestly.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the pedestrian light. The Mercedes was definitely driving at a normal speed when the green light appeared. The other car simply accelerated through the red light and caused the collision. It was clearly the fault of the second driver. I saw the dent occur on the side of the Mercedes immediately upon impact.

I was driving home to Sintra on the IC19 during the evening. Traffic was moving at about 70 km/h. I signaled to move into the center lane, but I miscalculated the speed of the car already in that lane. We made contact, and I ended up hitting their rear quarter panel. My headlight assembly took the brunt of it, so the lamp is broken, and there is a dent on my front wing. I feel awful about this, I just didn't see them.

I was in the middle lane of the IC19. The Volvo ahead of me started to merge, but they just didn't check their blind spot properly. I tried to move over, but they still made contact with my vehicle. It caused a bit of a mess, but luckily no one was injured. I saw their lamp broken and the dent on their front fender after we pulled over.

I was stuck in traffic, and I reached down to grab my water bottle. When I looked back up, the car in front had stopped for a pedestrian. I couldn't stop in time and just tapped them at a very low speed. My windshield has a glass shatter now, likely from the shock, and there is a scratch on the bumper. I am so annoyed with myself, man, I should have just waited to drink. It's totally my fault, I wasn't focused.

I was going around the roundabout and someone tried to cut inside me from the outer lane. I didn't have anywhere to go and we made contact. It was quite a stressful moment. My front lamp is broken, and there's a dent and a scratch on the passenger side door. I have lived in Porto my whole life and people drive like crazy here sometimes, you know? I just want the car fixed and back to normal, it's my only vehicle.

I was cycling near the roundabout when I saw the Audi inside the circle. The other car took the turn too sharply and tried to force their way in, which caused the impact. The driver of the Audi did everything they could to avoid it. I saw the damage to the lamp and the side of the car immediately after they stopped.

I was driving towards the city center during the morning rush hour when the traffic suddenly stopped. I tried to brake, but my car slid slightly on the damp pavement and hit the rear of the car ahead. The bumper now has a visible dent and several deep scratches from the impact. I am so incredibly worried about the repair costs, as I really need this car for my daily commute to university. I feel terrible about the whole situation, honestly, I was just trying to pay attention to the road.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The driver behind me couldn't stop in time. My rear bumper is scratched and dented from the contact, but luckily nobody was hurt in the collision. It was a standard urban accident, very unfortunate for both of us on a rainy morning in Porto.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, and I must have misjudged the distance when exiting. I accidentally clipped the rear light of the van in the outer lane as I moved to turn off. The impact broke my front left lamp completely. I have been driving for over forty years, and I truly cannot believe I made such a silly mistake today. It was quite chaotic, and I feel quite shaken by the incident, though I am thankful that there was no damage to the bodywork or the chassis.

The traffic on the EN125 was very heavy as usual. I attempted to change lanes to avoid a slow-moving truck, but I didn't see the car in my blind spot. We made contact, causing a dent and several long scratches along my side door. I am feeling extremely anxious right now because I have never been in an accident before. I should have checked my mirrors twice, but everything happened so fast and I am just hoping the insurance process doesn't become too complicated for me.

I was cruising in the middle lane when the other driver suddenly drifted into my lane without signaling. I tried to swerve, but we still sideswiped. My car has a dent and some scratches on the passenger side panel. It was clearly a momentary lapse in concentration, but the damage is quite frustrating to deal with.

I was slowly pulling out of a parking space in the center of Porto. Due to the limited visibility and the glare of the morning sun, I failed to notice a concrete pillar nearby. My front bumper hit the pillar directly, causing a significant crack in the plastic molding. This is very inconvenient as I use this car for client meetings throughout the city. I am clearly at fault here, and I am documenting everything so the repairs can begin as soon as possible through my insurance provider.

I was checking my navigation system for a moment when the traffic in front of me halted unexpectedly. I could not brake in time and hit the vehicle ahead. The force of the impact resulted in a dent on my hood and a broken lamp on the right side. It was a very stressful situation, and I am quite upset with myself for being distracted. I have been driving for over twenty years and I know better than to look at my phone, but here we are.

I was waiting to cross the street near the plaza when I saw the BMW hit the car in front of it. It looked like the driver of the BMW was looking down just before the impact occurred. The collision wasn't at a high speed, but it definitely damaged the front of his car, specifically the light and the bumper area.

The traffic was quite heavy on the way to the office. I moved to the left lane to make a turn, but I clearly misjudged the distance to the adjacent vehicle. We ended up colliding, which resulted in a dent and scratches on my rear door. I am a very punctual person, and this whole incident has really thrown off my schedule for the day. I have provided my insurance details to the other party so we can process this claim formally and correctly.

I was driving steadily in the left lane when the Audi driver attempted a merge. I was already alongside him, so there was nowhere for me to go. My car sustained a dent and scratches from the impact, but fortunately, no one was injured during the maneuver. It was a standard insurance matter.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was stopped at the traffic signal when a sudden loud noise occurred behind me. A car had failed to stop and hit my rear bumper quite hard. The impact caused the rear glass to shatter into pieces on the road. I am still quite shaky from the event; it really gave me a fright, you know? My grandkids were in the car earlier today, but thankfully they weren't with me during this incident. It is just such a messy situation for a Thursday afternoon.

The Circunvalação road is notoriously busy and confusing with all the lane changes. I was trying to merge right, and I didn't see the other car in the lane. We sideswiped each other, which resulted in a dent and multiple scratches on the passenger side of my vehicle. I am feeling very anxious about the repair process, dude. I have never dealt with an insurance claim before and I really don't want my premiums to go up because of this one mistake.

I was driving within the speed limit when the Skoda suddenly cut into my lane. I didn't have enough time to react, leading to the side-swipe. My car has some scratches and a dent on the driver side door. It's a real shame, but at least we can get it sorted out through the insurance companies.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was trailing a silver car, and when the driver ahead suddenly braked for a cyclist crossing the road, I didn't have enough distance to react. I managed to slow down significantly, but my front bumper still made contact with their rear. I am really stressed about this because I haven't had an accident in ten years, and now I see there is a noticeable dent on my hood and bumper.

I was minding my own business when I had to brake quite hard because a cyclist appeared out of nowhere in the middle of the road. I felt a bump from behind shortly after. When I pulled over to check the damage, I saw a dent on the driver's bumper. It was an honest mistake by the other driver, as the traffic was stop-and-go.

I was trying to park my car near the Rossio square area this morning. It was very crowded, and while I was maneuvering into a tight spot, I misjudged the distance to a concrete pillar on my right. I was moving at maybe 5 km/h, but I heard a scraping noise immediately. I checked the side of the car and found a long, deep scratch along the passenger door panel. I feel so clumsy for doing this, it's just really frustrating to have this happen on a Monday morning.

I was navigating the roundabout at Praça Mouzinho de Albuquerque. It was raining quite a bit, and the road surface was slippery. I was attempting to exit when a car on my left seemed to lose a bit of grip and drifted into my lane. We collided at a very low speed. I can clearly see a dent and a scratch on my rear door panel. I am just really worried about how the insurance process works and if this is going to be very expensive to fix.

The rain made the roundabout very slippery today. I was in the inner lane and tried to turn, but my car slid slightly towards the right lane where the Peugeot was driving. We made contact at low speed. There is some bodywork damage, specifically a dent and a scratch on the side of their car. It was just an unfortunate accident due to the weather conditions.

I was driving down Avenida 24 de Julho in the lane closest to the parked vehicles. Suddenly, a door from a parked car swung open right in front of me. I tried to swerve to the left, but I still grazed the edge of the door with my side mirror and rear panel. There is a visible scratch running along the passenger side. I really hope the other driver is okay, but this is such a nuisance to deal with right now, like, I have so much work to get back to.

I was driving slowly, perhaps 20 km/h, looking for a pharmacy on Rua de Santa Catarina. A delivery van in front of me stopped suddenly to unload, and I didn't stop in time. My front right corner hit their rear bumper. The impact caused my front lamp to break immediately. Back in my day, cars were a bit sturdier, but the plastic these days just cracks under any pressure. It's a real bother, especially since I had my grandson in the car and he got a bit of a fright.

I was walking down the street and saw the whole thing. The small Citroen was moving quite slowly but clearly didn't see the van stop abruptly. The impact was light, but enough to break the lamp on the car's front. Both drivers seemed shaken but were very polite to each other while exchanging information.

I was changing lanes on the Avenida da República to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the vehicle in the adjacent lane. As I started to pull over, I heard a grinding sound and realized I had made contact with the other car. There is a dent and a scratch on the side of my front wing. I feel awful about this, I really pride myself on being a safe driver, so this is quite embarrassing and stressful for me.

I was crossing the intersection at Rua de Cedofeita when another car coming from the cross-street didn't respect the yield sign. We collided at the intersection corner. The impact shattered the glass of my passenger window and broke the indicator lamp on the side. I am very shaken up by the whole experience. My daughter was in the passenger seat, but thankfully she wasn't hurt, just scared by the sound of the glass shattering near her.

I apologize, I completely misjudged the intersection and didn't see the other car until it was too late. I hit the side of their car. Their window glass shattered and the side lamp broke from the impact. I am taking full responsibility for not yielding, and I hope everyone is doing alright despite the damage to the vehicles.

I stopped briefly to drop off some groceries on Rua do Almada. When I was pulling out from the curb, I didn't realize how close the concrete planter was to the front bumper. As I turned the steering wheel to pull into traffic, the plastic part of my bumper caught the edge of the planter. I heard a distinct crack and found that the bumper plastic had actually cracked. It's a small issue, but I want to get it settled through the insurance since the car is still quite new.

I was standing near the storefront and saw the driver pull out. They turned a bit too sharply and hit the heavy concrete planter on the sidewalk. There was a loud cracking sound, and the front bumper definitely has a crack in the plastic now. The driver stopped immediately, looked at the damage, and seemed quite upset with themselves.

I was driving home from work around 6:00 PM in heavy Lisbon traffic. The flow was quite stop-and-go near the Marquês de Pombal square. Suddenly, the car in front of me braked hard because of a pedestrian, and I didn't manage to stop my Renault in time. I hit the back of the other car at a very low speed. My front bumper now has a noticeable dent and quite a few deep scratches from the impact. I am really worried about the insurance costs; this is the first time I've ever had a real accident.

Traffic was dense, and I had to stop abruptly. The driver behind me didn't react quickly enough and bumped into my rear bumper. My car sustained a dent and some scratches on the plastic trim. We pulled over safely to the side of the avenue to exchange information.

It was raining cats and dogs here in Porto this morning, and the narrow streets of Cedofeita were incredibly slick. I was trying to maneuver my Fiat into a very tight parking space near the local café. I misjudged the distance to the parked car next to me and ended up grazing the side panel. It was a really stupid mistake on my part, and I feel terrible about it. I checked the damage, and there is a visible scratch along the door, nothing else luckily.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, which is always chaotic. As I was exiting, a van drifted into my lane without warning. I tried to swerve, but we made contact with our side panels. My front lamp is completely broken and there is a large dent on the front fender. I am feeling quite shaken by the whole event, man. It just happened so fast, and I didn't see the van coming until we were already hitting each other. I hope this gets sorted out quickly.

I was in the roundabout and perhaps I didn't check my mirror well enough before changing lanes to exit. I felt an impact on my side. I stopped immediately and saw that the other driver's front lamp was broken and there was a dent on their fender.

The EN125 is always busy, especially in summer. I was driving along the coast when the driver to my left moved into my lane without signaling. I had no time to react and we sideswiped. The impact left a deep scratch and a long dent down the passenger side door. I was quite frustrated, you know, because I was heading to a family lunch and now my whole afternoon is ruined. It’s stressful dealing with the paperwork, but I’m just glad it wasn't a head-on collision.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista, heading toward the coast. A car coming from a side street didn't respect the stop sign and pulled out right in front of me. I slammed the brakes, but I couldn't avoid clipping their rear corner. My side mirror glass shattered immediately upon impact, and shards were everywhere on the asphalt. It was a really loud sound that startled me. The other driver was apologetic, admitting they were distracted by their GPS. I'm just lucky the glass didn't cut anyone in the car.

I was waiting to cross the intersection on foot. I clearly saw the Opel driving straight when the other vehicle emerged from the side road without stopping. The impact caused the Opel's mirror glass to shatter. Both drivers got out of their cars immediately to assess the situation.

Back when I was a young man, driving was so much easier, but now these modern cars are so wide! I was simply trying to park my Toyota outside the pharmacy in Coimbra. I must have misjudged the pillar near the entrance because I heard a sickening crunch. When I got out to look, I saw a nasty dent and a long scratch on the rear quarter panel. My wife was waiting in the passenger seat and she was quite upset about the whole thing. It is just such a nuisance, honestly.

I was driving slowly along the avenue because of the heavy rain. The car in front stopped suddenly because a tourist was crossing the road unexpectedly. My Nissan slid on the wet pavement and I tapped the back of their car. My right headlight lamp is broken and there is a dent on the hood. I am really stressed about the repair process, dude. I’ve never had to deal with this before, and I don't want my premiums to go up for such a small accident, you know?

I stopped for a pedestrian and felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me had clearly skidded on the wet road. When I inspected the damage, I saw their headlamp was broken and there was a dent on their hood. We exchanged details calmly.

Traffic on the bridge was quite heavy this afternoon. I was in the middle lane when I tried to signal and shift to the left. I checked my mirror, but there was a blind spot, I suppose. I made contact with a car that was already there. We were traveling at about 40 km/h. Thankfully, it was only a minor graze, resulting in a series of paint scratches along the side of my car. I feel quite professional about this, acknowledging it was my error in judgment during the maneuver.

I was driving through the city center, which is always so busy with trams and pedestrians. A delivery van parked illegally started pulling out into traffic without looking. I tried to veer away, but the side of my car caught the corner of his van. My passenger window glass shattered completely, and there is a significant dent on the door frame. I’m just glad I didn't hit any of the pedestrians on the sidewalk. It was a very scary moment for me and the passengers in my car, man.

I was finishing a delivery and pulled out, failing to notice the Audi coming alongside. I heard the impact and stopped. The Audi had a shattered window and a dented door. I take full responsibility for not checking my blind spot properly before pulling into the lane.

I was visiting the square and trying to find parking. It was very crowded, so I had to make a very sharp turn in a narrow lot. I didn't realize there was a concrete post so close. I hit the rear corner of my vehicle against it. The rear tail lamp is broken and there is a deep scratch near the bumper. I've been driving for forty-five years and I rarely make these mistakes, but the lighting in that garage was just terrible. I feel quite embarrassed by the whole situation, but it happens.

I was driving home from work along Avenida da Boavista, moving at about 30 km/h in the right lane. Traffic was quite dense as it usually is during rush hour. Suddenly, the car in front of me braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to react, but I couldn't stop in time and made contact with their rear bumper. My car has a noticeable dent and some paint scratch damage on the front hood area. I am really worried about how much this repair will cost, honestly, it was just a moment of bad timing.

The traffic was stop-and-go. I saw the pedestrian and pressed my brakes firmly to stop. A few seconds later, I felt a solid impact from behind. I checked my car and saw a dent and a deep scratch on the rear bumper. The other driver was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the exchange of information.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música, trying to exit towards the city center. I think I might have underestimated the speed of the vehicle in the outer lane as I was changing lanes. I felt a scraping sound and realized I had clipped the other car. There is a broken lamp on my side and a long scratch along the side panel. Man, I feel so terrible about this, I just hope their insurance covers everything because I was clearly in the wrong lane maneuver.

I was attempting to parallel park in a very tight spot near the Praça do Comércio. I was moving at a very slow speed, probably less than 5 km/h, when I misjudged the distance to the parked car behind me. I heard a scraping noise and stopped immediately. Upon inspection, there is a visible scratch on my rear bumper. I feel really anxious about this because I have never been in an accident before, and I am not sure if my policy covers these types of minor parking errors.

I was walking by the square and observed the driver of the small Fiat attempting to park. They were moving very slowly but clearly miscalculated the gap and brushed against the silver sedan parked behind them. I saw a clear scratch on the bumper of the Fiat. It was an honest mistake while parking.

It was raining heavily this morning, making visibility quite poor along the avenue. I was signaling to change into the left lane when I failed to notice a car in my blind spot. I steered back, but the contact was already made. My front fender now has a significant dent. I have been driving for over forty years, and this is truly embarrassing for me to report. My grandson says I should take it slow when it rains, and he is absolutely right; I should have paid more attention.

I entered the intersection on a green light, or at least I thought it was. A van came from the side street, and we made impact. It happened so fast that I am still a bit shaken up. There is a broken lamp and some glass shatter from the headlights on the road. Dude, I am just so stressed out by this whole situation, I really don't know what to do next. I just want to make sure the other driver is okay, honestly.

I was proceeding through the intersection when the Ford entered from my left side. I tried to brake, but we still collided. My front end is damaged, and I saw the other driver's headlight glass shatter on the tarmac. It was a hectic moment, but we both exited our vehicles to assess the situation.

I was driving down the avenue and kept my position in the lane. A car passing me on the left seemed to drift into my lane suddenly, swiping the side of my car. I have a long scratch running along the passenger side door. I am feeling really anxious about the insurance process because I have never had to file a claim for a side-swipe before. Do you think this will take a long time to fix? I use this car every single day.

I apologize, I was distracted by a notification on my dashboard and must have drifted slightly into the adjacent lane. I felt the impact and pulled over immediately. My car has a matching scratch on the door panel. I am fully prepared to take responsibility for this incident.

Traffic was very slow moving towards Cais do Sodré. I was tailing a vehicle at a speed of about 15 km/h. When they stopped, I didn't leave enough distance and my front bumper hit their back bumper. There is a dent and a surface scratch on my vehicle. I am a very careful driver usually, so this is quite frustrating for me. I have already filled out the accident form with the other party to ensure we have all the correct documentation.

I was coming to a full stop because of the traffic ahead. The Audi behind me wasn't able to stop in time and hit my car. My rear bumper sustained a dent and some scratches. We both pulled over to the side of the road immediately to exchange contact information and details.

I was driving along the coast, enjoying the view, when I decided to pass a slower vehicle. As I was merging back into the lane, I didn't see that the car had sped up. We scraped sides, and it caused some glass shatter from the side mirror and a noticeable scratch on my passenger door. Oh man, this is such a headache. I was just heading to the beach for the afternoon, and now my whole day is ruined by this stupid collision. I feel terrible.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving slowly, probably at 20 km/h, when I got distracted for a split second by a notification on my phone. When I looked back up, the car in front had stopped abruptly to turn, and I couldn't brake in time. I hit his rear bumper quite hard. My front bumper has a clear dent now, but thankfully everyone is physically okay. I am just really worried about the repair costs and my insurance premium going up because of this mistake.

I was indicating to make a turn when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I had come to a full stop because of a pedestrian crossing the road. The driver behind me didn't seem to notice the traffic stop. There is a noticeable dent on my rear bumper now.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal this morning, trying to get into the second lane to exit towards Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo. It was quite chaotic with all the buses and taxis moving around. I thought I had enough space to move over, but I misjudged how close the white van was in my blind spot. I ended up scraping against his side panel. I feel so stupid for not checking my mirror a second time, but the traffic was just so aggressive today, man.

I was parking my car near the park in Setúbal. I was trying to maneuver into a rather tight spot, and I thought I had plenty of clearance from the parked car next to me. Unfortunately, I underestimated the angle of my turn, and the rear corner of my bumper scraped along the front door of the other vehicle, causing a deep scratch and a dent in his door panel. It was entirely my fault; I was just trying to get to my doctor's appointment on time and didn't check my proximity sensors carefully enough.

I was inside a café when I heard a scraping sound outside. I went out to see this gentleman hitting my car while he was parking. There is a clear dent and a long scratch on the passenger side door. We have exchanged all the necessary insurance details now.

It was raining heavily in Porto, and the cobblestone streets were quite slippery. I was approaching the intersection near Rua de Santa Catarina and tried to stop at the light which had just turned amber. I didn't want to run it, but the road was so wet that my tires just lost traction. I skidded a few meters forward and tapped the car that was already starting to move across. My front lamp is broken from the impact, and I'm really shaken up by how quickly the car lost grip on the wet road.

I was driving along the main avenue in Aveiro, heading towards the university. I needed to shift into the right lane to prepare for my exit. I looked into my side mirror and signaled, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. As I began to steer over, I heard a horrible scraping noise. We both stopped immediately. There is a long, visible scratch running down the side of his car. I feel awful about this, I truly thought the lane was clear before I started my maneuver.

I was maintaining my speed in the right lane when the other car suddenly veered into mine without warning. I had no time to move aside. The impact caused a significant scratch along my rear door. It was an honest mistake, I'm sure he just didn't see me in time.

I was waiting to cross the street when I saw the Renault merge into the right lane. It looked like a blind spot error. The vehicles made contact and scraped against each other. Both drivers pulled over to the side of the road safely to talk.

I was driving across the bridge towards Almada. Traffic was moving at about 40 km/h, then it suddenly came to a complete standstill. I reacted as fast as I could, but my braking distance wasn't enough on the metal deck. I rear-ended the car in front. The impact was quite jarring; my hood has a significant dent, and unfortunately, the glass shatter from my headlight housing is everywhere on the road. I have been driving for years, and this is the first time I've ever had an accident like this. I am quite worried about the damage.

I was driving along the EN125 near Faro on my way to get some groceries. There was a car moving very slowly in the right lane, so I decided to overtake. As I was passing, a gust of wind caught my car, and I drifted slightly towards the left. I grazed the side of the other vehicle. It was a very minor incident, just a surface scratch, but I made sure to stop and provide my insurance information because that is the right thing to do. I’m just glad no one was hurt in the process.

I was driving steadily in the left lane when the Opel started passing me. He seemed to lose control for a second and drifted into my lane, causing a scratch along my side. We both stopped safely at the next pull-off to exchange details. No major issues.

I was looking for a parking spot near the square. I was turning slowly, barely doing 5 km/h, when I misjudged the distance to a concrete bollard. I ended up hitting it with my front corner. The impact was strong enough that my front lamp is broken, and there is a visible dent in the metal panel below it. I feel so frustrated with myself for being so careless. I was looking for a spot for my grandmother, and I suppose I was just a bit preoccupied. It’s an embarrassing situation, but I need to get this repaired.

Back in my day, we were taught to keep a much greater distance between cars, but today the roads are just so crowded. I was driving slowly near the city hall when the car ahead of me stopped for a bus that was pulling out. I applied the brakes, but I must have been following too closely. I tapped his bumper. There is a dent in his bumper now. It’s been a long day, and I am quite upset, but these things happen when there is so much traffic in the city center.

I was waiting for a bus to pull into traffic when I felt a tap from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the gentleman behind me looking quite stressed. There is a small dent on my bumper. We have agreed to fill out the European Accident Statement.

Dude, I was literally just trying to switch lanes because my GPS told me to turn right. I looked, I signaled, but everything happened so fast, man. I think the other car was speeding up to pass me. We side-swiped each other, and my side mirror glass shattered everywhere, and there's a nasty scratch down the side. I am super worried about the costs, and I really hope my insurance covers this. It was just a total accident, I promise I wasn't trying to cut anyone off or anything like that, you know?

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, just heading home after work. Traffic was quite heavy as usual. The car in front of me braked suddenly because someone pulled out of a side street unexpectedly, and I just couldn't stop in time. I hit the back of his vehicle at a low speed. I feel terrible about it, honestly. My bumper has a clear dent and a long scratch along the side now. I’ve exchanged all the details with the other driver and we are cooperating fully with the insurance process.

It was such a hectic morning at the roundabout near the airport. I was navigating the circle to take the third exit, and as I was changing lanes, another vehicle accelerated right into my side. It happened so fast, man, like, one second I was fine and the next I hear this scraping sound. I am so worried about the repair costs. The rear lamp is broken and there is a deep scratch on the fender. I was really stressed out but I have tried my best to document the scene properly.

I was maintaining my position in the outer lane of the roundabout when the other driver tried to move across without signaling in time. I tried to brake, but we made contact. My car suffered a broken lamp and some surface scratches. It was an honest mistake in heavy traffic, but it is certainly frustrating to deal with this administrative paperwork today.

I had gone to Coimbra to visit my daughter and was trying to park in a tight spot on a narrow street. The road was quite sloped and, while I was reversing, I misjudged the distance to the concrete bollard behind me. I backed into it at a very low speed. It was entirely my fault, of course. The rear bumper now has a significant dent, which I noticed immediately after I parked. I am quite embarrassed by the whole situation, as I usually consider myself a careful driver.

I was driving across the bridge when a sudden gust of wind—or perhaps just a loss of focus—caused the car in the lane next to me to drift into my path. It was a light collision, but the side of my vehicle now has a long, ugly scratch along the passenger door. I had to pull over at the first available safety zone to inspect the damage. I am very frustrated because I take great care of my car's paintwork, and this happened in such a chaotic environment.

I was driving behind both vehicles on the bridge. I clearly saw the vehicle in the right lane veer slightly to the left while trying to adjust his mirror, resulting in a side-swipe contact with the BMW. Both drivers handled the situation professionally by pulling over to the designated emergency area to check their vehicles for scratches.

It was raining, which made the cobblestones very slippery. As I approached the intersection, I saw the light turn yellow, but before I could safely stop, another driver entered the junction from the side. We collided at the corner. My car’s front window glass shattered and there is a noticeable dent on the hood. I am quite shaken up by this, as I was only trying to get to a doctor’s appointment. It is just one of those bad days, I suppose, and everything is quite overwhelming.

I was driving along the coast road, enjoying the view of the Atlantic, when the traffic suddenly stopped for an accident further ahead. I braked hard, but the road was damp, and I hit the car in front. The impact was enough to break my front lamp and leave a dent in the bumper. I feel terrible for the other driver. I’ve already contacted my insurance to report the incident truthfully as I don't want any issues with the claims process.

Traffic halted unexpectedly due to a separate incident ahead. I stopped my vehicle safely, but the driver behind me was unable to stop in time on the wet road. The collision resulted in a dent to my trunk and a broken rear light assembly. We have exchanged documentation and are waiting for the insurance assessment.

I was shopping at the mall and came back to find that my car had been scraped by someone trying to park next to me. I didn't see it happen, but the white paint transfer on my fender is very obvious. I am quite worried about how to handle this because I don't have the other person's details. It is just a surface scratch, but it is disappointing to see my car damaged while it was parked legally and safely in the bay.

I was proceeding north in the middle lane. I checked my mirror and signaled to move into the left lane. I thought I had enough space, but the driver in the left lane accelerated as I was moving over, and we made contact. My door has a dent and a long scratch from his trim. It was a miscalculation on my part regarding his speed. I’m quite anxious about the claim impact on my policy, but I know I have to report it accurately.

I was traveling at a steady speed in the left lane. The driver to my right attempted a lane change without noticing that I was already alongside him. The impact caused a dent and scratches on my rear passenger door. We pulled over immediately to resolve the matter and exchange our insurance information in a calm, civil manner.

While I was maneuvering out of a tight parking spot, I accidentally reversed into a stone planter. I was moving at a very slow speed, but I hit it at the wrong angle. It was quite a loud impact, and to my dismay, the rear light glass shattered and the housing for the lamp is also broken. I feel very foolish about this, as I should have been looking more carefully at the camera display. It is a minor issue, but I would like to get it fixed quickly.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving at maybe 20 km/h when the car in front suddenly slammed on their brakes. I hit mine as hard as I could, but the road was a bit damp and I just slid right into their bumper. I feel terrible about it. I got out to check and saw a clear dent on my hood and some paint scratches on the front bumper area.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, you know, trying to stay in my lane. It was super confusing with all the construction work going on there today. Suddenly, I felt a scrape on the side of my car. I think I might have been drifting slightly while trying to merge, man, I'm really stressed because I just got this car. There is a deep scratch along the passenger door panel now, it looks pretty bad but at least nobody was hurt.

I was already established in the middle lane of the roundabout when the other driver tried to move into my space too quickly. I honked but it was too late to avoid the contact. My door suffered a superficial scratch from the side of their vehicle as they scraped past me.

It was a sunny morning in Faro. I was traveling south on the main avenue. A van was parked illegally and as I tried to carefully pass it, another vehicle coming from behind clipped my side. The impact was loud and jarring. I pulled over immediately to inspect the damage. My side indicator lamp is completely broken, and there is a long scratch running along the rear quarter panel. I am just really shaken up by the whole experience, honestly.

I was sitting at the café terrace nearby. I saw the Seat Ibiza attempt to pass the double-parked van. The driver in the white sedan behind them tried to squeeze through at the same time. The sedan hit the Ibiza's side, breaking the signal lamp and causing visible scratches along the metal bodywork.

I was heading towards Quarteira when traffic slowed down to a crawl near the junction. I stopped my vehicle safely, but the driver behind me clearly didn't see the queue in time. They slammed into my rear at low speed. The impact shattered the rear glass of my trunk and smashed the tail lamp on the left side. It’s a very unfortunate situation, but I am keeping all the documentation for the claim as required.

I truly apologize, I was distracted by the GPS for a split second. The traffic stopped abruptly and I did not have enough distance to come to a full halt. I hit the back of the Mercedes, breaking their rear light and the glass of the hatchback.

I was driving north on the main avenue. I checked my mirrors, signaled, and began changing into the left lane to prepare for a turn. I suppose there was a blind spot, because as I moved, I felt contact with another vehicle that was also merging. We stopped right there. There is a noticeable scratch on the side of my front bumper. I am quite worried about the repair costs, so I hope the insurance procedure is straightforward.

I was in the lane next to the BMW. When they started merging, I thought they had seen me, but then the vehicles touched. It was a minor collision. My side panel received a light scratch, and the other driver's front bumper has a corresponding scratch.

I was visiting the beach in Monte Gordo today. I parked my car, and when I returned from my walk, I found a note on my windshield. Someone had scraped the side of my car while pulling out of the adjacent space. There is a long, visible scratch along the driver's side door. It is very frustrating, as I take great care of my car. I hope the CCTV footage from the nearby hotel can identify the responsible driver.

I was walking back to my car when I saw a silver hatchback scrape the parked Opel while attempting to reverse out of a tight spot. The driver looked around, seemed nervous, and left a note on the windscreen before driving away quickly.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly came to a complete standstill due to the evening rush hour. I managed to brake, but the person behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper. I got out immediately to check, and honestly, I was quite worried because it's a new car. There is a noticeable dent on the trunk lid and a few deep scratches across the paintwork. I exchanged insurance details with the other driver, who was very apologetic about the mistake.

The traffic was heavy and I simply misjudged the distance between my car and the Volkswagen ahead of me. I tried to slam on my brakes, but the road was a bit slick from the earlier drizzle. It was a low-speed impact, but I clearly caused a dent and some scratches on the back of his vehicle.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música, just minding my own business, when another car tried to switch lanes too aggressively. I was in the middle lane, and he was in the inner lane, and he just clipped my rear corner as he was exiting. My passenger side taillight assembly is completely smashed now. It happened so fast that I was in a total state of shock, just shaking, you know? I really hope the insurance covers the lamp broken because it's going to be expensive.

statements.text: It was just a typical Tuesday morning, traffic was crawling as usual near Saldanha. A van was pulling out of a side street and he didn't see me in his blind spot as I was passing. He scraped along my passenger side doors. It didn't dent the metal, but there is a very long, deep scratch running from the front door to the rear door. I am a busy man and this is really quite inconvenient, but we both acted responsibly and filed the report right there.

I was parking my car in a tight spot near the university. My daughter was in the back asking for snacks, and I was just a little distracted. I reversed a bit too quickly and bumped into a bollard. It was my fault entirely, just a silly mistake. I got out and saw a dent on the rear bumper and some white paint scratches. It makes me so anxious because I take such good care of this vehicle, but accidents happen, I suppose.

I was walking by the cafe and saw the Toyota driver reverse into the concrete bollard. It wasn't a fast impact, but definitely enough to leave a dent and some scratches on the plastic bumper. The driver seemed genuinely upset and immediately got out to inspect the damage to their car.

My goodness, I was just driving home from my granddaughter's school when the traffic light turned amber. I slowed down quite gently, but the gentleman behind me didn't anticipate the stop. His front bumper hit my rear hatch, and the impact caused my rear glass to shatter completely. It was quite a loud noise! I'm a bit shaken by the whole ordeal, and my neck feels a little stiff, though I didn't see any other physical damage besides the glass everywhere on the road.

I was driving along the coast road, the sea was beautiful today. I moved to the right lane to prepare for my exit, and a delivery truck was also merging at the same time. We both didn't see each other and his side mirror made contact with my rear quarter panel. It left a nasty scratch, but thankfully no dent. I've been driving for years and honestly, it was just one of those bad moments where timing was off.

I was merging onto the lane and I admit I might have moved over too fast. The road was busy and I was checking my mirrors, but the Mercedes was already there. It was just a minor contact, just enough to leave a scratch on their paintwork.

I had a green light at the intersection near the square, and I proceeded through carefully. Another driver coming from the cross-street ignored their red light and clipped my front bumper. It was frightening. My front left corner has a significant dent and deep scratches from the impact. I am just glad no one was hurt, but the car is clearly damaged. I've got photos of the scene and the other driver's license plate.

I was sitting at the cafe terrace right by the intersection. The Nissan was definitely moving on a green light, and the silver car rushed through the intersection after the light had already turned red. The contact was unavoidable, and I saw the dent and scratches appear on the Nissan immediately after.

I was driving home from work when the car in front of me suddenly braked for a pedestrian. I stopped safely, but the SUV behind me didn't. The impact was strong enough to push me forward. While the metal looks okay, my plastic bumper has a visible crack right down the center. I'm a professional, so I made sure to document everything clearly. It is a bit of a nuisance to have the vehicle in the shop, but it is necessary for safety.

I was waiting at the intersection, and the street is quite narrow here. A delivery bike was weaving through traffic and clipped my side door while trying to squeeze past. It didn't dent the car, but there is a very obvious scratch where the handlebars must have rubbed against the paint. It's frustrating because I try to keep my car in pristine condition, you know? It's just a small accident, but the scratch is really annoying to look at every single day.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving at maybe 20 km/h when the car in front of me suddenly braked hard for a yellow light. I tried to stop, but I didn't have enough distance, so I tapped the rear bumper of his car. It was completely my fault, I was just distracted for a second. There is a noticeable dent on my hood where I made contact. I feel terrible about the whole situation.

I was heading toward the city center when the light turned amber. I applied the brakes firmly but safely. The driver behind me failed to stop in time and bumped into the rear of my vehicle. The impact was low speed, but it left a dent on my bumper. The other driver was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the entire exchange of details.

Man, I am honestly so stressed out right now. I was trying to merge into the right lane near Praça do Comércio, and I swear I checked my mirror like three times, you know? But this van just came out of nowhere. I guess I didn't see him in the blind spot. We side-swiped each other, and now there is this huge ugly scratch along my passenger side door. I feel like such an idiot, I just wanted to get home before the rain started coming down harder.

I have been driving for forty years, and I usually take great pride in my record. This morning, while navigating the busy Rotunda da Boavista, I was distracted by a group of tourists on the sidewalk and drifted slightly out of my lane. I clipped the side of a delivery truck that was turning alongside me. My front indicator lamp is broken from the impact. It was a silly mistake caused by my lack of focus in such a busy area of the city. I am quite embarrassed by this.

I was in the outer lane of the roundabout when the passenger car drifted into my path. I couldn't avoid the collision despite honking my horn. The contact resulted in their lamp being broken and a few marks on my side panel. They admitted immediately that they were looking at the pedestrians instead of the road.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was attempting to parallel park outside a café on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo. The spot was quite tight, and as I was reversing, I misjudged the distance to the car parked behind me. I heard a crunch and realized I had hit their bumper. There is a small dent and a scratch on my rear corner panel now. It's my first time having an accident, and I'm really worried about the insurance premiums going up. I really should have asked my passenger to guide me into the spot.

I was driving slowly down the narrow Rua de Santa Catarina. A delivery cyclist swerved to avoid a pedestrian who stepped off the curb without looking. In a reflex to avoid hitting the cyclist, I steered to the right and hit a concrete bollard. The impact caused my side mirror to hit the bollard, resulting in the glass shatter of the mirror casing. It happened so fast that I barely had time to think, but I'm glad nobody was hurt during the sudden maneuver.

I was sitting at the outdoor terrace nearby. I saw the driver trying to avoid a cyclist who was acting erratically. The driver maneuvered sharply to the right and collided with the bollard on the sidewalk. I heard the glass shatter and went over to see if the driver was okay. They were clearly shaken but unhurt.

The traffic was moving at approximately 40 km/h along Avenida da República. I signaled to move into the center lane because I needed to make a turn up ahead. I checked my mirror, but I failed to account for the speed of the vehicle in the adjacent lane. We made contact, causing a long scratch along the side of my vehicle. The other driver pulled over immediately, and we exchanged our contact information. I take full responsibility for the incident as I did not check my blind spot carefully enough.

I was driving straight in the middle lane when the driver in the right lane pulled out suddenly. I didn't have enough time to brake safely without causing a pile-up. We scraped against each other, leaving a scratch on their door. It was a genuine error in judgment by the other driver.

I was at a supermarket car park in Vila Nova de Gaia. While I was reversing out of my space, I didn't see the vehicle behind me clearly because of the sun glare. I backed directly into his bumper. It created a dent on my trunk lid. I felt like such a fool because I was in a rush to pick up my granddaughter from school. The owner of the other car was very kind about it, which made me feel slightly less guilty, though the damage is still very upsetting.

The view along the Avenida Marginal is lovely, but the traffic can be stop-and-go. I was following a car quite closely when the sea breeze caught my attention for a second. By the time I looked back at the road, they were already stopped. I tried to slam on the brakes, but I hit them at maybe 15 km/h. My front lamp is broken and there is a dent on the bumper. It’s a very frustrating start to the weekend, but at least the impact was not severe.

I had slowed down for traffic near the Estoril turnoff. The driver behind me didn't stop and rear-ended my car. I could see the damage to their lamp and bumper through my rearview mirror before I even got out. The driver was very cooperative and provided their insurance details without any hesitation.

I was navigating the roundabout at Campo Pequeno during the afternoon rush. Another driver was cutting across lanes too aggressively, and I suppose I didn't move away fast enough. We sideswiped, and it left a long scratch across my driver-side door. I am a pragmatic person, so I just wanted to get the details sorted quickly so we weren't blocking the entire intersection. It was a standard traffic incident, nothing too dramatic, just annoying to deal with the paperwork and the body shop repairs later this week.

I was driving down Rua da Prata, and the streets are always so narrow and crowded with tourists. I was trying to avoid a delivery truck that was double-parked, and I clipped my wing mirror against a stone wall of a building. The impact caused the glass shatter of my side mirror. It was entirely my fault as I miscalculated the clearance between the truck and the wall. I feel quite silly, honestly. It is a minor thing, but I need the mirror fixed to drive safely in Lisbon traffic.

I was walking down the street when I saw the Mini Cooper trying to squeeze past a large delivery van. The driver clearly didn't have enough room and hit the wall with their mirror. I heard the glass shatter immediately. The driver stopped right away to inspect the damage. It was clearly an accidental miscalculation of the available space.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, you know, during the rush hour traffic. Everything was moving slowly, but the driver in front of me suddenly hit their brakes hard because of a pedestrian crossing the street. I tried to stop, man, I really did, but I just tapped their rear bumper. I feel so bad about it, I hope this doesn't cost too much to fix. There is just a small dent on my bumper where I hit them. I am really stressed about the whole claims process, honestly.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música when I tried to change lanes to exit towards Cedofeita. I didn't see the other car in my blind spot. I heard a scraping sound as our side panels made contact. I immediately pulled over safely. It was entirely my mistake; I was just distracted for a split second by the GPS. There is a noticeable scratch along my passenger side door.

I was maintaining my lane in the roundabout when the other driver suddenly merged into my space without checking. I tried to steer away but couldn't avoid the contact. We both stopped right after the exit to inspect the damage. My vehicle has a scratch along the rear quarter panel.

I was approaching the intersection near the Cais do Sodré station. The traffic light was yellow, and I was going at about 30 km/h. I thought I could make it through, but the driver coming from the side street didn't wait for their light to turn fully green. Our corners brushed against each other. It all happened so fast, I was quite shaken. The impact caused the lens on my front lamp to be broken completely.

I was waiting to cross the street when I saw the two vehicles collide at the intersection. It seemed like both drivers were rushing a bit too much as the lights were changing. One car's front lamp was clearly broken after the impact. They both pulled over immediately to exchange information.

I was driving along the right lane of the Avenida da Liberdade. I signaled to change to the left lane to prepare for a turn, and I checked my mirrors, but I simply didn't see the van approaching quickly from behind. We made contact, which caused a long scratch and a dent on my front fender. It was a lapse in judgment on my part, and I have already apologized to the other driver for the inconvenience caused today.

The insured vehicle pulled into my lane abruptly while I was driving at approximately 40 km/h. I honked but it was too late to avoid the scrape. My van sustained a scratch along the side panel, and their car had a dent. We agreed to exchange details right there on the avenue.

Well now, you see, I was driving my wife to her doctor's appointment on Rua de Santa Catarina. It was very crowded, and I was looking for a parking spot. I stopped suddenly because I saw a car leaving, and the lady behind me, bless her heart, wasn't paying attention and tapped my rear bumper. My car is an older model, but it's well-kept. There is now a clear crack in the plastic bumper cover. It's just a nuisance, really, but we must get it sorted.

I failed to notice that the traffic had come to a complete stop on the avenue. I was travelling at about 20 km/h and hit the car in front of me. I feel terrible about it. I was entering the intersection at Avenida da República when a cyclist unexpectedly cut across from the bike path. I swerved to avoid them and hit a concrete bollard on the sidewalk. I am honestly just grateful that everyone involved is safe, although I am very upset about the damage to my car.

I was standing near the bus stop when I saw the Volvo swerve hard. It was a very close call with the cyclist. The car hit the bollard at a low speed, and I heard the glass shatter immediately. The driver acted quickly to avoid a much worse collision with the cyclist.

statements.text: I was stopped at the red light on Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa. I was just checking my phone to see the ETA for my arrival. Suddenly, someone hit me from behind. I was distracted by my children in the back seat and did not notice the red light in time. I tried to brake, but I hit the Tesla. I feel terrible about this accident. The Tesla has a broken lamp and a dent on the bumper. I have provided all my insurance details to the driver.

I was proceeding through the green light at the intersection when the other driver ignored their red light and came across my path. I had to brake suddenly because a person crossed the street illegally. The driver behind me couldn't stop and bumped into my rear. There is a small dent on their front bumper. I am unharmed and the vehicle is still driveable, but I wanted to make the formal report.

I was parallel parking near the station yesterday evening. I thought I had cleared the other vehicle, but as I turned the wheel to straighten out, I heard that awful sound of metal on metal. I was driving in the right lane when the other car attempted to merge. I believe they did not see me. There was contact between our vehicles. I have damage on my bumper, and they have a dent and scratches on their passenger door.

I was driving through the roundabout when another vehicle failed to yield and struck my rear quarter panel. It was a very fast impact, and I barely had time to react. I was waiting to enter the roundabout and I saw the whole thing. The white car clearly did not stop for the Nissan already inside the circle. The impact broke the Nissan's tail light and caused a crack in the bodywork. It was quite a loud noise.

I feel terrible about it, honestly. My car has a visible dent on the front bumper now, but thankfully the other driver seems okay.

Man, I was just trying to get through the roundabout near the airport, you know? It was raining quite a bit and the road was super slick. I was merging into the outer lane and I didn't see the van coming up on my side in time. We scraped against each other. It’s super annoying, man, I’ve only had this car for like six months. There is just a long scratch down the side, but it really looks awful.

I was maintaining my lane in the roundabout when the small Fiat suddenly swerved toward me. I tried to brake, but there wasn't enough distance to avoid the contact. We both stopped safely at the exit. The passenger side of my van has a scratch from the collision with their door.

I was driving along the Avenida Luísa Todi, enjoying the sunny weather. I put on my turn signal to move into the left lane to prepare for a turn ahead. I checked my mirror, but I suppose I missed the car that was already there. We clipped each other as I drifted over. The impact broke the tail lamp of the other car. I’m quite shaken up by the whole situation, as I’ve never had an accident before.

I was cruising in the left lane when the driver in the adjacent lane decided to merge without checking their blind spot. I couldn't move over because there was another vehicle. The contact happened quickly, causing my rear lamp to break immediately upon impact.

Well, you see, I was heading home from my granddaughter's house on the Estrada da Circunvalação. It was getting dark and the traffic lights were changing quite quickly. The car ahead stopped abruptly for a cyclist, and I simply didn't react fast enough. I hit them from behind. It was a terrible sound, glass shattering everywhere from their rear window. I’m quite distressed, as I have been driving for over forty years without an incident like this happening to me.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when I saw the accident. The BMW didn't brake in time when the front car stopped. There was a loud crunch and I saw glass shatter from the back of the front car. Both drivers stepped out to exchange details.

The streets of downtown Lisbon are always so chaotic, especially during the lunch hour. I was navigating through the narrow cobblestone area when a scooter cut across my path. I had to brake suddenly, and the vehicle behind me couldn't stop. They nudged my rear bumper at about 10 km/h. It didn't seem bad at first, but there is a clear crack in the plastic molding now. I am worried about the cost of the repair, honestly.
