The Toyota in front of me braked very hard because of a scooter driver. I tried to stop as well but I just wasn't fast enough on the pedal. My front bumper hit the rear of the Toyota. There is a small crack on their bumper, but my car is mostly fine.

I was driving down Avenida da República during the morning rush. The traffic was moving slowly, and I decided to change lanes as I needed to turn left further up. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. We scraped doors as I moved over. It’s just a scratch, nothing structural, but it looks terrible. I’m feeling really stressed about the whole paperwork process, to be honest, I just want it sorted out.

I was driving straight when the Ford suddenly started moving into my lane. I honked my horn, but it was too late to avoid the contact. We both pulled over to the side immediately. There is a noticeable scratch on my driver-side door from the side-swipe.

I was entering the roundabout at Rotunda da Boavista, planning to take the third exit. The traffic flow was quite erratic. I was looking toward the exit when a van entered from my right and hit the rear quarter panel of my vehicle. It caused a significant dent. I am quite frustrated because I am sure I had the right of way in the lane. I’m worried about the repair costs and how long the vehicle will be in the shop.

I was waiting at the roundabout entrance and saw the whole thing. The Nissan was already in the roundabout when the other van tried to enter aggressively. The van hit the Nissan on the side, creating a dent. It was definitely a busy moment on the road.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy, as usual. The car in front of me stopped suddenly because of a light turning amber, and although I slammed on my brakes, I couldn't stop in time on the damp road surface. I hit the back of his vehicle at a very low speed. My car sustained a noticeable dent on the front bumper. I am really sorry about the inconvenience, I just feel so bad that this happened during the evening rush.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, trying to head towards the airport, and honestly, the roundabout was super chaotic. I was in the outer lane when a van suddenly cut across me to exit, and I just didn't have enough room to react properly. It was such a stressful moment, man, like, one minute I'm driving fine and the next I feel the side of my Fiat scrape against his rear panel. I've got a long, deep scratch along my passenger door now, and I'm honestly just really worried about how much this is going to cost.

I was exiting the roundabout and checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the smaller car in the adjacent lane. It was a simple misjudgment on my part while navigating the heavy traffic near the airport. We pulled over immediately to exchange details. There is a small scratch on my rear bumper and his passenger side door.

I had gone to the center of Setúbal to run some errands this morning, and while I was attempting to parallel park on Avenida Luísa Todi, I miscalculated the distance to the car parked behind me. I was moving at maybe 5 km/h, but my rear bumper clipped their front bumper. It was a very silly mistake on my part, and I feel quite embarrassed. I have a dent and a scratch on the corner of my rear bumper. The other driver was very patient while we sorted out the paperwork in this heat.

I was driving up Rua de Santa Catarina, which is quite narrow, and another vehicle coming from the opposite direction was hugging the center line a bit too closely. We both tried to edge away, but our side mirrors clipped each other, and then the side of my car hit his. It happened so fast. I have a broken lamp on the side mirror and a long scratch along the side panel. It was just a really unfortunate incident caused by the narrow street conditions here in the city center.

The streets here are just too narrow for two cars to pass comfortably. I felt my car graze the other driver's vehicle as we were passing each other. It was clearly an accident given the limited space available on the road. My side mirror lamp is broken and there is a scratch on my door.

I was approaching the intersection at Avenida da República when the traffic light turned yellow. I was unsure whether to stop or proceed, and by the time I decided to brake, a motorcycle had swerved to avoid another car and clipped my front passenger side. It was a total shock. The impact wasn't massive, but it was enough to cause the glass shatter on my headlight casing. I am quite shaken up by the whole experience and hope everyone involved is okay; it’s been a really stressful morning for me.

I was standing on the corner waiting to cross the street when I saw the Corsa attempt to brake. The motorcyclist tried to maneuver around the sudden stop but hit the car's front corner. It was definitely accidental and caused by the confusion at the traffic light change. I saw the headlight glass shatter upon impact.

My goodness, it has been such a long day. I was pulling out from a parking spot on Rua do Alecrim, looking carefully, but the street is quite steep and visibility is difficult with the parked delivery vans. I didn't see the other car coming down the hill until it was too late. I moved forward and hit his side door. I have a small dent on my front fender. It is just such a shame, I have been driving for years and never had an accident like this before in my life.

I was driving along Avenida 24 de Julho heading towards Cais do Sodré. The traffic was moving at about 30 km/h. I signaled to change to the right lane to prepare for my turn, and I checked my blind spot, but the other driver must have accelerated at the same time. We ended up making contact side-to-side. There is a surface scratch on my rear door. It was an honest error in judgment regarding the speed of the other vehicle in the adjacent lane, and I feel terrible about the delay I caused.

I was in the right lane when the Renault attempted to merge over. I was already in the lane and didn't have enough time to brake to let him in. We made light contact. There is a visible scratch on the side of my car. It was just an unfortunate case of poor timing in traffic.

I was driving around the Rotunda da Boavista, which is always busy. I was in the middle lane when another car suddenly veered into my lane from the inside. I tried to swerve, but my side mirror hit his rear light. It was just a split-second thing, you know? Like, totally unexpected. Now I have a broken lamp on my side mirror housing. I'm just really worried about the insurance process because this is my first claim and I'm not sure how it all works, man.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: Traffic on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo was extremely dense this afternoon. The car directly ahead of me had to stop abruptly due to a cyclist crossing illegally. I braked as hard as I could, but the road was slightly oily, and I slid forward, tapping his rear bumper. The impact caused a dent to my hood and a broken lamp on the front grill. I have provided my details to the other driver immediately. I am quite disappointed in myself for not maintaining a larger following distance given the heavy traffic.

I was walking on the sidewalk and witnessed the collision. A cyclist darted into the road, causing the first car to stop suddenly. The BMW driver tried to stop but couldn't avoid hitting the car in front. The collision was clearly accidental. I saw the dented hood and the broken lamp on the BMW.

I was trying to maneuver into a very tight space on Rua da Constituição to go to the pharmacy. I turned the wheel a bit too sharply while reversing, and my rear corner grazed the car next to me. I feel absolutely terrible about it. There is just a scratch on their fender and mine. I waited for the owner to return so we could exchange insurance information properly. It's just such a frustrating way to end my day, and I hope the repair isn't too complicated.

I was driving home from work along the Avenida da Boavista when traffic suddenly came to a complete standstill. I tried to brake, but I didn't stop in time and tapped the car in front of me at about 10 km/h. It was completely my fault, I was distracted for a split second by my GPS. There is a noticeable dent on my hood and some light scratches on the bumper where I hit the other driver's trunk.

I was waiting in the queue of traffic when I suddenly felt a jolt from behind. The other driver apologized immediately and admitted they hadn't seen me stop. My rear bumper has some scratches and a small dent from the impact. We exchanged details right there on the side of the road.

I was attempting to parallel park in a very tight spot near the Praça da Figueira this afternoon. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was backing in, I misjudged the angle and scraped my rear wing against the white van parked behind me. I feel quite silly about it, honestly. There is just a long, deep scratch along my rear quarter panel. The other driver wasn't there, so I left a note with my contact information on their windshield.

I was sitting at the café terrace nearby and saw the whole thing. The driver was trying to squeeze into a space that was clearly too small for the vehicle. They were moving very slowly but eventually made contact with the van. It was just a minor scrape, no major damage, just cosmetic scratches.

I was heading down the Avenida 24 de Julho in heavy afternoon traffic. I signaled to change into the middle lane, but a motorcycle rider was in my blind spot. I didn't see them until it was too late and brushed against their side. It was a very unfortunate oversight. My front bumper has a dent, the passenger side lamp is broken, and there are deep scratches all along the side panel. I am deeply sorry for the incident and have fully cooperated with the other driver.

I was riding in the middle lane when the BMW suddenly drifted into my lane without checking. The side of my bike was hit, which caused me to wobble, though I stayed upright. My turn signal lamp is broken and there is a dent on my frame along with some bad scratches.

It was raining quite heavily this morning while I was driving down the narrow Rua de Santa Catarina. I was looking for a parking spot and briefly took my eyes off the road. When I looked back, the car in front had stopped for a pedestrian, and I didn't have enough distance to stop. I slid a bit on the wet road and tapped them. The glass on my side mirror shattered completely. It was quite a shock, really, but thankfully we were going very slowly.

I had just finished my morning grocery shopping near the Estrada Monumental. As I was pulling away from the traffic light, the lady in front of me suddenly stopped again for no apparent reason. I was accelerating and hit her rear bumper. My front headlight housing is broken and there is a noticeable dent in my bumper where it impacted her towing hitch. It was an honest mistake and I am quite embarrassed by the whole situation, as I try to be a careful driver.

I stopped at the light because I realized I had missed my turn. The driver behind me didn't notice I had stopped and bumped into the back of my car. There is a dent in my rear bumper, but luckily it is just cosmetic. We have already filled out the accident report forms.

While driving on Avenida da República, there was a sudden maneuver from the taxi in the lane to my right. They drifted into my lane without warning. I tried to steer left to avoid them, but we still ended up scraping side panels. It was very confusing as it happened so fast. There are long, superficial scratches running down my passenger-side doors. I have been driving for over thirty years and rarely have accidents, so I am a bit shaken up by this entire ordeal this afternoon.

I was maneuvering slowly out of a narrow side street onto Rua do Ouro. I didn't see the bollard placed near the corner because of the shadows from the buildings. I turned a bit too sharply and the front corner of my car caught it. It caused a significant dent on the fender, broke my fog lamp, and left several scratches on the bumper paint. I feel quite foolish, as I know that area is difficult to navigate, but I simply didn't see the obstacle in time.

Driving through the Rotunda da Boavista is always hectic, dude. I was in the inner lane, and as I went to exit, a white delivery van cut across from the outer lane. I tried to brake, but we made contact. There is a dent on my front wheel arch and some nasty scratches on the door. Man, I'm just worried about how long it will take to get this fixed because I need the car for my internship commute every single morning, you know?

I was exiting the roundabout and thought the lane was clear. I must have miscalculated the distance to the Renault coming up behind me. There are minor scratches on my rear bumper and a small dent. It was an honest miscalculation on my part, and I've provided my insurance details to the other driver.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving along Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo during the evening rush hour. It was stop-and-go traffic. A car unexpectedly braked hard ahead of me to avoid a taxi that had swerved. I couldn't stop in time and hit the rear of that vehicle. The impact was enough to cause the glass in my headlight to shatter and there is a dent in my hood. I am quite stressed about the repair costs, but I understand that this is just part of the risk of city driving.

I braked because the taxi in front of me changed lanes abruptly. The Polo behind me didn't have enough time to stop. My trunk has a dent and the plastic trim is cracked. We are both safe, which is the most important thing, but it is certainly a nuisance to deal with all this paperwork today.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I looked down for a split second to adjust the radio volume, and when I looked back up, the car in front had stopped abruptly for a pedestrian. I pressed the brakes hard, but I couldn't stop in time. I hit his rear bumper at a very low speed, maybe 10 km/h. I feel terrible about it. I can see a dent on his bumper and a deep scratch on mine. I am just really stressed about the insurance paperwork.

I was stopped at the crosswalk because a person was crossing the street. Suddenly, I felt a solid impact from behind. I checked my car and saw a clear dent on the plastic bumper cover. The driver behind me was clearly upset and apologized immediately. We exchanged insurance information right there on the side of the road.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, trying to exit towards Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo. It was raining quite hard, and the visibility was poor. I signaled to switch lanes to the outer ring, but I didn't see the van in my blind spot. I ended up scraping against their side panel. I am so worried because I haven't been driving for very long. I can see my front lamp is broken, and there is a long scratch running along the side of the car. It was just a complete mistake.

I was trying to park in a tight spot near the university area in Coimbra. It was around 2:00 PM and the street was very busy with students. As I was reversing into the space, I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar near the shop entrance. I heard a thud and realized I had backed into it. I got out and inspected the area; there is a visible dent on my rear quarter panel. I am just so frustrated with myself, it was a completely avoidable error while I was rushing to my meeting.

The traffic was moving slowly along the waterfront. I was in the middle lane and decided to move to the left to avoid a bus that was signaling to pull over. I checked my mirrors, but perhaps I didn't hold the angle long enough. As I merged, I made contact with a car that was already occupying that lane. There is a scratch and a small dent on my door. I really hope this doesn't cost too much to fix, I've been very careful lately, and this is just an unfortunate lapse in judgment.

I was driving normally in the left lane when the Citroen next to me suddenly started moving over. I honked my horn, but it was too late to avoid the contact. We both pulled over safely. My car sustained a scratch on the side, but fortunately, no one was hurt in the incident.

I was driving down Avenida da República at about 40 km/h. It was a beautiful sunny afternoon. A parked car suddenly opened its door as I was passing, and I had to swerve slightly to avoid hitting the person exiting. In doing so, I brushed against a traffic pole. My paint is completely ruined with a deep scratch down the side. I am just really rattled because I have to drive to pick up my grandchildren later. Everything happened so quickly, and I am still shaking a bit from the surprise of the door opening.

I was turning into a narrow alleyway in the Cedofeita neighborhood. The streets here are incredibly old and tight. I was going very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but I underestimated the width of the turn. My headlight struck the edge of a brick wall. The impact was enough to break the lamp housing and cause the glass to shatter on the ground. I am a very experienced driver, but this specific turn is notoriously difficult. I am quite embarrassed and worried about the repair costs for this vehicle model.

I was walking my dog nearby and saw the whole thing. The driver was definitely not speeding; it was a genuine miscalculation of the turn radius on that narrow street. The sound of the glass shattering was quite loud, but the driver immediately stopped and inspected the damage. It was clearly an honest mistake.

We were in that stop-and-go traffic that you always find on the bridge during rush hour. I was following the car in front quite closely. When they braked, I reacted, but the road surface was a bit damp and my tires didn't grip as well as I expected. I tapped the back of their bumper. It caused a noticeable dent. I am so stressed because I have a meeting in the city center and now I am going to be late. I have all my insurance documents ready, but I am just really frazzled.

I was pulling into a parking bay in front of the town hall. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I heard a sound of metal on metal as I swung the front of my car around. It turns out I scratched the paint against a metal barrier. I am quite annoyed with myself because I take very good care of this car. It is just a surface scratch, but it is very visible. I have already contacted the parking attendant to document the location where the incident occurred.

I was approaching the intersection near the shopping center. The lights turned amber, and I made the decision to brake firmly. However, the driver behind me didn't anticipate the stop. They rear-ended me with some force. My rear bumper has a significant dent and one of the tail lamp units is broken. I am feeling a bit of pain, just in my neck from the jolt, but I am more concerned about the car damage. The other driver was very apologetic and admitted they were distracted by their mobile phone for a second.

I take full responsibility for the collision. I looked away for a brief moment and did not see the car in front stopping for the light. I hit them at about 20 km/h. I immediately checked on the other driver, and we agreed to file the report through the insurance companies. My bumper is also damaged, but the main issue is the impact to their rear.

I was maneuvering slowly in the loading zone near the plaza to drop off some supplies. It was early in the morning, around 8:00 AM, and the ground was still slippery from the night mist. I misjudged the proximity to a bollard and tapped it. It caused a crack in my plastic lower trim area. I am very frustrated as I have kept this car in pristine condition for years. I am hoping the body shop can repair the trim without needing a full replacement, but I wanted to report it officially right away.

I was driving around the Boavista roundabout in heavy traffic when I tried to change lanes to exit towards Avenida da Boavista. I checked my mirrors, but I honestly must have misjudged the distance of the silver sedan in the lane next to me. I heard a sudden crunch, and we both pulled over immediately near the statue. I am quite worried about my insurance premiums now, honestly, this is the first time I have ever been involved in a collision and I feel terrible about the dent on their side panel.

It was a very busy Tuesday afternoon near the center of Lisbon. I was attempting to reverse park into a small space, and I was being extra cautious because of the pedestrians, but I miscalculated the swing of my rear bumper. I ended up scraping the side of a parked delivery van. I felt awful about it, so I waited for the driver to return so we could exchange details. There is a visible scratch on the side of their van. I have taken photos of the damage to assist with the claim process.

I returned to my parked van to find the driver of the Smart car waiting for me. He was very apologetic and explained that he had scraped my van while trying to park in the tight spot behind me. We looked at the damage together, and there is a clear scratch on my passenger door panel. Everything was handled very politely and professionally.

I was driving along the EN125 when a heavy goods vehicle started merging into my lane. I didn't have enough time to react before he caught the side of my car. It was quite scary, man. I pulled over as soon as it was safe. There is a deep scratch and a dent along my passenger door where the contact happened. I'm really stressed about the cost of the repairs, as I've only had this car for about six months and I try to keep it in perfect condition.

I was changing lanes on the EN125 and I checked my blind spot, but unfortunately, I did not see the smaller vehicle coming up alongside me. I am very sorry for the incident. I stopped immediately after the contact to check on the other driver and exchange insurance information. My truck only has minor marks, but the other car clearly sustained a dent and a scratch.

It was pouring rain on the bridge. Visibility was quite low, and the traffic suddenly slowed down near the exit. I attempted to brake, but I think the road was a bit slippery. I made contact with the rear of the car ahead of me. The impact shattered my headlight and broke the lamp housing. I am an elderly driver, and this situation has really left me quite rattled. I have always been a careful driver, so this is quite distressing for me to deal with this afternoon.

I was driving in the lane next to the two vehicles involved. Due to the heavy rain, the traffic was moving slowly, but the driver of the Toyota clearly struggled to stop on time when the vehicle ahead braked. I saw the collision occur and pulled over to offer my details, as the impact caused the Toyota's lamp to break and the headlight glass to shatter on the road.

I was navigating through the very narrow streets near Santa Catarina. It was quite congested with tourists and delivery vans everywhere. I turned the corner a bit too tightly, and I didn't see the bollard until it was too late. I scraped the side of my rear bumper against it. It is just a surface scratch, but I wanted to report it formally to the insurance company to see what my next steps should be. I'm worried about the repair process, but I know it was my own mistake while driving.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around midday. I wanted to move from the middle lane to the right lane. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. As I started to shift, we made contact. It wasn't a hard hit, but there is a noticeable dent and a long scratch on the rear passenger door. I am a professional who values efficiency, so I am reporting this promptly to ensure we get the paperwork sorted without any unnecessary delays.

I was keeping a steady pace in the right lane when the BMW suddenly moved into my space. I tried to beep my horn, but it was too late. We clipped each other. I stopped immediately, and the other driver was very cooperative in exchanging information. My car has a dent and a scratch on the side from the impact.

I was entering the intersection near the square. The traffic light had turned green, but a cyclist suddenly crossed in front of me from the sidewalk. I slammed on the brakes, and the driver behind me didn't have enough time to stop, so they tapped my rear bumper. The force caused my rear light glass to shatter completely. I am really stressed because I have an important meeting today, but I made sure to stay and help exchange all the necessary documents with the other driver.

It was a beautiful sunny day, and I was driving along the coast road toward Cascais. There was a car parked partially in a loading zone that pulled out without looking, forcing me to swerve. I caught the side of a concrete divider. I didn't hit the other car, but I damaged my own vehicle significantly. There is a large dent on the front fender. I am feeling quite anxious about the repair costs, as I rely on this car for my family errands and visiting my grandchildren every weekend.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving to the office this morning during the rush hour. The traffic was extremely dense. I stopped for a yellow light, and the driver behind me failed to stop in time and hit my rear bumper. My rear lamp is broken and there is a deep dent on the trunk lid. I am a busy professional, so I am hoping that the insurance process is straightforward. I have already contacted the other party and we have filled out the standard European accident report form.

I was following the Renault in the heavy morning traffic. The driver braked unexpectedly fast for the light, and I was not able to maintain enough distance to stop safely. I hit the back of his car. I am very sorry for the inconvenience caused. My front bumper has minor damage, and the Renault has a dent and a broken lamp.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 9:00 AM in heavy morning traffic. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because a delivery truck pulled out unexpectedly. Even though I hit my brakes immediately, the road was a bit damp and I couldn't stop in time. I bumped into the back of his vehicle at a very low speed, maybe 10 km/h. There is a visible dent on my front bumper and some scratches near the grille. I am really sorry about the inconvenience, man, this is so stressful.

I was just moving with the flow of traffic when the car ahead suddenly slowed down. I managed to stop, but then I felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me clearly didn't have enough distance, but he seems like a nice guy and apologized immediately. My rear bumper has a noticeable dent and some paint scratches from the impact.

It was about 5:30 PM, and as I was exiting the roundabout near the airport, the traffic was merging quite aggressively. I was in the outer lane when a white van tried to cut across to take the exit and scraped the side of my car. I tried to steer away but there was no room. There is a long, deep scratch along my passenger side door now. I've been driving for years and this just feels like a classic case of a blind spot collision during rush hour.

I was trying to parallel park near the center of Coimbra. It was getting dark and the street lighting isn't great on that corner. I misjudged the distance to the parked car behind me while reversing and ended up nudging his rear fender. I feel terrible about it, honestly. I checked the damage and there is a dent and some scratches where my bumper hit his. I have already called my insurance and I am waiting for the other driver to return to his vehicle so we can exchange details.

I was sitting at the cafe terrace right next to the parking spot. I saw the driver trying to maneuver into the space. It was a very tight spot and she was going slowly, but she miscalculated the angle and hit the other parked car. I saw the dent and the scratch appear on the bumper of the silver vehicle. She has been very polite and is waiting for the owner.

I was slowing down approaching a pedestrian crossing near the beach. The car behind me was perhaps distracted, and he bumped into my rear. It was not a hard impact, but it was just enough to shatter the glass of my rear light cluster. I've lived in this area my whole life and the traffic on the Marginal can be treacherous, especially when people are looking at the sea instead of the road. I am just worried about the repair costs, to be perfectly honest with you.

I admit I was looking at the ocean for a split second. The traffic ahead slowed down and I didn't react quickly enough. I hit his bumper at maybe 15 km/h. It shattered his rear light glass. I am taking full responsibility for this incident. It was entirely my fault and I am happy to cooperate with the insurance companies to get this sorted out quickly.

I was carefully entering the intersection at Rua da Prata. The visibility was blocked by a large tourist bus parked on the corner. A taxi pulled out from the side street, and we collided at the front quarter panels. It was a low-speed impact, but the result is a dent and a deep scratch on my driver-side fender. I have been very careful, but this intersection is known for being extremely difficult to navigate during the busy midday hours, which makes me very nervous.

I was emerging from the side street, slowly creeping forward because I knew the view was obscured by the bus. I didn't see the other car coming until it was too late. We both stopped instantly. I have a dent and a scratch on the side of my cab. It's unfortunate, but clearly a case of bad visibility and poor timing for both of us.

I was pulling out of a driveway onto the main avenue. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I missed a cyclist or a car coming out of the shadows. I nudged the rear of a parked vehicle. It resulted in a dent on their bumper and my front lamp is broken. I'm a bit shaken, to be honest. I was just trying to get to the grocery store to pick up some things for my grandson, and now my whole afternoon is ruined.

I was circulating the roundabout when another vehicle entered too fast and side-swiped me. The impact was quite jarring. My side mirror glass shattered, and there is a dent and a deep scratch along the passenger door. It's really frustrating because I was clearly in the right lane and following all the rules. Now I have to deal with these repairs, and it's just a huge waste of time. I really hope the other driver's insurance handles this professionally.

I was waiting to enter the roundabout from the adjacent road. I saw the Audi circulating properly, but the second vehicle simply did not yield. It came in too hot, tried to force its way in, and slammed into the side of the Audi. It was a clear collision. I saw the mirror glass shatter and the damage to the side door. I am happy to provide my statement.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 8:30 AM when the traffic suddenly came to a complete halt near the intersection. I braked as hard as I could, but the road was a bit damp from the morning mist and I just didn't stop in time. I tapped the back of the car in front of me at very low speed. I feel terrible about it, man, I was just heading to work and totally didn't expect that sudden stop. There is a noticeable dent on my front bumper now.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the afternoon rush hour, trying to exit towards the airport. It was quite chaotic with cars cutting in from everywhere. I was in the outer lane when a vehicle to my left suddenly shifted into my lane without signaling properly. I tried to swerve, but we made contact on the side. I am quite worried about the repair costs as the insurance process seems so complicated. There is a long scratch running along my passenger side door.

I was merging to take my exit at the roundabout when I realized I misjudged the distance between me and the car in the lane to my right. I moved over quickly and unfortunately, the side of my car scraped the other driver's door. It was an honest mistake in the heavy traffic, and I am happy to cooperate with the insurance report.

I was driving along Avenida 24 de Julho in the lane closest to the parked cars. It was sunny and visibility was excellent, but I simply didn't see the other vehicle attempting a lane change at the same time I was accelerating slightly. The front corner of my car clipped their rear light assembly. The impact was light but enough to shatter the plastic casing. My own headlamp broken as a result of this contact, and I am quite anxious about getting this fixed properly.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the tram stop when I saw the two cars moving into the same lane. Both drivers seemed to be looking ahead, and neither noticed the other until the collision happened. The contact caused one of the headlamps to break instantly. It seemed like a genuine misunderstanding of lane positioning.

Well, you see, I was driving down the Estrada Monumental, just going to pick up my grandson from his music lesson, as I do every Tuesday. The traffic was slow, and I suppose I was looking a bit too long at the beautiful flowers near the hotel entrance. Before I knew it, the car in front had stopped for a pedestrian, and I couldn't stop in time. My bumper has a dent and the front lamp broken. It's just terrible, I haven't had an accident in twenty years.

I was stationary at the traffic light on Avenida da República. The light had just turned green, but the car in front of me hesitated for a second. I released the brake but failed to notice they hadn't actually moved forward yet. I moved forward a few meters and bumped into their bumper. It was a complete lapse in concentration on my part. There is a small dent on the rear of their vehicle and my own front bumper.

I was at the front of the queue at the traffic light. When it turned green, I checked for pedestrians before moving. The driver behind me moved forward prematurely and hit my rear bumper. I have a minor dent from the impact. Everything is clear and documented.

It was raining, and the visibility on the roundabout was quite poor. I was merging when a van entered too fast from the right. We clipped mirrors, and the impact caused my side mirror to shatter. I’m quite shaken up because I’ve been driving for years and never experienced this. It’s a mess, but I have gathered the other driver’s details and we are waiting for the authorities to assist with the paperwork. The mirror glass shatter is the main visible damage on my side.

I was taking the second exit on the roundabout and I didn't see the other car approaching from the inner lane. My mirror made contact with theirs, which unfortunately caused the glass to shatter. I am responsible for the error, as the road conditions made it harder to see. I have provided my insurance information to the driver.

My commute on Avenida da Índia is usually quiet, but today a motorcyclist was weaving through traffic, and I had to adjust my position to give them space. In doing so, I didn't check my blind spot well enough and moved into the side of an SUV. It’s entirely my fault, man, I was just trying to be careful around the bike and made a huge mistake. There is a long scratch on the side of the other car and my own bumper.

I was cruising in the middle lane when the vehicle to my left suddenly steered into my path. I tried to honk, but we still made contact along the side of my car. It resulted in a scratch down the driver's side. The driver apologized immediately and admitted they were distracted by a motorcycle.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly came to a complete standstill. I tried to brake, but I think the road was still a bit damp from the earlier rain. I ended up sliding just a little bit and tapped the bumper of the car in front of me. I felt terrible, man. I got out immediately to check, and I can see a visible dent on my hood and some light scratch marks along the front panel. It was honestly just a silly mistake on my part.

I was stopped at the red light near the roundabout when I felt a sudden impact from behind. It wasn't a high-speed collision, but it was enough to jolt the car. The driver behind me was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the entire process of exchanging our details. I am just relieved nobody was hurt in the incident.

I was trying to park my car in a very tight spot near Rua Augusta this morning. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was reversing, I must have misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar. I heard a scraping noise and stopped instantly. When I got out, I realized I had left a long scratch on the rear passenger door. I am really stressed about the repair costs because I have only had this car for a few months, and it was a completely avoidable mistake.

It was very busy at the roundabout. I was in the outer lane, and I think the driver next to me tried to exit without looking properly. He swung into my lane and hit my side panel. I honked, but it happened too quickly to avoid. Now, there is a clear dent on the side door and my indicator lamp is broken. I'm just so worried about how I'm going to get to work tomorrow while this is being sorted out. It's really frustrating when you're just trying to drive safely, you know?

I was navigating the roundabout and wanted to move to the exit lane. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I missed the car in the blind spot. We made contact at low speed. The other driver was understandably upset, but we both agreed to pull over safely to avoid blocking the flow of traffic.

I was driving towards the intersection at around 30 km/h when a cyclist swerved unexpectedly from the sidewalk. I swerved to avoid hitting him and ended up clipping a parked delivery van. The impact caused the side window glass to shatter completely. I am still shaking a little bit, to be honest. It all happened so fast, and I was just trying to make sure I didn't hit the person on the bike. The van owner was nearby and came over to help me check the damage.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the whole thing. The driver was clearly trying to avoid the cyclist who entered the road without looking. The car didn't hit the cyclist, but it definitely hit the parked van. The glass from the car window shattered onto the pavement. It was a very unfortunate accident.

I was heading home after visiting my daughter for Sunday lunch. I must have been distracted by the GPS for a split second, and the driver ahead of me slowed down to turn into a side street. I pressed the brake, but not soon enough to avoid a small bump. My front bumper has a visible dent now. I feel quite foolish as I have been driving for over forty years without an incident. My daughter helped me fill out the form because my hands were shaking quite a bit from the shock of it all.

I was pulling out of a petrol station on the Estrada Monumental. I checked the traffic, but I failed to see a motorcycle coming from my right side. We clipped each other as I moved forward. My left front lamp is broken, and there is a deep scratch along the bumper where we made contact. The motorcyclist remained upright, thankfully, but his bike fell over. We are both just relieved that there are no serious injuries to report, as it was a very scary moment for everyone involved at the pump.

I was riding along the road when the car pulled out from the service station. I tried to brake, but there wasn't enough space to stop entirely. We made contact at a very low speed. My bike went down, but I am unhurt. We have exchanged all the necessary insurance details for the car damage.

The traffic was moving slowly along the avenue. I needed to move into the left lane to prepare for my turn. I looked in my mirror, but I suppose the other driver accelerated when I was halfway into the lane. We scraped against each other's side panels. There is a long scratch on my driver-side door. I feel quite bad because I should have been more careful, even if I thought the other driver was leaving a gap. It is such a hassle dealing with this paperwork, but I want to be honest about what happened.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was circling the roundabout, staying in the middle lane. Another car was in the inside lane and suddenly decided to take the exit, cutting across my path. I tried to swerve, but I hit the curb, and he caught my rear bumper. There is a noticeable dent on the bumper and the rear lamp is broken. I am really annoyed, dude. I was driving perfectly well, and then this happens right in the middle of the city. I just hope the insurance covers the repairs without me having to pay a fortune.

I was following my GPS and got confused about which exit to take. I realized too late that I needed the next one. I made a move to the right, and unfortunately, the other car was there. I accept full responsibility for the collision. It was an honest mistake caused by my own confusion at the junction.

I was parked on the street. When I came back from the grocery store, I found a note on my windshield saying my car had been hit by a delivery driver while he was backing up. There is a dent and a scratch on the back panel. The driver left his phone number, so I called him immediately. He was very apologetic and admitted he didn't see me because the street was quite narrow. It's a shame, but at least he did the right thing and stayed to report it.

I was stopped at the traffic lights on the avenue. The sun was very bright and reflecting off the pavement, which might have blinded the driver behind me. Suddenly, I felt a heavy impact from the rear. My rear window glass shattered from the force of the collision, and the boot has a significant dent. I am quite shaken as I had my grandchildren in the back, but they are all okay, thank goodness. We are just waiting for the police to finish their report so we can leave.

The sun glare was absolutely blinding as I approached the lights. I didn't see that the car in front had stopped. I hit the brakes, but it was too late. I feel terrible about the damage and the fact that there were children in the vehicle. I am fully cooperating with the insurance requirements.

I was driving home from work along Avenida da Boavista during the evening rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy, stop-and-go as usual. I was keeping a safe distance behind the car in front of me, but when the traffic lights ahead suddenly turned amber, the driver in front hit their brakes quite hard. I tried to react quickly, but I just could not stop in time and tapped their bumper. It was a low-speed impact, but now there is a noticeable dent on my front bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just a lapse in reaction time.

I was stopped at the red light on Boavista when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. It was not a massive impact, but clearly enough to push my car forward a few centimeters. The driver behind me immediately pulled over and apologized, checking if I was okay. I can see a dent on my rear bumper where the impact occurred.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música, which is always chaotic. I was in the outer lane trying to exit towards the city center. I checked my mirrors, but I think I misjudged the position of the van in the inner lane. As I started to maneuver, I heard a grinding noise and realized I had grazed the side of their vehicle. I feel like such an idiot, I was just trying to get home to my family. There is a long, visible scratch running along my passenger side door.

I was attempting to park in a very tight spot near the Baixa district. It was raining slightly, and the cobbles were quite slippery. I miscalculated my turning angle while reversing into the bay and ended up bumping into a parked sedan. I am so incredibly worried about the repair costs because I am a student and this is my first car. I can see a nasty dent and a long scratch on the rear corner of my bumper where I hit the other vehicle.

I was walking past the parking zone when I saw a small car struggling to reverse into a space. It was raining quite hard at the time. The driver misjudged the angle and made contact with the stationary car. It was clearly an honest mistake, not a high-speed collision, but I saw the resulting dent and scratch on the bumper.

It was early morning and I was heading towards the Cais do Sodré area. The traffic was dense. I was in the middle lane and decided to move to the right lane because my exit was coming up. I put my signal on, but I think I must have been in the other driver's blind spot. We made side-to-side contact while moving. My front light assembly took the brunt of it and is now completely broken. It has been a very stressful morning for me, I really didn't mean for this to happen.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was approaching the green light at the junction. The weather was sunny, but the glare was really bad coming off the windows of the office buildings. I honestly didn't see the cyclist or the debris in the road until I hit something sharp, like a glass bottle that had fallen off a truck. It caused my passenger side window to shatter immediately. It was so loud and sudden, I am still shaking. I pulled over as soon as I could, but the glass is everywhere.

I was dropping off my groceries at the hotel, parked on a slight incline. I must not have engaged the handbrake firmly enough. As I walked away, the car rolled back slowly and nudged a stone wall planter. It was a very gentle impact, but unfortunately, there is a clear dent on the rear tailgate. I feel quite embarrassed by the whole situation, as it was entirely my fault for not securing the car properly. It is a real hassle to deal with this while on vacation.

I was commuting along Avenida da Liberdade, just enjoying the morning sun, you know, listening to the radio. Suddenly, traffic stopped dead. I applied the brakes, but I was maybe a bit distracted. I clipped the rear of the car ahead of me. It wasn't a huge crash, but it definitely damaged their light and left a long scratch on the plastic trim. The other driver was fine, but I'm just so worried about my premium going up, man. This is just not what I needed today.

I was minding my own business, driving slowly towards the roundabout. The car behind me didn't brake in time and hit my rear corner. It caused my brake light to break and left a visible scratch on the bumper. It’s an inconvenience, but the other driver was very apologetic about the whole thing.

I have lived in this neighborhood for forty years and the streets are getting tighter with all these new delivery vans everywhere. I was driving down Rua de Cedofeita, trying to give space to an oncoming cyclist. I swerved slightly to the right, forgetting about the metal post near the curb. I heard a scraping sound and stopped immediately. There is a long, deep scratch along my driver-side door now. It is such a shame, I keep my car in pristine condition usually. I should have been much more careful near that curb.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: It was a busy afternoon and I was trying to exit the main road. The driver in front of me signaled left but then stopped suddenly to let someone cross the street. I was looking at the traffic flow and failed to see them stop in time. I hit the rear of their vehicle, resulting in a dent on my hood and my front lamp being broken. I am quite anxious about the claims process, as I have never had to do this before. I just hope the other driver is not too upset.

I stopped my vehicle safely at the pedestrian crossing as required by law. Without warning, I felt a solid impact from the rear. I exited my vehicle to find the other driver looking very distressed. The impact caused visible damage to their front end, including a broken light and a dented bonnet.

I was pulling into a spot on Avenida da Republica to run a quick errand at the post office. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I was wrong. I scraped my side against a metal bollard on the sidewalk. It wasn't a hard hit, but the scratch is quite visible along the rear passenger door. It's frustrating because I'm usually very attentive, but I was in a rush and I suppose that led to a lapse in judgment. I just want to get it repaired as soon as possible.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy, and the driver in front of me suddenly braked hard for a turning vehicle. I tried my best to stop, but I tapped the rear bumper of his car. I feel terrible about the whole situation. It was just a moment of poor reaction time on my part. There is a noticeable dent and a few scratches on my front bumper where I made contact.

I was stopped at a red light when I felt a sudden bump from behind. I checked my mirror just before the impact and saw the driver looking down for a split second. The collision resulted in some paint transfer and a dent on my rear bumper. We were both cooperative and exchanged our insurance details right there on the side of the road.

I was proceeding along Avenida da Liberdade, maintaining a steady speed of about 30 km/h. A vehicle to my right initiated a lane change without signaling correctly and clipped my side panel. I attempted to steer slightly left to avoid him, but the contact was unavoidable. The impact caused a significant scratch and a shallow dent on my rear passenger door. It is quite disappointing as I try to maintain my vehicle in excellent condition.

I was sitting at the outdoor café nearby. I saw the Mercedes driving straight when the blue van in the right lane moved over abruptly. They collided mid-lane. The van driver definitely didn't check his blind spot. The impact created some noise, but luckily it was a low-speed incident and both drivers pulled over immediately to resolve the matter.

I was traveling on the N125 toward Faro. The sun was quite low, creating a bit of glare, and the car in front of me stopped suddenly for a cyclist. I applied the brakes, but I couldn't stop in time. My front right lamp is broken, and there is shattered glass from the lens on the road. I am very shaken up by this accident. I've already called the roadside assistance to clear the debris and move the vehicle safely.

I came to a stop because I noticed a cyclist swerving in the lane. The driver behind me didn't seem to see me braking in time. He hit my rear bumper. My car is relatively undamaged, but I was worried about the driver behind me because he looked quite distressed. We exchanged information immediately, and he seemed very concerned about the damage to his headlights.

It was a busy afternoon in Porto, and the streets were, as always, quite congested with tourists and delivery vans. I was proceeding slowly through a narrow section of the street when a parked van opened its door without checking. I swerved to the left to avoid the door, but I ended up scraping the side of my car against a concrete planter on the sidewalk. It left a very visible scratch along the entire passenger side. I am just glad no one was walking there at that time.

I was in the middle lane on Avenida da República. I signaled to move into the left lane. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other vehicle was in a blind spot. We made contact, which resulted in a dent on my front wing and a broken lamp unit. I feel terrible about this because I am usually a very defensive driver. The other party was kind enough to stop so we could write down all the relevant insurance details.

I was driving in the left lane when I saw the Renault moving over. I honked, but there wasn't enough space or time for them to pull back. The collision damaged their lamp and left a dent on their side panel. I am just relieved that both our vehicles are still drivable, even with the damage to the front lighting and the bodywork.

I was crossing the bridge, and the traffic was moving quite slowly due to the wind and the congestion. The car ahead of me, a silver sedan, slowed down abruptly because of a plastic bag blowing across the lanes. I hit the brakes, but I didn't stop in time and tapped his bumper. There is a small, noticeable dent on my hood. I am quite worried about how this will affect my insurance premiums, as I haven't had an accident in fifteen years.

I was maneuvering to get into a spot near the Praça do Comércio. I was moving at maybe 5 km/h, and I didn't see the low bollard in my rear-view camera because of the bright sunlight reflecting on the screen. I backed into it, which caused a scratch and some glass shatter from my rear light assembly. Man, this really ruins my day. I was just trying to get to my meeting on time, and now I have to deal with this mess.

I was standing near the square when I saw the small car reversing. The driver clearly didn't see the metal post behind him. He hit it quite softly, but the sound of the glass shattering was distinct. I walked over to ask if he was okay, and he seemed very stressed about the damage to his car. It was clearly just an unfortunate accident due to the poor visibility.

I was trying to park my car along the side of the road in Cedofeita this afternoon, just around 3:00 PM. I misjudged the distance between my bumper and the bollard on the sidewalk while backing up. It was only moving at maybe 2 km/h, but I felt a slight scrape. When I got out to check, I saw a long, deep scratch running along the rear passenger side panel. I feel terrible about it, honestly, as I just got this car painted last year and I really should have been paying closer attention.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relogio, heading towards the airport exit. Traffic was quite heavy, and as I was exiting the roundabout, the van beside me drifted into my lane without signaling. I slammed on the brakes, but he clipped my front fender. It caused a significant dent right above the wheel arch. I am quite stressed about the repair costs, man, it all happened so fast and I am worried my premium will go up just because of his mistake.

I admit I drifted slightly while distracted by my GPS at the roundabout. The sun was in my eyes, and I didn't see the Seat Ibiza in my blind spot. I hit his front fender at low speed, causing a visible dent. I accept full responsibility for the incident.

I was driving home along Avenida dos Aliados when the traffic light suddenly turned amber. I applied the brakes normally, but the vehicle behind me clearly didn't react in time. They slammed right into my rear bumper. The force was enough to leave a nasty scratch and, unfortunately, shattered my rear tail lamp. It was a very jarring experience, and I am still shaking a little bit from the shock of the impact, even though I am physically fine, thank you.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the plaza and saw the whole thing. The BMW slowed down reasonably for the yellow light, but the white hatchback behind it was definitely following too closely. It was a clear rear-end collision, resulting in the BMW's broken tail lamp and some scratches on the plastic bumper.

It was raining quite heavily on Avenida da Boavista, and the roads were slick. I was keeping in my lane, driving at about 40 km/h, when a delivery truck tried to squeeze past me. He moved back into my lane way too early and his rear side panel scraped against my front passenger door. It left a long, ugly scratch across the paint. I am so annoyed because I was driving cautiously due to the wet weather, but he just didn't leave enough space for the maneuver.

I was approaching the intersection near the airport when the car coming from the perpendicular road failed to respect the stop sign. They crossed into my path, and although I tried to swerve, they clipped my front corner. The impact caused a deep dent in my wing and smashed my headlight unit completely. I have been driving for thirty years and I always tell my grandson to be careful at these junctions, yet here I am dealing with this mess on a Tuesday afternoon.

I apologize, I honestly did not see the stop sign as I was looking for a street name. I pulled out into the intersection and hit the side of the Toyota. My bumper caught his lamp and wing, causing some dents and breaking the light. I am very sorry for the inconvenience.

I was parked near the pedestrian zone in the city center. When I returned to my car, I found a note on the windshield. Apparently, someone had miscalculated their turn while exiting the parking row and drove into the side of my car. There is a distinct dent on the door and several deep scratches along the side trim. I am incredibly frustrated because the car was parked perfectly legally, and now I have to deal with the insurance repair process, which is just such a hassle, you know?

I was enjoying the drive along the coast road in Cascais when traffic ahead suddenly came to a complete standstill. I managed to stop my Audi without issue, but the elderly gentleman behind me failed to react. He hit the back of my car quite hard. Fortunately, it resulted only in a large dent in my trunk lid, but nothing more. It was a stressful situation, especially being so close to the ocean, but we managed to pull over safely to exchange details afterward.

I was driving along the coast and did not anticipate the traffic stopping so abruptly. My foot slipped off the pedal, and I collided with the back of the Audi. It caused a dent to his rear bumper area. I am truly sorry for the trouble.

I was traveling in the middle lane of Avenida da Republica, heading north. I signaled to switch to the right lane to take the turnoff. Just as I was halfway through my move, a motorcycle suddenly sped up from behind and clipped my side mirror and door. It caused my indicator lamp to break and left a series of nasty scratches along the paint. I am really worried about this, man, because I feel like I signaled correctly, but he was moving way too fast in the city.

I was leaving the shopping area and backing out of a tight spot. I didn't see the concrete pillar behind me until it was too late. I hit it at maybe 3 km/h. It caused a dent in the bumper and, unfortunately, a visible crack in the plastic molding near the wheel. I should have been more careful, especially since the area was a bit dark, but it was entirely my fault and I am ready to pay whatever excess is required.

I saw the driver backing out of the parking spot. They were going very slowly, but they misjudged the position of the concrete pillar. The car impacted the pillar directly, causing a dent to the bumper and cracking the plastic trim. It was clearly an honest mistake.

The traffic was incredibly dense near the riverfront. I was driving straight when a bus attempted to merge into my lane without checking properly. I was forced to drive over the lane markings to avoid a worse collision, but he still caught my rear quarter panel with his side. It left a series of deep scratches along the body. It was a terrifying experience being pushed by such a large vehicle, and I am just glad that no one was hurt during the incident today.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM in heavy traffic. The car in front of me stopped quite abruptly because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to brake, but I didn't have enough distance and I bumped into their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it, man, honestly. I'm worried about my insurance premiums going up now. My car has a dent on the hood and some visible scratches on the front bumper. I just hope the other driver is okay because he seemed a bit shaken up too, you know?

It was raining this morning near the airport and everything was a bit chaotic on the roundabout. I was trying to exit towards the A1, but the traffic was moving in a tight flow. The driver next to me veered into my lane suddenly, and I just couldn't move out of the way fast enough to avoid contact. My front-right lamp is broken now. I am really stressed about how I am going to get to work without my car for a few days.

I was attempting to take the third exit at the roundabout when I felt a sudden impact on my rear-left side. I admit I might have been a bit hasty with my lane change because I was running late, and the wet road surface made it difficult to keep perfect control. It was completely unintentional.

I was pulling into a very narrow parking spot on Rua da Prata this afternoon. I thought I had calculated the distance to the concrete pillar correctly, but I clearly misjudged it. I heard a scraping sound and stopped immediately. When I got out, I saw a long scratch along the rear passenger door. I am feeling quite anxious because I have only had this car for three months and it was pristine. It was just a silly mistake on my part while trying to fit into a tight space.

I was proceeding through the intersection on a green light, and I honestly did not see the other vehicle coming from the side street until it was too late. I was going perhaps 30 km/h. They came out so fast that I hit the side of their car. It was quite a shock, really. There is a deep dent on my front panel and some glass shatter from the headlight unit. I am quite worried about the repair costs, as the damage looks rather significant to the front end.

I was walking nearby when I heard the loud sound of metal meeting metal. The car coming from the side street definitely appeared to enter the intersection without checking if the way was clear. The BMW driver tried to brake but couldn't stop in time. It was a clear accident; no one was speeding excessively, but the timing was simply unfortunate for both parties involved.

I was driving along the Estrada Monumental, and I checked my mirrors before signaling to change to the left lane to make a turn later. I suppose I did not notice the other car in my blind spot. As I began to shift over, I felt a vibration and heard a loud scrape against my side. I have a dent and several scratches on the driver-side door. I feel quite foolish, as I usually consider myself a careful driver, but the sun glare was really terrible at that moment.

My husband and I were out running errands in Gaia today. I was reversing out of a parking spot near the local grocery store, moving very slowly, maybe 5 km/h. I didn't see the bollard behind the car because it was obscured by the rear headrests. My bumper hit it directly. There is now a distinct crack in the plastic trim. We've had such a long day visiting our grandchildren, and I suppose I was just a bit tired and not paying enough attention to the sensors.

I was driving to the office this morning at approximately 9:00 AM. Traffic on Avenida da República was stop-and-go as usual. The car in front slowed down suddenly, and I followed suit, but the vehicle behind me clearly didn't react quickly enough. I felt a heavy shove from the rear. My bumper has a significant dent, and the rear lamp is broken. I am quite worried about the hassle of dealing with the repairs, as I rely on this car for my daily commute.

I feel absolutely terrible about this. I was distracted for just a split second by a notification on my phone mount, and when I looked back at the road, the car in front had stopped. I slammed on the brakes, but I still made contact. I take full responsibility for the accident and my failure to maintain a safe braking distance.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at the Rotunda da Boavista. The traffic was extremely dense, and a van was moving aggressively in the next lane. As we were curving around the square, the van edged too close to my vehicle, scraping along my passenger side panel. There is a deep scratch spanning the length of the rear door. I tried to honk, but I think the driver couldn't hear me over the traffic noise. It was quite a stressful experience during the morning rush.

It was getting dark, around 7:30 PM, when I reached the junction. I had the right of way, but another vehicle crossed my path while attempting an illegal U-turn. My car hit them on the side. I have a dent, a broken lamp, and multiple scratches on my front end. I am quite shaken up by the whole ordeal. I have never been in an accident before, and I am not entirely sure what the next steps are for filing the report correctly.

I saw the entire thing from the sidewalk. The driver of the Citroën was driving at a normal speed and clearly had the green light. The other driver tried to make a U-turn where it is clearly prohibited, which caused the Citroën to strike them. It was a genuine accident caused by the other driver's poor decision at the intersection.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was really heavy as usual. I was keeping a safe distance, but the car in front of me slammed on its brakes suddenly because of a cyclist. I tried to stop, but I just couldn't manage to pull up in time. I bumped into his rear bumper at a very low speed. There is a noticeable dent on my front hood now, and I feel absolutely terrible about the whole situation, man.

It was raining quite heavily this morning near the Rotunda da Boavista. I was navigating the roundabout in the middle lane when a van suddenly cut across from the inner lane to exit. I didn't have enough time to react before he scraped the side of my passenger door. I am quite worried about the repair costs, as I have a long scratch across the entire door panel. It all happened so fast, and the road was quite slippery due to the morning showers.

I was trying to exit the roundabout and perhaps misjudged the distance to the vehicle in the adjacent lane. The roads were very wet, which made braking difficult. I ended up scraping the side of the Seat Ibiza as I moved to the exit lane. I acknowledge that I initiated the maneuver and regret the inconvenience caused to the other driver.

I was attempting to park my Fiat 500 near Praça do Comércio. It was quite a tight spot, and I was trying to be extra careful given the amount of tourists walking around. As I was reversing, I miscalculated the angle and clipped the concrete bollard on the corner. The impact caused a deep scratch and a small dent on the rear bumper. I feel really foolish as this was entirely my error while trying to maneuver into a difficult space on a busy Saturday afternoon.

I was driving along Avenida 24 de Julho heading toward Cais do Sodré. I intended to change lanes to turn right, and I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the car in my blind spot. I initiated the move and felt a sudden jolt. Upon pulling over, I saw that my side lamp was broken and there was a scratch on the side wing. I am quite shaken up by this incident as I have always been a very careful driver.

I was maintaining my lane on Avenida 24 de Julho when the Peugeot 208 suddenly veered into my lane without giving me enough space to move aside. I tried to honk, but we collided before I could do anything. My side mirror took the brunt of the impact, and their side lamp was broken during the contact.

I was driving through a green light at the intersection on Avenida da República. Suddenly, another car entered the intersection from a side street without stopping at the sign. I slammed on the brakes but hit their rear quarter panel. The impact caused a significant dent on my bumper and my headlight glass shattered instantly from the force. It was really startling, and I am still trying to process exactly how it happened so quickly in front of the local pharmacy.

I was waiting on the sidewalk near the intersection when I saw the Renault Megane passing through on a green light. A car came out from the side street and failed to stop at the intersection, leading to a collision. I saw the headlight glass shatter and the dent on the bumper immediately after the impact occurred.

I was navigating the narrow streets of Porto, specifically Rua de Santa Catarina, looking for a parking spot. There was a delivery van unloading supplies, and as I tried to squeeze past him, the road narrowed quite significantly. I underestimated the space and scraped the side of my vehicle against the brick wall of a building. It left a long, ugly scratch along the passenger side. I feel rather embarrassed, as I should have just waited for the van to move instead of trying to pass.

I was stopped at a red light on Avenida Luísa Todi. I was just checking my navigation when the car behind me failed to stop and tapped my rear. I jumped out to check the damage and found that my rear lamp was broken and there was a clear dent in the boot lid. I am a bit worried about how long it will take to get these parts replaced, as I rely on this car every single day for my job.

I was coming up to the traffic lights on Avenida Luísa Todi and got momentarily distracted by the sunset over the water. By the time I looked back at the road, the Ford Fiesta in front was stationary. I applied the brakes, but I wasn't able to avoid a collision. I damaged their rear lamp and caused a dent on their car.

I have been driving in Lisbon for forty years, and I usually have no trouble, but this morning at the Rotunda do Relógio, things were quite hectic. It was very busy with airport traffic. While I was attempting to exit the roundabout, a driver clipped the front corner of my vehicle. The impact broke my left lamp. It was quite frightening for me, and I spent a good twenty minutes calming down before I could even start to talk to the other driver about the incident.

I was waiting for my bus near the roundabout and witnessed the collision. The Dacia was correctly positioned to exit, but a faster-moving vehicle tried to pass on the outside, clipping the Dacia's front corner. I saw the lamp shatter and fall onto the asphalt immediately after the contact.

I was traveling along the waterfront on Avenida Infante Dom Henrique. Traffic was stop-and-go because of the road maintenance nearby. I came to a halt behind a bus, and the car behind me simply didn't stop in time. He hit me at about 15 km/h. There is a deep dent on my rear bumper and quite a few surface scratches from the impact. I am just glad no one was hurt, but it is such a nuisance to deal with all this paperwork now.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, just heading home after a very long day at the office. The traffic was quite heavy as usual, and I was moving slowly, probably at 20 km/h. Suddenly, the car ahead of me stopped abruptly for a pedestrian. I hit my brakes, but I didn't stop in time and tapped their bumper. It was completely my fault, man, I'm so stressed about the repair costs because I'm just starting out in my career. I noticed a visible dent on the rear bumper of the other car.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio at mid-morning. It was quite chaotic, with cars coming from every direction, and I think I misjudged the distance while merging into the outer lane. I felt a slight scrape as I passed the side of a delivery van. I pulled over immediately to check the damage; there is a noticeable scratch along my passenger side door. I feel terrible about this because I have never had an accident before, and I really hope the insurance process isn't too complicated.

I was driving through the roundabout when the other driver tried to move into my lane without checking their blind spot. It was a low-speed impact, but they definitely scraped the side of my van. I stopped right away to exchange details. It is frustrating to have to deal with this, but I am glad no one was hurt.

I was parking near the city center, and it was a very tight spot. I was trying to reverse carefully, but I miscalculated the angle against a concrete post. It was a silly mistake on my part, honestly. My car hit the post and I can see a clear dent and some long scratches on the rear panel now. I'm worried about how much this is going to cost me to fix. I should have been much more patient while maneuvering, especially with how cramped the parking spaces are around here.

I was approaching the intersection on Avenida Luísa Todi under the rain. The road surface felt quite slippery, you know? When the light turned amber, I tried to brake, but I think I skidded slightly and nudged the vehicle in front. It was just a small bump, but I can see that my front left lamp is broken now. I am so worried because this is my only car for getting to university, and I really hope I can get it sorted out quickly without too many issues.

The light changed, and I slowed down normally, but the driver behind me didn't seem to account for the wet road. They hit my car from behind. I checked my vehicle and it seems okay, but their front light is definitely broken and hanging loose. We exchanged information immediately after the incident.

I was driving along Avenida da França during the late afternoon. I wanted to switch lanes to make a left turn, and I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the car in my blind spot. I moved over and we made contact. It was such a loud noise, which really startled me. There is a long scratch on the rear quarter panel of my car. I feel so bad about the mistake; I should have double-checked before moving over into the lane.

My goodness, I was just driving slowly along Rua da Prata looking for a pharmacy for my wife, and it was quite crowded with tourists everywhere. I was moving at maybe 10 km/h when I turned too sharply and brushed against a parked car. I didn't mean any harm, but I can see a distinct dent on my door now. It's truly a nuisance, as I have so many appointments to attend today and I simply do not have the time for all this paperwork and insurance fuss.

I was walking down the sidewalk when I saw the small Fiat turn too tightly while trying to navigate around the traffic. It clearly impacted the side of a parked vehicle. I saw the driver get out immediately to assess the dent. It was an honest mistake in a very narrow street.

I was driving towards Faro on the EN125 when the traffic suddenly came to a complete halt due to roadwork. I was distracted for just a split second by the GPS, and by the time I looked up, I was already too close to the car in front. I slammed on the brakes, but I hit them. My headlight cover cracked and I can see glass shatter on the ground from the impact. I am so panicked about this; I am just a student and have no idea how this process works.

I was maneuvering to leave a parking spot on Avenida dos Aliados. I was being quite careful, checking my mirrors, but there was a delivery vehicle coming up the lane faster than I anticipated. I didn't see him in time and our bumpers collided. It caused a significant dent on my bumper and my side lamp is broken as well. I am very embarrassed about this incident, as I have been driving for over thirty years without a single claim. It is truly quite upsetting for me.

I was driving down the street when the Corsa pulled out of their spot without waiting for me to pass. I couldn't swerve in time because of the traffic in the other lane. We collided at low speed. Their car has a broken light and a dent. I stopped to exchange insurance details.

It was during the morning rush hour on Avenida da República. The traffic was bumper to bumper, and I was trying to merge into the lane to my right. I guess I didn't leave enough space because the other driver and I made side contact. There is a long scratch running along the side of my vehicle. I am just really stressed out about it because I was already running late for a very important client meeting. I'm sorry for the inconvenience caused to the other driver.

I was driving along the waterfront at about 40 km/h. The vehicle in front stopped suddenly because a tourist was crossing the road unexpectedly. I couldn't stop in time, even though I was at a safe distance. I impacted their rear bumper. It created a noticeable dent on my hood and their rear bumper. I'm just so worried about my insurance premiums increasing after this. I've always tried to be a responsible driver, but these city roads can be so unpredictable, especially with all the foot traffic around.

I was walking nearby and witnessed the incident. A pedestrian darted out into the street, forcing the first driver to slam on their brakes. The driver behind them didn't have enough time to react and rear-ended the first car. It was clearly an unavoidable situation for the second driver.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic was quite heavy near the roundabout. I came to a complete stop because the car in front of me halted suddenly, but the driver behind me, perhaps distracted, failed to brake in time. I felt a solid jolt as he struck my rear bumper. When I got out to check, I saw a clear dent on my bumper. It was quite a stressful moment, especially since I'm already worried about my insurance premiums going up because of this unavoidable accident, you know?

I admit that I misjudged the distance between our vehicles while checking my GPS. I was traveling at a very low speed, probably under 15 km/h, but I couldn't stop in time to avoid hitting the back of the Golf. It was entirely my fault, and I am ready to cooperate with the insurance companies to settle the damage.

I was pulling into a parking space near the square this morning. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I miscalculated the angle while reversing. I heard a slight noise as I brushed against the side of the car parked next to me. I immediately got out and noticed a scratch on the rear passenger door. I feel terrible about it, honestly. I've never had a claim like this before, and I really hope the repair process isn't too complicated or expensive to handle through the normal insurance channels.

I was navigating through the narrow streets of the city center when a delivery truck tried to overtake me. The road was tight, and the driver of the truck didn't allow enough space, swiping the side of my car. I stopped immediately and saw a scratch and a dent along my front fender. It was all so sudden, and I was quite shaken up by the proximity of the impact. I just want to make sure my car gets fixed correctly without any further hassle.

I was in a rush to complete a delivery and didn't notice the Yaris was so close when I moved into the lane. I clipped the side of the vehicle while trying to pass. I fully accept responsibility for the damage caused to the other car.

It was pouring rain this morning on the way to the bridge. The traffic was bumper-to-bumper, and the road was incredibly slippery. The car ahead of me braked hard due to a sudden stop in traffic, and although I slammed on my brakes, my car skidded slightly into their rear. It resulted in a broken lamp and some glass shatter on the road. I am really distressed about the whole thing, as I've been driving carefully, but the weather just made it impossible to avoid.

I was walking on the sidewalk nearby when I heard the loud sound of glass shattering. I saw the Renault slip on the wet road surface and bump into the vehicle in front. The rain was very heavy, and visibility was quite low at that time of the morning.

The weather was lovely, typical for a Saturday near the coast, and I was enjoying a drive with my grandson. I was maintaining a steady speed of about 50 km/h in my lane, and I suppose the other driver was distracted as they veered into my lane without checking.
