I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was trailing a silver car, and when the driver ahead braked suddenly for a pedestrian crossing, I just couldn't stop in time. I was probably only doing 20 km/h, but I bumped into their rear bumper. It was completely my fault, I was a bit distracted by the radio. There is a noticeable dent on my front bumper now. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just a lapse in concentration on my part.

I was stopped at the crosswalk because someone was trying to cross the street. Suddenly, I felt a solid impact from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the Volkswagen behind me. He came out and apologized immediately, clearly upset. My rear bumper sustained a dent from the impact, but thankfully nobody was hurt in the incident.

Man, this is so stressful, I've only had this car for six months! I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, trying to exit towards the airport, and I guess I misjudged the distance of the car in the inner lane. As I tried to change lanes, I heard this horrible scraping sound. I pulled over immediately. There is a long, deep scratch along my passenger side door. I’m just so worried about how much this is going to cost to fix, you know? It was just a stupid mistake during a busy morning commute.

I was trying to parallel park near the main square here in Porto. It was a tight space, and while I was reversing, I turned the wheel a bit too early. I clipped the corner of the van parked behind me. I heard the sound and stopped right away. When I got out, I saw that I had caused a dent and a scratch on the side of the van. I feel absolutely awful about it. I have already exchanged insurance information with the owner who was nearby having a coffee.

I was sitting at a cafe when I heard a loud thump outside. I ran out to find the driver of the BMW looking quite panicked. He had hit the back of my van while parking. It caused a dent and some scratch marks on my rear panel. He was very polite and admitted he had miscalculated the distance while reversing.

Well, back in my day, we were taught to check our mirrors three times before moving, but I suppose I let my guard down today. I was driving along the N125, heading towards Faro, and decided to move to the left lane. I didn't see the car coming up alongside me, and we scraped sides. It was quite a shock, really, especially with the sun glaring so brightly off the road. It left a nasty scratch on my left side door. I’m just glad we both managed to keep our cars steady and pull over safely.

I was driving about twenty meters behind the two vehicles. I saw the Renault begin to move into the left lane without signaling clearly. The other driver couldn't react in time, and there was a clear contact between the two sides of the cars. It left a visible scratch on both vehicles, but thankfully they didn't collide hard enough to lose control.

I was crossing the intersection at Avenida da República when the lights changed faster than I expected. Another driver was turning, and we just caught each other's corners. I think I was doing about 30 km/h. It’s my fault, I was definitely trying to beat the amber light, which was a very poor decision. My front left lamp is broken from the impact. I am just really shaken up by the whole experience. I have provided the other driver with my policy details and we are waiting for the police report.

I was waiting at a red light on the main avenue. It was a quiet morning, just minding my own business, when suddenly, WHAM. The car behind me didn't stop in time. It wasn't a very fast hit, maybe 15 km/h, but it was enough to shatter my rear glass. The driver behind me was just as surprised as I was. We pulled over by the sidewalk to discuss everything. I'm quite worried about driving it home like this with the glass shattered everywhere, it's quite a mess in the cabin.

I am so incredibly sorry. My foot slipped off the brake pedal while I was reaching for my water bottle. I bumped into the back of the Smart car ahead of me at the red light. The impact was enough to cause the rear glass to shatter on their vehicle. I feel terrible for the inconvenience I have caused them today.

Traffic on the bridge was moving quite slowly, probably around 40 km/h, which is normal for this time of day. I tried to merge into the lane to my right, but I clearly miscalculated the speed of the other driver. There was contact, which resulted in a dent and some scratch marks on my passenger fender. I immediately signaled and moved to the emergency lane. I’ve been driving for years and never had an issue like this. I hope the repair process isn't too complicated given the location.

I was driving down Rua de Santa Catarina, looking for a spot to drop off my groceries. The street is so narrow and crowded. As I was turning, I clipped a bollard on the sidewalk. It was a very low speed impact, but enough to result in my front lamp being broken. It’s embarrassing, really. I was just focused on the pedestrians and completely forgot how tight the turn actually was. I've already cleared the debris from the road so that no one else gets a flat tire.

It was raining quite heavily, which made the roads very slippery here in Braga. I was approaching the roundabout on Avenida da Liberdade when I had to brake hard. The car behind me hit my bumper. It wasn't a massive impact, but it left a visible dent on my rear bumper. The other driver was very apologetic, considering the poor weather conditions. We have exchanged all the necessary details for the insurance claim. I am just glad no one was hurt despite the road conditions.

With the rain pouring down like that, my brakes just didn't hold as well as I expected on the wet asphalt. I slid forward and hit the back of the Nissan. I am truly sorry about the dent on their car. I was driving slowly, but the road was just too slick for a safe stop at that distance.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: Honestly, dude, I don't even know how it happened. I was just cruising along in the middle lane, and another car came up from my right. It was like they didn't see me at all. We side-swiped each other, which caused a long scratch across my door. I’m just totally stressed out because this is a lease vehicle and I don't want to deal with high repair fees, you know? It’s just super frustrating. The other guy was nice about it, but it’s still such a headache to deal with the insurance paperwork.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM yesterday when traffic suddenly slowed down. I pressed the brakes, but I guess I didn't leave enough distance between me and the car ahead. I tapped the rear bumper of the Mercedes in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. It was completely my fault, I was just a bit distracted by the heavy traffic. I got out, checked the back of his car, and saw a clear dent on the bumper. I'm really sorry about this, I hope it's not too expensive to fix.

It was raining so much this morning near the airport. I was exiting the roundabout and thought the blue van in the next lane was going to let me pass, but he moved toward the exit at the same time. I tried to pull away but our side panels touched. There is a long scratch running along my passenger door now. I am honestly just shaken up because I have a big exam today and dealing with this paperwork is super stressful, you know?

I was in the roundabout heading toward the exit when the driver in the Seat tried to squeeze into the lane alongside me. I didn't see him in my blind spot until it was too late. We made contact at low speed, just enough to leave a scratch on his door and my quarter panel. It was a simple mistake in the rain.

I was driving along the coast road, heading towards Belém. I was in the right lane and needed to move to the left to avoid a bus that was stopped at the station. I looked in my mirror, but I must have missed the motorcycle coming up quickly. We clipped each other, and my rear indicator lamp broken from the impact. I am quite worried about the motorcyclist, though he said he was fine, just shaken. The whole experience has left me feeling very anxious about driving again today.

I was filtering through traffic on the left lane when the Peugeot suddenly shifted lanes. I didn't have enough time to react before his rear quarter hit my handlebar, which then struck his rear light cluster, causing his lamp to break. I remained upright, but it was a close call.

My husband and I were driving to the market in Faro on the E.N. 125. It was a beautiful Saturday morning, very bright. We stopped because the car ahead braked suddenly for a dog crossing the road. Unfortunately, the young man behind us was not paying attention and hit us quite hard from behind. The impact caused a massive dent in our trunk and the rear glass shattered completely. My husband is worried about the insurance costs, but the boy was very apologetic and admitted it was his fault.

I was looking at the GPS on my phone for a split second, and when I looked up, the Volvo was already stopped. I tried to brake, but I wasn't fast enough. I hit them squarely in the back. I feel awful about the damage to their car, especially the shattered glass.

I was passing through the intersection when a van pulled out from the side street without checking. I was going about 30 km/h and had to swerve, but I still clipped his front bumper. It left a significant dent on my passenger side door. I was quite surprised because I had the green light, but I suppose these things happen in busy city centers. I am just glad no one was hurt, as the impact could have been much worse had I been driving faster.

I was trying to maneuver into a parallel parking space near the square. I was watching my front bumper so closely that I didn't realize my rear wheel arch was drifting into the car parked behind me. I heard a slight noise and stopped immediately. When I got out, I saw a long, ugly scratch along their door and my own bumper. I feel really bad, I should have asked my friend to guide me from outside, but I thought I had enough room.

I was sitting at the café terrace right in front of the parking spots. I watched the Mini try to park. It was a tight fit, and they misjudged the angle, causing their rear quarter to scrape the side of the stationary car. It was clearly an honest mistake, just a misjudgment of the turning radius.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving home from work in the evening. I was changing lanes to take the exit, and I think I checked my mirrors, but perhaps not long enough. A car was already there, and we scraped sides. My side lamp broken, and there's a big dent and scratch on the fender. I am really stressed because this is a company car and I have to explain this to my boss tomorrow. It was just a stupid, momentary lapse in judgment while checking the traffic.

I was driving along the coast on the Marginal towards Cascais. It was about 7:00 PM, and the sun was setting right in our eyes, which was blinding. The car in front of me stopped for a pedestrian crossing, and I didn't see their brake lights until the very last second. I slammed on the brakes but still ended up hitting them. There is a dent and a scratch on both our bumpers. Man, this really sucks, I've never been in an accident before and I am worried about my insurance premium.

I stopped for a person at the zebra crossing, and suddenly I felt a jolt from behind. The BMW behind me didn't stop in time. We both checked the damage—just some dents and scratches on the bumpers—and agreed to file the paperwork properly. The driver was very apologetic about the glare from the sun.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM heading towards the Foz area. Traffic was quite heavy as usual, and the car in front of me suddenly braked hard for a yellow light. I tried to stop, but I just couldn't slow down enough on the wet pavement. I ended up tapping their rear bumper. It was a really stupid mistake, I feel terrible about it. There is a noticeable dent on my front hood and some long scratch marks near the license plate area. I am just really stressed about the repair costs, man.

It happened while I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio. I was in the outer lane, intending to exit towards the airport, and suddenly another driver decided to merge right across my path without signaling properly. I swerved to avoid a direct T-bone, but I still clipped their rear wing. The impact shattered my left side mirror glass and broke the housing for my front fog lamp. I was quite shaken up by the whole experience, you know? It happened so fast that I barely had time to react or hit the brakes.

I was trying to exit the roundabout and perhaps I misjudged the distance of the car in the outer lane. I turned the wheel and felt the impact on my rear bumper. I immediately pulled over to the side to check on the other driver and exchange insurance information. It was an honest error on my part during the merge.

I was trying to parallel park near the center of Coimbra earlier this morning. The spot was tighter than it looked from the road. As I was reversing into the space, I miscalculated the angle of my rear fender and ended up scraping against a concrete pillar. It was just a small lapse in judgment on my part. There is a long, deep scratch along the side panel now. I've been driving for years and I'm really annoyed with myself for making such a silly parking error today.

I was cruising along Avenida 24 de Julho when a delivery van to my right suddenly veered into my lane to avoid a cyclist. I tried to steer away but there wasn't enough room, so we sideswiped each other at about 30 km/h. It caused a significant dent on my passenger door and a long scratch down the trim. The driver was very apologetic and we both moved to a side street to avoid blocking the tram line. It was quite a stressful morning, honestly, I just want the car fixed.

I was walking my dog near the tram stop when I saw the van swerve sharply to miss a cyclist who had drifted into the lane. The Citroën couldn't move over because of the traffic in the left lane. It was clearly an accidental collision caused by the cyclist's sudden movement forcing the van's reaction.

I was coming home from the supermarket, driving up Estrada Monumental. As I entered the intersection, the lights were green, but another car coming from a side street didn't seem to stop at their red light. I slammed on the brakes, but I still struck their rear bumper with my front corner. My front turn signal lamp is completely broken now. I am still a bit shocked, everything happened in a split second, and I didn't even have time to curse before the impact occurred.

My wife and I were driving through the narrow streets of central Porto to reach our hotel. It was raining quite heavily and visibility was poor. As I turned a tight corner, the car slid slightly on the cobblestones and hit a stone wall at very low speed, maybe 5 km/h. There is a noticeable dent on the rear bumper. We are quite disappointed, as we only arrived in the city a few hours ago, but we are thankful nobody was injured during this rather unfortunate little incident.

I was changing lanes to prepare for a left turn on Avenida da República. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I missed the small car in my blind spot. I moved over and heard a grinding sound. When I stopped, I saw a long scratch along their rear quarter panel and my own side. It was a genuine miscalculation, I feel very bad because the other driver was clearly not at fault. I just hope the insurance covers the necessary repairs without too much headache.

I was driving steadily in the middle lane when the Ford abruptly pulled into my path. I tried to honk but it was too late and he scraped the side of my car. We pulled over immediately to inspect the damage. It was clearly a blind spot accident, and he was very apologetic throughout the entire process.

I was driving towards the Tejo riverfront around 8:00 AM, the sun was shining directly in my eyes, and traffic was stop-and-go. I looked down for a second at my GPS and by the time I looked up, the truck in front of me had stopped completely. I hit the rear of the truck. My bumper has a large dent and my left headlight glass is shattered. I am incredibly worried about the repair costs, this is going to be a very expensive mistake for me to handle.

I was driving on Estrada de Benfica when a delivery motorcycle tried to squeeze between my car and the sidewalk. It was a very tight space and he ended up sideswiping my passenger side panels. There is a deep dent and a long scratch where his handlebar must have made contact. The delivery guy actually fell over, but he was okay, just shaken. I am reporting this because the damage is quite obvious and I need to get it professionally repaired as soon as I possibly can.

I was trying to reach a delivery point and thought there was enough space to filter through the traffic. I was wrong. I caught the side of the car and went down. It was definitely my mistake, I should have waited behind the car instead of trying to pass in such a narrow gap.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: Back in my day, people drove more carefully, but here I am. I was going around the roundabout near the Marquês de Pombal square, just heading to my granddaughter's house. I was in the proper lane, but a taxi driver decided to cut across the inner lane to reach his exit. He clipped my corner, breaking my indicator lamp and leaving a nasty scratch on my paint. I was quite flustered because I am not used to such aggressive driving during my daily errands. It was truly an unpleasant morning.

I was driving a client and I believe I misjudged the lane exit in the heavy traffic. I moved to exit the roundabout and I didn't see the lady in the side lane. I hit her bumper and broke her light. I fully admit my error here, I was distracted by the GPS directions.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was slowing down because the car in front of me stopped suddenly, and I managed to brake in time, but the driver behind me didn't. He hit my rear bumper quite hard. I am really worried because this is my only car for commuting, and I have never dealt with an accident claim before. It just feels like a big dent right in the middle of the bumper, and I really hope the repair process is straightforward.

It was my mistake entirely. I was momentarily distracted by my GPS and failed to notice that the traffic ahead had come to a complete standstill. By the time I looked up and applied the brakes, it was too late to avoid the impact. I apologize for the trouble caused to the driver of the Volkswagen.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, staying in the outer lane as I intended to take the third exit. The driver to my left, who was in the inner lane, suddenly decided to exit as well, clipping the side of my car. It happened so fast. There is a noticeable scratch running along the passenger side door. I was quite shaken up, man, because I have only had this car for a few months and I try to take such good care of it. I just want to know how the insurance will cover this.

I was backing out of a parking space near the University of Coimbra this morning. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I misjudged the angle because I scraped against a concrete pillar in the garage. There is a small dent and a long scratch on the rear quarter panel. It is just so embarrassing, you know? I feel like I should have been more careful. I am really stressed about the cost of repairs, given that I am still paying off the financing for the vehicle. This is honestly the last thing I needed today.

I was driving northbound on Avenida dos Aliados at a slow speed due to the rain. A taxi driver attempted to overtake me in the narrow lane and swiped my side. The impact caused a scratch on the side panel and my rear lamp is broken. I am a professional consultant, so I need to get this sorted as quickly as possible. I have already documented the damage with photographs, and I expect the claims process to be handled with the necessary efficiency. Please let me know what the next steps are for the claim.

I miscalculated the distance between our vehicles while attempting to pull into the lane to drop off a passenger. The road was slippery due to the light drizzle, which made braking difficult. I accept full responsibility for the contact made with the Citroën, which resulted in the damage to their rear light and the side panel.

Well, you see, I was driving down the N125 near Faro on my way to visit my granddaughter, and the weather was perfectly sunny, which made the drive quite pleasant until I reached that junction. I was changing lanes to prepare for my turn, and I suppose the driver in the other lane didn't see me, or perhaps they were going a bit too fast, but they hit the side of my car. It left a rather nasty dent on the driver's side door. I was quite startled, to be honest, and had to pull over to compose myself.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the two vehicles collide during a lane change. The Toyota had its indicator on, but the vehicle in the adjacent lane seemed to accelerate just as the merge was happening. It appeared to be an honest misjudgment of speed and distance by both drivers.

I was moving through the intersection at Praça de Espanha after the light turned green. Another vehicle entered the junction from the right and struck my passenger side door, which caused the side window to shatter. It was a terrifying moment, man. I am just really glad that no one was seriously injured. The glass is everywhere, and I am honestly just confused about what to do next. I have never had to deal with an insurance claim for something this messy before. I just want it all resolved so I can get back to my normal routine.

While navigating the narrow streets of Cedofeita, I encountered a delivery van that had stopped suddenly. I applied the brakes, but my car slid slightly on the cobblestones and bumped into the van's rear. This resulted in a broken tail lamp and some light scratches on the trunk. It is a very tight area and visibility is poor, but I accept that I was moving too fast for the conditions. I am hoping for a quick repair, as I use this car daily to manage my small business deliveries around the city center.

Traffic on Avenida da República was backed up due to a construction project. I was at a complete standstill when I felt a heavy impact from behind. My rear bumper has a significant dent, and the rear lamp is broken. I am quite worried about the repair costs, as the sensor systems in the bumper might be affected too, though I cannot confirm that myself. It has been a stressful day, and I would appreciate it if the insurance company could guide me through the repair process as soon as possible.

I am terribly sorry. The sun was glaring directly into my windshield, and I completely lost sight of the distance between my car and yours. I did not realize you were stopped until it was too late. I will cooperate fully with the insurance process to ensure the repairs are handled appropriately for both our vehicles.

I was enjoying the coastal drive along the Marginal heading towards Cascais. It was around 4:00 PM and the traffic was moderate. Another driver attempted to merge into my lane without checking their blind spot, which led to their mirror scraping along my passenger side door. There is a long, ugly scratch across the paint. I am very frustrated because I keep my car in pristine condition, and this was an avoidable error by the other driver. I would like a professional evaluation of the damage to ensure it is restored to its original state.

Oh dear, I was driving through the roundabout near the hospital, and I must admit I was a bit preoccupied with finding the right exit to pick up my prescriptions. I believe I might have veered slightly out of my lane, and another car clipped me. There is a dent in the side panel and the window glass has shattered. I feel quite foolish about the whole incident. I have been driving for over forty years, and this is truly the first time I have caused such a mess. I am very sorry for the inconvenience.

I was following the Opel around the roundabout when the driver suddenly veered into my lane. I tried to swerve, but we made contact. It was a very sudden maneuver, and I had no time to react. I am just relieved that we both managed to stop safely after the collision occurred.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, just heading home after work. Traffic was quite heavy, stop-and-go as usual. Suddenly, the car in front of me stopped abruptly for a cyclist, and even though I slammed on my brakes, the road was a bit slick from the earlier rain. I couldn't stop in time and bumped into the rear bumper of the car ahead. There is a visible dent on my front hood now. I feel terrible about the whole situation, man, honestly, it's just so stressful dealing with this during rush hour.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, staying in the middle lane, you know? I was just trying to follow the signage to the A1 highway. A car to my right suddenly tried to exit while I was still moving forward. It happened so fast, dude, like I didn't even have time to react. I think they miscalculated the curve. My front right panel has a nasty scratch and a dent now. I'm just really worried about how much this is going to cost me to repair since the car is almost brand new.

I was taking the exit from the roundabout when I felt a sudden impact on my side. The other driver seemed to be moving quite quickly through the lane. I accept that I might have turned too sharply, but it was all very sudden. There is some paint transfer and a small dent on my door.

I had been driving around the center of Coimbra for nearly twenty minutes trying to find a parking space for my daughter's piano lesson. It was raining quite heavily and visibility was poor. When I finally found a spot, I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar in the underground parking garage. I heard a scraping sound against the side of my rear door. When I got out to check, I saw a long, deep scratch along the panel. I am just so frustrated with myself for being so careless and distracted today.

I was proceeding through the green light at the intersection near the harbor. Another vehicle approached from the side street, seemingly failing to notice the red light. I tried to swerve, but we made contact. My front corner hit their side. The impact caused my headlight to shatter and left a large scratch across the bumper. It all happened within a split second. I was really shaken up, but thankfully neither of us was injured. I just want to make sure the insurance handles the repairs for the broken lamp and the paint damage correctly.

I was standing on the corner waiting to cross the street. The Nissan definitely had the green light. The other car didn't seem to slow down at all for the light. I saw the Nissan driver swerve right before the collision. It was quite a loud impact, and I saw parts of the headlight scatter on the asphalt.

I was driving along the coast road toward Cascais. It was a beautiful sunny afternoon, so there was quite a bit of traffic. I attempted to move into the left lane to overtake a slow-moving truck. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the car that was already there. As I began to merge, there was a loud bang. We both pulled over immediately. My rear fender has a clear dent where we touched. I feel awful because I know I should have checked my blind spot more carefully. It was a simple human error.

I was trying to maneuver into a very tight space on a narrow street. The road was wet, and the car slipped just a few centimeters further than I intended when I reversed. I ended up hitting a low post on the sidewalk. It wasn't moving fast, but the impact was enough to break the rear tail lamp cover. I feel a bit embarrassed, honestly. I've lived in this neighborhood for years, and I know these streets are narrow, but I just had a momentary lapse in judgment this morning.

Traffic on the main avenue was backed up due to construction. I was at a complete standstill when a delivery van behind me failed to stop in time. They hit me quite hard, pushing my car forward into the one ahead. It caused significant damage to my rear bumper, leaving a large dent and a long scratch. Also, the force of the impact caused some of the rear window glass to shatter. I am quite worried about the repair process since the car is very important to my daily commute.

I apologize, but my foot slipped off the brake pedal while I was looking at the GPS. I hit the Mercedes in front of me. I know I am at fault here. The front of my van has some damage, and I can see that the Mercedes has a dent and a broken tail light lens, and some glass shattered.

I was driving in the right lane near the train station. There was a bus merging from a stop, and the road narrowed significantly. I tried to give the bus room, but another car on my left also shifted toward the center. I got caught in between. It was just a light graze, but there is a long horizontal scratch along the side of my driver-side door. It is really unfortunate because I just had the car cleaned yesterday. I hope this is something the insurance company can resolve quickly.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: Entering the roundabout, I was following the flow of traffic. The driver beside me, who was in the outer lane, suddenly decided to change lanes without signaling. I couldn't avoid the collision. My front lamp assembly is broken, and there is a dent on the wheel arch. I am a retired teacher and usually very cautious, so I find this quite upsetting. It was just a very confusing moment with so many cars merging at the same time in the roundabout.

I was cycling nearby and saw the whole incident. The car in the inner lane was driving straight, and the other vehicle definitely veered into them. I saw the lamp break on impact and the metal frame get dented. It looked like the driver in the outer lane didn't see the Toyota at all.

I was parking near a local cafe. I thought I had plenty of room to pull into the parallel space, but I miscalculated the curb angle. When I turned the steering wheel, the front fender caught the edge of a metal bollard on the pavement. It made a really loud noise. Now there is a dent and a deep scratch on the side of the bumper. I'm feeling really anxious about this because I've never had an accident before, and I'm not entirely sure what the next steps are for my insurance.

I was driving home from work around 6:00 PM when traffic on Avenida da Boavista came to a sudden halt. I applied my brakes, but the car behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper. It was such a shock, honestly. I got out and saw a visible dent and a long scratch on the trunk lid. My hands were shaking a bit because this is my first accident in five years, and I really just wanted to ensure everyone was okay before we started swapping insurance details.

The traffic was moving quite slowly due to the rush hour congestion. I was distracted for a split second by the GPS, and when I looked up, the car ahead had already stopped. I tried to brake, but I couldn't stop in time. I am very sorry for the collision and the damage I caused to your bumper.

I was attempting to parallel park outside a café near Saldanha this morning. I thought I had enough clearance, but I misjudged the distance and grazed the side of the car parked behind me. I feel terrible about it; I've never had this happen before. I checked the area and noticed a light scratch on their rear quarter panel. I left a note on their windshield immediately because I believe in being responsible, and I really hope they call me back soon so we can settle this through our insurers.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música when another driver tried to change lanes without signaling. I didn't have enough room to maneuver, and we made contact. It was such a loud thud, dude, I was totally panicked. When I pulled over to the side, I saw a dent right on my passenger side door. I'm just really worried about how much this is going to cost to fix, and if my premiums will go way up. I have the other driver's info, but man, what a stressful start to my Tuesday.

I was entering the roundabout and moved to the outer lane, assuming the driver in the adjacent lane was going to exit. I didn't realize they were continuing around. I feel bad about the dent in the door; I clearly made a mistake by moving over too quickly without checking my blind spot thoroughly.

It was a beautiful morning along the coast, and I was driving towards Cascais at about 50 km/h. A van tried to squeeze into my lane way too fast and scraped the entire side of my car. I have a nasty scratch and a dent along the front passenger door now. I've been driving this road for twenty years and never seen someone drive so recklessly. I'm just thankful no one was hurt, but I'm quite upset about the condition of my car, which I keep in perfect shape for my commute.

I was crossing the intersection at a green light when another car ran their red light and clipped my front bumper. It happened so fast I barely had time to react. I got out to check and my front right lamp is completely broken. It's really frustrating because I only just had the car serviced last week. I'm honestly so worried about how the insurance process works and if they'll cover everything, you know? Like, I really need this car for my university classes every single day.

I was walking my dog near the corner of the intersection. I clearly saw the Fiat entering the crossing on a green light. The other driver definitely didn't stop at the red light and collided with the Fiat, causing the lamp to break upon impact. It was quite a loud crash.

I had stopped at a pedestrian crossing near the top of the avenue. The traffic light changed, and just as I started to move, a delivery van behind me accelerated and hit my rear, causing my rear window to shatter completely. There is glass everywhere inside the trunk. It was a very loud explosion sound. I am quite shaken up by the whole situation and just want to get this documented properly so the repair shop can take care of it as soon as possible.

While looking for a parking spot near the town hall, I reversed slowly into a bollard that I hadn't noticed because of the heavy rain. I miscalculated the distance because the visibility was so poor today. My rear bumper has a significant dent, and unfortunately, the rear lamp is broken as well. I feel quite silly for doing this, as I am usually a very careful driver. I am documenting the damage now for my insurance company, as I know I'll need a claim number for the body shop repairs.

I was merging onto the main road in Almada, checking my mirrors as usual. I signaled for the lane change, but a driver in the left lane accelerated suddenly, and we made contact. There is a long scratch along my driver-side door. Honestly, man, I don't know why he had to speed up when I was already halfway into the lane. It's just super annoying to deal with this, you know? Like, I'm already late for my shift at the restaurant. I hope the insurance can handle this fast.

I was driving in the left lane at approximately 40 km/h. I saw the Ford attempting to merge, but I felt they were coming over before it was safe. We made contact, resulting in a scratch on their door. I accept that I could have slowed down to let them in.

I parked my car in the designated area near the square. When I returned after grabbing a coffee, I noticed a dent and a deep scratch on my rear bumper. There was no note left by the other driver. I was really upset, but then a bystander told me they saw a delivery truck hit it while turning. I'm just hoping the security cameras in the area caught the incident. It’s frustrating to have damage to a new car when I wasn't even inside it at the time.

I was sitting at an outdoor table when I saw a large delivery truck attempt a tight turn. It backed into the Tesla, clearly causing a dent and a scratch on the bumper. The driver got out, looked at the car, then got back in and drove off without leaving any information.

It was just a normal trip to pick up my grandchildren, and while waiting for the light to change, the traffic behind me just didn't stop. It was quite a forceful impact from a small hatchback. My rear lamp is broken and there is glass shattered all over the road. I am a bit shaken and my neck feels a little stiff, but thankfully the children weren't with me in the car today. It's just such a mess, and I am not sure how the insurance process will proceed given the state of the bumper.

I was driving slowly towards the traffic lights near the Serralves Museum when the car in front of me stopped quite suddenly. I did my best to brake in time, but the roads were still damp from the morning drizzle in Porto, so my car skidded forward just enough to make contact. I felt a small jolt when I hit his bumper. I am really sorry about this, I feel terrible that I caused a dent to his trunk, but I definitely didn't have enough distance to come to a complete stop safely.

I was attempting to park my Fiat in a tight spot near the Praça do Comércio. I was being super careful because the space was really narrow, you know? But then I misjudged the angle when backing up and heard a horrible scraping sound against the car next to me. I immediately stopped the vehicle, heart pounding, and saw a long scratch along the side panel of the other car. I'm honestly so worried about the repair costs, I've never been in a situation like this before, and I feel really bad about hitting his paintwork.

I was sitting in my car having a quick lunch when I heard a scraping noise. I looked out and realized the driver next to me had hit my passenger door while trying to parallel park. She came over immediately to apologize and explain what happened. There is a clearly visible scratch on my door panel. We exchanged all the necessary insurance details right then and there on the street.

I was driving along Estrada Monumental heading towards the city center when a van moved into my lane without checking properly. I tried to swerve to avoid him, but we still collided on the side. My vehicle sustained a scratch and a noticeable dent on the driver's side door. It happened so quickly that I didn't have much time to react. I am just glad that the traffic wasn't moving any faster, or it could have been much worse for both of us.

I was checking my side mirror to change lanes, but I failed to see the Toyota in the lane next to me until it was too late. I moved over and we clipped each other. My van has some paint damage, and he has a dent and a scratch. It was entirely my mistake as I did not confirm the lane was clear before maneuvering.

I was heading home after picking up my granddaughter from school. It was raining quite hard, and the streets were slick. As I entered the intersection, the traffic signal turned amber. I thought I could make it through, but the other driver entered the junction from the cross-street. We hit at a low speed, but the impact was enough to cause the glass on my side mirror to shatter completely. I am still a bit confused about exactly who had the right of way, but I am just relieved we are all safe.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the Volvo enter the intersection just as the light was changing. The other car was already moving through. The impact caused the mirror of the Volvo to hit the other vehicle and shatter the glass. It looked like a genuine mistake by both drivers due to the poor visibility from the rain.

I was driving down the main avenue when the traffic flow slowed down unexpectedly. I was distracted for just a second checking my navigation system. By the time I looked back at the road, I realized the car ahead had come to a full stop. I hit the brakes hard, but I still made contact with the rear of their vehicle. My front lamp is broken, and there is a deep dent on the hood. I am very embarrassed about this incident and clearly take full responsibility for the accident.

I was driving along the avenue when I decided to shift into the left lane to prepare for an upcoming turn. I signaled and checked my mirrors, but I simply didn't see the other car in the lane. We scraped against each other as I moved over. There is a visible scratch along the rear panel of my car. I feel awful about the damage I caused to his vehicle. I have been driving for many years, but today I just made a simple, unfortunate error in judgment.

I was maintaining my lane when the driver in the adjacent lane tried to move over without seeing me. I honked my horn, but it was too late to avoid the contact. We both pulled over safely. There is a long scratch on the side of my car where his fender hit my door. He was very cooperative and apologetic throughout the process of exchanging contact information.

The streets in this part of Porto are so incredibly narrow. I was driving slowly, perhaps around 15 km/h, looking for a place to turn. I miscalculated the clearance when rounding a tight corner and brushed against a stationary delivery van. It caused a dent on my rear fender. I didn't see the driver of the van nearby, so I left a note on his windshield with my phone number and insurance details as required. I'm worried about the repair costs, but I want to make sure I handle this properly.

The traffic was extremely heavy on the bridge. We were barely moving, maybe 10 km/h. The car ahead of me braked suddenly because of a vehicle stalling in the distance, and my foot slipped on the brake pedal while I was reaching for my coffee. I bumped into him. His rear lamp is broken, and there is a scratch on his bumper. I am so annoyed at my own clumsiness. I know I should have been paying more attention to the traffic flow instead of fumbling in the center console.

I was stopped in the traffic jam on the bridge. The driver behind me didn't stop in time and hit my bumper from behind. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to break my rear lamp and leave a deep scratch. The other driver admitted immediately that he had been distracted. We moved to the shoulder to exchange details so we didn't block the rest of the bridge traffic.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, which is always quite chaotic. As I was merging, I didn't account for the speed of the car entering from the right. We made contact at low speed, which resulted in a dent on my front bumper. It was a very confusing situation with cars coming from all directions. I am quite stressed about the whole ordeal, and I truly hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, as I rely on my vehicle every single day for my work commute.

I was driving home after work along Avenida da Boavista, moving at about 30 km/h in slow traffic. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to react, but I didn't leave enough distance and my front bumper hit their rear bumper. I'm really sorry about this, I was just distracted for a split second by my radio. It caused a noticeable dent on my hood and their rear panel. I'm feeling quite anxious about the repair costs, but I have my insurance details ready.

I came to a complete stop at the pedestrian crossing as required by the law. The driver behind me didn't brake in time and bumped into the rear of my car. I checked my bumper and found a significant dent from the impact. Everything was straightforward, and the driver apologized immediately.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: It was raining quite hard this morning near the Saldanha roundabout. I was changing lanes to prepare for my turn and didn't see the other car in my blind spot. I heard a scraping sound as our side panels made contact. I pulled over immediately to ensure the other driver was okay. There is a long, visible scratch running down the passenger side door. I am very frustrated with myself for not being more careful during the lane change, especially with the poor weather conditions.

I was attempting to parallel park in a tight spot near the shopping center. I must have misjudged the distance to the vehicle behind me because I felt a slight jolt as I backed up. I stopped immediately and got out to check. It turns out I scraped the other car's bumper, causing a scratch and a small dent. I feel terrible about this mistake. The street was quite narrow and I was worried about holding up traffic, which probably made me rush the maneuver more than I should have.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Fiat 500 attempting to park. The driver seemed to be struggling with the space. They reversed too far and made contact with the stationary car. I saw both a scratch and a dent on the rear bumper area.

I was navigating the roundabout near the Cais do Sodré area, maintaining about 20 km/h. As I was exiting the roundabout, another driver attempted to merge into my lane too quickly. I didn't have enough room to maneuver and their rear wheel clipped my front corner, which left my front lamp broken. I have been driving for over forty years, and this is the first time I have been involved in such a situation. It was quite a shock, but at least nobody was hurt in the incident.

I was pulling out of a private driveway onto the main street. I checked the traffic, but I failed to see a cyclist passing by on the side. I moved forward just a bit too far and the side of my car hit their bike handle. The contact caused the glass shatter on my side mirror housing. I feel absolutely awful about the accident. I should have double-checked my blind spot again. I immediately stopped to check on the rider, who thankfully seemed okay aside from being very shaken.

I was riding my bike along the street when the car pulled out from a driveway without stopping properly. The car hit my handlebars. The impact was loud enough that I heard the car's side mirror glass shatter. I am lucky I didn't fall off.

I was driving along the coast road toward Cascais. The traffic was moving at around 50 km/h. I signaled to change lanes to avoid a parked truck. As I moved, the car in the right lane accelerated unexpectedly. We ended up side-swiping each other. There is a clear dent and several long scratches on my rear door. Honestly, man, I'm just so stressed about this. I really try to be a safe driver, but it feels like the other guy just didn't see me signaling at all. It's a huge bummer.

I was slowly maneuvering through the Marquês de Pombal roundabout. I was staying in my lane, but a truck was drifting slightly towards the inner circle. We ended up rubbing fenders at a very low speed. There is a visible scratch on my front wheel arch. Being a professional driver, I usually pride myself on my defensive driving, but in this heavy traffic, there was simply nowhere for me to move to avoid the contact. It is unfortunate, but these things happen in busy cities like Lisbon.

I was trying to maneuver out of a parking spot on the street. I looked back, but I must have misjudged the angle of my car relative to the one behind me. I backed into their bumper with a loud thud. It caused a dent on their rear quarter panel. I am so sorry about this incident. I was in a rush to pick up my daughter from school, which I realize is no excuse for being careless. I have already provided my insurance information to the other driver.

I was sitting at a cafe table nearby. I saw the Volkswagen driver trying to exit the parking bay. They reversed with a bit too much speed and struck the car behind them. The impact was clearly enough to create a dent in the parked vehicle.

I was traveling at about 40 km/h along the avenue when the vehicle in front suddenly hit the brakes because of a dog running into the road. I slammed on my own brakes, but I still made contact with their bumper. The impact caused my front lamp broken and some glass shatter from the headlight assembly. I am still shaking a bit from the incident. I have never been in an accident before and really don't know how the insurance process works, but I want to make sure everything is handled correctly.

I was driving around the Boavista roundabout when the traffic suddenly stopped due to a pedestrian crossing the road. I pressed my brakes, but I was going maybe 20 km/h and just couldn't stop in time, hitting the car in front of me. I am so sorry about this, I was just distracted for a second by the GPS. My bumper has a visible dent from the impact. I am really worried about the insurance premiums going up, you know? It was just a complete lapse in judgment on my part.

I was attempting to park my Fiat on Rua Augusta this afternoon. The space was quite tight and, while I was reversing at a very low speed, I misjudged the distance to the vehicle parked behind me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed the rear quarter panel of the other car. There is a clear scratch on my passenger side door. I feel terrible about the damage; it was entirely my fault as I miscalculated the turning radius in such a narrow spot.

I was sitting in my car finishing a coffee when I felt a jolt. The driver of the Fiat 500 was trying to park and hit the side of my vehicle. I got out and inspected the area; there is definitely a deep scratch along my rear door panel. The driver was very apologetic and admitted they didn't see me parked there. We exchanged information immediately.

It was raining quite heavily on Avenida dos Aliados. I was changing lanes to prepare for a turn and didn't see the van in my blind spot. As I moved, I clipped the side of their vehicle. It all happened so fast, I was really shaken up. I see a dent and a scratch on the side of my car. I have lived here for forty years and have never had an accident like this before, but the visibility today was truly quite poor.

I was driving near the beach when the car ahead braked very hard for a cyclist. I tried to stop, but the road was still damp from the morning mist. I collided with their rear bumper. My headlight unit is completely shattered and there is glass on the road. I'm really concerned because this is my main car for work and I'm stressed about how long the repairs will take. I've taken photos of the lamp broken and the glass shatter as requested.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk near the beach. I saw the Citroën attempt to brake, but they slid slightly on the damp road surface. The collision was not at high speed, but it was enough to break the lamp and shatter the glass on the front of the Citroën. The driver seemed quite distressed but was cooperative with the other party.

While navigating the inner lane of the roundabout, I decided to exit. Unfortunately, I did not check my mirror thoroughly enough, and there was a car already positioned in the outer lane. We made contact at low speed. The incident caused a scratch along my side and the front lamp is broken. It is a straightforward case of human error on my part. I am prepared to accept full responsibility for the damages to both vehicles and have filed this report accordingly.

I was driving correctly in the outer lane of the roundabout to take the second exit. The Renault in the inner lane tried to exit suddenly and cut across my path. They struck my vehicle, causing a scratch on my door and breaking their own lamp. I had no time to react to their maneuver.

It was a busy afternoon on Rua do Ouro. I was backing out of a parking bay and didn't notice a pole hidden by a large plant container. As I reversed, I hit it, causing a large dent in my rear bumper. I'm honestly so worried about how much this will cost, man. It's just my luck, you know? I was just trying to get home to pick up my kids. I've already cleared the debris from the area so it doesn't cause more accidents.

I was driving along Avenida 24 de Julho heading towards Cais do Sodré. The traffic was very dense. As I shifted into the left lane, the other car was also moving into that lane at the same time. We bumped sides. There is a long scratch on the passenger side of my vehicle. I am quite stressed about the paperwork, but I just want to handle this as efficiently as possible. I am certain that it was a mutual misunderstanding due to the heavy traffic conditions.

We were both attempting to enter the left lane at the same time. I did not see the Polo in my mirror as they were in my blind spot. When we moved, there was a minor contact. My car only has a small scratch, and the Polo has a longer scratch along the door. We both stopped safely.

I was pulling out of a private driveway onto the street. There was a parked delivery truck obstructing my view of the oncoming traffic. As I inched forward, I caught the side mirror of a passing car, which caused their side window to shatter. It was a very low-speed maneuver, but the impact was unfortunately perfectly positioned to break the glass. I am truly sorry for the inconvenience caused to the other driver. I am waiting for the police to document the scene as the road is narrow.

I was driving slowly down the street when the Audi pulled out unexpectedly from a driveway. Their mirror hit my window, which caused the glass to shatter immediately. I was quite frightened by the noise of the glass breaking. The driver of the Audi stopped immediately and was very cooperative. We are now waiting for the authorities to finish their report.

I was driving slowly towards the traffic lights near the Serralves Museum when the car ahead of me stopped quite suddenly. Even though I was only going maybe 20 km/h, the road was a bit slick from the morning drizzle and I just couldn't stop in time. My front bumper made contact with their rear bumper. I feel so terrible about this, I was distracted for a split second looking at my GPS. There is a noticeable dent on my front bumper now. I hope the insurance covers this quickly because I really need the car for work.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal to head up the Avenida da Liberdade. The traffic was extremely dense, and as I attempted to change lanes to exit, I misjudged the proximity of the vehicle in the adjacent lane. My side mirror clipped the side of a black sedan, causing a long scratch along my passenger door. I feel awful about the oversight; it was just a lapse in concentration during the chaotic afternoon rush hour, and I am very worried about the repair costs for both cars.

I was maintaining my lane in the roundabout when the Peugeot suddenly steered into my path. I tried to brake, but there was nowhere to go due to the surrounding traffic. The driver hit the side of my car. It caused a visible scratch on my rear door. It was an honest mistake, but quite a stressful situation for both of us.

I was attempting a parallel park on this narrow street in Coimbra. It was getting dark and I clearly didn't see the concrete bollard near the sidewalk. As I reversed to straighten out, I miscalculated the distance and hit it quite firmly. It resulted in a deep scratch and a dent on the rear quarter panel. I am honestly so embarrassed about this whole situation. I was just trying to get home after a long shift, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork for my poor car.

I was pulling out of a side street onto the main avenue. I thought the intersection was clear, but as I moved forward, another vehicle appeared faster than I anticipated. I clipped their rear corner with my front light housing. The impact was enough that my lamp is broken. I am so shaken up by this; I have been driving for years and never had an incident. I feel really bad that I caused damage to the other driver's vehicle as well. It was completely my fault for not checking twice.

I was traveling along the main avenue at a steady speed. The insured driver pulled out from the side street without enough clearance. I did my best to swerve, but they still made contact with my car. Their front lamp hit my vehicle and broke, scattering debris on the road. It was an unfortunate accident.

I was driving along the coast road in Funchal, enjoying the view, when I decided to shift lanes to prepare for a turn. I turned my head to look in my blind spot, and by the time I looked back, I had already drifted too close to the car in the next lane. We made contact, resulting in a scratch on my driver's side door. It was such a silly error on my part. I am very worried about how this will affect my insurance premium; everything happened so fast and I am just quite overwhelmed.

I was walking along the promenade and saw the two cars driving side by side. The Citroen driver seemed to drift into the adjacent lane while checking their blind spot, leading to a light collision with the other car. Both drivers stopped immediately to check for damage, which appeared to be a scratch on the side of the Citroen.

It was a very busy morning near the square. I was inching forward in heavy stop-and-go traffic. I was looking at the traffic light, and when the car in front of me stopped, I didn't react quickly enough because I was checking my coffee. I nudged the car ahead of me, which caused their rear window to experience glass shatter. I am devastated. I know I should have been paying closer attention to the road instead of my drink. I have already exchanged details with the other driver who was surprisingly calm about it.

I was driving home from my daughter's house in Braga. It was raining quite hard and the visibility was not great, to be honest. I was approaching the roundabout when the traffic ahead slowed down drastically. I applied the brakes, but the road surface was slippery and my car slid forward, hitting the rear of the vehicle in front of me. I caused a significant dent on their trunk and my own lamp is broken. I feel absolutely dreadful about it, especially since the roads were so dangerous today. I just wish I had maintained a much safer distance.

I was braking for the roundabout given the heavy rain. The Qashqai behind me clearly misjudged the stopping distance on the wet pavement and collided with my car. The impact left a visible dent on my trunk and smashed one of their own lamps. It was a clear rear-end collision due to the conditions.

I was trying to maneuver into a very tight parking space on this narrow street in Porto. I thought I had enough room, but as I turned the wheel to back in, I clipped the side of the car already parked there. It resulted in a long, ugly scratch along the side of my door. I feel so bad for the other driver. I've only had this car for a few months and I'm really upset with myself for being so careless while trying to park in such a congested city center area.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving in the center lane of the avenue. A van to my right suddenly moved into my lane without checking. I tried to steer left, but I didn't have enough time and we collided. My passenger side now has a deep dent and a nasty scratch. I am quite shaken up; this is a very busy street and I feel lucky that we didn't end up hitting the median. I just want to get this sorted as quickly as possible so I can get my car back to the workshop.

I was checking my mirrors to move into the center lane. I didn't see the Mercedes coming up alongside me. When I started to merge, we made contact. It caused a dent and scratch on their passenger side. I take full responsibility for the accident as I didn't verify the lane was completely clear before changing.

I was stopped in traffic on the main avenue. Suddenly, I felt a hard jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't stop in time. The impact caused a large dent in my bumper and my rear lamp is broken. I am quite worried about the repair costs, as the damage looks quite significant even at low speed. It was a very unfortunate moment; I was just sitting there waiting for the lights to change when it happened. I am waiting for the police report to be finalized so I can submit this claim properly.

The traffic stopped abruptly and I was unable to apply my brakes in time due to a moment of distraction. I collided with the back of the Audi, which resulted in a dent and broken lamp on their vehicle. I accept that I was at fault for the accident and am ready to cooperate with the insurance procedures.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música around 6:00 PM, trying to exit towards Avenida da Boavista. The traffic was quite heavy as usual during the commute. I signaled clearly to change lanes, but as I moved, a white van appeared in my blind spot. I tried to brake, but we made contact. There is a visible scratch and a small dent on my rear passenger door. I am honestly quite worried about the repair costs, you know, being a student and all, but I just want to get this sorted out properly.

I was maintaining my lane in the roundabout when the driver of the Seat moved into my path suddenly. I did not have enough time to stop completely to avoid the contact. We both pulled over safely to the side to exchange information. I can confirm there is a scratch and a dent on the side of their vehicle.

It was just a normal Tuesday morning, and I was driving down the Avenida Almirante Reis heading towards Martim Moniz. The traffic was stop-and-go because of the tram tracks. The car ahead of me slowed down quite suddenly, and although I slammed on my brakes, I couldn't stop in time. I bumped into his rear bumper. It was definitely my fault for not keeping enough distance. There is a noticeable dent on my hood from the impact, but thankfully no one was hurt. It was such a stressful experience for me.

I was trying to parallel park near the University of Coimbra campus. I was going very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but I misjudged the distance to the car parked behind me. I heard a slight noise and realized I had grazed the rear bumper of the other car. I immediately felt terrible about it. There is a clear scratch on their plastic trim. I am a very careful driver usually, but I must have been distracted by the rain and the narrow street. I provided my insurance details to the owner right away.

I was sitting in my car when I felt a light jolt. The driver of the Toyota apologized immediately, explaining that they miscalculated the parking space. I checked the bumper and saw a long scratch. It was an honest mistake and they were very cooperative during the exchange of information.

I was driving towards Cascais on the Marginal road around 9:00 PM. It was dark, and the road was quite empty. I moved to the left lane to overtake, but I didn't see the vehicle approaching from behind in the same lane. We clipped each other's side. My car has a broken lamp, a deep scratch, and a dent on the driver's side panel. It was a very unfortunate error of judgment on my part, and I've already informed my insurance company about the incident to facilitate the repairs as soon as possible.

I was stuck in that miserable bridge traffic, just crawling along, when my mind wandered for a second. When the traffic stopped abruptly, I didn't react fast enough. I hit the back of a black sedan at about 15 km/h. It was just a stupid accident. My front bumper has a huge dent, and my left headlight glass shattered during the impact. I feel so embarrassed and stressed about the repair bills. It was just one of those bad days where nothing seems to go right, you know? I really regret not paying closer attention.

The traffic was heavy and slow on the bridge. I felt a sudden impact from behind while stationary. I got out and spoke to the other driver, who was quite shaken. I inspected the damage, which included a dent and shattered glass on their front end. We exchanged our documentation while waiting for the lane to clear.

I was proceeding through the intersection near the City Hall after the light turned green. A delivery bike was coming from the right, and even though I braked as hard as I could, the car next to me blocked my view of his movement. We made side-to-side contact while navigating the turn. My passenger door has a significant dent and a long scratch along the panel. I have been driving for over 40 years, and I must say this was quite an unsettling event in such a busy part of the city today.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the Aliados square when I saw the cars collide at the intersection. It seemed like the driver of the Citroen had the green light, but visibility was poor due to other vehicles turning. I saw a dent and a scratch on the side of the car afterwards.

I was trying to turn into a narrow street near the beach. I didn't see the bollard on the corner because of the sun glare. I turned too sharply and hit the stone post. It resulted in a broken lamp on my front right corner. It’s annoying because I’m on vacation and now I have to deal with this, but I guess it’s my fault for not being more careful with the layout of these older streets. I’ve taken photos of the damage for the claim and will follow the standard procedure.

The traffic was incredibly slow this morning. I tried to change lanes to avoid a stopped bus, but I misjudged the proximity of the car in the lane to my right. We ended up rubbing sides. There is just a superficial scratch along the side of my car. I’ve already spoken to the other driver, and we both agreed it was a minor lapse in judgment. I’m quite frustrated with myself, man, I usually check my mirrors twice. It's just a really bad start to my working day, you know?

I was traveling at about 30 km/h when the Ford moved into my lane without noticing I was already there. It was a minor side-swipe. I pulled over to check, and there is a visible scratch on both cars. The other driver was very apologetic about the whole situation.

I was driving towards the Saldanha area around 8:30 AM. As I approached the traffic light, it turned yellow, and the driver in front of me stopped much faster than I anticipated. I wasn't able to stop in time, and I ended up rear-ending him. My front bumper has a dent, and the left lamp is broken. I feel terrible about the accident, especially during the morning rush hour. I am just hoping the repairs can be handled quickly so I can get back to my normal routine.

I was trying to maneuver into a very tight parking space here in the city center. While backing up, I accidentally hit a stone pillar. My rear bumper got a dent and there is a long scratch across the paint. I’ve lived in this neighborhood for years, and I’m usually very good at parking this tiny car, but today I was just rushing to get to my grandson's school event. It’s honestly a bit embarrassing to admit, but I really didn't see that pillar behind me in the shadows.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, moving slowly in the heavy traffic on Avenida da Boavista. I got a bit distracted by a notification on my phone mount for just a second, and when I looked back, the silver car in front had stopped abruptly. I slammed on the brakes, but I still couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit their rear bumper. It was a low-speed impact, maybe 10 km/h, but I can clearly see a visible dent on the hood of my car now.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, trying to exit towards Avenida da Liberdade. I was in the middle lane when a white van suddenly swerved from the outer lane to exit as well. There was not enough space, and I felt a graze along my side. I pulled over immediately to check the damage. There is a long, deep scratch running along my driver-side door. I am honestly quite shaken up as I have never been in an accident before, and the traffic here is just so aggressive today.

I was in the roundabout and I misjudged the distance while changing lanes to take my exit. I didn't see the Peugeot until it was too late. I moved over slightly and felt contact. I stopped as soon as I could to exchange insurance details. The scratch on their car is definitely from my van's rear panel.

It was a busy Saturday afternoon in the Baixa district. I was trying to parallel park between a bollard and a delivery truck. The street is quite narrow and I miscalculated the turn while reversing. I ended up hitting the metal pillar on the sidewalk. I am so embarrassed about it, but I just want to get it fixed properly. I can see a dent on the rear panel and a significant scratch where the paint has completely come off. It was entirely my mistake, I was just tired from running errands all morning.

I was crossing the intersection near the Cais do Sodré area with a green light. Out of nowhere, a cyclist who ran the red light darted into my path. I swerved to avoid them and hit a concrete planter. It was a terrifying moment, truly. My front right lamp is broken, and there is glass shatter all over the pavement from the headlight unit. I am really worried about the insurance premiums going up, man. This whole process feels so overwhelming, and I just wish the cyclist hadn't been so reckless.

I was waiting to cross the street on foot. I saw the driver of the Toyota proceed on green. The cyclist definitely ignored the red signal. The driver tried to dodge him and hit the planter. The broken lamp and glass are definitely from that impact with the planter.

The weather was quite foggy this morning driving along the Marginal near Cascais. The visibility was really poor, maybe 20 meters at best. The driver ahead of me had to stop suddenly because of a cyclist on the road. I pressed my brakes hard, but given the damp asphalt, I slid forward and tapped the back of their vehicle. My front lamp is broken, and there is a noticeable dent on the bumper. I spoke with the other driver, and we were both very calm about the situation, but the damage is clear.

Yes, I agree with the statement. The fog was very dense. I stopped for a cyclist, and the car behind me couldn't stop in time on the wet road. It was an honest accident. I can see the broken lamp on his front end.

I was driving down Avenida da República heading north. I checked my mirrors before switching from the center lane to the left lane to prepare for a turn. I thought I had plenty of room, but there was a car in my blind spot. We made side-to-side contact. I immediately pulled over safely. There is a long scratch on the passenger side panel. I feel terrible about it; I usually check my blind spots religiously, but I must have missed him this one time. I just want this sorted out quickly.

I have lived in this neighborhood for thirty years, and the streets are getting more cluttered by the day. I was pulling into a spot outside the pharmacy. I misjudged the height of the curb and the angle of the turn, and I backed into a concrete post. It’s quite a shame, really, as the car was in such good condition. There is now a significant dent on the rear tailgate. My daughter told me I should have asked for help, but I thought I could manage. It was just a silly oversight on my part.

location: Av. Marechal Gomes da Costa, Porto

statements.text: I was entering the intersection when another driver failed to yield at a stop sign. It happened so fast. They clipped my front fender as they pulled out. The impact caused my lamp to break, and there is a dent and a deep scratch on the wheel arch. I am quite worried about how long it will take to get these repairs done because I need the car for my daily commute to the university. I hope the other driver's insurance handles this without too much fuss, as it was not my fault at all.

I was running a bit late and I honestly didn't see the stop sign until it was too late. I pulled out and struck the side of the Ford. I am completely at fault. I saw the damage to their lamp and the dent on their car. I am happy to provide all my details.

I was moving through the taxi lane near Praça do Comércio. A delivery scooter stopped suddenly to avoid a pedestrian, and I had to brake really hard. The car behind me didn't have enough reaction time and hit my rear end. It was quite a jolt. The force shattered my rear glass and pushed the bumper in, causing a large dent. It’s been a very long day, and honestly, this is the last thing I wanted to deal with. The other driver and I are waiting for the police report to be finalized now.

The traffic stopped abruptly because of a scooter. I was driving too close, and I couldn't stop in time. I hit the back of the Mercedes. I can see the rear glass is shattered and there is a dent in his bumper. I am taking full responsibility for the accident.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving in the right lane on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo. There was a bus merging into my lane from a stop, and I moved slightly to the left to give it space. Unfortunately, I didn't see the motorcycle passing in the left lane at that exact moment. We scraped against each other. It was just a minor scratch on my passenger door. I feel really bad for the motorcyclist, even though it was an accident. I have provided my insurance information and am waiting to hear from the claims department about the next steps.

The driver of the Hyundai tried to avoid a bus and moved into my lane while I was filtering through. I couldn't move out of the way in time and the side of my bike scratched their door. It was an honest mistake by the driver, no one was speeding or acting dangerously.

I was driving around the Boavista roundabout during the evening rush hour, probably doing around 20 km/h. Traffic was stop-and-go as usual. Suddenly, the van in front of me braked quite hard because of a motorcycle cutting in. I pressed my brakes immediately, but I didn't stop in time and hit the rear of his vehicle. It was a very low-speed impact, but now I have a noticeable dent on my front bumper. I'm feeling really stressed about the repair costs, honestly, because I've never had an accident like this before. It was just a lapse in concentration.

I was navigating the lane toward Entrecampos around 9:00 AM. A delivery truck in the adjacent lane began to merge without checking his blind spot properly. I tried to pull over toward the pavement to give him space, but he still grazed the side of my passenger door. It resulted in a long, deep scratch along the panel. I am a very careful driver, so this is quite frustrating to deal with during my commute. Everything happened so quickly that I didn't even have time to honk before the contact occurred.

I was changing lanes to prepare for a turn onto a side street. I checked my mirrors but I suppose I missed the small car as it was right in my blind spot. I felt a slight contact and immediately pulled over. There is a visible scratch on the side of the Peugeot. I apologize for the inconvenience as I was clearly at fault for not observing the traffic lane properly before merging.

It was raining quite hard this afternoon while I was trying to park in this narrow street near the university. I misjudged the distance while backing up and ended up hitting a concrete pillar on the side of the road. It was purely my own error because of the poor visibility and the slick surface. Now there is a dent and a large scratch on my rear bumper. I feel really foolish for hitting a stationary object, but I was just tired after a long day of work and wasn't focused enough on the proximity sensors.

I was cruising along the Marginal toward Estoril, staying within the speed limit of 50 km/h. The driver in the left lane suddenly swerved to avoid a stray dog, and his side mirror smashed into my rear window. It was so unexpected and loud that I nearly lost control of my own car. The glass shattered everywhere inside the cabin. I am shaken up, man. I just wanted to get home for dinner and now I have to deal with all this broken glass and the paperwork. It's really overwhelming.

I was walking my dog on the promenade and saw the whole thing. The car in the left lane made a very abrupt movement to avoid something in the road. The BMW was just driving straight in its lane. The side mirror of the first car definitely hit the back window of the BMW, causing the glass to shatter. It was a clear-cut case of the first driver losing control during an emergency maneuver.

I was entering the intersection carefully because the traffic light had just turned green. I didn't see the other car coming from the side because a large van was blocking the view, but the other driver definitely ran a yellow light that was turning red. They hit the corner of my car. My front headlight is completely broken now. I am just really worried about the claim process, you know? I rely on this car for everything and having a broken lamp makes it impossible to drive at night.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista at about 40 km/h when the traffic light ahead changed. I braked as gently as I could, but the car behind me didn't stop in time. He rear-ended me quite firmly. I checked the back of my car and saw there is a significant dent and the brake lamp is broken. I'm 72 years old and this really caught me off guard, dear. I was just on my way to visit my granddaughter and now my whole afternoon is ruined by this unfortunate incident.

I am terribly sorry. I was distracted for a split second by my radio and I didn't realize the traffic ahead had come to a full stop. I tried to slam on the brakes but I still bumped into the back of the Toyota. I accept full responsibility for the damage to his car, specifically the dent and the broken lamp. I've already exchanged insurance details with the other driver.

It was late in the afternoon, very busy as usual on the 24 de Julho avenue. I was keeping to my lane when a taxi tried to squeeze into the narrow space between my car and the lane markings. The driver was too impatient and scraped the entire side of my vehicle with his wing mirror. It left a long, ugly scratch along my driver-side doors. I am very frustrated because I always try to maintain safe distances, but you just can't predict what some other drivers are going to do.

Driving on the EN125 is always a bit stressful, especially with the tourist traffic. I was slowing down to turn into a supermarket entrance when a rental car behind me misjudged the speed and tapped my rear bumper. There is a noticeable dent from the impact. I just want to get this resolved as quickly as possible. The other driver was very apologetic and admitted he didn't realize how quickly I was slowing down. It was a standard accident, no high speeds involved at all.

I am not very familiar with these roads and I was looking for the turn-off. I wasn't looking at the car ahead as much as I should have been. When I looked back, the Nissan was braking and I just couldn't stop in time. I hit the back of his bumper, causing a dent. I am very sorry for the trouble.

I had parked my car near a boutique on Avenida da Boavista for about twenty minutes. When I came back, I saw a long scratch along the rear wheel arch. A witness nearby told me a delivery van had tried to parallel park, got too close, and scraped my car before driving off. I was able to get the license plate number, thankfully.
