It is so annoying to have this happen while I was just shopping for a few minutes. I take good care of my vehicle, so this is quite disappointing.

I was sitting at the outdoor cafe right in front of the car. I saw a white van trying to reverse into the spot behind the Audi. He turned the wheel too early and I heard a distinct scraping sound against the metal. The driver of the van got out, looked at the damage, then just got back in his vehicle and drove away before the owner returned.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic was incredibly heavy on Avenida da Boavista. As I slowed down for the stationary line of vehicles, I checked my rearview mirror and realized too late that the car behind me wasn't stopping. He bumped into my rear bumper at a very low speed. It was just a minor impact, but it left a noticeable dent on the bumper. I'm honestly quite stressed about the insurance process because I need my car for my daily commute to Matosinhos.

The traffic was stop-and-go. I was distracted for a split second by my GPS, and when I looked up, the car ahead had already stopped. I tried to brake, but I wasn't fast enough and made contact with the rear of his Golf. It caused a dent on his bumper. I am very sorry about this.

I was attempting to parallel park in a tight spot near Rua Augusta on a very busy Saturday afternoon. I thought I had enough clearance while maneuvering, but I miscalculated the angle and grazed the side of the vehicle already parked behind me. I feel terrible about it because I was being careful, but it left a visible scratch along the passenger door of the other car. I've left a note with my details and am just waiting for the owner to call me back so we can settle this.

I was circling the Rotunda da Boavista, planning to exit toward the city center. Another driver was in the outer lane and tried to exit at the same time, misjudging the space between us. His car swiped my side, causing a long scratch and smashing my passenger-side lamp. It happened so fast I barely had time to react. I’m really worried about the repair costs, man. Like, I’m a student and don’t have much savings for this kind of unexpected repair bill. It's just really frustrating.

I was exiting the roundabout and thought the Fiat was further back. I initiated the turn, but we collided. I definitely see the scratch and the broken lamp on his vehicle. I have insurance and am happy to cooperate with the report.

It was raining quite heavily this morning on Avenida 24 de Julho. I was driving in the right lane, and a van in the left lane suddenly tried to change lanes without signaling properly. I tried to swerve, but the wet road didn't help. The van clipped my front fender, causing a dent and a deep scratch. My hands were shaking for an hour after it happened; it was quite a shock. I just want to make sure the claim is handled correctly.

I was walking on the sidewalk nearby when I heard the screeching of tires. I saw the van merge into the Fiesta's lane, leading to the collision. The impact left a dent and a scratch on the Ford. The driver of the van seemed to be in a rush.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: Traffic was dense at the roundabout of Marquês de Pombal due to the afternoon rush. The vehicle ahead of me stopped abruptly for a pedestrian crossing. I applied my brakes, but the car behind me didn't react in time and hit my rear bumper. It resulted in a clear dent on the plastic bumper. I have documented the contact with photos for the insurance company. This is a standard commute for me, and I've never had such an issue before.

I was behind the BMW and got distracted by the heavy traffic lights. When I looked ahead, he was stopped, and I couldn't stop in time. I hit him, causing a dent to his rear bumper. I accept full responsibility for the incident.

I was cruising along Avenida da República at about 40 km/h. A delivery scooter tried to cut through the lane to my right and swiped my side, causing a series of marks. My side lamp is broken, there is a deep dent on the door, and a long scratch along the side panel. Honestly, it all happened so quickly that I didn't see the scooter coming until the impact. I'm just concerned about how long the repairs will take, dude, because I rely on this car every day.

I tried to weave through the traffic to reach my delivery destination. I misjudged the distance between the Hyundai and the curb. I clipped his side, which broke the lamp and left a dent and scratch on his car door. I am sorry.

I was waiting at a red light at the bottom of Avenida dos Aliados. The driver behind me must have thought the light had turned green and moved forward prematurely. He gently rear-ended my car, causing a crack on my rear taillight assembly. I was sitting there quietly with the radio on, thinking about my afternoon errands, when I felt the bump. It's a small crack, but clearly, the light needs to be replaced now. I’ve exchanged information with the other driver who was very apologetic about the mistake.

I was driving through the Alameda das Antas area during the evening. A car merging from a side street entered my lane too quickly. To avoid a direct hit, I swerved slightly, but he still grazed my side panel. It caused a long scratch across the rear passenger door. My daughter was in the car, and we were both quite shaken by the sudden movement, but thankfully nobody was hurt. It’s just unfortunate that this happened, but I have the insurance details from the other driver to process the repair.

I saw the Nissan driving correctly in its lane. The other car pulled out from a side road without yielding, forcing the Nissan to swerve and leading to the scratch on the side of the car. It was clearly the merging driver's fault.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, just heading home after work. The traffic was really heavy, as it always is at that time. The car in front of me suddenly hit their brakes hard because of a pedestrian crossing the road. I tried to brake, but I just didn't have enough distance to stop completely. I tapped the back of the other car. My front bumper has a noticeable dent now and there is a deep scratch right across the plastic trim.

I had to stop abruptly because someone stepped into the crosswalk without looking. I felt a firm bump from behind almost immediately after I came to a halt. When I checked my car, I saw a dent on the rear bumper and some white paint transfer from the other car's bumper.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, and honestly, I think I just misjudged the distance of the car coming from the inner lane. I was trying to exit toward the N125. It happened so fast, man. I just wanted to get to the airport to pick up my sister. I feel terrible about it. I hit their side and my front right lamp is broken now. It's just a complete mess and I am really worried about my insurance premiums going up.

I was trying to park in a very tight spot near the university. I thought I had cleared the parked car next to me, but as I was reversing, I heard a horrible scraping sound against my rear passenger door. It was quite embarrassing, really. I checked and there is a long, ugly scratch along the side panel. It's not deep, but it definitely needs a professional repaint. I am just a student and this is my first car, so I am quite stressed about the repair costs.

I was sitting at the cafe terrace right next to the parking spots. The driver of the small Fiat was trying to reverse into a space and miscalculated the angle. I heard the metal scrape against the other vehicle's door as they turned the steering wheel too early. It was definitely a low-speed impact.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was traveling in the middle lane when I signaled to move to the right. I must have had a blind spot because I didn't see the van coming up beside me. As I began to shift, we made contact. It wasn't a high-speed collision, just a side-swipe. I have a dent on my front fender and a series of deep scratches along the side door panel. I am a professional driver and I usually pay closer attention, so I am quite frustrated with my own lack of awareness today.

I was maintaining my lane at approximately 40 km/h when the BMW suddenly drifted into my lane without noticing I was there. I tried to swerve slightly but the space was limited. The impact caused a dent on my side panel and some scratches on the door handle area.

I entered the intersection, thinking the light was still yellow, but it turned red just as I reached the middle. Another car entered from the side street, and we collided at a very low speed. It was a stupid mistake on my part, and I'm very worried about the cost of fixing the bumper and the broken lamp. I've been driving in Lisbon for twenty years and this is the first time I've ever caused an accident like this. I feel terrible about the other driver.

I had a green light to proceed through the square. I didn't see the Citroen until it was right in front of me. They hit my front corner. The impact left a significant dent on my bumper and completely smashed my passenger side lamp housing.

I was parked on the side of the street, running into a shop to get some bread for dinner. When I came back out, I saw that another car had tried to pull into the space behind mine and clipped my rear bumper. There's a long, nasty scratch across the corner of the bumper where they clearly misjudged the length of their vehicle. It's a real headache because I need the car for work tomorrow morning and now I have to deal with this administrative process.

I was changing lanes to prepare for a left turn. The traffic was dense and moving at about 30 km/h. I checked my blind spot, but the other vehicle was likely accelerating into the space as I merged. We grazed each other along the side. I have a dent on my rear door and some deep scratches along the body line. It was just one of those unfortunate moments in city traffic where timing is everything and things don't go as planned.

The driver of the Polo moved into my lane while I was already committed to the space. I tried to honk but it was too late. The impact caused a series of scratches and a small dent along my front passenger door and quarter panel.

location: Vila Nova de Gaia, near the bridge

statements.text: The bridge traffic was gridlocked as usual. I was looking at my GPS to see if there was a faster route when the traffic suddenly stopped. I hit the back of the SUV in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. My front lamp is broken and there is a noticeable dent in the middle of my hood. I'm quite anxious about this whole process, you know? Like, will the insurance cover this? It was just a complete lapse in concentration for a split second.

I was pulling away from the curb after a meeting. As I checked my left mirror to merge into traffic, I didn't see the cyclist who was coming up alongside the parked cars. We collided at a very slow speed. I immediately stopped to help. There is a dent on my door and some scratches from where the handlebar must have hit. I am very concerned about the cyclist's well-being, honestly, as that is much more important than the car damage at this moment.

I was walking past the car when it started to pull out. The driver didn't seem to notice the cyclist riding in the gap between the cars. The impact was slow but audible. I saw the bike hit the side of the car, leaving a dent and a scratch on the door.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving at about 20 km/h when the car ahead of me stopped abruptly for a pedestrian. I tried to brake, but I didn't leave enough distance and my front bumper hit their rear bumper. There is a noticeable dent on my hood from the impact. I feel terrible about the whole situation, man, I really wasn't paying close enough attention for a second there. It’s just so stressful dealing with this paperwork now.

It was a busy Tuesday morning, and I was navigating the Rotunda da Boavista trying to exit towards the center. I was in the middle lane when a car in the inner lane attempted to cut across to take the same exit. I did my best to swerve, but we made contact on the side. My driver-side door has a long, deep scratch from the friction. I am quite worried about how this will affect my insurance premium, as I really need my car for my daily commute to the university.

I was circulating the roundabout, intending to exit towards Rua de Júlio Dinis. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the Seat Ibiza clearly in my blind spot. As I merged right, we scraped against each other. It was a genuine mistake on my part, and I am happy to cooperate with the insurance companies to resolve this quickly.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving northbound on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo during the mid-afternoon. I signaled to switch to the right lane, but I miscalculated the speed of the approaching vehicle. There was a collision between my rear passenger quarter panel and their front bumper. My vehicle now has a dent and a visible scratch in that area. I’m quite frustrated with my own lack of judgment here. It’s a busy road and I honestly thought I had more clearance than I actually did. This is very embarrassing for me.

Well, you see, I was trying to park my car near the Baixa district to run a quick errand at the bakery, which I do every Thursday morning. The street is quite narrow and I was maneuvering quite slowly, maybe 5 km/h. I turned the wheel a bit too sharply while reversing into the space and caught the bollard on the pavement. There is a deep, ugly scratch along the rear passenger side panel now. My poor car has been through so much, and now this, it just breaks my heart to see it damaged.

I was sitting at the outdoor cafe nearby watching the traffic. I saw the driver trying to park the Yaris. They were moving very slowly, but they just didn't see the bollard behind them as they turned the steering wheel. The car scraped against the concrete post, causing a visible scratch on the side of the vehicle.

The traffic on the EN125 was very stop-and-go due to the summer tourist season. I was traveling at roughly 30 km/h when the driver in front of me slammed on their brakes to avoid an animal crossing the road. I couldn't stop in time and hit them from behind. The impact caused my front lamp to be broken and there is a significant dent on the bonnet. I am really anxious about the repair costs, as I wasn't expecting this expense at all this month, you know?

I was driving towards Faro when I saw something move in the road, so I braked firmly. I felt a sudden jolt from behind. When I got out, I saw that the car behind me had hit my rear bumper. The driver was clearly shaken, but we exchanged all our necessary insurance details on the spot.

It was just a typical rainy afternoon in Lisbon. I was proceeding down Avenida da República at a moderate pace, around 40 km/h. Another driver attempted to merge into my lane without checking their blind spot properly. I tried to avoid the contact, but the side of their car grazed mine. There is a noticeable scratch along my passenger side door. I am really worried about getting this fixed because I need the car for my job. It’s just been a very long and stressful day for me, honestly.

I was reversing out of a narrow alleyway onto Rua de Santa Catarina. The visibility was poor due to the tall buildings and I unfortunately misjudged the proximity of a parked delivery van. My rear tail light caught the edge of their frame, causing the glass to shatter immediately. I am so sorry for the trouble. I’ve lived in this city my whole life, but these streets never get easier to navigate, especially with such a small car. I feel quite foolish about the whole incident.

I was walking down the street when I heard a distinct sound of breaking glass. I turned around and saw that a Fiat 500 had backed into a stationary delivery van. The rear light of the Fiat was shattered from the impact. The driver of the car looked very upset and immediately got out to check the damage.

Traffic was crawling across the bridge at about 10 km/h. I was checking my navigation system for a split second, and in that time, the car in front of me came to a complete stop. I struck their bumper. My front left lamp is broken and there is a dent on the wing. It’s purely my fault for being distracted; I feel terrible about it. I just hope the other party is okay. The bridge is always so chaotic, especially during the afternoon peak, and I definitely learned my lesson about looking at the road.

I was trying to squeeze into a tight parking spot in front of the City Hall. I misjudged the distance to the vehicle parked ahead of me. As I pulled forward, the corner of my bumper brushed against their fender. There is a light scratch on the plastic trim. I am 45 years old and I have been driving for decades, but this spot was unusually tight. I have provided my details to the other driver and we have already filled out the friendly report forms to handle this through the standard insurance channels.

I was driving along the coast road in Cascais, enjoying the beautiful view, when a cyclist swerved into the lane unexpectedly. I swerved to avoid them and clipped a parked car on the side of the road. My side panel now has a dent and a long scratch. I was going about 45 km/h. It was a reflexive action to avoid hurting the person, and I’m just glad they are safe, even though I am stuck with the repair bills for my own vehicle and the one I scraped.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, trying to exit towards Avenida da Liberdade. I was going very slowly, maybe 15 km/h, when the car in the lane next to me drifted inward without signaling. I slammed on the brakes, but we still made contact. There is a noticeable dent on my rear passenger side panel now. I'm honestly so worried about how much this is going to cost to repair and if my premium will go up. It all happened so fast, I feel really shaken up by the whole situation.

I was trying to parallel park on Rua de Santa Catarina around midday. The street was quite busy with shoppers. As I was reversing into the space, I misjudged the distance to the car behind me and scraped against their front bumper. It left a clear scratch along my rear quarter panel. I feel terrible about it, honestly. I've been driving for years and this is the first time I've ever hit someone while parking. I am really anxious about the repair process, do you think they can fix just the paint?

I was sitting in my car waiting for my wife to finish her errands when I felt a gentle jolt. The driver behind me was attempting to park and miscalculated the space, resulting in a low-speed impact against my front bumper. It was clearly an honest mistake, just a simple misjudgment of distance in this tight street.

I was driving down Avenida dos Aliados when the traffic light ahead suddenly turned amber. The driver in front of me braked quite hard, and although I tried to stop as quickly as I could, the road was slightly damp from the morning drizzle. My front bumper hit their rear end at a very low speed. It resulted in a dent on my hood and my passenger side lamp is now completely broken. It was just one of those bad moments, you know? I am really stressed out because I rely on this car to get to work.

I was driving on the EN125 toward Faro in the right lane. Traffic was moving at about 60 km/h. I checked my mirrors to change lanes to the left, but I didn't see the van in my blind spot. As I began to move over, we made contact along the side. It caused a long scratch and a shallow dent on my driver's side doors. I feel absolutely awful about my lack of attention. I am very worried about the repair costs as this is my only vehicle for commuting every single day.

I was driving straight in the left lane on the EN125 when the other vehicle tried to merge into my lane without noticing me. I did my best to swerve to the shoulder, but the front side of their car still grazed the side of my van. It was a momentary lapse in concentration, clearly not intentional.

I was crossing the intersection on Avenida da Boavista when a car coming from the side street didn't stop at the sign. I didn't have time to react, and we collided at the corner. My front lamp is broken, and there is glass shatter all over the pavement from my headlight assembly. It was such a loud noise, it really rattled me. I was on my way to visit my granddaughter, so the whole day has just been turned upside down. My hands were shaking for an hour afterwards, I just couldn't believe it happened.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk near the intersection when I saw the whole thing. The white Yaris was proceeding with the green light, but the other driver just rolled through the stop sign without checking properly. It was a clear case of failing to yield, resulting in the collision I witnessed right there in front of me.

The traffic on Avenida 24 de Julho was extremely heavy today near the docks. I was crawling along, maybe at 10 km/h, when the delivery truck to my left started drifting into my lane. There wasn't much space to move over, so they caught my side panel. It left a deep scratch running down the length of the passenger door. It's really frustrating, man, because I just had the car cleaned yesterday. I hope the insurance covers this efficiently because I can't afford to be without a car for too long, you know?

I stopped behind a bus at the stop on Avenida Luísa Todi. I believe my foot slipped off the brake pedal while I was looking for my sunglasses in the bag. I rolled forward at a very low speed and tapped the rear bumper of the car in front of me. It caused a minor dent on their bumper. I felt so embarrassed. I've never caused a collision before. I am quite worried about the claim process, but I want to make sure the other driver's car is fixed properly by the insurance company.

I was stationary at the bus stop when the car behind me slowly rolled into my rear bumper. It was a very low-speed impact, but it left a dent on my plastic bumper cover. The driver was very apologetic and admitted they made a mistake while reaching for something in their car. It was an honest accident.

It was very narrow in the Baixa district today. I was turning a corner and misjudged the proximity of a concrete bollard. I didn't see it because of the angle, and my front lamp hit the post directly. The lamp is completely broken now. I am feeling quite anxious about the cost of the parts, as I've heard these lights are expensive. It was a stupid mistake, and I am kicking myself for it. I was just trying to navigate the tight streets to get to my parking spot near the square.

I was exiting the Rotunda da Boavista. A taxi was in the outer lane, and I think we both tried to merge into the same exit lane at the same time. We brushed against each other. It left a scratch and a small dent on my driver's door. It's just bad luck, I suppose. I'm really concerned about how the insurance handles these disputes, especially with a taxi involved. I hope they look at the facts and see that I was just following the lane markings correctly.

I was exiting the roundabout and the Corsa beside me attempted to move into my lane at the same time. Neither of us saw the other in time to avoid the graze. It was a simple case of a collision due to simultaneous lane changing in heavy roundabout traffic. There was no aggressive driving, just an unfortunate incident.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was heading north on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo. I moved into the middle lane to pass a slower vehicle. I checked my mirrors, but I think I didn't hold the lane long enough before a car in the center lane came up beside me. We made contact along the side, resulting in a surface scratch on my door panel. I am quite worried about this, man. I've only had this car for six months and I've been really careful with it. I hope the repairs don't take too long, you know?

I was stopped at the red light nearby when I watched the two cars moving in the traffic lanes. It appeared that the driver of the Polo moved into the center lane while the other vehicle was already positioned there. The contact was brief and clearly the result of a miscalculated lane change in dense city traffic.

I was driving home from work along the Avenida da Boavista when traffic suddenly came to a complete stop due to the signals. I tried to brake, but I think I was a bit distracted by the radio and just didn't react fast enough. I ended up tapping the bumper of the car in front of me at maybe 5 km/h. It was really embarrassing, but I have a clear dent and some deep scratches on my front bumper now. I am honestly so worried about my insurance premium going up because of this mistake.

I was fully stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The other driver apologized immediately and looked quite stressed about the whole situation. My rear bumper sustained a noticeable dent and several scratches from the impact. We pulled over to the side of the road to exchange our insurance details right away.

It was pouring rain in downtown Lisbon and the visibility was really poor. I was attempting to pass a delivery truck on Rua da Prata, but I must have misjudged the distance between our vehicles because I felt a side contact. I pulled over as soon as I could find a safe spot. I see a long scratch along the side panel of my car. I feel terrible about it because I was trying to be careful, but these narrow streets are just so difficult to navigate when it is storming like this.

I was navigating the Rotunda da Boavista, keeping to the outer lane, when a vehicle entered from my left and didn't see me. I tried to swerve, but we made contact. My left headlight is completely broken and there is shattered glass everywhere on the tarmac. It happened so fast, man, I'm still shaking a little bit. I've never been in a crash before and I'm really unsure what the next steps are for filing this claim properly without messing anything up.

I was walking near the roundabout and saw the whole thing. The Toyota was already in the circle, and the other driver just entered too fast without looking. The impact broke the Toyota's headlight and sent glass shards flying across the road. It was clearly an honest mistake due to someone rushing in traffic.

I was trying to parallel park near the market on Avenida Luísa Todi this morning. It was very busy, and as I was reversing into a tight spot, I didn't see the concrete bollard obscured by the sunlight. I ended up scraping the rear quarter panel. It left a clear dent and a deep scratch on the paintwork. I am quite annoyed with myself for being so careless, as I usually pride myself on my parking skills, but I guess it was just one of those bad mornings.

Back in my day, drivers were much more attentive to their blind spots. I was driving down Rua de Santa Catarina to pick up my granddaughter, and I moved to the left lane. I didn't see the van coming up quite fast. We clipped mirrors and doors. My door panel has a significant dent and a long scratch now. It's frustrating because I have been driving for forty years without a single incident, and then this happens right in the middle of a busy Tuesday afternoon.

I was moving through the lane when the Fiat suddenly pulled out in front of me. I slammed on the brakes, but we still caught each other's side. The impact caused a dent and scratch to the side of the Fiat. I think both of us were just having a moment of confusion with the flow of traffic.

I was creeping forward at the intersection on Avenida da Liberdade, looking for a break in the traffic to make a right turn. I didn't realize the driver ahead had stopped abruptly. My front lamp is broken because I hit the rear of their vehicle. I feel terrible about it. I was just trying to follow the flow of cars and got caught off guard when the traffic stopped so suddenly. My car is not drivable with the light in this condition, so I need help arranging a tow.

I was driving along the beautiful Estrada Marginal near Cascais. It was a lovely sunny day, and I was admiring the ocean view for a split second too long. When I looked back, the car in front had stopped for a pedestrian crossing. I slammed on my brakes, but the distance was too short. I bumped them at low speed, resulting in a dent on my hood. I am really sorry about this, as it was entirely my fault for losing focus behind the wheel.

I stopped at the pedestrian crossing as required by the law. The Mercedes behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper. There is a visible dent on the rear of my vehicle. The driver was very cooperative and apologized immediately, admitting they were distracted by the view of the sea.

I was navigating the chaotic traffic at Praça de Espanha. It is always a nightmare during rush hour. I was trying to exit the roundabout when a motorcycle tried to squeeze between me and the curb. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had made contact. There is a long, ugly scratch along my passenger side door. I am just really stressed out about this because I have a meeting in twenty minutes and now I have to deal with all this paperwork instead.

I was backing out of a parking spot near the town hall on Avenida dos Aliados. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the stone pillar behind me. I hit it at a very low speed. My rear lamp is broken and there is a noticeable dent in the boot lid. I am so frustrated because I've only had this car for six months. I feel like such a fool for not seeing that pillar, but honestly, the lighting in that parking area is quite dim.

I was sitting on the bench nearby and witnessed the lady reversing her Mini. She seemed very careful, but the pillar is poorly positioned. I was driving slowly down Rua Augusta, trying to navigate through the tourist crowd, when a delivery van suddenly pulled away from the curb without signaling. I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, traffic was quite heavy as usual on Avenida da Boavista. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to react quickly, but the road was a bit damp and I just couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit the rear of their vehicle, resulting in a visible dent on my hood. I am really sorry about the inconvenience, but I was focused on the traffic and the distance just wasn't enough to prevent the contact.

Man, I am honestly so stressed out right now. I was going around the Rotunda da Boavista, you know, just trying to get to the exit towards the city center. I think I drifted slightly into the next lane while checking my mirrors. There was this other driver there, and we ended up scraping side-by-side. I feel terrible about it because I consider myself a careful driver, but the traffic was just so chaotic and fast-paced today. I checked and there is a clear scratch on my passenger door.

I was maintaining my lane in the roundabout when the other driver drifted into my space without signaling. I attempted to steer away, but there was no time to avoid the contact. The paint on my rear fender was scratched by their side panel.

Well, I was parking near the Santa Justa Lift earlier this morning. It was quite a tight spot, and I was trying to be extra careful because these streets in Lisbon are so narrow. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar while backing in and my car made contact. It was such a silly mistake, I feel quite embarrassed. There is a noticeable dent and a long scratch on the rear corner of my bumper. I just hope the repair process isn't too complicated to manage.

I was driving along the Avenida 24 de Julho heading toward Belém. The driver in the adjacent lane attempted an abrupt lane change without looking. I tried to sound my horn to warn them, but the impact was unavoidable. My front right corner hit their rear panel. The collision caused a scratch along my side and my indicator lamp is broken. I am a very pragmatic person and I just want to ensure the documentation is handled correctly for both parties so we can resolve this matter efficiently.

I moved to change lanes as I needed to turn right soon. I must have miscalculated the position of the other vehicle in my blind spot. I take full responsibility for the scrape and the broken light on their vehicle.

I was driving to visit my sister near the marina in Faro. It was a beautiful sunny day, but the sun was hitting the windshield at such a weird angle that I didn't see the traffic light turn amber quickly enough. When I hit the brakes, I slid a bit and bumped into the car that was turning. I am quite shaken up by the sound of the glass shatter from the impact. There is also a dent on my front wing. It's been a long time since I had an accident.

I was walking my dog near the intersection. I saw the Nissan driver struggle with the low sun position. They tried to stop but ended up colliding with the side of the turning vehicle. The impact shattered the passenger window of the other car.

Dude, I am so worried about my car. I was just trying to pull out of a parking space on the Estrada Monumental, moving like maybe 5 km/h. I didn't see the delivery van coming down the road. I turned my wheel too early and clipped their bumper. It wasn't a huge hit, but my front fog lamp is broken now. I am super stressed about how much this is going to cost. Is this going to affect my insurance rates a lot? I feel like such an idiot for not checking twice.

My day started with a quick errand to the shops. Traffic on Rua de Santa Catarina was heavier than usual. I was slowing down for a cyclist when the car behind me failed to react to my deceleration. They nudged into my rear bumper. The damage is clearly visible as a dent in the center and some surface scratches. I have recorded the details of the other driver and we have already exchanged insurance information. I want to proceed with the repair estimate as soon as the insurance company authorizes the inspection.
Traffic stopped abruptly. I hit the brakes but could not stop in time to avoid hitting the BMW in front of me. I apologize for the dent and scratch caused by this low-speed impact.

I was cruising along Avenida Luísa Todi, enjoying the view of the river, when a vehicle to my left suddenly decided to merge into my lane. I swerved slightly to the right to try and avoid them, but we ended up making contact with our side mirrors and side panels. It resulted in a long scratch along my driver-side door. I am really anxious because I use this car every single day to commute. I just hope the painting work is matched correctly to the original color.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: It was a hectic afternoon at the Rotunda. I was attempting to exit the circle, but a car inside the roundabout miscalculated their trajectory and hit my side. The impact was quite loud. My side mirror glass shattered instantly and the indicator lamp on the housing is broken. I am quite shaken, as this is my first accident in ten years of driving. I have all the details and I am ready to follow the instructions provided by my insurer to get this resolved as quickly as possible.

I was sitting at a cafe overlooking the square. I saw the two cars collide as they were exiting the roundabout. It appeared to be a simple misunderstanding of lanes, resulting in the breakage of the Audi's mirror glass and lights.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was heading to a meeting downtown and the traffic on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo was crawling at about 15 km/h. I was distracted for just one second looking for my parking app, and when I looked back, the SUV ahead had stopped completely. I tapped my brakes hard, but the momentum was too much. I hit their tow bar, which caused a significant dent on my front grille. I am fully aware that I am at fault here and I want to get the claim processed immediately.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM yesterday when traffic suddenly stalled. I braked hard, but the road was damp from the morning rain, and my Golf slid forward, tapping the rear bumper of the vehicle in front of me. It was honestly such a stressful situation, and I am really worried about the repair costs, you know? There is a visible dent on the tailgate and some nasty scratches where we made contact. I feel terrible about the whole thing, but I reacted as quickly as I possibly could.

I was stopped completely in traffic when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The driver behind me clearly couldn't stop in time on the slick road. Upon checking my car, I saw a clear dent on my bumper and a few deep scratches across the plastic trim. We exchanged details right there on the side of the road.

I was navigating the roundabout at Praça Mouzinho de Albuquerque when I attempted to change lanes to exit towards the city center. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I misjudged the distance of the car in the outer lane. We clipped each other as I moved over. My indicator lamp is broken and there is a long scratch along the side panel. It was a stupid mistake and I feel quite anxious about the insurance process given how busy the traffic was at that hour.

I was trying to parallel park near a cafe on Avenida da Liberdade, which is always an absolute nightmare with the traffic flow. I thought I had enough room, but as I was backing up at a very low speed, I miscalculated the angle of my rear bumper and caught the side of the car already parked behind me. I feel awful about it. There is a visible scratch on the other person's door panel. I am just really concerned about how the premiums will change after this.

I was sitting at the outdoor cafe table when I saw the Fiat 500 attempting to park. It was moving very slowly, but the driver clearly didn't realize how close they were to the parked sedan. I heard a scraping sound when the metal brushed against the paintwork. It was a clean, low-speed accident with only surface-level paint damage.

It was a hectic morning near the Baixa district. A delivery van suddenly pulled out from the side of Rua do Ouro without looking properly. I tried to steer away but we ended up side-swiping. The impact shattered the passenger side glass of his van and put a significant dent in my front fender. It all happened in a split second, and I am honestly quite shaken up by the sheer suddenness of the event. I just want to make sure everything is handled correctly through the proper channels.

I was passing through the intersection when the lights turned amber. I proceeded with caution, but another driver entered the junction from the right side, thinking they could make the turn. The collision was inevitable at that point. My front left lamp is broken and there is a noticeable dent on the bumper. I have lived in Setúbal my whole life and take this route every day; I am just very upset that this happened, as I pride myself on being a safe driver.

I admit I made a lapse in judgment. I saw the light turning yellow and tried to beat it, but I didn't see the Toyota coming from the main road. The impact caused my front lamp to break and left a dent on the wheel arch area. I am very sorry for the trouble.

Traffic was crawling over the bridge due to a previous stall in the lane ahead. I came to a complete stop, but the driver behind me was clearly distracted and did not stop in time. They hit the rear of my car quite hard. The bumper has a clear dent where they made contact. I am a very frequent commuter on this bridge and have never had an issue like this. I am mostly just annoyed because this will take a lot of time to resolve with the repairs.

I was moving from the middle lane to the right lane to exit towards the docks. I checked my blind spot, or so I thought, but I failed to see the car pulling up beside me. We made contact, resulting in a long scratch along the rear passenger door. It was a very minor incident, but it is still quite frustrating as I am a busy person with a tight schedule today. I feel bad for the other driver who was clearly caught off guard.

I was driving steadily in the right lane when the Mercedes suddenly merged right into my path. I blew my horn, but it was too late to avoid the scratch on my side panel. Fortunately, it wasn't a high-speed collision, just enough to mark the paint quite badly.

I was driving through the narrow streets of the city center. I had to pull over to let a bus pass, and in doing so, I underestimated the distance to a low stone bollard. I ended up scraping the side and shattering my turn signal lamp. It was a silly, low-speed mistake, but I'm quite embarrassed about it. I have been driving for forty years and honestly, the streets in Braga seem to be getting tighter or perhaps my car is just getting larger.

I was waiting at the red light near the Marquês de Pombal square. When the light turned green, the car ahead of me started moving but then immediately slammed on their brakes because a pedestrian stepped into the street. I didn't stop in time and tapped their bumper. There is a dent and a scratch on the back of their bumper. It was a very minor contact, but still, I feel responsible and just want to get this sorted out as quickly as possible for everyone involved.

I had to brake abruptly due to a jaywalker. The driver behind me couldn't stop in time. It was a gentle nudge, but it left a dent and some scratching on my rear bumper. We were both moving at barely 5 km/h, but these things happen in heavy city traffic.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front of me stopped abruptly for the light, but the driver behind me didn't react fast enough. He hit my rear bumper at a very low speed. I got out to check, and there is a visible dent on the bumper. Honestly, I'm just so stressed about the whole paperwork process since this is my first time dealing with an insurance claim like this, you know?

It was raining quite hard this morning near the airport. I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, keeping to the outer lane, when a van attempting to exit suddenly drifted into my lane without signaling. I slammed on the brakes, but he clipped my side panel as he passed. I have a long scratch running along the passenger door. It happened so fast, and honestly, man, I'm just shaking a bit because I really rely on this car to get to my classes at the university every single day.

I admit I miscalculated my distance while entering the roundabout. The rain made visibility quite poor, and I didn't see the Seat Ibiza in my blind spot when I moved to exit. I apologize for the contact; it was purely an oversight on my part while navigating the busy roundabout traffic.

I was pulling into a parallel parking spot near the city center of Coimbra. I thought I had enough clearance, but I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar near the curb. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had hit it. There is a noticeable dent and several deep scratches on the rear fender. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole thing. It was just a simple parking maneuver that went wrong, and now I have to manage the repair costs, which is quite annoying at this time of the month.

I was cruising along the Avenida 24 de Julho in the middle lane. A vehicle to my right suddenly signaled and tried to switch into my lane, not seeing that I was already alongside him. His rear bumper caught my front corner. The impact caused my headlamp to break and shattered part of the side glass housing. I was quite frustrated at the moment, as it was completely unavoidable on my part. Everything is clearly damaged, and I need the insurance company to facilitate the repairs as soon as possible.

I was walking down the sidewalk and saw the whole thing. The white sedan definitely moved into the BMW's lane too early. It looked like the BMW driver didn't even have a chance to swerve. The collision resulted in visible damage to the BMW's front light and mirror area.

Back in my day, people paid more attention to the road. I was driving slowly down the Estrada Monumental here in Funchal, enjoying the view and thinking about the groceries I needed to pick up for my daughter's visit. Suddenly, a young man behind me just didn't brake in time and bumped into my rear. It left a rather ugly dent on my trunk. I’m quite upset because the car was in pristine condition, and now I have to deal with body shop appointments instead of my usual gardening.

I was driving perfectly normally down Avenida da República when a delivery van coming from the opposite direction took the turn too wide. He clipped my driver-side door with the side of his vehicle. There is a long, ugly scratch across the paint now. I am just a bit anxious about how long the car will be in the shop, as I use it to drive to work every single morning and taking the bus is not really an option for me, you know?

I was rushing to deliver a parcel and I must have taken the turn a bit too wide because the street here is quite narrow. I felt the contact immediately and stopped the van. I'm sorry for the damage caused to the door of the Toyota, I simply didn't check my clearance well enough.

I was approaching the intersection at Rua de Cedofeita, and the light turned yellow. I decided to stop, but the driver behind me was clearly distracted by his phone or something and crashed into my rear light, causing it to break completely. I've documented the scene with photos. It's a real pain, honestly, because I have a busy schedule this week. I just hope the claims process is straightforward and I don't have to spend all day on the phone trying to get this fixed.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: Traffic was crawling on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo this afternoon. A taxi in front of me suddenly stopped to let a passenger out in an area that wasn't really a proper drop-off zone. I hit the brakes, but the road was a bit slick, and I slid into him at very low speed. It caused a small dent and a scratch on my front bumper. I'm just really worried about the insurance premiums going up, which is why I want to be as honest as possible about how it happened.

The passenger asked me to stop, and although it wasn't a designated stop, I pulled over. I felt a light bump from behind. I checked my rear bumper and there is minimal damage, but I acknowledge the driver behind me didn't have enough time to react to my sudden stop.

Driving along the Marginal in Cascais is usually lovely, but today was just hectic. A truck merged into my lane while I was right next to him. He didn't see me at all. His metal side rail scraped my door and managed to shatter the side mirror glass. I am incredibly frustrated by this incident because the car is brand new and I have always been a very careful driver. I need this to be resolved quickly, as I have an important business trip coming up soon.

I was navigating the tight parking area near Praça do Comércio. I was trying to reverse into a space, and I misjudged the position of the bollard behind me. I hit it with my rear bumper, which caused a deep dent and also smashed the rear lamp assembly. It was a silly mistake on my part, but I'm really stressed about the cost of the repairs. I've never had to file a claim before, and the whole situation is just making me feel very anxious about the financial implications of this accident.

I was driving towards the city center during the morning rush hour when traffic suddenly stopped. I tried to brake, but the wet road caused me to slide forward, and I hit the back of the car in front of me at very low speed. I felt terrible about it because the driver was just waiting for the light to change. My hood has a dent and some deep scratches from the license plate of the other car. It was just a lapse in judgment on my part due to the rain.

I was completely stopped at the red light near the roundabout when I felt a sudden bump from behind. I checked my rearview mirror just before the impact, but there was no time to move. My trunk is scratched and has a small dent where the other driver hit me. He apologized immediately and admitted he miscalculated the braking distance on the slippery asphalt.

I was traveling along the Estrada Monumental, moving into the right lane to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. We sideswiped each other at about 30 km/h. It was a very unfortunate maneuver on my part. The side panel of my car now has a significant dent and several scratches. I am just really worried about the repair costs, as I rely on this car for my daily commute to work every single morning.

I was driving straight in the right lane when the other vehicle suddenly merged without indicating. I tried to steer away, but we made contact. My door has a large scratch and a small dent from the impact. It all happened so quickly, and I was quite shaken up afterwards, though luckily neither of us was moving very fast when it happened.

I was heading towards the marina, and the traffic light turned yellow. I thought I could make it through, but the driver from the cross street started moving a bit early. We collided at the intersection. My front light is broken and the fender has a deep scratch. It was such a confusing moment, honestly, and I felt quite anxious about the whole scene. I just want to make sure the insurance process handles this correctly because I have never been in an accident before.

I was standing on the corner waiting to cross the street. The Citroën tried to beat the red light, but the other car entered the intersection just as it turned green. The impact was audible, and I saw the headlight lens break on the Citroën. Both drivers seemed genuinely shocked and stepped out of their vehicles immediately to inspect the damage.

I was pulling out of a private driveway onto the main road. The morning light was really blinding, and I simply did not see the parked car until it was too late. I clipped the edge of his rear window while turning. The glass shattered instantly. I feel absolutely terrible about this, as it was clearly my mistake. I am an older driver, and I suppose my eyes aren't what they used to be in this kind of harsh morning sun, which is quite regretful.

I was driving home from the market when the driver ahead of me braked very hard to let a pedestrian cross. I was following a bit too closely and couldn't stop in time on the cobblestones. I hit his rear bumper, which caused a dent and broke my own indicator lamp. I am very frustrated with myself for not leaving more space. It was a really simple error, but the consequences are quite annoying for both parties involved today.

I saw a pedestrian starting to cross, so I slowed down significantly. The car behind me didn't react quickly enough and bumped my bumper. My bumper has a clear dent where his light fixture hit it, and his lamp assembly is shattered on the road. We spoke briefly, exchanged insurance details, and agreed that it was just a bad moment on a busy afternoon.

I was entering the intersection when the car coming from the side failed to observe the yield sign. I tried to steer away but couldn't avoid the collision. My car sustained a dent on the fender, a broken headlight, and deep scratches. It was an extremely stressful morning, and I am still shaking a bit, to be honest. I just want to get this sorted out quickly, as this vehicle is essential for my small business deliveries throughout the city center.

I was turning into the main road and I admit I misjudged the approach speed of the other driver. I saw him too late. The front of his car struck my side, causing damage to his headlight and bodywork. I apologized profusely as I know it was my fault for not checking the intersection properly before pulling out. We are both cooperating fully.

I was backing out of a parking spot in this very narrow street in Porto. There were many tourists walking around, which was quite distracting. I backed into a stationary pole. My bumper has a significant dent and the paint has a deep scratch. It is really disappointing, man, I've had this car for only six months and now it's damaged. I was just trying to be careful, but I guess I didn't check my rear sensors well enough in all that chaos.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly stopped. It was raining quite heavily and I didn't judge the distance correctly at 30 km/h. I tapped the back of the car in front of me. I am really sorry about this, I feel so terrible because I know I wasn't paying enough attention. There is just a small dent on the rear bumper of their car, and I'm really worried about the insurance process. Do you think this will take a long time to get fixed?

The traffic was quite dense due to the afternoon rush hour. I had come to a complete stop behind a bus, and suddenly I felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me clearly didn't brake in time. My rear bumper has a noticeable dent now, but thankfully the damage is limited to that area.

I have lived in this neighborhood for forty years, and I usually park in the same spot near the bakery. Today, while reversing out of my space, I didn't see the post hidden by the shadow of the nearby tree. It was very clumsy of me. I heard a scraping sound and a small thud. I checked the vehicle and found both a scratch and a dent on the passenger side door. I am truly embarrassed to be filing this claim, but the damage is quite visible.

It was noon and the sun was reflecting off the buildings on Avenida dos Aliados, making it hard to see. I was changing lanes to prepare for a turn when I clipped the side of a van. I really thought I had enough space to merge, but I clearly miscalculated. I feel awful about the disruption. The side of my car has a long scratch and my front side lamp is broken. I hope the other driver is okay.

I was driving steadily in the left lane when suddenly the BMW veered into my lane without checking the blind spot properly. I had no time to maneuver away. It hit the side of my van, causing a scratch along the passenger door and shattering my indicator lamp. It was just a simple driving error in busy traffic.

I was heading toward Cascais along the coast. At the intersection, the light turned yellow and I wasn't sure if I should stop or go. I slowed down, but the car behind me didn't. They bumped into me while I was almost at a standstill. The impact wasn't hard, but it was enough to cause the glass on my rear light cluster to shatter completely. I am worried about the cost of these parts; I hope it is covered by my insurance policy.

I was stopped in traffic on Rua da Prata waiting for the tram to pass. Suddenly, I felt a heavy bump from behind. The driver who hit me was clearly distracted; they hit me with enough force to dent the trunk lid and break my tail lamp. I am very frustrated because I was just sitting there perfectly still. My car is a bit of a mess now, and I rely on it for my daily work commute.

I was checking my GPS for a moment and failed to notice the traffic ahead had come to a full stop. I tried to brake, but I hit the car in front. I feel terrible about this. I caused a dent to their trunk and broken their light. I will accept full responsibility for the damage caused.

I was driving home from the office around 6 PM, just trying to get through the city center. A car in the adjacent lane began to merge without signaling. I tried to accelerate to avoid contact but there wasn't enough room. The side of my car sustained a long, deep scratch. It is so annoying, man, because I just got the car cleaned yesterday. I really hope the insurance can handle this quickly so I can get it painted.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the pedestrian crossing light. I saw the silver Ford trying to move ahead, and the other vehicle drifted into their lane without looking. It wasn't a high-speed collision, just a side scrape. The Ford definitely had a scratch along the passenger door after the contact.

The traffic approaching the bridge was crawling at about 10 km/h. Everyone was braking constantly. The driver behind me was clearly following way too close. When I tapped my brakes, they slammed into me. It broke my rear brake lamp instantly. The whole situation is incredibly stressful as I have my family in the car, and we are just trying to get home. I have tried to document everything, but the lighting is quite poor here now.

I was driving behind the Hyundai and I admit I was distracted by the view of the bridge for a second. I didn't see them stop in time. I hit their rear light and caused it to break. It was entirely my fault, and I am happy to provide my insurance details to resolve this.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, which is always chaotic. I was in the outer lane when a taxi suddenly swerved to exit, hitting the side of my car. I tried to beep my horn to warn him, but it was too late. There is a dent and a large scratch on my front passenger door. I am really upset about this damage; the car is almost new and I always take such good care of it.

I was attempting to exit the roundabout from the middle lane. I checked my mirrors, but I believe the driver in the outer lane was in my blind spot. We made contact, which caused a scratch and a small dent on their door. I apologize for the miscalculation.

I was navigating the roundabout at a very slow pace, probably around 15 km/h, heading toward the Avenida da Boavista exit. Out of nowhere, the car behind me didn't brake in time and hit my rear bumper. I feel so bad because this is a new car and I’ve been so careful, you know? It's just really stressful. When I got out to look, I saw a noticeable dent on the bumper and some deep scratches near the license plate frame. It was honestly just a split-second lack of attention from the other driver.

I truly apologize for the incident. The traffic in the roundabout was quite heavy, and I simply looked away for a fraction of a second to check my GPS. By the time I looked back, the Volkswagen was stationary. I applied the brakes immediately, but it was too late to avoid the impact. I accept full responsibility for the dent and scratch on their vehicle.

I was driving straight along Avenida 24 de Julho at about 40 km/h, staying firmly in my lane. Suddenly, a commercial van attempted a lane change without signaling properly. Even though I tried to swerve slightly to the right, he grazed my passenger side door. It really scared me, man, I'm just so shaken up by the whole thing. The paint on my door is ruined; I can clearly see a long, deep scratch running across the entire side panel. I really hope the insurance covers the repairs properly.

I was parking my car near the shopping center on a very narrow street. I thought I had enough room, but I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar near the curb. I heard a scraping sound and stopped immediately. When I stepped out, I saw that I had hit the pillar with my rear wheel arch. There is a clear dent in the metal and several white scratches where the paint transferred. I am very embarrassed about this, but it was purely my own error while parking.

I was walking down Rua de Santa Catarina and watched the driver attempt to park. The street is notoriously tight, and it seemed like they were struggling with the maneuver. They misjudged the turn and made contact with the wall at a very low speed. I saw the dent and the scratch happen exactly as described by the driver. It was clearly an honest mistake.

It was raining quite hard on the IC19, and the traffic was at a standstill due to the rush hour congestion. I was at a full stop for a few seconds when a vehicle slammed into my rear. The force of the impact was quite significant. My rear tail lamp is completely broken and there is glass shatter all over the pavement behind my car. I’m just feeling quite overwhelmed by the process of dealing with this, especially since it was raining and visibility was so poor.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I was entering the intersection carefully when another car coming from the side didn't respect the stop sign. It happened so fast. We were both moving at around 20 km/h, but the impact was enough to cause damage. My front bumper has a significant dent, and the indicator lamp on the corner is broken. It is quite frustrating because I have an important meeting today, and now I have to deal with this paperwork and the repairs. I really hope the other driver admits it was his fault.

I admit that I failed to see the stop sign in the busy intersection. I was distracted by the sun glare reflecting off the buildings. I collided with the Renault at a low speed. I acknowledge that I damaged their front bumper, specifically causing a dent and breaking their indicator lamp. I am ready to cooperate with the insurance details.

I have been driving for forty years, and I usually take great pride in my safety record. I was driving down the avenue this morning, enjoying the mild weather, when a delivery driver suddenly pulled out from the curb into my lane without checking his mirror. I tried to steer left, but he still made contact with my passenger-side rear door. It caused a very long, deep scratch along the paintwork. I am quite disappointed, as I had just had the car polished last week. It’s just very unnecessary.

The traffic along the coast was moving slowly, about 30 km/h, due to the tourists in Cascais today. I was stopped at a pedestrian crossing to let someone pass, and the driver behind me clearly didn't see that I had stopped. He hit me from behind. The impact pushed my car slightly forward. I checked the rear immediately; there is a deep dent on the trunk lid and the left tail lamp is completely broken. I am worried about the repair costs, as the parts for this model are usually expensive.

I was following the Mercedes at a distance that turned out to be too short for the traffic conditions. When the driver stopped for the pedestrian, I reacted late. I hit them at a low speed, but it was enough to break their tail lamp and dent the trunk. It was my fault entirely, and I am very sorry for the inconvenience caused to them.

I was parked on the side of the street, and when I returned to my vehicle, I noticed damage to my front bumper. It looks like another driver tried to maneuver into the space in front of me and must have tapped my bumper. There is a distinct crack in the plastic cover now. I didn't see who did it, but it's clear someone hit me while I was away. It’s very annoying because the car was perfect this morning before I parked it here.

I was exiting the roundabout when a car coming from the inner lane tried to cut across to exit as well, not realizing I was right there. He collided with my front side. It was a chaotic moment, man, like, I didn't know how to react. My fender has a massive dent and some really ugly scratches, plus the side indicator lamp is broken. I really don't want to be involved in a long dispute. I just want this fixed so I can get back to my normal routine.

I take full responsibility for the accident at the roundabout. I was in the inner lane and miscalculated my exit, turning into the path of the Ford Focus. I caused the damage to their side, including the dent, the scratches, and the broken lamp. I am happy to provide all my details to the insurance company to facilitate the claim process.

I was driving along the avenue when a cyclist swerved into the road, forcing me to shift slightly to my left. Unfortunately, I didn't see the car in the lane next to me in my blind spot. I ended up grazing their side panel. It was a very unfortunate series of events, but I am relieved that nobody was hurt. There is a long scratch on the other car's passenger door. I am documenting the accident now and will contact my insurance provider immediately to handle the damages.

I was driving in the lane next to the Audi when the driver swerved to avoid a cyclist. I tried to brake, but we made contact. The impact was light, but it left a noticeable scratch along my rear door panel. The other driver stopped immediately and was very polite about the situation. I have no concerns about their conduct, it was clearly an unavoidable accident.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy, and the vehicle in front of me stopped suddenly for a pedestrian. I tried to brake, but I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit their rear bumper, which caused a visible dent and some scratches on the plastic trim. I am honestly quite worried about the repair costs, as I just had this car serviced last month. It was a complete lapse in concentration on my part, and I feel terrible about the inconvenience caused to the other driver.

I had come to a complete halt because someone was crossing the road. Suddenly, I felt a solid impact from behind. When I stepped out, I saw that the car behind me had bumped into my rear bumper, leaving a noticeable dent and several deep scratches on the paint. The other driver was very apologetic and admitted they were distracted for a split second.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, trying to exit towards the airport, when I misjudged the distance to the car in the inner lane. As I moved to change lanes, my side mirror and rear quarter panel made contact with their front corner. It resulted in their lamp being broken upon impact. I've been driving for years and I honestly don't know how I didn't see them coming around the roundabout. It was a silly mistake on my part, and I've already spoken to the other driver to exchange all our insurance details.

I was trying to parallel park near a café on Rua Augusta. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I must have miscalculated the angle because I felt a slight scraping sensation against the parked car next to me. I got out immediately to check and noticed a long scratch along the rear passenger door. It's such a nuisance, honestly, I've had a long day and this is just the last thing I needed. I am really sorry about the damage to the other vehicle's paintwork.

I was sitting at the outdoor terrace of the café watching the street. I saw the Peugeot driver trying to maneuver into the parking spot. They were going quite slowly, but they steered too close to the parked car, resulting in a visible scratch on the side of the stationary vehicle. It was clearly an accident caused by misjudgment of space.

It was raining quite heavily on Avenida 24 de Julho, making visibility very poor. I indicated to move to the middle lane, and I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other car was in my blind spot. We collided, and the force was enough to cause a dent, a deep scratch, and a lamp broken on their side. I feel so anxious about this; I've never been in an accident before and I really don't want my insurance premiums to skyrocket. I was just trying to follow the flow of traffic.

Back in my day, people were much more careful at intersections, but today the streets in Porto are so chaotic. I was approaching the junction on Rua da Constituição and, honestly, I think the traffic light turned yellow just as I was entering. The other car clipped my rear door as I passed through, which caused a significant dent and caused the glass shatter on their side window. My poor car is such a mess, and I just wanted to get home for dinner, but now I have to deal with all this paperwork.

I had a green light and was entering the intersection when the Ford accelerated through the yellow. They hit my side, which shattered the glass of my passenger window and put a large dent in the door panel. I am quite shaken up by the sudden impact, but thankfully no one was physically injured during the collision.

I was driving over the bridge when traffic suddenly came to a dead stop. I was maintaining a safe distance, but the car ahead of me braked so hard that I couldn't avoid tapping them. My front bumper has a visible dent now, and there are some scratches where it hit their tow hitch. I am incredibly worried because I rely on this car for my commute to university, and I really hope the repair process isn't going to take too many weeks to complete.

Driving along the EN125 is always stressful due to the narrow lanes. A truck was driving slightly over the center line, so I moved further to the right, but I clipped the bushes and then sideswiped a parked car on the shoulder. It resulted in a long scratch down the passenger side of the parked vehicle. I feel terrible about it, honestly. I've been driving for twenty years and I should have been much more aware of the surroundings. It's just a complete nightmare dealing with all this today.

I was walking nearby when I heard the sound of metal scraping. I looked over and saw the BMW had side-swiped a stationary car parked on the roadside. The driver was very visibly distressed and pulled over immediately to examine the damage, which was a long scratch on the other car's side. The driver of the BMW was very cooperative.

I was attempting to park in front of a shop on Avenida da Liberdade. I thought the spot was larger than it actually was. While turning, I misjudged the position of a concrete planter and the corner of another vehicle's bumper. I heard a crunch, and when I inspected the damage, I saw a dent in my fender and the other driver's tail lamp broken. I am so embarrassed about the whole situation. I will pay for whatever needs to be fixed, just please let me know how the claims process works.

I was driving through the historic center of Porto. At the intersection, I didn't see the stop sign in time because I was looking for a parking space. I entered the junction at about 20 km/h and hit the side of another car. The impact caused a large dent, several scratches, and even caused the glass shatter on their rear window. I feel so incredibly anxious; this is my first accident and I'm just terrified about what my parents are going to say. I know I made a huge mistake and I accept full responsibility.

I was proceeding through the intersection when the Citroën just didn't stop. They drove right into my side door. It caused a massive dent, paint scratches everywhere, and shattered the side window. I am very frustrated because I have an important meeting to attend, but I appreciate that the other driver admitted they missed the sign immediately.

I was on the roundabout in Funchal, and it was a bit confusing with the tourist traffic. I moved to the outer lane too early and ended up hitting the front corner of a car that was already there. There is a dent and a scratch on the side of their bumper. I've been living here for a while, but sometimes these tourist-heavy areas get really overwhelming with all the erratic driving. I feel quite bad about the damage and I've already called my agent to start the insurance claim process.

I was driving home after a long shift at the office, caught in that typical afternoon congestion on Avenida da Boavista. Traffic was stop-and-go, moving at maybe 10 km/h. Suddenly, the driver ahead of me braked hard for a turning bus, and I just couldn't react fast enough. I touched his bumper with my front end. I feel terrible about it, honestly. I got out to check and there is a visible dent and some noticeable scratches on my bumper. It was just a stupid lapse in concentration, man, I'm really worried about my insurance premium now.

I was attempting to park near the square to meet my grandson for a coffee. I misjudged the distance to the concrete bollard on the edge of the curb. I was moving very slowly, maybe 3 km/h, but I heard a sickening scraping sound. When I got out to inspect the vehicle, I saw a long, ugly scratch along the passenger side door. I have been driving for forty-five years and I rarely make such silly mistakes, but the sunlight was really reflecting off the pavement, making it quite difficult to see the curb clearly.

I was driving along the avenue when the car in the lane to my right started merging into mine without looking. I honked but it was too late. We sideswiped, and the impact caused a dent in my rear quarter panel and left quite a few scratches along the door. I am really stressed out, like, I only bought this car six months ago. I hope the repair process isn't going to be a nightmare, because I need this vehicle for my internship every single day next week.

I moved over because I saw my turn approaching. I really miscalculated how close the Peugeot was to my rear corner. I am sorry for the trouble. My car also has some marks, but I am mainly concerned about the damage I caused to the other driver's car.

I was backing out of a tight parking spot on a side street near the faculty. There was a delivery truck parked awkwardly behind me. I thought I had enough clearance, but I heard glass shattering and realized I hit the truck's rear light fixture. My own headlight also took a hit and is now broken. I feel so stupid for not having someone spot me, but I was in a rush to get to my lecture. It is just such an inconvenient situation for everyone involved.

I was walking down the street when I saw the BMW backing out. The driver didn't see the truck's protruding tail section. It was a low-speed impact, but clearly loud enough to shatter the glass of the lamp. I stayed to make sure the driver was okay.

I was at a red light on a busy intersection in Braga. The light turned green, and the car in front of me started to move but then stopped abruptly because a pedestrian stepped out. I did not have enough room to stop and hit their rear bumper. It created a noticeable dent in my hood. I am honestly just feeling really worried about the repair costs, man. I try to be a careful driver, but this just happened so quickly, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork.

I was driving towards the marina area, looking for a parking spot. I signaled to change lanes to the left. I checked my mirror, but somehow I missed the vehicle that was coming up quickly in that lane. We made contact, and it caused a dent and some scratches on my front fender. It was my fault for not checking twice. I am a pragmatic person, so I just want to get the claim settled quickly without unnecessary drama. I have already contacted the other driver to exchange insurance details.

The Renault driver moved into my lane unexpectedly. I slammed on the brakes but the side-mirrors clipped. I have damage to my side door too. It was clearly a mistake during a lane change. No one was injured, thankfully.

I was delivering some documents to the warehouse area. I was maneuvering around a forklift parked in an alleyway, and I misjudged the angle. My rear lamp hit a metal post and it shattered completely. I've been working these routes for years and I'm usually very attentive, but it was just a really tight space and I suppose I was distracted by my phone buzzing on the dashboard. I need to get this fixed urgently because I cannot drive at night without a functioning rear lamp, obviously.

The road was narrow due to some roadworks. A car coming in the opposite direction was driving slightly over the center line. We both swerved, but the side of my car still clipped theirs. It left a long scratch and a dent on my side door. I was quite shaken, it's a beautiful road but the conditions are treacherous today. I just want to make sure the claim is handled correctly, as this is a relatively new car and I am quite meticulous about maintaining its condition.

I was walking on the sidewalk and saw the whole thing. The road is very narrow there, and both drivers were trying to give each other space, but it was impossible. The side impact caused clear damage to the Audi. I am happy to provide my details for the insurance report.

I was driving my grandkids home and the traffic was quite heavy near the historic center. I was distracted by the kids talking in the back, and the car in front of me stopped for a pedestrian. I hit them with enough force that my headlight glass shattered and the bumper sustained a dent. I feel terrible because I am usually a very careful driver, especially with the little ones in the car. It was just a complete lapse in my attention, and I am quite worried about the repair costs for the headlight.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly stopped for a red light. I hit the brakes, but the road was damp and I just couldn't stop in time. I ended up hitting the back of the car in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. It was really stressful because it's my first car, you know? I checked the bumper and saw a dent and a visible scratch right on the center. I feel so bad about the whole situation, man, I was just trying to get home.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror and saw the other driver looking quite panicked. We both pulled over safely to the side. Upon inspection, my rear bumper had a clear dent and a scratch from the impact.

I was navigating the roundabout at Rotunda da Boavista, staying in the middle lane, when another car suddenly tried to merge into my lane without checking. It happened so fast, honestly. I tried to steer away but felt the contact on the passenger side door. I was really worried about my insurance premium, like, is this going to be expensive to fix? There is a long scratch running along the side panel. I have never been in an accident before and it was quite an overwhelming experience for me.

I was backing into a parking space near Praça do Comércio this morning. The sun was reflecting off the cobblestones and I misjudged the distance to the bollard on my right. I hit it at a very low speed, but it was enough to cause some damage to the rear fender. I am so annoyed with myself for being so careless. There is a noticeable dent and a deep scratch where the metal made contact. I have already contacted my insurer to report the incident as I want to handle this professionally.

I was trying to turn into a narrow side street off Rua Augusta while it was raining quite heavily. A van was parked a bit too far into the road, and as I tried to squeeze past, I clipped the corner of my car against their rear bumper. I heard a loud crack, and when I got out, I saw that my front lamp was broken. It was truly unfortunate weather conditions for driving. I am just relieved nobody was hurt, though I am definitely worried about the repair costs for the light assembly.

I was walking down the street when I saw the Smart car attempt to pass the parked van. It was raining and visibility was poor. The car scraped the van and I saw the driver's front lamp break upon contact. Both drivers exited their vehicles immediately to check the damage.

I was driving along Avenida dos Aliados at about 30 km/h when I checked my mirror to change lanes to the right. I thought the lane was clear, but as I started moving, another car appeared in my blind spot. I couldn't avoid the collision. It caused a dent and a scratch on my rear door panel. I feel terrible about the mistake. I've been driving for years without incident, so this is quite stressful.
