I've been driving for years and this is my first incident; I feel absolutely terrible about it.

Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as usual. I checked my blind spot before moving into the middle lane, but a black hatchback had accelerated into the gap at the exact same moment. We side-swiped each other at about 40 km/h. It was really loud and terrifying. There is a long, deep scratch running along my passenger door and the rear fender. I should have been more careful, man, I'm just so rattled by the whole thing right now.

I was in the middle lane moving at a steady pace. The driver of the BMW tried to merge without seeing me. I tried to swerve, but we still scraped side-to-side. My car has some light scratches along the driver's side door, but no major damage.

Oh dear, I was taking my granddaughter to the park and it was quite a drizzly afternoon here in Funchal. When I entered the roundabout near the hotel, I was looking for my exit and didn't notice the van coming around the inside lane. We collided near the front bumper. My front left corner has a dent, a deep scratch, and the lamp glass is broken. I feel quite foolish, as I have been driving for over forty years and rarely have these kinds of mishaps.

I was driving home from work yesterday evening, around 6:30 PM. The traffic was bumper-to-bumper as it usually is on this stretch. I was checking my navigation system for a split second and, when I looked back, the vehicle in front of me had come to a complete stop. I hit the brakes, but I still made contact with the rear of his car. It resulted in a dent on my front bumper. It was a lapse in concentration, and I accept full responsibility for the collision.

I was sitting at a complete standstill in traffic when I felt a sudden impact from behind. The driver behind me didn't stop in time. My rear bumper has a significant dent, but luckily, no one was hurt in the incident. The driver was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the exchange.

I was crossing the intersection when another car entered from the side street. I don't know if they didn't see the stop sign, but it all happened so fast. My side window glass shattered from the impact and the debris was everywhere. I am so shaken up, you know? I really didn't expect this on a Tuesday morning. Everything happened in slow motion and I just want to make sure I'm doing the right things for the insurance claim, dude. I'm worried about the repair process.

I was moving along the avenue in the right lane. I signaled to change lanes because I needed to turn left shortly. I started to merge, but the driver in the other lane accelerated, and we made contact. It was a graze rather than a direct hit. I have a dent on the rear panel and a scratch along the side. I should have checked the mirror one last time before moving, but it was just a bad split-second decision in heavy traffic.

I was traveling at about 40 km/h when the Ford started moving into my lane. I didn't have enough room to dodge them, so our sides touched. My side door has some scratches and a slight dent from the contact. The other driver apologized immediately.

It was raining quite heavily when I arrived at the parking garage near the stadium. I was trying to fit into a tight space and underestimated how close the concrete column was. As I turned, I scraped the side of my car against the corner of the pillar. It resulted in a scratch and a small crack in the plastic bumper housing. I've been driving for thirty years and it is quite disheartening to have such an avoidable accident, especially in my own neighborhood.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Boavista junction, moving quite slowly because of the heavy morning traffic, when the car next to me suddenly swerved into my lane without signaling. I slammed on the brakes but couldn't avoid the contact. It was really stressful, honestly, I am still shaking a bit. I just hope the repairs aren't too expensive or take too long because I need this car for work every single day. The impact resulted in a clear dent on my rear passenger door.

I was driving through the narrow streets near the city center. A delivery van ahead of me stopped abruptly to unload goods, and because the street was so narrow, I couldn't maneuver around it quickly enough. I nudged the rear of his vehicle at a very low speed. My front right indicator lamp is broken from the contact. I feel quite worried about the insurance premiums going up, but I know it is important to report this honestly and follow the correct procedures.

I had stopped my van briefly on the street to deliver a package to a local shop. I felt a sudden jolt from behind and realized the driver behind me had misjudged the distance and bumped into my rear bumper. The other driver was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the entire exchange of details.

I was driving in the right lane and started to change to the middle lane. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the other car in my blind spot. We collided, and there is now a scratch and a small dent on my side panel. I am quite concerned about the repair costs, as I have always been a very careful driver. This is a very stressful experience, and I hope the claims process is straightforward and quick.

I was maintaining my speed in the center lane when the vehicle to my right suddenly veered into my path. I had no time to move away, so we scraped alongside each other. It was a fairly minor impact, but it was still quite a shock for me.

I was driving slowly through the intersection when another car came from the side street. I don't know if they misjudged the signal or if they just weren't looking, but we collided near the passenger side. My side window glass has shattered completely due to the impact. I am feeling very anxious about everything, especially the paperwork. I have never been in an accident before in my life, and this is truly an overwhelming situation to deal with on a busy Tuesday afternoon.

I was waiting to cross the road at the pedestrian signal when I saw the two vehicles approach the intersection. It seemed like the driver from the side street did not stop in time for the red light. I witnessed the impact clearly, and I am happy to provide my contact details as an official witness to the insurance companies.

I was parking my car near the park under the nice afternoon sun. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I must have turned the wheel too sharply because I ended up scraping the side of my car against the concrete wall of the underground parking exit. It resulted in a deep scratch along the passenger door. I am feeling quite disappointed in myself for being so careless. I would like to get this repaired as soon as possible, as the car is fairly new.

I was driving along the Monumental road returning from my grocery shopping. It started to drizzle slightly, making the tarmac quite slick. The vehicle in front of me braked very suddenly for a pedestrian crossing, and despite my attempt to stop, I slid slightly on the wet road and hit the back of their car. I am quite worried because my rear lamp is broken and there is a noticeable dent on my hood. I am just hoping that everyone is okay and that the insurance can handle this.

I saw the pedestrian crossing and braked, as is required. The driver behind me didn't stop in time and hit me. It was definitely the weather conditions making the road slippery, as they seemed to be trying to stop. Thankfully, it was only a low-speed impact.

I was driving down the avenue when a car from the outer lane decided to merge without sufficient space. I tried to avoid it, but they swiped the side of my car, leaving a long scratch along the rear quarter panel. I am quite an experienced driver, but even so, this caught me off guard. I have the insurance details of the other driver, and we both agreed to document the damage immediately so there would be no confusion later on.

I was trying to move over to the left lane to make an upcoming turn. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the car that was already there. We ended up making contact while moving at slow speeds. I admit full responsibility for the error in judgment.

It was quite a busy day with tourists everywhere near the shopping district. I was trying to maneuver out of a narrow alleyway. I didn't realize how close the stone wall was because the sun was glaring right into my windshield. I hit the wall at a very low speed, which caused a dent on my front bumper. My grandson was in the car with me, and he was a bit frightened by the noise, which makes me feel even worse about the whole incident.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was quite heavy as usual. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to hit my brakes, but I wasn't fast enough and tapped the rear of the other vehicle. It was totally my fault, I feel terrible about it. My front bumper has a noticeable dent and some deep scratches from the impact. I am just really worried about how much this is going to cost to repair, man.

I had to stop abruptly because a person stepped into the crosswalk without looking. The driver behind me didn't react in time and bumped into my rear bumper. There is a visible dent on my trunk and a long scratch where their car made contact. It was an honest mistake in dense traffic.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, heading towards the exit for the A1 motorway. It was raining quite a bit, and the roads were slippery. I was changing lanes to the right, and I didn't see the van next to me in my blind spot. I ended up scraping against his side panel. I feel so anxious about this, I've never been in a crash before. My car door has a long, ugly scratch along the side. I just hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, honestly.

I was trying to parallel park near the center of Coimbra this morning. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar near the curb. I was moving very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but I turned the wheel too sharply and hit the corner of the pillar. My rear passenger side panel now has a dent and some nasty scratches. It’s my own car, and I’m just so frustrated with myself for being so clumsy. I really need this fixed before the weekend as I have a long trip planned.

It was about 3:00 PM and I was driving down the avenue. The sun was extremely bright, making it hard to see clearly. Another car was pulling out from a side street and didn't see me, so they veered into my lane. I swerved to avoid a direct hit, but my front corner caught their side. My headlight is broken now and there is a deep scratch along my bumper. I am really stressed about the paperwork involved and whether the repairs will take weeks to complete.

I was pulling out onto the main road and the glare from the sun was blinding. I didn't see the other vehicle coming down the lane until it was too late. We brushed against each other. My car is fine mostly, but theirs has a broken lamp and some paint scratches.

Oh man, I was cruising along the Marginal toward Cascais. The traffic was stop-and-go because of the beach crowd. The driver ahead of me braked suddenly to look at the sea, I guess, and I couldn't stop in time. I hit the back of his car. The impact shattered one of my front indicator lenses and caused a big dent on my hood. I am honestly just so worried about how much this is going to cost me, you know? It was totally a moment of distraction on my part.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the BMW hit the car in front. The driver in the BMW was looking to the side right before the impact. There is glass shattered all over the road from the lamp and a significant dent on the hood.

My grandson was with me in the back seat, and we were heading to get some groceries on this lovely Tuesday morning. I approached the intersection and thought the light was still green, but it turned amber quickly. A delivery van was coming from the right, and we touched fenders. It was quite a shock, really, at my age one doesn't expect such things. The side of my car has a small dent and a very long scratch from the van's sliding door metal rail. I am just so shaken up.

I am a delivery driver, so I am on these roads all day. I was merging left on the Avenida and I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. We made contact, just a light graze at maybe 20 km/h. There is a series of scratches down the side of my vehicle. It is unfortunate, but it's just part of the job sometimes, I suppose. I've already provided my details to the other driver so we can get this settled professionally.

I was driving in my lane when the delivery driver merged suddenly without enough space. My side panel rubbed against his vehicle. It didn't cause a major crash, just some superficial scratches on the paintwork. It was a minor incident, but still frustrating to deal with during my lunch hour.

I was trying to navigate the very tight streets in downtown Porto. The road was narrow with cars parked on both sides. I was backing up to let a bus pass, but I miscalculated the distance to the bollard behind me. I heard a crunch, and when I got out, I saw that my rear tail lamp was broken into pieces. I’m honestly so upset because I love this car, and the repair costs are likely going to be quite high for such a small, silly mistake.

location: Autoestrada A2, Near Alcácer do Sal

statements.text: I was driving south on the A2 highway, heading to the Algarve for the weekend. The traffic suddenly slowed down to about 40 km/h due to road work ahead. I braked, but the person behind me was definitely following too closely and couldn't stop. They slammed into my rear bumper. My car has a large dent and paint scratches from their license plate frame. I'm just relieved that nobody was hurt, but I am really worried about the quality of the repair work being done.

I didn't notice the traffic slowing down as quickly as it did on the highway. By the time I hit the brakes, I had already struck the back of the Volvo. It left a clear dent and scratch on their bumper. I admit I wasn't keeping enough distance, and I take responsibility.

I was entering the roundabout near the train station. I thought I had clear space to enter, but a motorcycle was coming around the circle faster than I anticipated. I had to brake hard, and while I didn't hit him, the sudden stop caused the car behind me to nudge my rear bumper. My bumper now has a spiderweb crack in the plastic cover. I am just really stressed about this because it's a newer car and I wanted to keep it in perfect condition, you know?

The Tesla in front of me slammed on his brakes because of a motorcycle. I was following at a normal distance, but I didn't have enough time to stop completely on the wet road surface. I hit his bumper at a very low speed. It caused a small crack in his bumper.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5 PM, heading towards the city center. The traffic was quite heavy as it usually is at that hour. The vehicle in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing, and I just couldn't react fast enough. I pressed the brakes, but I still bumped into their rear bumper. It was a very low-speed impact, but now there is a visible dent on my front hood. I feel terrible about the whole situation, as I really should have kept more distance.

I was trying to park my car in a very tight spot near the Rossio square. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar on the side of the parking garage. As I was turning the wheel to tuck in, I heard a nasty scraping sound. I got out immediately to check and saw a significant scratch along the passenger side door. I am so stressed out about this; I have only had this car for three months and it was my first time parking in this specific underground lot.

I was walking nearby to get some coffee and saw the driver attempting to maneuver into the parking bay. They were moving very slowly, but the space was clearly too small for that vehicle. I saw the side of the car graze the pillar and heard the metal scraping against the concrete. It was definitely an honest mistake during a difficult parking maneuver.

I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música. I was in the middle lane, and another driver in the outer lane decided to exit suddenly without signaling. I tried to steer away, but there was no time. We made side-to-side contact. I am really shaken up, man. My car has a dent and a long scratch on the rear fender now. I don't know how much this is going to cost to fix, and I have to go to work soon. It’s just a really bad day for me.

I admit I was distracted by my GPS and moved to the exit lane quite abruptly while on the roundabout. I did not check my side mirror carefully enough before turning. I felt the impact on my front bumper and immediately pulled over to exchange details. I am fully responsible for the contact.

It was raining, so the road was quite slippery while I was driving along the Marginal road towards Estoril. A delivery truck in the lane next to me drifted slightly into my lane while avoiding a cyclist. I tried to move as far to the left as possible, but the truck's side panel still swiped my driver-side door, causing a long, ugly scratch. I’ve lived in Cascais for thirty years and never seen the traffic this chaotic, honestly. I'm just grateful that nobody was hurt in the rain.

I was proceeding through the intersection at the green light. Suddenly, a car came from the right side and hit my front corner. The light was green for me, but the other driver seemed completely unaware. My front lamp is broken, and there is a noticeable dent in the bumper. I am just really concerned about the insurance process because I need this car for my daily commute to the university. I hope everything gets settled quickly because this is my only vehicle.

I honestly thought I had the green light, but I must have misread the signal in the glare of the morning sun. I drove into the intersection and collided with the other driver's front bumper. I feel terrible about it. I have already confirmed with the other driver that I will cooperate fully with the insurance claim report.

I was reversing out of a narrow alleyway in the city center. I checked my rearview mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the glass storefront display or the bollard properly because of the low light. I reversed into it, and my rear window suffered a complete glass shatter. It was a very stupid mistake, and I am quite embarrassed by it. I just want to get the glass repaired as soon as possible, as the car is not safe to drive in this condition.

I was changing lanes to prepare for a right turn. I checked my mirror, but I failed to see the motorcycle in my blind spot. I started moving over and heard a shout, so I immediately steered back. We made slight contact, which caused a scratch on my rear door panel. I am quite distressed, as I never want to be the reason someone falls off their bike. Fortunately, the rider kept his balance, but I feel really guilty about my lack of attention during the maneuver.

I was riding in the right lane when the car suddenly started merging into my path. I had to brake hard to avoid a worse accident, but the car still clipped my handlebar and left a scratch on their door. I am shaken but okay. It was just a classic blind-spot error, I suppose.

Traffic on the bridge was stop-and-go as it usually is. The driver behind me didn't stop in time when the line came to a halt. They hit my rear bumper quite hard. My rear lamp is broken and there is a significant dent in the trunk area. This is highly inconvenient as I was on my way to a business meeting in Almada. I am currently waiting for the police to document the scene so I can get back on my way.

I was trying to maneuver into a public parking space near the square. Another driver was pulling out at the same time and didn't see me clearly. We both ended up scraping our bumpers against each other. It’s just a scratch on the side, but it’s still very frustrating. I am a careful driver, but this busy area makes it impossible to avoid little incidents sometimes. My grandson told me to take extra care, and I suppose he was right.

I was reversing out of my spot and simply did not see the other car approaching from behind. It was a lapse in judgment on my part. We both stopped instantly and checked for damage. There is a small scratch on both of our bumpers. We are currently exchanging insurance policy details.

I was driving at a steady 30 km/h along the avenue. A taxi driver attempted to pull over to pick up a passenger without signaling, and his rear quarter panel caught my front fender. It caused a noticeable dent. I am quite worried about the repair costs as this is a luxury car. I need a formal assessment for my insurance company to process this claim. I hope the taxi driver admits his fault because it was clearly his maneuver that caused the collision.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when I saw the taxi pull toward the curb very suddenly. The Audi was passing at the same time and couldn't avoid the collision. It wasn't a high-speed accident, but the contact was clear. Both drivers stepped out immediately to talk.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM yesterday when traffic suddenly stopped. I tried to brake, but the road was damp from the light drizzle and I ended up bumping the back of the car in front of me at very low speed, maybe 10 km/h. I am honestly quite shaken up by this; it is my first time being involved in a collision and I am worried about the insurance premiums. There is a noticeable dent on my front bumper where I hit the other vehicle's trailer hitch.

I was waiting at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror and saw the driver had hit my bumper. He came out immediately to apologize. My vehicle only shows a minor dent on the rear step, so it was a very light impact overall.

I was attempting to park my Peugeot in a tight space on Rua da Prata this morning. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was turning the wheel to tuck the car in, I misjudged the distance to the stationary vehicle next to me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed their rear quarter panel. I feel terrible about it because the other car was parked perfectly. There is a long scratch on my passenger side door where the metal made contact.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, and I must admit I was a bit distracted by my GPS instructions. I was changing lanes to take the exit toward the A1 when I didn't notice the other driver coming up on my right. We ended up colliding at a shallow angle. It happened so fast. My car has a dent and a deep scratch on the rear wheel arch. I am very worried about the repair costs, honestly, it was just a silly moment of distraction.

I was maintaining my lane in the roundabout when the BMW driver suddenly swerved into my path without signaling. I slammed on the brakes, but we still touched. I have a dent on my front fender and a scratch along the door panel from the side-swipe.

It was late at night, around 11:30 PM, and I was driving home along the riverfront. The street lights were dim, and I was trying to merge into the right lane. I didn't see the van in my blind spot until it was too late. I clipped their side, and my headlamp shattered against their frame. I am really sorry, man, I just didn't check the mirror properly. There is a scratch on my bumper and my front lamp is broken.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Toyota try to merge into the right lane. The driver didn't seem to notice the van already there. It was a clear case of a failed blind-spot check. I saw the lamp break and heard the scraping sound of the vehicles colliding.

I have been driving for forty-five years, and I usually consider myself quite careful, but today was just one of those days. I was heading to pick up my granddaughter from school, and the traffic was incredibly heavy on Avenida da República. I signaled to switch lanes, and I suppose I misjudged the speed of the approaching car. We bumped fenders as I merged. My car has a visible dent on the side panel. It is quite frustrating, but these things do happen in the city traffic, I suppose.

I was driving steadily in the left lane when the driver in the Mercedes decided to move over. He came into my lane too quickly for me to avoid him. We made contact, resulting in a dent on his passenger door and my front bumper.

Honestly, this is just so typical of my luck. I was trying to squeeze into a parking spot in the city center. I am usually very good at this, but I miscalculated the angle of the curb. I ended up scraping the side of my car against a concrete bollard, and unfortunately, it also caught the bumper of the car parked in front. There is a deep scratch along the side. I am really worried about what the insurance company will say about my record, man.

Driving along the Marginal in Cascais is usually pleasant, but today the sun was blindingly bright as I headed west. A car in front slowed down abruptly for a pedestrian crossing, and because of the glare, I didn't see them stop until the very last second. I slammed the brakes and skidded a bit, hitting them. My front lamp is broken and there is a dent on the hood. I am so stressed out; I hope the other driver is okay, despite the damage to their car.

I had to brake firmly for a person crossing the street. I was already stopped when I felt a hard hit from behind. The Audi driver was very apologetic about the glare. My rear bumper has a significant dent and a broken rear light assembly.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving along the avenue when the lane suddenly narrowed due to roadworks that weren't clearly marked. The vehicle to my left also tried to merge into the remaining lane at the same time. There wasn't enough space for both of us, and we side-swiped each other. It caused a long scratch and a dent on my driver-side door. It’s quite annoying because I was keeping a steady speed and the signage was really poor in that area.

The road narrowed unexpectedly. We were both trying to merge. I thought I had the right of way, but we both converged on the same spot. We hit each other's side doors. My car has a scratch and a dent from the impact.

I was navigating the cobblestone streets of Porto, trying to find a hotel. The streets are incredibly narrow, and I was turning a corner when my front-side bumper caught the edge of a brick wall. It was a very low-speed maneuver, probably 5 km/h, but the corner was much sharper than it looked. My headlamp is broken, and there is a large scratch running down the panel. I am just really annoyed with myself for hitting the wall; it’s a beautiful city, but the driving is difficult.

I was driving home after work around 18:30 in heavy traffic. The car in front of me suddenly stopped because the light turned red at the intersection. I braked as hard as I could, but the road was a bit slippery from the light drizzle and I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly. I got out immediately to check on the other driver. There is a noticeable dent on my hood where it met their trunk. Everything happened so fast, I am just so shaken up.

I was stopped at the red light near the roundabout when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the other driver had rear-ended me. When I stepped out, I saw a dent in my rear bumper cover. The other driver was very polite and apologized immediately, admitting they just didn't see me stop in time.

I was trying to parallel park in a very tight spot on Rua de Santa Catarina. I misjudged the angle while reversing and scraped against the side of the car parked behind me. I feel so embarrassed about it. I immediately stopped and waited for the owner to return so we could exchange details. There is a long scratch on the rear passenger door of the other car and a matching scratch on my front bumper. It was entirely my mistake, the spot was just way too small for my car.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving in the middle lane when I signaled to move to the right. I looked, but I suppose I missed the other car in my blind spot. As I started moving over, I heard a loud scraping noise and realized I hit the other vehicle. I corrected my steering immediately. We pulled over safely. My car has a dent and a deep scratch along the side panel. It was a lapse in judgment on my part, and I really hope the other driver is okay.

I was driving straight in the right lane when this car suddenly came into my lane without looking. I tried to swerve, but there was a dent and a scratch left on my rear quarter panel. It happened in a split second. The driver apologized right away when we stopped to exchange insurance information.

It was pouring rain this morning near the Boavista roundabout. I was exiting the roundabout and thought the car next to me was staying in the inner lane, but they decided to exit as well. We clipped each other during the turn. My front lamp is broken and there is a bad scratch on the fender. I am so worried about the repair costs, man. It's just been a really stressful morning and I definitely could have been more careful with my positioning in such heavy, wet traffic.

I was maneuvering to turn into a narrow side street near the downtown area. A delivery van was parked slightly protruding into the road, and as I tried to squeeze past, I hit my side mirror against their rear corner. My mirror's glass shattered instantly. It was a very low-speed impact, maybe 5 km/h, but the sound was quite startling. I am very frustrated with myself for being so reckless in such a narrow passage. I have documented the glass shatter and the position of both vehicles for the report.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Smart car attempt to pass the delivery van. The driver clearly underestimated the distance. There was a loud pop when the mirror hit the van, and I saw the glass shatter all over the pavement. The driver stopped immediately.

I was driving along the coast, heading towards Cascais. The morning sun was quite low and very bright, which made it hard to see the brake lights of the car in front of me clearly. By the time I realized they were stopping for a pedestrian crossing, I was too close. I hit the brakes hard, but still made contact. There is a significant dent on the trunk of the car I hit. I feel terrible about this because I am usually a very careful driver, but the light was just blinding.

I was slowing down for the pedestrian crossing on the Marginal. The driver behind me didn't seem to notice until the last second. They hit my rear bumper quite hard, causing a large dent. I checked my car and the driver was very apologetic, explaining that the sun had blinded them temporarily.

I was parked on the side of Rua de Cedofeita, and as I was pulling out into the traffic, I didn't check my side mirror well enough. A car was passing by, and I sideswiped their passenger side. There is a long, ugly scratch along their door. I am just really anxious about how the insurance process works and how much this will affect my policy. I have all the photos of the scratch and the location where it happened. I truly didn't see the other vehicle coming.

I was visiting the aquarium with my grandchildren. While reversing out of the parking space, I miscalculated the pillar nearby. I backed into it, which caused a dent in my trunk and my rear lamp is completely broken. It was a foolish mistake; I was just distracted thinking about the tickets and the kids. I feel quite silly about it, honestly. My granddaughter was crying because of the loud noise. I am just glad no one was hurt during the maneuver, just a bit of damage to the car.

I entered the intersection, thinking I had the green arrow, but I might have been mistaken. A car coming from the cross-street struck my front side. There is a nasty dent and a long scratch on the fender. I am so confused because I really thought the light was for me, but clearly, something went wrong. I have exchanged all details with the other driver. I am just hoping the repairs won't take too long as I need my car for my sales appointments next week.

I had the green light and was proceeding through the junction when the Audi suddenly pulled out in front of me. I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit their side, causing a dent and scratch. It was definitely their fault, but the driver was at least very professional about admitting they might have misread the signal.

I was driving along Estrada Monumental towards the city center. A scooter ahead of me had to brake suddenly because a pedestrian stepped onto the road, and I had to brake hard to avoid hitting the scooter. The car behind me, unfortunately, did not react fast enough and collided with my rear end. The impact was quite strong; my rear light glass shattered and the lamp unit is completely broken. I am just relieved that the scooter rider didn't fall, but my car is in a bad state now.

I was walking on the sidewalk and saw the whole thing. The car had to slam on its brakes because of the scooter, and the car behind didn't have enough distance. The crash was quite loud, and I saw the rear lamp glass shatter all over the road. The driver of the Volvo stayed calm and called the police.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, you know, during the rush hour traffic. It was super crowded and everyone was moving at like 20 km/h. Suddenly, the car in front of me stopped completely for a pedestrian. I tried to brake, but I didn't leave enough distance and my front bumper hit the back of his car. It was really stressful, man. I got out and saw a visible dent on his rear bumper. I feel so bad about the whole situation because it was totally my fault for being distracted.

I was stopped at the designated pedestrian crossing when I felt a significant impact from behind. I checked my rearview mirror and realized the driver behind me hadn't stopped in time. Upon inspecting the vehicle, I noted a clear dent on my rear bumper cover. We exchanged details calmly.

I was circling the Rotunda do Relógio trying to exit towards the airport. It was raining quite heavily, and the visibility was poor. As I moved to the outer lane, I didn't see the van next to me properly and we ended up scraping against each other. It was just a small scratch along my passenger side door. I am really worried about how much this will cost to repair, as it’s a relatively new car and I’m trying to be very careful with my expenses.

I was attempting to park in a very narrow spot in downtown Coimbra. I must have miscalculated the angle while reversing at very low speed, maybe 5 km/h. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had clipped the rear fender of a parked vehicle. There is a visible dent and a long scratch on the other car's panel. I left a note on their windshield immediately because I know how annoying it is to find damage on your car when you return to it.

I was heading home from work on Avenida dos Aliados. I checked my mirrors before merging lanes, but there was a huge blind spot and I didn't see the motorcyclist coming up fast. When I moved, he had to swerve and clipped my side mirror, causing the glass to shatter completely. I stopped immediately to assist. It was truly an honest mistake, I just didn't see him in the flow of traffic at that specific moment.

I was riding in the right lane when the car in front of me started merging without using their indicator. I tried to avoid the collision, but my handlebar struck their mirror, resulting in the glass shattering. I did not fall, but my bike sustained minor scrapes to the mirror casing.

It was a beautiful morning in Funchal and I was driving to the supermarket on Estrada Monumental. As I reached the intersection, the sun was right in my eyes and I completely missed the stop sign for a split second. I entered the junction and bumped into a car crossing my path. My front right lamp is broken as a result of the impact. I am so embarrassed; I pride myself on being a safe driver, but today I just made a really careless mistake.

Traffic on Avenida da República was stop-and-go as usual. I was looking for an address on my phone for a second and looked up too late. The car ahead had already stopped, and I hit them. My front bumper has a deep dent and the left lamp is broken. I feel terrible about this because it was entirely my fault. I'm just thankful that nobody was injured, as that would have been a much worse situation.

I was walking along the sidewalk and saw the whole thing. The Ford Focus driver didn't brake in time because they were clearly looking down at something in their hand. It was a low-speed impact, but definitely enough to cause the damage to the headlamp and bumper I see now.

I was driving home along the coast on the Marginal road. The light turned yellow and I decided to stop, but the driver behind me didn't expect it. He hit me from behind at around 30 km/h. The force of the impact caused my rear tail light glass to shatter and there is a significant dent in the tailgate. I am really shaken up by the suddenness of it all, but I am just glad nobody in either car was hurt in the collision.

I was following the VW Polo and misjudged the distance. When they stopped suddenly for the yellow light, I couldn't stop in time. I hit the back of their car. My front bumper is okay, but I clearly caused the damage to their rear light and the dent on their trunk.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on the Avenida was extremely heavy as usual. I stopped my Renault behind a black sedan at a red light near the Marquês de Pombal square. Unfortunately, I was distracted for a split second by my phone notification and my foot slipped off the brake. I gently tapped the rear bumper of the car ahead, resulting in a small dent and a long scratch on my front bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was completely my fault for not paying attention.

I was sitting at the traffic light waiting for it to turn green when I suddenly felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't seem to stop in time due to the dense traffic. When I got out, I saw that the collision caused a slight dent and some scratches on the plastic bumper of my vehicle. We exchanged insurance details right there on the side of the road.

Man, this is so stressful, I'm just a student, you know? I was navigating the busy roundabout at Boavista in Porto. It was raining slightly and the road was super slick. I was changing lanes to exit when I didn't see the van in my blind spot. I clipped their side and it broke my headlight lamp and left a nasty scratch down the passenger side. I feel so bad, dude, I was just trying to get to my class on time and wasn't careful enough with the lane change.

I was trying to park my Fiat in a very tight spot on Rua da Prata this morning. I thought I had enough clearance while turning the steering wheel, but the angle was sharper than I estimated. I ended up scraping the rear quarter panel against a concrete pillar in the parking garage. There is a deep scratch there now. It is incredibly frustrating because the space was quite narrow and I was being careful, but I clearly misjudged the proximity to the wall.

I was walking by the parking area when I saw the driver attempting to maneuver the Fiat into the narrow spot. They were going very slowly, but the car made a scraping sound against the pillar. I saw the driver get out immediately to check the damage, which looked like a visible scratch on the side of their car. It was clearly an honest mistake while trying to park.

The traffic was moving slowly along Avenida dos Aliados. I signaled to switch lanes to the right to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I think I had a blind spot because I didn't see the motorcycle coming up. I swerved slightly and knocked into them. My car sustained a dent on the driver's side door and the indicator lamp is broken. I am so relieved the motorcyclist is okay, but I am really worried about the insurance paperwork and the costs involved for these repairs.

My wife and I were driving down the EN125 near Faro to visit our grandchildren. The weather was bright, but the sun was hitting the windshield at an awkward angle. While merging onto the main road, I didn't notice the pickup truck coming from my left side. We made contact, causing a long scratch and a shallow dent along my driver-side door. We are both over 70, so we were a bit shaken up, but thankfully it was only a low-speed side-swipe and no one was physically hurt in the process.

I was driving along the EN125 at about 50 km/h when the Toyota attempted to merge without seeing me. I tried to brake, but we still ended up swiping each other. My side of the truck is fine, but their car definitely has a dent and a scratch where we made contact. It was an unfortunate incident, but the elderly couple was very polite and cooperative throughout the whole insurance exchange.

I approached the intersection at Alameda das Antas. The light had just turned yellow, and I misjudged the distance required to stop safely. I crossed the line just as the cross-traffic started moving. A small van clipped my rear passenger door. The force caused the window glass to shatter completely. I am honestly quite shaken by the experience; the noise of the glass breaking was very loud. I acknowledge that I should have braked earlier, but the timing of the signal caught me completely off guard.

I was idling in the heavy afternoon congestion near Praça de Espanha. I was looking at my GPS to double-check my route. I thought the car in front had started moving, so I eased off the brake, but they were actually still stopped. I bumped into their rear bumper. It resulted in a visible dent on my hood near the grill. I feel incredibly stupid for not paying attention to the road ahead. I have already contacted my insurer to start the process for the bodywork repair.

I was waiting for the traffic to move forward at the intersection. Suddenly, I felt a thump from behind. I checked my rearview mirror and saw the Hyundai driver had hit my bumper. They came out immediately to apologize. There is a small dent on their hood where they hit my tow bar. It was a clear-cut case of inattention in slow-moving traffic.

I was parked on a very narrow street in Cedofeita to drop off some groceries. When I pulled out of the parking spot, I didn't realize how close the concrete post was to my corner. I heard a crunch and saw that I had scraped the side panel and shattered my side marker lamp. I'm just so annoyed with myself, I've had a long week and clearly wasn't focusing on the spatial awareness of my vehicle while exiting the bay. I'll need to get the lamp and the scratch fixed soon.

I was driving at about 40 km/h along the Avenida da República. A delivery truck in the adjacent lane began merging into my lane without checking. I tried to steer away, but their back corner clipped my passenger side. It left a long, deep scratch and a noticeable dent along the door panel. The driver was very cooperative once they realized what had happened. I'm just hoping the repair process is straightforward, as I use this car daily for my professional appointments and can't afford to be without it for too long.

I am a delivery driver in Lisbon. I was changing lanes to make a delivery, and I simply didn't see the Tesla in my peripheral vision until it was too late. I clipped the side of their car. It was my fault entirely for the lane change. I checked the damage and there is a dent and some scratches on their door. I provided all my company insurance documentation to the driver to assist with their claim.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Porto

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marechal Gomes da Costa. It was raining quite hard, and visibility was reduced. As I was exiting, a car from the inner lane tried to force their way out and hit my passenger side window, causing the glass to shatter inward. I had to pull over immediately because the shards were everywhere. It was a really scary moment for me, and I'm just trying to make sense of the accident report forms now. I hope the insurance company can process this quickly so I can get back on the road.

I was waiting at the roundabout entrance when I saw the two cars collide. The driver in the inner lane seemed to lose control slightly on the wet pavement and drifted into the Volvo. The impact was right on the passenger window of the Volvo, which shattered instantly. It was a rainy day and both drivers were moving slowly, but the contact was unavoidable given the sudden movement of the second vehicle.

I was driving down Avenida da Liberdade around 5 PM in heavy traffic. The car in front of me suddenly braked for a pedestrian crossing, and although I tried to brake, I didn't stop in time. I hit the rear of the other vehicle at a very low speed. It was totally my fault, man, I was just a bit distracted by the radio. My bumper has a clear dent and a deep scratch from the impact. I am so worried about the repair costs, you know, being a student and all.

Traffic was stop-and-go as usual near the center of Lisbon. I stopped safely at the pedestrian crossing, but the driver behind me failed to stop. They bumped into the back of my Golf. I got out and saw a dent on my bumper and some paint scratches. The other driver was very apologetic and admitted they were distracted.

Navigating the Rotunda da Boavista in Porto is always chaotic, but today was worse than usual with the rain. I was changing lanes to exit toward the bridge when I misjudged the proximity of the van next to me. I heard a scraping sound immediately. When I pulled over, I saw a long scratch along the side of my car. I feel terrible about the accident; I have been driving for years and never hit anyone before, it's just such a stressful situation for me.

I was parking near the market on Avenida Luísa Todi this morning. It was quite busy with people shopping. As I was reversing into the spot, I didn't see the concrete post hidden by a trash bin. I backed into it slowly, but I still managed to put a significant dent in my rear quarter panel. I was quite embarrassed as people were watching. I am just hoping the insurance covers the repairs because I really need the car for my daily commute to work.

I was walking by the market and saw the small Fiat backing into the parking space. The driver seemed to be checking their mirrors but clearly missed the concrete post partially obscured by the waste container. The car hit the post at a low speed, resulting in a visible dent on the rear panel. It was clearly an honest mistake.

I was pulling out of a very tight parking spot on Rua de Santa Catarina. The street is extremely narrow, and I must have miscalculated the turn while exiting. I grazed the side of the car parked in front of mine. It left a long, visible scratch along my front fender. I feel quite bad about damaging the other vehicle, even though it’s just a superficial mark. I’ve already left my contact details under their wiper blade to ensure everything is handled properly.

It was raining heavily on Avenida 24 de Julho, and visibility was quite poor. The taxi in front of me slammed on their brakes, and I couldn't stop in time on the slick road. I hit the back of his taxi. My front bumper has a noticeable dent and my right lamp is broken from the impact. I've been driving for years and I usually pride myself on my reaction times, but today I was just unable to avoid it. I am very sorry for the inconvenience.

Traffic stopped abruptly due to a cyclist on the road. The BMW behind me clearly couldn't handle the wet surface and rear-ended my taxi. My bumper is fine, but the BMW has a broken lamp and a dent on their hood. We exchanged insurance info and both agreed the weather was the main factor.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista when a bus pulled out from the stop suddenly. I tried to maneuver to the left to give him space, but I ended up getting too close to the parked cars on the side of the road. I scraped the rear wing of a parked sedan. It’s just a scratch, but I feel terrible about it. The bus driver didn't even notice what happened, so I had to stop and take responsibility for the damage I caused.

I saw the whole thing from the cafe terrace. The bus pulled out, forcing the Audi to swerve. The Audi driver couldn't avoid the parked car and caused a scratch on its body. It was clearly a forced maneuver by the bus, not the Audi driver's fault, though they stopped to take care of the damage.

I was crossing the intersection at Estrada de Benfica during the afternoon rush. Another driver was turning, and we both moved into the same space simultaneously. It was a low-speed impact, but my front left side now has a dent and the turn signal lamp is broken. I am so worried about the costs, man. I am a young driver and I really need this car to get to university every day. I hope everything is sorted out quickly without too much stress.

We both misjudged the intersection timing while turning. It was a minor collision at very low speed. My car sustained minimal damage, but the other driver's front lamp is broken and there is a dent on the bumper. We both were confused as to who had the right of way in the moment.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 9:00 AM heading to my office. The traffic was quite heavy as usual, and when the car in front of me suddenly braked hard, I didn't have enough time to react fully despite driving slowly. I managed to slow down, but my front bumper tapped their rear bumper. It was a low-speed impact, but now I can clearly see a visible dent on the hood and some surface scratches where we made contact. I feel terrible about this, I just hope the repair process isn't too complicated.

I was stopped in the queue when I suddenly felt a nudge from behind. I checked my mirror and realized the driver behind me had misjudged the distance during the stop-and-go traffic. We pulled over immediately to exchange details. There is a clear dent on my bumper and a few noticeable scratches on the paintwork.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, intending to take the third exit. As I was moving from the inner lane to the outer lane, I misjudged the position of the van next to me. It was a rainy Tuesday and visibility was poor, man, I'm really stressed because this is my first accident. I felt a crunch and when I checked, my front right lamp was broken. It was honestly just a silly mistake on my part while trying to merge safely in the busy city traffic.

I was attempting to reverse into a tight parallel parking space near the university. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I must have miscalculated the angle of the curb and the position of the parked car behind me. I heard a scraping sound and stopped immediately. Upon inspection, there are clear white scratches along the side of my rear quarter panel. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident, honestly, as I have been driving for years and pride myself on being careful, but this parking spot was just incredibly narrow.

I was driving along the EN125 towards Faro when I decided to shift into the right lane to prepare for my turn. I looked in my mirror, but I clearly missed the other vehicle moving up in my blind spot. I steered into the lane and felt a jolt as we sideswiped each other at about 40 km/h. There is a dent and several deep scratches along my passenger door. I am really worried about how much this is going to cost to fix, and I just feel completely responsible for this lapse in attention.

I was proceeding straight in the right lane on the EN125 when the car next to me suddenly veered into my lane without signaling. I slammed on the brakes but we still made contact on the side. I have a dent and deep scratches on my front driver-side panel as a result.

I was driving down the narrow Rua de Santa Catarina to drop off some shopping bags. A delivery truck was backing out of a side street and didn't see me coming. I tried to sound my horn, but it happened too fast. The edge of their heavy loading gate hit my side window, causing the glass to shatter completely. I am shaken up, just an old lady out on a Tuesday afternoon trying to run errands, and now this happens. It's just such a mess, glass everywhere on the passenger seat and the door frame.

I was approaching the intersection on Avenida Luísa Todi. The light had just turned yellow, and I made a quick decision to proceed, but the driver coming from the cross street was also trying to clear the intersection. We hit at a low speed. My front bumper has a significant dent and the headlight assembly is completely destroyed, with the lamp broken. It's a professional matter, I need the car for my daily visits, so I hope the insurance assessment can be processed promptly. I have documentation from the scene as well.

I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing nearby. I saw the Citroën try to beat the light at the same time the other car was crossing. It was a low-speed impact, but I clearly heard the sound of plastic breaking and saw the headlight glass shatter on the ground.

Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it often is during the morning commute. I was following the car in front at a distance of about 5 meters, doing maybe 20 km/h, when they braked abruptly for a stalled vehicle further ahead. I slammed on my brakes, but I just couldn't stop in time. The impact caused a noticeable dent on my hood. It's very frustrating because it was just a minor slip in focus, and I've been driving for years without a single incident like this until now.

I was trying to park on Rua da Prata. The street is quite busy with tourists and pedestrians, which made me quite nervous. I was reversing slowly when I didn't see the metal bollard on the edge of the sidewalk. I heard a nasty scraping noise against the passenger door. I checked and there are deep scratches along the side. Man, I feel so stupid. I just wanted to get a quick coffee and now I have to deal with this whole insurance claim process. It's just really discouraging, you know?

I was driving North on Avenida da Liberdade at a moderate speed. A vehicle in the left lane attempted to make a right turn without checking his blind spot effectively. We sideswiped, causing damage to my driver-side door. There is a large dent and a long scratch where our paints rubbed together. I am quite shaken as the traffic here in Braga can get very aggressive during the rush hour. I am just trying to be factual here so that the insurance can settle this correctly and efficiently.

I was in the middle lane and moved to the right, failing to notice the driver alongside me. It was a momentary lapse in judgment. I take full responsibility for the collision. The side of his vehicle has a dent and some scratches from my rear bumper area.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I was circling the roundabout when another vehicle entered too quickly from the side and clipped my front corner. The impact broke my front left lamp and there is also a visible crack in the plastic bumper housing. I have been driving for over forty years, and while I try to be as careful as possible, these things can happen even to the best of us in such congested city centers. I am quite worried about the repair costs, but I have already taken photos of the damage for the insurance records.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM. The traffic on Avenida da Boavista was really heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front of me braked suddenly, but the driver behind me, who I think was distracted by his phone, didn't react in time. He hit my rear bumper quite hard, causing a noticeable dent. I am honestly quite shaken up because I have never been in an accident before and I am worried about the cost of repairs for my car.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the right lane to exit towards the airport, and there was a delivery van in the inner lane. As I moved to exit, the van tried to cut across to the same exit, and his side mirror grazed my rear door. It left a long scratch on the paint. I stopped immediately, and the driver was very apologetic, admitting he just didn't see me in his blind spot.

I admit fault in this situation. I was in the middle of the roundabout and intended to exit, but I miscalculated the positioning of the Peugeot beside me. My van made contact with his side, resulting in a scratch on his bodywork. We exchanged information immediately.

It was raining heavily on Avenida 24 de Julho. I was maintaining about 40 km/h in the right lane. A car tried to change lanes without signaling and clipped my front right side. The impact smashed my signal lamp and left a nasty scratch down the passenger side door. It happened so fast that I barely had time to brake. I'm really stressed about this, as I rely on this car to pick up my children from school every afternoon.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when I saw the silver Nissan driving correctly. The other driver changed lanes way too quickly given the slick conditions. The collision broke the lamp on the Nissan and caused visible scratches. It was clearly the fault of the car that merged into the lane.

I was pulling out of a parallel parking spot on Avenida dos Aliados. I checked my mirrors, but as I started to move into the lane, a delivery motorcycle sped past and I clipped him with my front fender. He fell over, but thankfully he wasn't hurt. My car has a small dent on the wheel arch from the contact. I feel terrible about it, honestly, I should have double-checked my blind spot one more time before moving.

I was driving down the lane when the Fiat pulled out. I think the driver didn't see me because of the other parked vehicles. I swerved but couldn't avoid the contact. The Fiat hit my leg guard, causing a dent to her fender. I am fine, just a bit shaken.

The traffic was moving at about 30 km/h on Avenida da República. I stopped at a pedestrian crossing because someone was waiting to cross. The car behind me hit the back of my vehicle with significant force. The impact pushed me forward slightly, and my rear window suffered glass shatter, along with a massive dent on the trunk lid. It was very loud and scary. I hope the repair process goes smoothly as I need the car back by next week for a business trip.

I am terribly sorry for the accident. I was looking at my GPS for a split second and didn't notice the Audi in front of me had come to a complete stop for the pedestrians. I hit him quite hard, causing damage to his trunk and rear glass. I accept full responsibility for the collision.

I was cruising along the Estrada Marginal enjoying the sea view. A car was merging onto the road from a side street and he didn't check his speed. He merged way too quickly, clipping the side of my car. It left a long, ugly scratch along the driver's side door. It's frustrating because the car is fairly new. I spoke to the other driver, and he was quite apologetic, acknowledging he didn't estimate the speed of the traffic on the main road correctly.

I was walking my dog on the nearby path and saw the whole thing. The Tesla was driving steady at the speed limit. The other vehicle entered the main road without looking and swiped the side of the Tesla. The impact clearly left a scratch on the side of the Tesla. The other driver should have waited for a clear gap in traffic.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving slowly, maybe 15 km/h, when the car in front of me braked suddenly to avoid a cyclist. I tried to press the brake pedal immediately, but I just couldn't stop in time. I hit the rear of the other vehicle with my bumper. I felt really bad because it was my fault, and now there is a noticeable dent on my hood from the impact.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, and honestly, it was so confusing with all the construction work going on today. I was in the outer lane trying to exit toward the highway when a van suddenly cut into my lane from the inside. I tried to steer away, but we ended up side-swiping each other at a very low speed. It was just a minor scratch on my passenger door, but I am still pretty shaken up by how quickly it all happened.

I was driving in the middle lane of the roundabout and needed to exit. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the Peugeot was in my blind spot because I didn't see them before I started moving over. We made light contact, resulting in a scratch on their side panel. It was an honest mistake on my part, and I've already apologized to the other driver.

I was trying to parallel park in front of a cafe on Rua da Rainha this morning. I thought I had plenty of space, but I misjudged the distance to the concrete bollard on the sidewalk. As I turned the wheel to reverse, I heard a horrible scraping noise. When I got out to look, I saw a dent and a deep scratch on my rear bumper. I feel so embarrassed about it, as I've been driving for years and have never done anything this clumsy before.

It was pouring rain this afternoon, and the visibility near the waterfront was really poor. I approached the intersection and thought the light was still yellow, but it turned red just as I entered. Another car was already moving through, and I clipped their rear corner. My front lamp is broken and there is glass shatter all over the road from my headlight casing. I am so worried about the repair costs, this is just not my day, man.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the collision. The weather was truly terrible, very heavy rain. The driver in the Renault clearly misjudged the intersection timing, and the impact caused their headlight to shatter. I stayed to make sure everyone was okay and confirmed that the Renault's lamp was indeed broken during the impact.

I was driving along the main tourist area in Funchal when I decided to change lanes to get into the correct lane for the exit. I turned on my indicator and checked my side mirrors, but I suppose the other driver accelerated just as I started to move over. We ended up rubbing fenders at about 30 km/h. There is a visible scratch along my driver-side rear fender. I truly believed the lane was clear when I checked, but the timing was just unfortunate.

I was pulling out of a very narrow parking spot on Rua de Cedofeita. The streets in this part of Porto are so tight, and I was trying to be extra careful. I guess I didn't see the post hidden behind a delivery truck. I backed into it at a very low speed. It caused a dent on the rear hatch and my taillamp is broken. My grandson usually tells me to be more careful with these narrow streets, and I suppose he was right this time.

I was driving down Avenida Luísa Todi on my way to the market. The traffic was stop-and-go because of the roadworks. I was looking at the traffic light ahead and didn't notice that the driver in front had stopped completely. I tapped their bumper. It was a very minor impact, but there is a clear dent on my front bumper now. I am quite annoyed with myself for being distracted by the lights, but thankfully nobody was hurt in the process.

I was completely stopped in traffic. I felt a sudden bump from behind. It was not a violent impact, but it was enough to leave a small dent on the Seat's bumper. I checked my own vehicle and luckily there was no significant damage. We both exchanged insurance details calmly and left the road clear for others.

Driving through Coimbra is always a bit stressful with all the hills and the constant start-stop traffic. I was coming down a steep street and the car ahead stalled. I hit them from behind at about 20 km/h. My front lamp is broken and there is a noticeable dent on my front panel. It was a genuine accident caused by the steep incline and the unexpected stop of the vehicle ahead. I am very sorry for the trouble caused to the other driver.

I was driving up the hill when my engine stalled unexpectedly. Before I could restart it, the car behind me hit my rear. The impact broke their headlight. It was a purely accidental situation given the difficult conditions on that street. We exchanged information, and I am currently waiting for my own vehicle assessment.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to hit my brakes, but I was just a bit too late and tapped the back of his bumper. It was totally my fault, I was a bit distracted by the radio. I can see a visible dent on the rear bumper of my car, and it's quite worrying because I need my car for work tomorrow.

I was driving steadily toward the city center when traffic came to a sudden halt. I stopped safely, but moments later I felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me admitted he was distracted and apologized immediately. My rear bumper sustained a clear dent from the impact.

I feel absolutely terrible about this, man. I was just trying to squeeze into this really tight parking spot near Rua Augusta, you know? It’s super busy here today and I was trying to be quick so I wouldn't block traffic behind me. I misjudged the angle while reversing and scraped the side of the car parked next to me. There is a long scratch on my passenger door now. I’m just so stressed about how much this is going to cost to fix, honestly, I didn't mean for this to happen.

I was navigating the roundabout, and honestly, the traffic was moving quite fast. I signaled to change lanes to exit towards the center of Porto, but I think I didn't check my blind spot well enough. I heard a loud noise and realized I had clipped another vehicle. My front lamp is broken, and there is a deep scratch along the side panel. It happened so fast, and I'm really shaken up by the whole experience. I just hope the other driver is okay, this has never happened to me before.

I was walking near the roundabout and saw the Peugeot attempt to switch lanes abruptly. The driver of the other vehicle didn't have enough time to react. I saw the Peugeot's lamp shatter upon contact with the side of the other car. It was clearly an unfortunate driving error due to lack of visibility.

I was driving along Avenida 24 de Julho this morning in the right lane. A delivery van suddenly pulled out from the side without checking, and to avoid hitting him head-on, I swerved slightly to the left. In doing so, I sideswiped a car that was cruising in the next lane. There is a long, ugly scratch across my driver's side door now. I’m quite frustrated, as it was a reaction to the van, but I acknowledge I made contact with the other vehicle. It’s all very stressful.

It was a lovely afternoon, I was running some errands for my granddaughter, picking up a few items from the pharmacy. As I entered the intersection at Avenida dos Aliados, the traffic lights seemed to have switched, and I suppose I moved forward too quickly. Another vehicle entered from the cross street, and we collided. My front bumper has a noticeable dent and my headlight lamp is broken. I feel quite embarrassed as I have been driving for forty years without an incident. It was just a simple lapse in my concentration.

I had the green light at the intersection. The other driver entered the junction while I was passing through, leading to the collision. My car sustained damage to the front corner, including a broken lamp and a dent in the fender. I am relieved that nobody was physically hurt.

I was parking at the Alameda shopping center, it was extremely packed as it’s Saturday. I thought I had cleared the concrete pillar, but clearly I hadn't. I heard a scraping sound and then a thud. When I got out, I saw a dent and a long scratch on the rear quarter panel of my car. I’m so annoyed with myself for being so clumsy. I really should have had my partner guide me into the space, as it was quite a tight turn.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving towards Saldanha in heavy morning traffic. I signaled to switch to the center lane to avoid a parked bus, but I miscalculated the speed of the car in that lane. We made contact, resulting in a scratch along the passenger side of my vehicle. I stopped immediately and we both pulled over to exchange details. I am a very careful driver, but this morning I was definitely rushing because I was late for a meeting, which I now realize was a poor decision.

I was maintaining my lane on the main avenue when the driver to my right attempted an unsafe lane change. I could not avoid the contact. The impact resulted in a surface scratch on my vehicle's rear door panel. The driver was cooperative throughout the exchange.

It was raining quite heavily in Porto, and the visibility was poor. I was reversing out of a narrow side street onto Rua de Santa Catarina. I didn't see the delivery truck passing by because of the rain on my mirrors. My side mirror hit his side mirror, and the glass shattered completely. It was just a low-speed impact, but the sound was quite alarming. I feel terrible, but I genuinely didn't see him coming in the gray conditions. It’s been a really difficult day with this weather.

I was cruising down Avenida da República and keeping a decent distance. Suddenly, the car in front slammed on their brakes for no apparent reason. My vehicle’s sensors warned me, and I did what I could, but the road was a bit slick, so I couldn't stop in time. I hit them, causing a dent in my hood and a broken lamp. I'm just so disappointed because I try to maintain my car in perfect condition. It’s just one of those things that happens in city traffic.

I was driving at a normal speed when I had to stop for a cyclist who crossed the street suddenly. The driver behind me hit my vehicle. The impact was enough to break one of my rear lamps and leave a dent in my bumper.

I was heading home to Cascais along the coastal road. It was quite a beautiful day, honestly, but then this bike lane situation caught me off guard near the turn. I moved over slightly to allow a cyclist more room, and I accidentally scraped the concrete divider on the side of the road. There is a long, deep scratch on the side panel of the car. I’m just glad I didn't hit anyone else, but the car is definitely damaged. I have already contacted the dealership to see how soon they can look at it.

I was driving home after work around 18:30. Traffic was quite heavy on the Avenida da Boavista. I came to a full stop because the car in front of me halted abruptly due to a cyclist crossing the street. Unfortunately, the driver behind me didn't react in time and hit the rear of my Golf. It was a low-speed impact, but I can see a visible dent on my bumper. I am honestly quite shaken up by this; it happened so fast, and I really do not know what to do about the repairs.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the middle lane when a van suddenly cut across from the inner lane toward the exit. I tried to brake, but there was a light scrape between our vehicles. I am really worried about how much this is going to cost, you know? It's just a long scratch along my passenger side door, but it looks really obvious. I'm just a student and this is my first car, so I'm pretty stressed about the whole claims process.

I was moving through the roundabout and misjudged the distance while merging into the exit lane. I realized too late that the Seat Ibiza was still beside me. My rear panel made contact with their door. It was a momentary lapse in judgment on my part.

It was such a rainy afternoon, and I was trying to park in a tight spot near the university. My vision was obscured by the heavy downpour on the windshield. I miscalculated the turning radius and nudged the vehicle parked ahead of me. Upon inspection, I noticed a dent and a scratch on the corner of my bumper. I feel terrible about damaging someone else's car, as I have always been very careful when parking. I have already left my contact details on their dashboard, just as one should.

I was driving along the Avenida Luísa Todi in the right lane, maintaining about 40 km/h. A car to my left signaled and started moving into my lane without checking their blind spot. I hit my brakes, but their rear wheel struck my front light, which is now broken. I am so upset because I was headed to my daughter's graduation. It is just a broken lamp, but the whole situation has left me quite rattled and confused about the next steps to take for the insurance.

I intended to change lanes to reach the upcoming turn-off. I checked my mirror, but I clearly didn't notice the Yaris already being there. My bumper clipped the front of their car, and I heard the sound of plastic breaking. I take full responsibility for the error.

Traffic on the bridge was crawling at maybe 20 km/h due to the high volume of commuters. The driver behind me was clearly distracted and did not stop in time when the flow slowed down. The impact was quite strong; it caused a significant dent on my trunk and the rear window suffered a glass shatter from the vibration and force. I was honestly worried for my own safety given the speed of the traffic behind us. Thankfully, nobody was injured, but my car is in a bad state.

I was driving in the lane next to them. I saw the silver BMW slowing down normally with the flow of traffic, but the car behind it didn't slow down at all. The driver of the trailing car seemed to be looking down at their phone just before the impact occurred. It was quite a loud crash.

I was reversing out of a driveway onto the street when I didn't see a bollard partially obscured by a shop display. My bumper made contact with it. It resulted in a crack on the plastic trim. I've lived in this neighborhood for forty years and I know these streets like the back of my hand, but today, with all the commotion from the nearby market, I simply had a momentary lapse in my concentration. It is quite embarrassing to have to file a claim for such a small error.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I had a green light and proceeded through the intersection. Another driver entered from the side street, seemingly failing to notice their red light, and hit the front corner of my vehicle. The impact was right near the headlight, which is now broken, and there is a noticeable dent on the fender. I am incredibly frustrated because my car is brand new. I'm trying to remain calm, but the whole situation feels very unfair given that I followed all the traffic rules perfectly.

I was heading home after a long shift and I genuinely thought the light was still amber when I entered the crossing. I realized my mistake immediately when I saw the Audi. I am so sorry for the damage caused to the front of your vehicle.

I was driving west along the Estrada Monumental when a heavy delivery truck tried to overtake me on a narrow section of the road. I tried to move as close to the sidewalk as I could, but there was nowhere else to go. It was a very tight squeeze, and I'm really worried about the paint job repair costs.

I was delivering goods to a hotel nearby. The road is very narrow and I honestly thought I had cleared the Citroën, but the trailer must have swung a bit too far to the right during the overtake. I apologize for the contact.

It was around midday, and I was stopped at a pedestrian crossing to let someone pass. The person behind me, who I think was looking at their GPS, didn't notice I had stopped. I have taken photos of both cars and exchanged details with the other driver, who was very polite and admitted fault immediately.

I was waiting to cross the road on foot. I saw the Nissan stop properly for the pedestrian. The car behind it didn't brake at all and just drove straight into the back of it. It seemed like the driver was distracted by their dashboard display.

I was navigating the narrow streets of downtown Lisbon. While trying to squeeze into a parallel parking spot, I misjudged the angle and my rear quarter panel grazed the stone wall of a building. I've checked the damage, and it doesn't look like any structural components are affected, just the surface.

I was driving home from work around 6:00 PM in the heavy Porto traffic. The car in front of me suddenly stopped because of a pedestrian crossing. I am so sorry for this, I honestly didn't expect the traffic to halt so abruptly. There is a visible dent and a long scratch on my front bumper where the metal pressed against theirs. I feel really terrible about this whole situation.

When I got out to check, I saw a dent and a large scratch on my rear bumper. The driver behind me was quite shaken up and admitted immediately that he hadn't been able to stop in time due to the slippery road.

I was circling the roundabout, trying to navigate toward the correct exit, when the other driver suddenly attempted a lane change without signaling correctly. I've been driving for years and never had an issue like this; it's really distressing to have my car damaged in such a busy, confusing spot during rush hour.

I was merging to get off the roundabout and I admit I didn't check my side mirror as carefully as I should have. I heard a loud crunching sound as I hit the other car. My car only has a minor mark, but the other driver's front lamp is definitely broken and they have a scratch on the side of their fender. I feel responsible for the confusion.

I was driving along the EN125 towards Faro when a delivery van drifted into my lane while trying to overtake a cyclist. I tried to move as far to the right as possible, but there was no shoulder space. The van sideswiped me, causing a significant dent in my rear quarter panel and a long, ugly scratch that runs all the way to the fuel cap. It was a very close call and I am still shaking a bit from the shock. I really hope the insurance process isn't too complicated to handle.

I was crossing the intersection when the traffic lights changed faster than I anticipated. Another car entered from the side street at a low speed.
