It’s a very modern car, and I’m quite worried about the repair timeline since I rely on it for my daily commute to the office. I was just focused on the flow of traffic and didn't see him coming until the very last second.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the pedestrian crossing light. Both drivers seemed to be driving cautiously, but the light cycle was quite short. They collided at the intersection point. It wasn't a high-speed crash, but the impact caused some clear damage, specifically a broken lamp and glass shatter on the ground. Neither driver seemed to be speeding, just an unfortunate timing error.

It was a busy afternoon and I was trying to pull out of a very narrow space on Rua de Santa Catarina. I was so worried about not hitting the car behind me that I miscalculated the angle of my front bumper. I brushed against a bollard on the edge of the sidewalk. It wasn't a hard hit, but the paint job on the front corner is ruined with a nasty scratch. Man, I feel so stupid. I just wanted to get home before the evening traffic started building up, you know?

I was enjoying a drive along the coast with my grandkids. As we reached a point near the Estoril Casino, the traffic slowed down significantly because of a sightseeing bus stopping. I tried to slow down gently, but the car behind me didn't react in time. They hit the back of my vehicle. There is a visible dent on the rear trunk lid now. It's a shame, really, as the car was in such perfect condition before today. We weren't hurt, thank goodness, but it has certainly put a damper on our afternoon family outing.

I was distracted by the beautiful view of the ocean and didn't notice the BMW in front of me slowing down. When I looked back at the road, I had no time to stop safely. I bumped into their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it. I caused a dent in their car, but I'm glad nobody was injured during the accident.

I was navigating through the narrow cobblestone streets in the city center. A delivery cyclist swerved suddenly, forcing me to veer toward the side of the road. I hit a stone decorative post. The impact wasn't fast, but it caused a dent in my hood and the headlight assembly is completely ruined with the lamp broken and bits of glass shatter scattered around the front of my vehicle. I'm quite stressed out by the costs involved here. I've lived in this city all my life and driving through these narrow streets is always a challenge, even for experienced drivers.

I was driving down a narrow secondary road in Gaia, returning from a grocery run. A vehicle coming the opposite way was hugging the center line very closely. We both tried to pull over, but there was contact between our side mirrors and the body panels. I noticed a long scratch along my driver-side door. I wasn't speeding at all, as these roads are quite tight. It's frustrating because I maintain my vehicle very meticulously, and seeing it damaged like this is quite upsetting to me.

The road was extremely narrow and I think we both underestimated the clearance. My passenger side brushed against the other car. I stopped as soon as I heard the noise. There is a surface scratch on both our vehicles. It was an honest mistake caused by the road conditions, which aren't really built for two large vehicles to pass each other comfortably.

I was moving from the middle lane to the right lane to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the other car in my blind spot. As I turned, I heard a sharp impact. Their car hit my front corner, causing a dent and breaking my turn signal lamp. I'm honestly so worried about how this will affect my insurance premium, dude. I've been driving this car for three years without a single scratch. This is so stressful and I just want to get it sorted as soon as possible.

I was driving home from work along Avenida da Boavista when traffic suddenly came to a complete standstill near the roundabout. I tried to brake, but the road was damp from the earlier rain, and I unfortunately tapped the back of the car in front of me at very low speed. My front bumper hit their rear bumper, causing a visible dent and some scratches on the plastic trim. I am incredibly worried about the repair costs because I have never been in an accident before, you know? It was just a complete lapse in concentration.

I was stopped in heavy traffic when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't stop in time. When I got out to check, I saw a dent and a long scratch on my rear bumper. We exchanged details immediately and were both very cooperative given the stressful situation.

I was trying to parallel park in a very tight spot near the center. I misjudged the distance to the car parked behind me while reversing at maybe 3 or 4 km/h. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed the side of the other vehicle with my rear panel. There is a noticeable scratch on their door now. I feel terrible about the whole situation as it was entirely my fault. I stayed until the other driver returned to the car so we could settle the insurance paperwork properly.

I was navigating the roundabout, moving from the inner lane to the outer lane to take my exit. I must have miscalculated the blind spot because I didn't see the van coming alongside me. We made contact, and it resulted in a dent on my passenger door and some scratches along the side panel. It was such a frantic morning, man, and I honestly just didn't see him there. I hope the repair process isn't too complicated because I need the car for my daily commute to the university.

I was driving through the roundabout when the other car pulled into my lane without checking. I tried to swerve, but there was a significant impact on my side. I can see a deep dent and several scratches on the driver's side of my van. We both pulled over to the side immediately.

It was a busy afternoon with lots of tourists on the road. I signaled to move into the left lane, and I thought the car behind me was slowing down to let me in. Unfortunately, he accelerated slightly, and the front of my car grazed his rear quarter panel. It caused a long, visible scratch across the paintwork. I have always been a very careful driver, so I am quite disappointed with myself for making such an error in judgment while navigating the traffic flow here.

I was walking along the sidewalk and saw the Opel Corsa try to change lanes. The other driver didn't seem to notice the signal or perhaps didn't want to yield. There was a loud scraping noise when the two vehicles touched. I saw a clear scratch on the body of the car.

I was distracted for a split second by the GPS on my phone, and when I looked up, the traffic in front had stopped. I slammed on the brakes, but I still rear-ended the SUV in front of me. The impact was quite hard, and I can see a deep dent on my hood and my headlight glass shattered upon impact. I feel so embarrassed and anxious about this. I know I shouldn't have been looking at the screen, and I am worried about the insurance premiums going up because of this.

I was backing out of a narrow side street onto the main road. The visibility was poor due to the parked delivery vans. I didn't see the cyclist crossing, but luckily I only made a very slight impact with the bumper of a stationary car behind me. It left a small, localized dent on the bumper. I have been driving this route for years, and it is just a very difficult corner to maneuver around. I have provided my details to the owner of the parked car immediately.

My car was parked legally on the side of the road. When I returned, I noticed a fresh dent on my rear bumper. The driver of the Fiat was still there and admitted to hitting it while reversing. We documented everything right there on the street.

I was stopping at a pedestrian crossing because someone was waiting to cross the street. The driver behind me didn't notice I had stopped and bumped into me. The collision was not too fast, but it broke my tail lamp and caused a scratch and a small dent on the rear hatch. I have been a driver for forty years and honestly, these city streets have become so chaotic lately. It is just a real nuisance to deal with all this paperwork, but the other driver was very polite.

I was driving in the right lane when a vehicle tried to merge into my lane without leaving enough space. I tried to move toward the center line to avoid them, but we ended up rubbing sides. There is a long scratch running along the length of my passenger side doors. Dude, it happened so fast I didn't even have time to react properly. I'm just lucky neither of us lost control of the cars because there were other people around on the street at the time.

I thought I had enough room to move into the lane. It seems I misjudged the distance between our vehicles. There is a surface scratch on my door panel. We pulled over safely and agreed to fill out the amicable accident report forms.

statements.text: Traffic was crawling along at about 20 km/h. The vehicle ahead of me braked suddenly to avoid a scooter that cut them off. I hit my brakes hard, but the road was a bit slick, and I slid forward just enough to hit their rear bumper. It resulted in a visible dent on my front bumper. I am really stressed out about this because I am late for an important meeting, and now I have to wait for the police report to be finalized.

I was waiting at the bus stop nearby and saw the whole thing. A scooter darted in front of the line of cars, causing a chain reaction. The Mini driver didn't have much time to stop and bumped the car in front. I saw a dent on the Mini's bumper.

I was driving home after work along Avenida da Boavista, and the traffic was quite heavy as it was around 6 PM. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I feel terrible about it, honestly, I was really trying to be careful, but it happened so fast, and now there is a noticeable dent on my bumper.

I moved to the middle lane to take the exit towards the highway, but the other driver decided to keep going around the roundabout. We made contact, and it caused a nasty scratch and a dent on my passenger door. I am really stressed out about how the insurance process works, as this is my first accident since I got my license, you know?

I was already inside the roundabout, maintaining my lane to head towards the terminal. The insured driver simply cut into my path without checking his mirrors properly. There wasn't much I could do to avoid the collision at that point. It resulted in minor bodywork damage to the side of his car.

statements.text: It was a busy afternoon near the square, and I was trying to merge into the right lane to turn. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the other vehicle was in my blind spot. I was walking past the parking zone and saw the whole thing. The driver was trying to maneuver into a space and clearly misjudged the distance to the concrete bollard on the corner. It was a low-speed impact, but the sound was quite distinct. It left some visible damage on the front bumper area.

I'm just shaken up by the noise of the impact and thankful that neither of us was moving particularly fast when it happened.

The light changed quite quickly from green to yellow. The lady in front of me slammed on her brakes very abruptly. I was following at a safe distance but not enough to account for such a sudden stop on this dry pavement. My front bumper hit her rear corner.

I was pulling out slowly from the loading zone. I checked my mirrors, but the Mini was moving quite fast and was in my blind spot. I heard a scrape and saw that we had grazed each other along the side. It was just a minor contact, really.

I stopped perfectly normally for a pedestrian crossing the road. Suddenly, I felt a hard jolt from behind. The gentleman in the Ford behind me clearly didn't see me stop. His lamp housing is broken and he has a dent where he struck my bumper.

I was proceeding north on the avenue, keeping at a steady speed of about 40 km/h. A vehicle to my right decided to merge into my lane without checking if I was there. I was moving into the left lane to prepare for a turn at the next junction. I didn't see the BMW already in that lane. We sideswiped, leaving a scratch and a small dent on his fender. I apologize for the error.

I was maintaining my speed in the right lane when the Ford suddenly changed lanes into my path. I couldn't avoid him and we side-swiped. It resulted in minor bodywork scratches. The driver of the Ford admitted immediately that he hadn't seen me. It was a straightforward traffic incident.

I hit it at a very low speed. It resulted in a dent to the rear panel and my brake lamp is broken. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole situation. It's a small car, but I really should have been more careful with my surroundings in such tight spaces.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: Navigating the Marquês de Pombal roundabout is always intense with so many lanes. I was in the middle lane when the bus on my right moved left unexpectedly. I tried to avoid it, but there was nowhere to go. We made contact, which left a dent and a long scratch along my side. I am just glad it wasn't a more serious accident, but the bodywork damage is definitely visible. I have already contacted my insurer to get the repair estimate underway.

I was pulling away from the bus stop area and preparing to shift lanes within the roundabout. I didn't see the Nissan in my side mirror until it was too late. I clipped the side of his vehicle, resulting in a scratch and a dent on his passenger door. I've reported the incident to my company and have provided my details to the driver of the SUV.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was stopped at a red light on Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa when I was suddenly hit from behind. The impact was quite strong, enough to shatter my rear glass and create a large dent in the tailgate. I am still feeling a bit shaken because it was such a sudden jolt while I was stationary. The other driver was very polite and admitted that he was distracted by his mobile phone for a split second, which led to the collision.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk nearby. I clearly saw the Volvo stopped at the red light. The driver behind him clearly wasn't looking at the road and drove straight into the back of him without braking. The sound of the glass shattering was quite sharp. I stayed to confirm to both drivers that the Volvo was indeed stopped at the red light when the collision happened.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM heading towards the city center. The traffic was quite heavy because everyone was finishing work. Suddenly, the car in front of me stopped abruptly for a pedestrian. I hit the brakes as hard as I could, but I still slid and tapped their rear bumper. It was a low-speed impact, but now I have a noticeable dent and a scratch on my front bumper. I feel so stressed about the repair costs, honestly, I just don't know how I'm going to manage all this paperwork.

I was stopped in traffic on Avenida da Boavista when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't brake in time and bumped into my rear. There is a small dent and a few scratches on my bumper now. We exchanged details immediately and everything was very calm.

I was trying to parallel park near Praça do Comércio on a very tight spot. I misjudged the distance while reversing and scraped against the side of the car already parked there. It was entirely my fault, and I feel terrible about it. I was trying to be careful, but the street was so crowded and I just got confused with the mirrors. There is a visible scratch on the rear passenger door of the other vehicle. I have already contacted the owner to sort out the insurance details.

Coming around the Rotunda da Boavista, I tried to exit toward Avenida da França. A car coming from the inner lane moved out unexpectedly. I didn't have enough room to maneuver and ended up brushing against their side. It happened so fast, and now I have a broken lamp and a deep scratch on my side panel. I am really worried because this is my main car for work and I need to get it fixed quickly. It was a messy situation, but we both stopped right away to check.

I was exiting the roundabout and thought the lane was clear, but the Renault appeared in my blind spot. We made contact at low speed. My car has a scratch and a broken lamp on the side. We have filled out the accident report correctly.

I was driving along Avenida Luísa Todi this morning, thinking about the grocery list for my wife's birthday party later. It was a beautiful, clear day by the river. As I signaled to change lanes to turn right, I didn't see the van in the lane beside me. I pulled in and we made contact. It caused a dent on the side panel of the other vehicle. I am so embarrassed; I have been driving for forty years and haven't had a mishap like this in a very long time.

I was navigating the very narrow Rua de Santa Catarina. A delivery truck was parked with its door slightly open, and as I tried to pass, my mirror hit the edge of the door. The impact caused the mirror's glass to shatter completely. I am just so anxious about how much a replacement mirror for this model will cost. It was such a silly, small mistake on my part, man. I was just trying to get around the truck because the street was getting blocked, and I totally misjudged the clearance.

I was walking down Rua de Santa Catarina and saw the whole thing. The Fiat tried to pass the delivery truck slowly, but the driver clipped the edge of the open truck door. The mirror glass shattered on the ground immediately. The driver stopped and looked very upset.

I was driving down the main avenue in Lisbon when the traffic suddenly stopped due to a taxi pulling over. The impact resulted in a dent on my bumper and a lamp broken. It was a loud thud, but nobody was hurt. I am quite worried about the insurance premiums going up after this. It's just such a hassle to deal with this.

I had to brake suddenly because of a taxi. The Toyota behind me couldn't stop and hit my rear. There is a dent on my bumper and my tail light is broken. The driver of the Toyota was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the process.

I was driving along the beautiful coastline on Avenida Marginal, enjoying the view of the Atlantic. The road was wet from a brief morning shower. This is a very stressful day. I have been very careful, but the road surface just seemed slippery today. I hope the paint damage isn't too expensive to repair.

I was turning off the roundabout and missed the Nissan in the lane next to me. We clipped each other during the turn. My side lamp is broken. I spoke with the other driver and we agreed to document the incident for our insurers.

I was traveling around the roundabout and the SUV just merged into my lane too aggressively. I tried to brake, but they had already hit my side. My paint has a long scratch, and their signal lamp was broken in the process. It's a shame, but it happens in this busy part of Lisbon.

I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música, trying to exit towards Avenida da Boavista. The traffic was quite heavy as it was around 6:00 PM. I was circulating in the outer lane of the Rotunda da Boavista when the Peugeot tried to cut across to take the exit. I didn't see him in time to move out of the way. The impact broke my side lamp and caused a dent on my rear passenger door. It happened very quickly during the morning commute.

I was driving along the Avenida 24 de Julho heading towards Cais do Sodré. The traffic was moving at about 40 km/h. I signaled to change lanes to the left to prepare for a turn, and I checked my mirrors, but I simply didn't see the van in my blind spot. As I began the maneuver, we made contact. It caused a long scratch and a shallow dent along the side of my car. I feel awful because the other driver was clearly visible, but I just had a momentary lapse of concentration.

Back in my day, people drove more carefully, but these streets in Porto are getting busier every year. I was reversing out of a small street onto the main road, checking both ways, but I didn't notice the low bollard behind me until it was too late. I was going very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but the bumper hit the post directly. It didn't dent the metal, but it did cause a nasty crack in the plastic bumper housing. My grandson usually drives this car, but I had to take it for a quick errand today.

I was walking my dog on Rua de Cedofeita when I saw the Citroën reversing. The driver seemed a bit unsure and backed into the stone bollard near the corner. It was a low-speed hit, but I heard a loud noise when the plastic bumper cracked. The driver stopped immediately and looked quite concerned about the damage to the vehicle.

I was driving down Avenida da República during the evening rush. The driver in front of me suddenly hit their brakes because of a cyclist crossing the street. I didn't have enough distance to react and ended up colliding with their rear end. I feel really bad, man. My front bumper took most of the impact, resulting in a dent and a broken lamp on the driver's side. It's my first accident, so I'm honestly quite shaken up and just want to get this sorted as quickly as possible.

It was a busy afternoon near the square, and finding parking is always a nightmare. I found a spot, but as I was trying to pull in, I misjudged the angle against the car already parked there. I scraped my side against their rear door. It was a total accident, just me being clumsy with the steering wheel. There is a visible scratch running along my passenger door now. I left a note on the other car's windshield because the owner wasn't there, and then I called you folks right away.

I was moving through the narrow lane on Rua de Santa Catarina. The street is quite tight for two cars to pass. A delivery truck was coming in the opposite direction and didn't leave enough room for me to pass safely. We scraped sides as we passed. My mirror hit his side, which led to a dent, a deep scratch, and unfortunately, my wing mirror glass shattered onto the pavement. I was driving slowly, but it was just impossible to avoid contact in such a tight space with that truck.

The street was very crowded and I was trying to stick as close to the side as possible. The Audi driver didn't slow down enough for the narrow section. Our sides made contact, causing some denting and scratching on his side, and I saw his side mirror glass shatter. I stopped immediately to check the situation.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I had a green light at the intersection, but as I entered, a car coming from the cross-street didn't stop in time. I tried to steer away but it was too late. We hit on the corner of the intersection. My front right side has a dent and the turn signal lamp is broken. It was a very confusing experience because I was sure I had the right of way. I'm just thankful that nobody was hurt, though I'm really anxious about the insurance claim process.

I was sitting in traffic on Avenida da Liberdade this morning, listening to the radio and waiting for the lights to change. I looked away for a second to adjust my seat, and when I looked back, the car in front had stopped abruptly. I hit the brakes, but I still tapped their rear bumper. There is a small dent on my hood from where I made contact. I feel quite foolish for the lapse in attention. I immediately exchanged details with the other driver, who was very understanding about the whole incident.

I was waiting for the traffic light to turn green. I felt a bump from behind, and when I checked, it was the Mercedes driver who had hit me. There was a slight dent on my rear bumper. We both got out and exchanged insurance information immediately. It was a genuine accident caused by a moment of inattention.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was trailing a small hatchback, and when the driver ahead braked suddenly to avoid a cyclist, I misjudged the distance. I pressed the brakes as hard as I could, but my car still slid forward and bumped into his rear bumper. I feel terrible about it; it was just a moment of distraction, and now there is a visible dent on my front bumper.

I was stopped safely in the traffic lane when I suddenly felt a significant jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror just before the impact and saw the gentleman behind me failing to stop in time. My rear bumper definitely took a hit, and I am quite shaken by the sudden noise and vibration.

location: Roundabout at Praça de Espanha, Lisbon

statements.text: Man, I am honestly so stressed out right now. I was navigating the busy roundabout near Praça de Espanha, trying to get to the exit for the highway. I think I drifted just a little bit too far to the left while checking my mirrors, and I accidentally scraped the side of a van that was also circulating. I feel like such an idiot, I really didn't see him there in my blind spot. There is a long scratch running along my passenger door now. I hope this doesn't cost a fortune to fix.

I was trying to park my car in a very tight spot near Rua Augusta this morning. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was maneuvering to straighten the vehicle, I miscalculated the angle and hit the concrete pillar of the parking garage wall. I heard a loud crunch and realized I had done some damage to the rear fender. There is a noticeable dent and several deep scratches on the side panel. It was entirely my fault, and I am just hoping the insurance process is straightforward.

I was walking by the parking area when I saw the driver attempting to maneuver the Nissan into the space. The space was quite narrow, and it looked like they underestimated the distance to the pillar. The impact caused visible damage, specifically a dent and scratches on the back area of the car. I stayed to confirm that the driver was alone.

I was driving slowly along Avenida 24 de Julho when the traffic light turned yellow. I slowed down, but the car behind me didn't notice, and he bumped into my rear corner. It wasn't a high-speed accident, but it was loud enough to be scary. My rear tail lamp is completely broken now. I am just a bit shaken up by the whole experience, you know? I really don't like dealing with these things, but I suppose that is what insurance is for, right?

I was traveling along the EN125, heading towards Faro. I needed to change lanes to take the upcoming turn-off, and although I checked my mirror, I must have missed the car in the lane beside me. As I began to merge, I felt a sharp scrape. The driver in the other lane signaled, and we both pulled over immediately. There is a nasty scratch along my driver-side door. I feel quite embarrassed by the oversight, as I pride myself on being a cautious driver.

I was maintaining my lane on the highway when suddenly the Toyota beside me started moving into my space. I honked, but it was too late to avoid the contact. We both pulled over safely. My vehicle has a deep scratch, and I am glad we were driving slowly enough that nobody was hurt, though the car damage is quite unfortunate.

I was picking up my grandson from school in Braga, and as I was reversing out of the parking space, I didn't see the low concrete barrier behind me. I backed up just a little bit too far, and the plastic bumper hit the barrier with a sickening sound. When I got out to check, I saw a large crack running through the lower part of the bumper. It is such a shame because the car was in perfect condition until this afternoon. I should have been much more careful.

I was entering the roundabout at Praça da Batalha around noon. The weather was bright and sunny. Another vehicle tried to exit the roundabout from the inner lane and didn't see me in the outer lane. We collided at a very low speed, causing contact between his front bumper and my rear passenger side. My rear bumper is pushed in with a clear dent, and the indicator lamp is completely broken. It was a very confusing situation with so many cars merging at once, but we exchanged details immediately.

I was navigating the roundabout to take the third exit. I thought the lane was clear, but as I turned, I realized the driver in the other lane was closer than I anticipated. We made contact, resulting in damage to both our vehicles. I have a dent on my bumper and some broken glass from the indicator, and I acknowledge I made a mistake in timing my exit.

I was driving down Rua do Ouro when I had to brake suddenly because a pedestrian stepped onto the crossing. The taxi behind me was following too closely and couldn't stop in time. He hit my rear end, and the force was enough to cause the rear window glass to shatter. It was a stressful experience, especially being in the city center with so much traffic behind us. I am mostly concerned about the glass shards being everywhere. I have already contacted the police to report the incident.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving along the avenue when the car next to me suddenly swerved to avoid a pothole and scraped my driver-side door. I had no room to move over because of the median on my left, so I just had to hit the brakes. It was a quick incident, but there is a long, ugly scratch across the paintwork. I am quite frustrated as I keep my vehicle in excellent condition. The other driver apologized profusely, and we have shared our insurance information to resolve this through official channels.

I reacted instinctively to a large pothole in the road and drifted into the adjacent lane. I didn't see the Audi there, and we sideswiped each other. I take full responsibility for the maneuver. My car has a scratch on the side, and I have already provided my insurance details to the owner of the Audi.

It was pouring rain here in Porto, and I was trying to park outside the stadium. Visibility was very poor, and I misjudged the distance to the vehicle parked in front of me. I bumped into his rear bumper at very low speed. My car sustained a small dent on the hood from the contact. I feel quite foolish, as I usually park with much more care, but the weather really made things difficult today. I have left a note with my contact details on the other vehicle since the owner wasn't present.

I was observing from a nearby café. The rain was very heavy, and the driver of the Skoda was struggling to park. I saw the vehicle hit the car in front quite slowly, causing a visible dent on the bumper. The driver immediately got out, inspected the damage, and left a note on the windshield of the other car before waiting for the owner.

I was driving towards the city center during the morning rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy, and the car in front of me suddenly stopped for a pedestrian crossing. I tried to brake, but I wasn't quick enough, and I hit the back of the other vehicle at maybe 10 km/h. It was really stressful, man, I'm just so worried about how this is going to affect my insurance premiums. My hood has a noticeable dent and some deep scratches near the front grille now. It was completely my fault, I just didn't react in time.

I had come to a complete stop at the zebra crossing on Avenida da Boavista when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. It was a low-speed impact, but it was enough to cause visible damage to my rear bumper. The other driver was quite shaken and admitted immediately that he had been distracted for a split second.

I was trying to park my car in a very narrow spot in Coimbra. It was raining quite heavily, and the visibility was poor. I thought I had enough clearance, but I heard a scraping noise against the concrete pillar of the parking garage. I got out to look and saw a significant scratch on my rear passenger door. It was such a silly mistake, I was just trying to get out of the rain and get home to my family. I feel quite embarrassed about the lack of spatial awareness I had today.

I was driving straight on the main avenue when another vehicle, parked on the side, suddenly pulled out without signaling or checking their mirrors. I tried to swerve, but the side of my car hit theirs. I felt a heavy thud, and now there is a significant dent on my side door. I am really worried because this is a new vehicle and I hope the repairs don't take too long. Everything happened so fast, I didn't even have time to honk before the impact occurred.

I was exiting a parallel parking space on Avenida dos Aliados. I checked my mirror, but I suppose I missed the approaching vehicle because of the parked van blocking my view. I moved out and heard a collision. My car also sustained a dent on the driver's side. It was an honest mistake on my part.

I was traveling along the EN125 toward Faro. The traffic lights suddenly turned amber, and the car in front of me braked much harder than I anticipated. I slammed on my brakes, but I could not avoid hitting the back of their bumper. The impact caused the rear glass of their car to shatter, and my own hood has a large dent from the collision. I am really shaken up by this, you know? It’s just one of those bad days where everything seems to go wrong while trying to get to work.

I was pulling into a narrow street to drop off some groceries near the Baixa district. There was a parked delivery truck that made the passage very tight. I miscalculated the swing of my rear bumper and caught the edge of a parked hatchback. It resulted in a deep scratch and a small dent on my rear quarter panel. It was entirely my fault, as I was too focused on the traffic behind me rather than the proximity to the parked vehicle. I'm just hoping for a straightforward claims process.

I was walking down Rua da Prata when I saw the driver attempting to maneuver past the delivery vehicle. The driver was going very slowly, but they misjudged the angle and made contact with a parked car. It was clearly a low-speed accident caused by the narrowness of the street and limited space.

I had a green light at the intersection and proceeded to go straight. Suddenly, another car tried to make a turn across my lane without seeing me. I honked and applied the brakes, but we collided near the front corner. My front turn signal lamp is completely broken and hanging off. I am feeling really frustrated and anxious about the whole situation because I have a very busy week ahead. I truly thought the other driver would wait, but it seems they were in a rush and misjudged the timing.

Traffic on the bridge was moving, then stopped completely due to an accident further ahead. I stopped, but the driver behind me didn't notice the flow had halted. They hit me right in the rear. I’ve checked my car, and there is a clear, deep dent in the trunk lid. It was quite a shock, and I’m just waiting for the authorities to clear the road. I hope my insurance will cover the repairs quickly, as I rely on this car for my daily commute across the river.

The traffic was stop-and-go on the bridge. I looked down at my dashboard for a second to adjust the radio, and by the time I looked up, the car in front had stopped. I couldn't stop in time. I hit the rear of the Megane, causing a dent to his trunk.

I was driving down the one-way street in Porto. A car exiting from a private driveway swung out too wide, sideswiping my passenger side. The impact shattered the passenger side mirror glass and left a long, deep scratch along the door panel. I am quite worried about the repair costs, as the mirror assembly looks like it took a hard hit. I’ve been driving in this city for over forty years, and it's just exhausting to deal with these kinds of incidents during my afternoon errands.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was moving from the left lane to the middle lane to prepare for my exit. I checked my mirrors, but there was a blind spot issue, and I clipped the side of another car that was also changing lanes. The contact damaged my rear bumper and broke my tail lamp. I feel terrible, man. I was just trying to follow my GPS instructions and got a bit confused with the road layout. I'm really sorry to the other driver; I hope everyone is okay and we can get this sorted out soon.

We were both changing lanes at the same time in the heavy traffic on the avenue. I saw the Ford Focus coming into my lane, but it was too late to avoid the contact. The collision dented my door and broke the light housing on his vehicle. It was an unfortunate case of both of us not seeing each other.

I was driving home from work along Avenida da Boavista during the peak traffic hours. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because a pedestrian started crossing the road unexpectedly. I hit the brakes, but I could not stop in time and tapped their rear bumper. There is a visible dent on my front bumper. I feel terrible about the accident; I was really trying to be careful, but everything happened so fast and I am quite worried about my insurance premium increasing after this.

I was driving down Boavista and had to brake suddenly for a person crossing the street. The driver behind me didn't react quickly enough and bumped into the back of my vehicle. It was clearly a low-speed impact, but it left a noticeable dent on my trunk lid. I am disappointed as my car is relatively new, but I appreciate that the other driver stopped immediately to exchange information.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, heading towards the city center. I believe I was in the correct lane, but I think I misjudged the distance when exiting. I felt a scraping sensation on the side of my vehicle. I am honestly quite shaken up by the whole experience. It's my first time being involved in any incident in Lisbon, and I just want to make sure I follow the correct procedure for the repair. There is a deep scratch along my passenger door.

I was trying to park my car in a narrow spot on Rua Augusta. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was reversing, I turned the wheel too early and clipped the side of the vehicle parked next to me. I immediately got out to check. It caused a visible dent and a long scratch on the rear quarter panel of my own car. I feel so embarrassed because it was a completely avoidable mistake on my part while trying to fit into a tight space.

I was walking down Rua Augusta when I saw the driver attempting to reverse into a parking space. They miscalculated the angle and hit the car already parked there. It was a clear accident; no speeding or recklessness involved, just a simple misjudgment of the space. I saw them immediately get out to inspect the dent and scratch on both vehicles and wait for the other owner to return.

Traffic was quite heavy coming off the 25 de Abril bridge. I was changing lanes to take the exit for Almada. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the car in my blind spot. I heard a sharp noise and realized I hit their rear lamp. It broke the plastic cover. I am so sorry for the delay I caused to other drivers. I have been driving for years without incident, and this is very stressful for me, especially in such busy traffic.

I was driving slowly along the cobblestone street of Santa Catarina. A delivery truck was parked partially on the road, so I had to maneuver around it. I misjudged the proximity to the car coming from the opposite direction and we sideswiped each other. It left a significant scratch along the driver-side door. I am really annoyed with myself because I was driving so slowly. I have been very careful today, and it is just unfortunate that this happened in such a busy, narrow street.

I was driving down the road when I saw the Renault trying to pass a delivery vehicle. The driver didn't leave enough room for me to pass safely, and our cars scraped against each other. It was definitely an accident caused by the narrowness of the street and the parked truck. There is a scratch on the side of my car. We both pulled over to exchange details calmly once we realized what had happened.

I was driving along the EN125 near Faro, enjoying the sunny weather. I got distracted for a split second by the view, and when I looked back, the traffic had stopped completely. I could not avoid hitting the car in front. The impact was strong enough to create a dent in my hood and break the lamp on the other vehicle. I feel terrible. I'm an older driver, and I suppose my reactions aren't what they used to be. This is a very stressful situation for me.

I parked my car in the city center to attend a meeting. When I returned, I noticed a fresh scratch on my passenger door. I checked the surveillance nearby and spoke to a shop owner, who confirmed that a car backing out must have clipped me while I was gone. It's just a cosmetic scratch, but it's frustrating as I keep my vehicle in very good condition. I am filing this claim so that I can have the body shop look at it next week.

I work in the cafe right next to where the Nissan was parked. I saw a silver car pulling out of the space next to it earlier this morning. The driver clearly hit the side of the Nissan while reversing, left a scratch, and just drove off without leaving a note. I saw the owner come back later and discover the damage. I am providing my contact details in case they need a witness report.

It was a busy day in downtown Lisbon. I was at a stop sign, and I think I took my foot off the brake slightly too early before the car in front moved. My car rolled forward and tapped their bumper. It was a very minor incident, but it left a small dent on the other car's bumper. I am quite worried about the repair costs, you know? I really didn't mean to hit them, it was just one of those silly mistakes.

I was driving down Avenida de Roma when the vehicle in the lane to my right decided to merge without looking properly. I tried to swerve, but they hit my side. The impact caused a deep scratch along my door and smashed my indicator lamp. I am very frustrated because I was driving safely in my lane. This whole situation is very inconvenient for my work schedule, and I just want the repairs handled as quickly as possible by the insurance company.

I was moving into the right lane on Avenida de Roma to prepare for a turn. I admit I might have moved over too quickly before checking my blind spot thoroughly. I heard a collision, and we both stopped immediately. There is a scratch on the side of the BMW and their lamp is broken. I acknowledge it was my mistake and I am ready to cooperate with the insurance claim process completely.

I was driving home after work around 6:00 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was extremely heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front of me braked suddenly, but the driver behind me didn't react in time. He hit the back of my car quite hard. It was a massive shock, you know? I got out to check the damage and found a clear dent on the rear bumper. I am really worried about how much this is going to cost to repair properly, man.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, and I believe I was in the correct lane to exit. Another driver suddenly tried to merge into my path without checking his blind spot. I tried to steer away, but he clipped the side of my door. I was quite shaken up as it was my first incident driving in Lisbon. There is a visible, long scratch running across the driver's side door panel. I hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, as I really need my car for my commute.

The traffic was dense as we entered the roundabout. I signaled to change lanes to take the exit, but I failed to see the Peugeot alongside me. It was an honest mistake on my part due to the congestion. I grazed his side as I turned, resulting in a scratch. I feel terrible about the situation and fully accept responsibility for the collision.

I was attempting to park in a tight spot in the city center of Coimbra. It was a stressful maneuver because the streets are very narrow and there were cars honking behind me. I misjudged the distance and grazed the concrete pillar of the parking structure. It caused a dent and a deep scratch on the front fender. I am so embarrassed, but I want to report it correctly so it can be fixed. It’s been such a long day and this is the last thing I needed.

I was crossing the intersection when the lights were green, but another vehicle turning left miscalculated my speed. They impacted my front corner at a low speed, which was enough to break the lamp on my vehicle. It happened so fast that I barely had time to react. I am very concerned about the safety of my car, given the damage to the lighting unit. The weather was rainy and visibility was poor, which probably contributed to the other driver not seeing me clearly.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the intersection when I saw the accident occur. The Toyota entered the junction on a green light, and the second vehicle turned too early. It was definitely a low-speed impact, but it was enough to leave the lamp on the Toyota broken. It looked like a simple accident caused by the heavy rain and poor visibility at that moment.

I was driving along the coast road, heading toward the beach. I moved to the right lane to prepare for my turn, but I didn't see the cyclist or the car next to me clearly because of the sunlight glare. I veered slightly and made contact with the side of a parked van. There is a visible scratch on my side mirror and the passenger door. I am really stressed about the insurance paperwork, as I’ve never had to file a claim before and I hope it is straightforward.

While navigating a narrow turn near the city hall, the back end of my car swung slightly too wide. I accidentally brushed against a bollard. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to cause the glass shatter on my rear passenger side light. I feel quite foolish about the whole thing. I've been driving for years, but this road layout is very tricky. I just want to ensure that the repair is handled quickly so I can return to my work schedule.

The traffic in Cascais was busy this morning. I was waiting to turn at a junction when a motorcycle swerved to avoid a pedestrian and ended up brushing against my front bumper. It caused a minor dent and some surface scratches. The motorcyclist was fine, thankfully, but he was quite shaken. We exchanged details immediately and decided to call the insurance. I am just a professional trying to get to my morning meeting on time, so this delay is quite frustrating for everyone involved.

I was riding down the street when a pedestrian stepped off the curb unexpectedly. I had to swerve hard to avoid hitting them. In the process, I clipped the front of the Mercedes that was waiting at the intersection. I am very sorry for the damage caused; it resulted in a dent and a scratch on the car. My priority was to avoid an injury to the pedestrian.

I returned to my car after grocery shopping at the local market to find that another vehicle had hit my bumper. It seems they tried to park and didn't see my car. The impact was enough to create a crack in the plastic bumper cover. There was no note left, but a witness nearby pointed out the vehicle that had just driven off. I am quite frustrated as I take very good care of my car. I hope the camera footage from the shop can help identify the responsible party.

I was walking to my own car when I saw a silver sedan backing into the parked Renault. The driver of the sedan didn't seem to notice or just didn't care, because they pulled away quite quickly after the contact. I inspected the Renault and clearly saw a crack in the bumper. I stayed around because I knew the owner would be upset to find such damage.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 9:00 AM when the traffic came to a sudden, unexpected halt. I applied my brakes firmly, but unfortunately, I couldn't stop in time to avoid hitting the car in front of me. The impact was quite low-speed, but I still felt the jolt. I am really worried about the repair costs, to be honest. I got out immediately to check, and there is a visible dent on the front bumper. I hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, man, I'm just so stressed about this whole situation.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the afternoon rush. I was in the outer lane, intending to exit towards the airport, when another driver tried to change lanes without signaling properly. I tried to pull over to avoid contact, but we ended up side-swiping each other at a very slow pace. It was such a frustrating moment because I was already late for my meeting. I checked my passenger side door afterward and there is a long scratch running across the panel. It is just really bad luck, honestly.

I was driving on the roundabout and honestly, I thought I had enough clearance to move into the outer lane. I clearly misjudged the position of the Seat Ibiza in the adjacent lane. It was a simple error of judgment on my part. We both stopped safely at the exit and exchanged details. I saw the scratch on his car; it's unfortunate but these things happen in busy Lisbon traffic.

I was trying to park in a tight spot near the university. I miscalculated the distance while reversing into the space because the sun was hitting my mirrors at a really awkward angle. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had clipped the rear bumper of the car behind me. I felt terrible immediately. Upon inspection, I noticed there is a small dent and some significant scratching on the rear quarter panel of the other vehicle. I have already contacted the owner to explain what happened; I just want to make things right.

The traffic on Eixo Norte-Sul was moving very slowly, maybe 30 km/h. I was keeping to my lane when the driver to my left decided to merge into my path. I didn't have enough room to swerve, and we made contact. My left headlight lens is completely smashed, and there are deep scratches along the side of the wing. I am quite shaken up because I have never been in an accident before. It all happened so fast, and I was just trying to get home after a long day at the office.

I admit I was looking at my GPS for a split second and didn't check my blind spot thoroughly enough before moving right. I drifted into the lane occupied by the Toyota. I heard the crunch of the lamp breaking immediately. I take full responsibility for the mistake as I failed to yield during the lane change.

I was proceeding through the intersection when the lights turned amber. I didn't want to slam on the brakes, so I proceeded, but the car coming from the cross street entered the junction prematurely. We collided at a very low speed. I was driving with my daughter in the back, and we were quite scared, but thankfully no one was hurt. My front bumper has a noticeable dent now. I am a very careful driver, so this is quite distressing for me to deal with today.

I was standing on the corner waiting to cross the street. I saw the Renault entering the intersection just as the light was changing. The other vehicle didn't wait for the light to fully turn green for them and pulled out into the junction. It was a low-speed impact, but clearly, there is a dent on the bumper of the Renault.

I was driving along the coast near Cascais, enjoying the nice weather. The car ahead of me braked very hard for a cyclist. I tried my best to stop, but I tapped the back of their vehicle. My headlight is broken and, honestly, there is glass shattered all over the road from my indicator casing. I feel terrible about the incident. I am an older driver, and I try to be very vigilant, but the sudden stop caught me off guard. It is a very regrettable situation for everyone involved.

I was heading north on Avenida da República during the early evening. The traffic was dense and moving in starts and stops. As I accelerated to match the flow, the car beside me drifted into my lane without warning. We made contact, and I felt the car vibrate. I pulled over to the side immediately. Upon inspection, there are clear, long scratches along my rear door panel. It is very annoying as the car is fairly new, but these things happen in heavy urban traffic.

I was trying to avoid a pothole in the right lane and drifted slightly left without realizing how close the Audi was. It was unintentional. I heard the scrape as the side mirrors and panels made contact. I accept that I was the one who drifted out of my lane, causing the scratch on the other vehicle's side.

I was trying to navigate the narrow streets of Porto. It was raining slightly, and the cobbles were very slippery. As I turned a corner, I lost a bit of traction and slid into the back of a parked delivery van. It was really a slow maneuver, maybe 10 km/h, but it was enough to cause damage. My front lamp is broken, and there is a visible dent on the hood. I am really quite anxious about how to report this as I am still learning the local driving conditions here.

Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it usually is. I was stopped, but the driver behind me failed to stop in time and hit my rear bumper. The impact caused some of my rear light housing to break, leaving glass shattered on the bridge surface. It was quite a shock; I didn't see it coming at all. I am just a professional trying to get home, and this is a major inconvenience. I hope we can resolve the insurance claim quickly without too much administrative hassle.

I was distracted by my radio for a second, and when I looked up, the traffic had already stopped. I pressed the brake, but the wet surface made it difficult to stop completely. I tapped the back of the Skoda. I acknowledge that I was at fault for the rear-end collision and the resulting damage to the rear lights.

I was pulling out of a parking space in the downtown area. I thought I had checked the mirror thoroughly, but I misjudged the angle of the car coming up behind me. We touched bumpers as I exited. It was just a light graze, leaving a scratch on my side panel and the other person's bumper. I feel really silly, you know? It's the kind of thing you just don't expect to happen when you're being careful, but there you go. I'm just hoping it's not too expensive to fix.

I was walking down the street when I saw the small car pulling out of the parking spot. It didn't look like the driver saw the oncoming vehicle. They collided at a very slow speed. I saw the mark on the car; it's definitely a scratch, nothing more, and luckily no one was injured.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour when the traffic came to a sudden halt. I pressed my brakes hard, but given the wet road conditions from the light rain, I couldn't stop in time. I ended up bumping into the car in front of me at a very low speed. I felt terrible about it. The impact caused a noticeable dent on my front bumper, but fortunately, no other parts of my car were damaged during the small collision.

Man, this is so stressful, you know? I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio near the airport, and I guess I misjudged the distance while merging into the outer lane. I turned the wheel a bit too quickly and scraped the side of a van. There is a clear scratch and a dent on my passenger door now. I am really worried about how much the repairs will cost, as I am still just a student trying to get by.

I was driving steadily inside the roundabout when the driver of the Peugeot attempted to change lanes without checking his blind spot properly. He clipped my rear panel, resulting in a deep scratch and a small dent on his car's side. It was clearly a lapse in concentration, but it was just a minor accident.

I was proceeding along the right lane of Avenida dos Aliados. I signaled to move to the middle lane, not realizing there was a car already occupying the space. I only noticed when I heard the impact. My front indicator lamp is broken from the contact. I feel quite shaken by the incident, as I honestly did not see the other driver at all during the maneuver.

The driver of the Seat moved into my lane without sufficient space or warning. I tried to brake, but he still hit my side mirror. His indicator lamp was shattered during the brief impact, which occurred at a low speed of approximately 20 km/h.

I was driving home along the coast in Cascais. It was late, and I was quite tired after a long day. As I approached the intersection, the driver in front of me braked very hard for a pedestrian. I didn't react quickly enough and struck his rear end. The impact caused a dent in my hood and the glass shatter of my headlight. I'm really upset with myself for not maintaining a safer distance.

I was walking nearby on the sidewalk of the Estrada Marginal when I saw the Mercedes collide with the back of the station wagon. The Mercedes driver seemed distracted or slow to react. There was a loud bang, and I saw shattered glass on the pavement and a large dent on the front of the Mercedes.

I was driving down the narrow street when a delivery truck started pulling away from the curb. I tried to steer around him, but the road was simply too narrow. I ended up brushing against the side of his truck. The side of my car now has a long scratch and a shallow dent. I'm quite worried about the insurance premiums going up, as I'm working on a tight budget lately.

I was checking my mirrors to pull out from the side of the road. I thought I had space, but the Citroen driver was moving faster than I anticipated. We made contact, resulting in some scratches and a dent on his passenger door. It was an unfortunate case of misjudged speed.

It was a busy afternoon here in Braga. I was taking the exit from the roundabout when another driver entered without yielding properly. I had to hit my brakes to avoid a direct crash, and in the process, I clipped the central island's curb. This caused a crack in my wheel cover. It really wasn't my fault, but the other driver just kept going. I am so frustrated, honestly.

I was standing near the roundabout observing traffic. The Polo driver was forced into a sharp turn by a reckless entry from another vehicle. I saw him hit the curb while trying to avoid the other car. There is a visible crack on his front wheel hubcap from the impact.

I was driving along Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy, and the vehicle in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to press the brake pedal, but I could not stop in time and hit the rear bumper of the car ahead at a very low speed. It was a really stressful situation, man, I feel terrible about it. I checked my car and noticed a clear dent on the front bumper. I am really worried about how much this is going to cost to repair, you know?

I was waiting at the traffic lights when I suddenly felt a bump from behind. It was not a violent impact, but it was enough to see that my rear bumper was pushed in. The driver behind me came out immediately and was very apologetic. We exchanged contact details and checked the damage to both vehicles.

I was attempting to park in a tight spot near the shopping area in Baixa. I thought I had enough clearance while reversing into the space, but I miscalculated the angle. I must have been going at about 5 km/h, but I heard a scraping sound against the concrete pillar nearby. When I got out to look, I saw a long scratch along the rear passenger door. It was purely an honest mistake on my part, and I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident. I hope the insurance process is straightforward.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, which is always quite chaotic with all the taxi traffic. I was in the outer lane, intending to exit towards the highway. Suddenly, a van appeared in my blind spot while trying to cut across the lane. I tried to steer away, but there was contact between our side panels. I pulled over to the side immediately. My door has a visible dent and some paint damage, like a deep scratch. It was all so fast, and honestly, I am quite shaken by the experience.

I was turning right to exit the roundabout when I felt a graze on the side of my van. I did not see the other car until the last second because of the heavy traffic and the sun glare. We stopped safely and confirmed that our vehicles had made contact during the lane change.

I was driving home from work along the Avenida 24 de Julho. It was raining quite heavily, and visibility was limited. The car beside me started to drift into my lane. I honked, but they didn't seem to hear me, and their side mirror struck my driver's side window. The impact caused my side window to shatter instantly. I had to pull over immediately to clear the glass from the seat. It was a terrifying moment, and I'm really concerned about driving the car in this state with the window broken.

I was pulling out of a very narrow side street onto the main road. I was being very cautious, moving at probably less than 10 km/h. I didn't see the cyclist coming from the sidewalk, and when I saw them, I swerved to avoid them and clipped a parked car. My front turn signal lamp is completely broken now. I am so relieved the cyclist was okay, but I am really upset about the damage to my car. It was just a lapse in concentration, and I feel truly terrible about hitting that parked vehicle.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the tram when I saw the Yaris pull out slowly. The driver seemed to be looking for cyclists, but they swerved suddenly to avoid one and hit the parked car. It was definitely a low-speed accident and not malicious at all.

I was stuck in traffic on Avenida da República, it was one of those days where nothing moves. I was just checking the radio when the car in front stopped abruptly for a delivery truck. I didn't have enough time to react and tapped the back of their car. It wasn't a major hit, but my front bumper has a visible dent and the passenger side headlamp is broken. I feel like such an idiot, I was only distracted for a second, you know? It's just a lot of hassle for everyone involved.

Well, you see, I was visiting the market area and trying to park my car in a space that was perhaps a bit too tight for a vehicle of this size. I was being quite careful, or so I thought, watching the mirrors and checking the sensors, but I must have misjudged the distance to the wall. There is a rather significant scratch along the rear fender now. It's a shame, really, as I try to take such good care of the paintwork, but these things happen when you are running errands in the busy city center.

I was driving down Avenida dos Aliados and there was this black car in the left lane that started moving into mine without checking. I tried to speed up to avoid it, but they hit my rear quarter panel. It left a nasty dent and a long scratch down the side. I am really frustrated because I was driving perfectly fine, man. It's like people don't even look before they switch lanes anymore. Now I have to go through all this paperwork and wait for repairs. This is exactly what I did not need this week.

I was merging into the right lane as I needed to take the next exit. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the Audi was in my blind spot. I heard a scraping sound and realized we had touched. We both pulled over immediately to resolve the issue and share our insurance information.

Traffic was backing up as usual on the bridge. I was behind a large van and the driver ahead performed an emergency stop. Despite my best efforts to brake, the road surface was a bit slick, and I slid forward, hitting the van. The impact caused the front grille to cave in, resulting in a large dent, and my headlight housing shattered on impact. I am quite shaken by this, as it's my first accident in over ten years of driving. I have notified the authorities as required by the protocols for bridge incidents.

I was looking for a parking spot on Rua da Prata. I saw an opening, but as I turned the corner to enter the space, I didn't see the metal post marking the pedestrian area. I was moving very slowly, maybe 3 km/h, but the corner of my bumper hit the post. It broke my rear tail lamp completely. It was just a silly, careless mistake while I was distracted looking for street parking. I am feeling really bothered about the cost of the repair, as I know these modern lamps are quite expensive to replace.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 9:00 AM in quite heavy traffic. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a cyclist crossing unexpectedly. I applied my brakes, but I couldn't stop in time on the wet asphalt and gently bumped into his rear bumper. I am really worried about this, honestly, because I have never been in an accident before and the insurance process is quite intimidating for me. There is a visible dent on the rear bumper of the other car where I made contact.

Traffic was slow and I had to stop abruptly when a bicycle cut into my lane. The driver behind me didn't react fast enough and hit my car from behind. It was a low-speed impact, but it left a noticeable dent on my trunk.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio trying to exit towards the airport. It was mid-afternoon and the roundabout was busy. As I was changing lanes to take the exit, I misjudged the distance to the vehicle in the adjacent lane and grazed their side panel. It was a stupid mistake, really, and I feel terrible about it. My car has a long scratch on the passenger side door, and I believe the other driver sustained a similar scratch on their vehicle during the maneuver.

I was parking near the University of Coimbra this morning. I was trying to reverse into a tight spot, and I suppose I didn't see the post clearly or turned the wheel too early. I scraped against a parked car while backing up. It was quite embarrassing, to be honest. I looked at the damage and there is a clear scratch and a small dent on the rear fender of the other vehicle. I left a note on their windshield with my contact details immediately.

I was walking by and saw the driver of the Renault attempting to park. They reversed too quickly and scraped the side of a parked car. I saw both a scratch and a dent on the rear fender after they stopped.

I was driving home from work along Avenida 24 de Julho when a delivery van suddenly pulled out of a side street without looking. I swerved to avoid a head-on collision, but I ended up scraping the side of a taxi waiting in the lane next to me. The taxi's side lamp is now broken and there are several scratches along the side of the door. I am feeling extremely stressed about the costs involved, as my car is relatively new and I take great care of it.

I was proceeding through the intersection when the traffic light turned amber. I thought I had time to pass, but a car coming from the cross street entered the junction prematurely. We collided at a very low speed. My front lamp is broken, and there is glass shatter on the road from the impact. I am quite shaken up by the event. I have been driving for many years, and I truly regret this lapse in judgment regarding the traffic signal timing.

I was moving through the intersection when the other driver entered the junction. They hit the corner of my car, shattering my headlight glass and breaking the plastic housing. It all happened so fast, but I am just glad no one was hurt.

I was driving on Estrada Monumental, and I wanted to move into the left lane to turn. I checked my mirror, but I must have missed the car in my blind spot. As I began to merge, I heard a grinding noise and realized I had made contact with another vehicle. There is a visible scratch on the rear passenger door of the other car. I feel awful about this, as I usually consider myself a very careful driver who is always checking mirrors twice.

The traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it often is during the evening rush hour. I was looking down for just a second to change the radio station, and when I looked up, the car ahead had stopped completely. I didn't have enough distance to come to a full stop. I hit them, causing a dent in their tailgate and breaking the glass of my own fog lamp. I am very worried about the repair costs, man, this is definitely going to hurt my savings.

Traffic was stop-and-go. I was at a complete standstill when I felt a hard jolt from behind. The impact caused a significant dent to my rear bumper and hatch. I remained in my car until the other driver approached.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving near the city center, and it was a very busy morning. I was trying to merge into a line of cars when my bumper hit the side of a stationary vehicle. I am very concerned about the implications of this incident for my insurance premium, as I am trying to keep everything in order. I was attempting to navigate through the narrow streets of Cedofeita to find a parking space. While turning a corner, I miscalculated the swing of my back wheel and lightly brushed against a parked car. I checked the damage and found a thin scratch along the side of their door. I am truly sorry for the inconvenience, as I know how hard it is to maintain a car in such a busy city with these tight parking spots.

I saw the driver maneuvering the small Volkswagen around the corner. They turned too sharply and the rear of their car rubbed against a parked silver sedan. I observed a long scratch on the paint afterward.

It was raining heavily in Porto, and the streets were quite slippery. I was driving up towards Avenida dos Aliados and had to brake for a pedestrian crossing. The driver behind me didn't anticipate the stop and hit my car from behind. The impact was quite forceful, resulting in a large dent on my trunk and the glass shatter from my rear lights scattered on the road. I was following the Audi, but the rain was so heavy that my visibility was reduced. When the driver ahead stopped for the crossing, I skidded on the wet pavement. I collided with the back of their car, causing damage to their trunk and rear lights.

I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música when another driver attempted to exit from the inner lane and cut across my path. I tried to brake, but I couldn't avoid the contact. I was attempting to parallel park near the city hall around 10:00 AM. I misjudged the distance while reversing into the spot and ended up scraping the bumper of the car parked behind me. I was driving toward Faro when the traffic ahead suddenly slowed down. I slammed on my brakes, but the road was a bit damp and I slid right into the back of the car in front of me. I just didn't expect the traffic to halt so abruptly on the highway like that. I'm hoping the insurance process is straightforward.

I was stopped at the traffic lights when I felt a hard jolt from behind. I got out and saw that the driver behind me had hit my vehicle. My bumper is damaged, but the driver was very apologetic and cooperative. We exchanged our insurance details right there on the shoulder of the road. It was an unfortunate accident caused by the sudden stop of the line ahead.

I was driving down a narrow street in downtown Lisbon yesterday. It was quite crowded with tourists, and as I tried to squeeze past a delivery van that had stopped to unload, I miscalculated the clearance. I felt a jarring sound against the side of my car. I stopped immediately to inspect the vehicle and found a long, deep scratch along my passenger side door. I am really anxious about the repair timeline since I use the car every single day for my commute. I have already taken photos of the area and the van's position.

I was driving north across the bridge during the evening rush hour. I checked my mirror and signaled to change into the center lane, but I didn't see the vehicle in my blind spot. We made contact, causing some bodywork damage to both cars. I feel awful about the oversight. There is a noticeable dent and a set of scratches on my front quarter panel. I should have been more careful given how busy the bridge is at that time of day. I am really worried about how much this will cost to fix.

The other driver attempted to switch into my lane while I was driving at a steady 60 km/h. They clipped my driver-side mirror and the side of my car. We both pulled over safely after the bridge to inspect the damage. The insured driver was extremely apologetic and admitted they did not check their blind spot properly before maneuvering across the lane.

It was raining quite hard, and the streets were slick. As I entered the intersection, a vehicle coming from my right didn't stop at the sign and collided with my front corner. The impact was quite loud. My front lamp is broken and there is a deep dent on the fender. I've lived in this neighborhood for forty years, and I've never had an accident like this before. I was just coming back from the market with my groceries, and now I'm here dealing with this mess instead of being home for dinner.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the whole thing. The gray car definitely rolled through the stop sign without checking properly. The Mercedes was proceeding through the intersection legally when it was struck. It was a very unfortunate incident, especially given the bad weather we are having today. I saw the broken parts fly off onto the pavement after the impact.

I was navigating through the narrow cobblestone streets near the plaza. I was trying to turn around, and I accidentally misjudged the position of a stone bollard. I reversed slowly, but I still made contact. There is a clear dent on my rear bumper. I feel very embarrassed because I consider myself a careful driver. I am going to contact my insurance company immediately to see how to proceed with the repairs. It's a busy area and I just got a bit confused by the traffic flow and the tight space.

I was driving through the city center on my way to pick up my daughter from school. Another car was trying to park and swung out too wide into my lane while I was passing. We collided, and there is some damage to my side. I have a scratch and a dent on the passenger door. I am quite worried about how this will impact my commute for the next week. I just hope the other driver has all their documentation in order so we can resolve this matter quickly.

I admit I was trying to maneuver into a parking space and I didn't see the car coming down the street. It was a lapse in judgment on my part. The other driver stopped immediately, and we discussed the situation calmly. My vehicle also has some minor damage. We are both cooperating fully to get the insurance paperwork submitted correctly.

Driving along the coastal road, the sun was hitting the windshield at a very sharp angle, and I was momentarily blinded. A cyclist veered suddenly into the road to avoid a puddle, and I swerved to avoid them. I hit a road sign instead. The glass of my side mirror shattered, and there is a major dent in the fender. I am so relieved I didn't hit the cyclist, but my car is in a bad state. It was a very scary moment for everyone involved, honestly, I am still trying to catch my breath.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, just heading home after a very long day at the office. I tried my best to stop, but I just couldn't slow down enough in time and tapped the back of their bumper. I feel terrible about the whole situation. There is a noticeable dent and a long scratch on my front bumper now, and I am really worried about the repair costs.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the outer lane when a vehicle attempting to exit the roundabout from the inner lane cut directly across my path. I had absolutely no time to react and we collided. The impact resulted in my right side lamp broken and a significant scratch along the passenger door. It was a very stressful morning and I am just trying to get all the documentation sorted out properly for the claim.

I admit I made a mistake while exiting the roundabout. I was trying to reach the exit quickly and didn't check my side mirror thoroughly before changing lanes. I hit the other driver's car on the side. I am prepared to accept full responsibility for the damages, including the broken lamp and the scratch on the side of their vehicle.

I am so incredibly sorry about what happened today. I was attempting to parallel park on Avenida dos Aliados, which is always so tight, you know?
