I got out and saw there is a deep scratch on the rear bumper of the parked car. It was purely an accident, and I really want to make sure it gets fixed properly for the owner.

I was driving slowly along Rua da Prata at about 20 km/h. A van tried to squeeze through a very narrow gap next to me while I was turning, and they ended up swiping the entire side of my car. It was quite a shock. My front lamp is broken now, and there is a massive dent and several deep scratch marks along the side panel. It’s all very confusing, but I have already exchanged details with the driver so we can proceed with the insurance formalities.

I was walking down the street when I saw the van attempt to pass the Renault. The van driver clearly underestimated how narrow the street was. I watched them collide, causing clear damage to the Renault's lamp and door. It was an unfortunate incident but I am happy to provide my statement for the report.

It was a lovely sunny afternoon in the Algarve, and I was driving home on the EN125 when traffic came to an unexpected standstill. My brakes were fine, but the driver behind me clearly wasn't paying enough attention. They struck my rear bumper quite hard. I stepped out to find a large dent right in the center. I am quite an experienced driver, so this was definitely not my fault. The other party was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the entire exchange of information.

I entered the intersection at Avenida da República with the green light. Another vehicle came from the cross street and failed to stop at their red signal. They impacted my front passenger door. It was terrifying; the window suffered glass shatter, and there is a significant dent in the door frame. I am still quite shaken up by the event, but I am very thankful that it wasn't any worse than it turned out to be.

I made a terrible error of judgment. I thought I could clear the intersection before the lights changed, but I was clearly wrong. I hit the other driver's side door. I acknowledge the damage I caused, including the shattered glass and the door dent. I am fully prepared to cover the insurance excess for the victim.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Porto

statements.text: I was cruising along at about 50 km/h in the middle lane. I checked my mirrors before signaling to move to the left lane, but as I started my maneuver, a small city car was already in my blind spot. We made contact, resulting in a series of paint scratch marks along my rear quarter panel. It was a lapse in my concentration, and I feel quite bad about it. The weather was a bit misty, which might have affected visibility, but I take full responsibility.

Well, I was parking near the center to do some shopping, and it was quite crowded, as it often is. I was turning into a spot and miscalculated the turn, hitting the side of a stationary vehicle parked there. I felt awful immediately. There is a scratch and a small dent on the panel now. I waited for the owner to return, and we exchanged details quite peacefully. These things happen, I suppose, when one is having an off-day and perhaps not as attentive as usual.

I was stopped at a red light on Avenida da França when I was hit from behind by a large delivery truck. The impact was quite forceful, causing the rear glass shatter and the tail lamp broken. My passengers and I were quite shocked. The driver of the truck was very professional and stayed until the police arrived to ensure all documentation was correct. I caused significant damage to their rear, including the lamp and the glass. I have apologized to the driver and am filing this report to get their repairs covered as quickly as possible.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, the traffic was quite heavy as usual. I was keeping a safe distance, but the car in front suddenly braked hard because of a cyclist. I am honestly quite shaken up by this; it's the first time I've ever had an accident and I'm really worried about my insurance premium going up. There is a noticeable dent on my front bumper.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, planning to take the second exit toward the airport. I was in the inner lane when the car next to me tried to move across without checking their blind spot. I swerved slightly to avoid a full collision, but we still ended up scraping each other on the side. I am just really annoyed because I was heading to a meeting and now I have this scratch on my passenger door to deal with. It all happened so fast, honestly.

I was on the roundabout and I thought I had enough room to shift into the outer lane to exit. Clearly, I misjudged the speed of the other car. There is a light scratch on my rear door panel, but fortunately, no one was hurt in the incident. I accept responsibility for not checking my side mirror carefully enough before moving over.

I was driving along the Marginal road towards Cascais, enjoying the coastal view, and I decided to move to the right lane to exit. My indicator lamp is broken, and there is a deep scratch along the side panel. I am just really stressed about the repair process, man, I hope the insurance covers most of it.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the two cars collide. The Nissan began to change lanes while the other car was already in its blind spot. It didn't look intentional, just a simple mistake due to the glare from the sun. I saw the lamp shatter and heard the metal scraping before both vehicles pulled over to the shoulder.

I was pulling out of a parking garage on Avenida dos Aliados. I was looking left to check for oncoming trams and pedestrians, and when I started to move, I didn't see the bollard that was slightly obscured by the shadow of the building. I ended up reversing directly into it at a very low speed. It was so stupid of me, I am quite embarrassed. The force was enough to cause the glass shatter on my rear light cluster. I hope this won't take too long to fix.

I was driving slowly through the narrow streets of downtown Lisbon. It was a busy Saturday afternoon with many tourists walking about. A van coming in the opposite direction was taking the corner too wide, and I didn't have enough space to pull over further to the right. We swiped mirrors and panels. There is a dent and a long scratch down the side of my driver-side door. The other driver stopped, and we exchanged insurance info right there on the spot.

The streets here are very narrow for a commercial van. I tried to be careful, but I think I clipped the Citroën while navigating the bend. I stopped immediately to ensure the other driver was okay. We both have some surface damage, specifically a dent and scratch on the side panels. It was an unfortunate accident caused by the limited road width.

Well, you see, I was heading to the market on this lovely morning in Viseu, just minding my own business. Suddenly, the gentleman in front of me slammed on his brakes because a cat ran across the road. I pressed my brake, but with the road being a bit damp from the morning mist, my car just didn't stop in time. I bumped into his rear bumper. I feel quite shaken, being 72 years old, these things rattle you. I have a dent and a broken lamp on the front.

It resulted in a long scratch along the side of my car. I am reporting this formally as per the insurance requirements. Dude, I am so stressed out right now. I was trying to park near the Matosinhos beach and I misjudged the height of a concrete barrier. I was proceeding through the green light at the intersection of Avenida da Liberdade. Another car coming from the cross-street failed to stop at their red light. I admit I was distracted by my GPS for a split second and I completely missed the red light at the intersection. I realize now that I entered the junction when I shouldn't have. I am very sorry for the trouble I've caused. I saw the damage to the other vehicle's lamp and bumper. I am ready to cooperate with the insurance companies to resolve this matter quickly.

I was already in the lane when the driver in the Peugeot tried to cut across to take the exit. I didn't see them coming until the last second. They swerved, but we still made contact on the side. We stopped immediately to exchange details. It was just a minor scratch on both our vehicles.

I was attempting to reverse into a tight parking space near the market on Avenida 24 de Julho. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar behind me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had backed into it. Now there is a dent and some scratches on the rear bumper. I've been driving for years and I'm quite embarrassed, to be honest. I am reporting this because I need to make sure my insurance covers the repair work at the shop.

It was raining quite heavily on the Estrada Monumental. I put on my turn signal to change into the right lane. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. As I moved over, we clipped each other. My rear passenger-side lamp is completely broken now. I am very worried about the safety of driving it like this. I was being careful, but the weather really made visibility poor today, and I just didn't see them there.

I was driving straight in the right lane when the Nissan started moving into my lane without enough space. I tried to brake, but the rain was slick. We made contact, and their light broke on impact. It was just a simple case of a miscalculation in the bad weather.

I was going through a green light at the intersection near the luxury boutiques. A delivery scooter came out of nowhere from the side street, trying to beat the red light. I slammed on the brakes but still collided with the side of their bike. My passenger side window suffered from glass shatter when they fell against it. I am shaken up, but thankfully everyone seems to be okay. It happened so fast that I barely had time to process what was going on.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the light to change. The car clearly had the green light. The scooter driver tried to cut through the intersection far too quickly. There was definitely glass shatter from the car window when the scooter leaned into it during the fall.

I was on my way to visit my daughter in Setúbal. I was slowing down because of the heavy traffic on Avenida Luísa Todi, just observing the lovely view of the river, when the car behind me didn't stop in time. They hit me quite hard. My rear bumper has a large dent and my left brake lamp is broken into pieces. I am a bit confused by the paperwork, but I just want to ensure my little car gets back to the condition it was in yesterday.

I was distracted by the sun glare coming off the water. I didn't see that the traffic in front had come to a complete halt until it was too late. I hit the back of the Fiat, causing damage to their lamp and bumper. I apologized to the lady immediately; it was entirely my error.

I was driving down a narrow street in Braga. An elderly pedestrian stepped out unexpectedly. I swerved to avoid them and clipped a bollard on the side of the road. There is a long, ugly scratch down my front passenger side door panel. I am just relieved I didn't hit the person, but I definitely need to get the paintwork fixed. It's a busy part of the city and there are always tourists walking around, so I have to be extra careful next time.

I was going around the roundabout near the airport. It was super busy, as usual. The taxi in the inner lane tried to exit suddenly and crossed right over my path. I couldn't move out of the way. They hit the front of my car, and it caused a hairline crack in my plastic bumper casing. I am really worried, man, because I need this car for my job tomorrow. I don't know why they didn't check their mirrors before turning like that.

I parked my car on the street while I went to buy some books. When I came back, I noticed someone had scraped the rear corner of my bumper while trying to park behind me. There is a clear dent and a deep scratch where they must have pushed into my car. It is frustrating that they didn't leave a note, but I have the time of the incident from my dashcam. I just need to get it back to its original state.

I was sitting at the café across the street. I saw a large silver sedan hit the parked Mini while trying to reverse. They hit it hard enough to cause a dent and scratch the paint. The driver looked out the window, hesitated, but then drove away without leaving any contact information.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal around 5:30 PM, just trying to merge toward Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo. Honestly, I think I was a bit stressed with the heavy evening traffic, you know? I checked my mirrors, but I guess I didn't see the silver car in my blind spot. I pulled over to the side and saw a noticeable scratch on my rear door. I am just so worried about my insurance premium going up now; I feel like a total idiot for not being more careful.

I was maintaining my lane inside the roundabout when the driver in the Polo attempted to merge without checking. I tried to brake, but they grazed the side of my vehicle. There is a long scratch along my passenger side door where we made contact at a very low speed. It was an honest mistake, but it is quite frustrating.

It was pouring rain in Porto this morning while I was trying to park near the market. I misjudged the distance to the bollard while reversing, even though I was moving at less than 5 km/h. I heard a dull thud and immediately stopped. When I got out to check, I saw a dent right on the corner of my rear bumper. I feel terrible about this because I have been driving for years without a single incident, but the visibility was just so poor.

I was heading down Avenida dos Aliados when the traffic suddenly stopped. The car in front braked much harder than I expected. I did my best to hit the brakes, but I just couldn't stop in time on the slick road surface. I hit the back of his vehicle with enough force to cause a dent and break my front passenger-side lamp. I am honestly shaken up; my hands were literally trembling when I got out to talk to the other driver.

I came to a complete stop for a pedestrian crossing the road. The car behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper. I noticed that their headlight was broken and their hood had a significant dent from the impact. I just want to get this sorted through the proper insurance channels.

I was driving along the EN125 towards Faro when a truck pulled out of a side street without looking. I swerved to avoid a head-on collision, but I clipped the side of his trailer. I ended up with a dent on my front fender and a deep scratch running down the side of the door. I am just really shaken by the whole event, man. It happened so fast that I barely had time to react before the contact occurred.

I was waiting at the junction on my bike when I saw the truck pull out into the path of the oncoming Megane. The driver of the car swerved to avoid the impact, but they still scraped the side of the truck. It was clear the car driver was doing about 40 km/h and had no time to stop.

I was proceeding through the green light at the junction near the park, and everything seemed fine. Suddenly, another car clipped my side as they were trying to turn across my path. The impact was loud, and I was shocked to see my driver-side window glass shatter instantly. I’ve lived in this neighborhood for forty years and have never seen such a messy situation at this intersection; it really is quite a dangerous spot when the sun hits the traffic lights just right.

I was backing out of a tight parking spot in Coimbra. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but the narrow streets here are really deceiving. I must have miscalculated the turn, and I backed right into a street lamp post. The impact was very minor, but it was enough to break the rear lamp cover completely. I feel so bad because it's such a silly mistake to make, but I guess I was just a bit distracted by the kids in the back seat.

Traffic on Avenida Luísa Todi was crawling along, and I was checking my navigation system for a second. When I looked up, the car in front was stopped. I pressed the pedal, but I hit them anyway at low speed. There is a small dent and some light scratching on their bumper. I feel really terrible about this; I was not being careful enough, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork, which is quite stressful for me right now.

I was stationary in heavy traffic when I felt a jolt from behind. I checked my rear bumper and saw a dent and a scratch where the Corsa had hit me. It was a minor incident, but it is certainly an inconvenience to have to take the car to the repair shop next week.

I was moving from the left lane to the middle lane on Avenida 24 de Julho. I turned on my signal, but I didn't notice the motorcycle coming up alongside me. We made contact, and there is a visible scratch on the side of my door. I am just really concerned about the well-being of the motorcyclist; I hate that this happened and I hope they are alright, as that is much more important than the paint on my car.

I was riding in the middle lane when the Qashqai suddenly shifted into my lane without checking the blind spot. They side-swiped me, causing a scratch along my fairing. I managed to stay upright, thank goodness, but it was a close call that left me quite shaken up on the road.

I was exiting the roundabout at Boavista and thought the lane beside me was clear. As I began to turn, I realized a van was still alongside me, and we collided. My front bumper has a dent and the headlight assembly has a broken lamp housing. I've been driving in Porto for over twenty years, and this is the first time I've ever had such an incident; it's quite a shame, really, as I try to be very careful.

I was continuing around the roundabout while the BMW was attempting to exit. The driver of the BMW did not see me and clipped my rear panel, which resulted in damage to their lamp and bumper. It was a simple case of not checking the blind spot properly, but no one was injured, which is the main thing.

I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música, trying to exit towards Avenida da Boavista, when traffic suddenly stopped. It was raining and the road was quite slippery, you know? I hit the brakes, but I just couldn't stop in time and tapped the back of the car ahead of me. I am so worried because this is my first car and I honestly didn't mean to cause any trouble. There is a visible dent on my front bumper and some nasty scratches on the hood where it hit his trunk, man.

I was driving home from work along the Avenida 24 de Julho around 6 PM, just trying to merge into the middle lane. I checked my mirror, but I suppose I didn't see the other vehicle coming up fast in my blind spot. I moved over slightly and felt a distinct graze against the side of my door. I immediately pulled over to apologize. There is a long, deep scratch running along my passenger side door panel that I am really upset about.

I was maintaining my lane on the Avenida 24 de Julho when the driver in the Volkswagen suddenly swerved into my lane without signaling properly. I tried to steer away, but there was a light contact between our side panels. I pulled over with him to inspect the damage, and he was very apologetic. My car has a long scratch on the rear quarter panel.

It was a busy afternoon near the city center, and I was distracted for just a split second by my phone GPS. The car in front had stopped for a pedestrian crossing, and I just couldn't stop in time. I am so terribly sorry about this. My front lamp is completely broken, and there is glass shattered all over the road from the headlight assembly. I am really stressed about the repair costs because the car is relatively new and I take very good care of it.

I stopped my vehicle safely at the pedestrian crossing as required by the law. Without any warning, I felt a hard jolt from behind. When I got out, I saw that the driver behind me had crashed into my rear. His headlight was broken and there was glass on the ground. It was quite an alarming experience, to be honest.

I was heading towards Cascais along the coast on the Estrada Marginal. The traffic was quite heavy with many tourists. As I tried to change lanes to avoid a slowing bus, a vehicle in the next lane moved at the same time. We collided side-by-side at a low speed. It was a simple miscommunication, really. My car sustained a dent and a scratch on the driver's side door, which is quite annoying given the car was in perfect condition until today.

I was walking along the path near the beach when I saw two cars trying to merge into the same lane. Both drivers seemed to be unaware of each other's presence. There was a low-speed impact, resulting in some clear damage to the doors of the Toyota. It appeared to be an honest accident caused by poor visibility in the heavy traffic.

I was sitting at a red light in Vila Nova de Gaia. The driver behind me didn't seem to notice the light was still red and just rolled forward into my bumper. It wasn't a high-speed collision, but the impact was enough to break my rear lamp and push the bumper into a dented shape. I am really stressed about the repair time, man, because I need this car to get to my university classes every day. Do you think it will be fixed quickly?

I simply took my foot off the brake too early while looking at my navigation screen. I rolled forward into the car in front of me at the red light. I feel terrible about it. I have already inspected the damage and accepted full responsibility for the broken lamp and the dent I caused to the other driver's bumper.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: It was during the morning rush hour here in Lisbon. I was driving straight on the Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo when a delivery van to my left attempted to merge into my lane without checking. It scraped along my left door and fender. The driver was very cooperative and we exchanged details immediately. There is a long, ugly scratch along the side of the car now. It is quite disappointing because I just had the car polished last week, but these things happen in city traffic.

I was approaching the crossing on the Circunvalação when a driver coming from the opposite direction made a sudden left turn right in front of me. I had absolutely no time to react and hit them on the side. The impact was quite significant. My headlight is shattered, the lamp is broken, and there is a massive dent on my hood where it crumpled. It was a very loud crash and quite a traumatic moment for me, to be honest.

I was standing at the bus stop and witnessed the whole thing. The Skoda was going straight with a green light, but the other car turned directly into its path without waiting. It was unavoidable for the Skoda driver. There was glass shattered everywhere from the lamp and a clear dent on the front of the vehicle. I felt I had to provide my contact details.

I was driving around the roundabout near the Casa da Música when another vehicle suddenly moved into my lane. I slammed on the brakes but could not avoid the impact at low speed. The other driver clipped my rear left panel. It was quite stressful, and I’m honestly worried about the repair costs because the car is my only way to get to work. I clearly see a visible dent on the wheel arch and a long scratch along the side paintwork. I was just trying to navigate the traffic flow carefully when this happened.

I was trying to exit the roundabout and I think I misjudged the distance of the car in the outer lane. I turned the steering wheel too early and ended up hitting the side of the other car. I apologize for the mistake, I was just a bit distracted by the GPS navigation instructions.

Traffic was incredibly heavy near the Cais do Sodré area this afternoon. I was stopped in a line of cars when the vehicle behind me failed to stop in time and hit me from behind. The impact was quite jarring, and I felt a bit shaken up. When I got out to check the car, I saw that my rear lamp is broken and there is a significant crack in the plastic bumper casing. Everything happened so fast, and I am just hoping the insurance process goes smoothly for everyone involved.

I was trying to park my car in a tight spot near the shopping center. It was a very narrow street, and I miscalculated the angle while reversing. I ended up scraping the side of a parked vehicle. I feel terrible about it because I was being extra cautious, but it was just a lapse in judgment on my part. There is a visible scratch on the side door panel. I am waiting for the owner to return so we can exchange insurance information properly.

I was sitting at a cafe table right next to the parking spot when I saw the driver trying to reverse. They were moving very slowly, but they just misjudged the space and scraped the side of the stationary car. It was clearly an honest mistake while trying to park.

I was driving home after visiting my daughter, the traffic was moving quite slowly as it usually does on this avenue. I signaled to change lanes to the right, checking my mirrors as I always do, but I clearly missed the other car that was already there. We ended up colliding on the side. My front lamp is broken, and there is a deep dent and a scratch along the passenger door. I am feeling quite embarrassed, as I pride myself on being a safe driver for over forty years.

It was pouring rain earlier today, man, and the visibility was just super poor. I was slowing down because the car in front of me braked hard, but the road was so slick that my tires didn't grip well enough. I rear-ended the car ahead of me, which honestly sucks. I am super worried about the repair costs, dude. There is a noticeable dent on the middle of the trunk lid now. I hope my insurance covers this because I really didn't mean for this to happen at all.

I was driving ahead and had to stop suddenly due to a pedestrian crossing the road. The car behind me couldn't stop in time on the wet asphalt and hit my rear bumper. We both got out and agreed that the weather made it really difficult to brake safely.

Driving across the bridge is always a nightmare with the dense traffic. I was in the middle lane when the driver to my right tried to cut in. I didn't see them until it was too late. There is a long scratch along my passenger side door. I am really annoyed, to be honest, because I try to be so careful with my car. The other driver apologized and admitted they were in a rush, but that doesn't really fix the paintwork, does it?

I was attempting to merge into the middle lane because my lane was ending soon. I didn't check my blind spot properly and bumped into the side of the BMW. I take full responsibility for the scratch on their door, it was completely my error.

I was pulling out of a parking space in the city center. I did not realize there was a pole behind me as I turned the wheel. It was a very silly mistake, and I am quite upset with myself. The impact resulted in a dent in the rear quarter panel and my tail lamp is now broken. I have been driving for many years, but today I was just distracted by my phone ringing. It’s an expensive lesson, but I am glad no one else was hurt.

I was delivery driving in the old town area, and the streets are just so incredibly tight. I tried to squeeze past a delivery truck that was double-parked, but I miscalculated the clearance. My side mirror clipped the truck and the glass shattered completely. I feel really bad about it, man. It's a small car, but I guess I underestimated the width of the gap. I just need to get this sorted out quickly so I can get back to my delivery route.

I was walking down the street and saw the small car trying to pass the parked truck. The driver was moving slowly, but the road is simply too narrow there. I heard the glass shatter when the mirror hit the truck's metal side. It was just a tight space accident.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: The morning commute was absolutely packed today. I was driving towards the roundabout and the car ahead of me braked suddenly to let a bus pass. I hit the brakes, but I was maybe a bit too close and tapped their rear bumper. It was quite a loud noise, which worried me. Looking at the car, there is a minor dent and some surface scratches on my hood. I am quite frustrated because I am always careful about keeping a safe distance, but it just happened so fast.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, driving at about 20 km/h, when the car to my right tried to exit and didn't see me. I tried to brake, but we ended up making contact. It happened so fast, and I was just trying to get to a work meeting. My passenger side door took the brunt of the impact, and now there is a visible dent and a long scratch along the panel. I am really stressed about how I am going to get to work tomorrow without my car, honestly.

I was in the roundabout and misjudged the distance while changing lanes to take the exit. I feel terrible about it. I hit the side of the other driver's car. I can see a clear dent and some paint scratches on their passenger door where my bumper made contact.

I was trying to parallel park in a very tight spot on Rua de Santa Catarina late in the afternoon. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was reversing, I miscalculated the angle of the car parked behind me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had caught the corner of their bumper. It is just a surface scratch, but I feel like an absolute idiot for doing this. I have always been careful, but this street is just so narrow and busy.

Traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy, just stop-and-go. I was following the car in front at a very slow pace, maybe 10 km/h, but I got distracted for a split second by a pedestrian on the sidewalk. When I looked back, the car in front had stopped dead. I slammed on the brakes, but I still bumped into them. It left a nasty dent on my hood and my front left lamp is broken. I am so worried about the repair costs, this is just a nightmare.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my mirror, and the driver behind me had clearly misjudged the stop. My rear bumper is affected, but their car clearly has a dented hood and a broken headlight lamp.

It was raining, and the traffic was really dense on the bridge heading toward Almada. I was in the middle lane, moving at about 40 km/h, when the vehicle in the left lane suddenly tried to merge into my space. I had nowhere to go because of the median. They sideswiped my car, causing a dent on the rear quarter panel and a deep scratch along the side. It was such a scary moment, and the rain made it hard to even see properly what was happening.

I was driving home from my granddaughter's house on the Estrada Monumental. I recall it was a bit breezy, the palm trees were swaying, and I was going quite slowly as I always do. At the intersection, a delivery van just didn't see me and clipped my front corner. The impact caused my side lamp to shatter completely and some glass from the housing to break onto the road. It was quite a shock, I must say, as I've been driving for forty years and rarely see such things.

I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing nearby. I saw the Fiat entering the intersection properly. The delivery van driver clearly didn't notice the Fiat and turned into the side of it. I heard the glass shatter when the lamp broke upon impact.

I was driving along the avenue when the car ahead braked very abruptly for a cyclist. I reacted, but because the road was a bit slick, I couldn't stop in time and tapped their bumper. It was only a low-speed impact, but it left a visible dent on the rear of their vehicle and my own front grille. I am feeling quite anxious about the whole insurance procedure, as I have never had to file a claim before and I really hope everything goes smoothly.

I was driving down Rua da Prata. The street is quite narrow due to some roadworks. A large delivery truck was trying to pass, and it seems the driver miscalculated the width of the gap. They sideswiped my car as they moved past. It left a significant dent and a large scratch on my front fender. The truck driver stopped, and we exchanged details, but I am still very worried about the damage and what it will cost to fix it properly.

I was maneuvering the truck through the construction area. I thought I had cleared the other vehicle, but I heard a scraping sound. When I checked, I saw a dent and a scratch on the side of the passenger door of the car I was passing.

I was traveling on the EN125 when a vehicle stopped suddenly in the middle of the road. I was keeping a safe distance, but it wasn't enough. I hit them from behind at about 30 km/h. It was a mess. My front lamp is broken, and there is a deep dent on the hood. I am just really shaken up by the whole experience. The sun was also very low in the sky, which made it hard to see the brake lights of the car ahead.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: The traffic was moving at a moderate speed of 50 km/h. I was in the right lane intending to turn into the side street. Another vehicle in the lane to my left attempted to move into my lane at the same time. We both made contact while trying to merge. It resulted in a scratch along my rear door panel. I am quite professional about these things, so I made sure to gather the driver's info immediately after we pulled over to a safe area.
I was checking my blind spot but clearly missed the BMW. I moved into their lane and we made contact. It caused a minor scratch on their vehicle. I admit my fault in this lane-change maneuver.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, heading toward the A1 highway. The traffic was extremely dense as usual at 9 AM. I was in the middle lane, and as I went to exit, another vehicle came alongside me. I didn't see him in my blind spot, man. We made contact, and now there is a noticeable dent and a deep scratch on my rear wing. I'm really stressed about the repair costs, honestly, but I just want to get this sorted out properly.

I was driving my Seat through the roundabout, following the flow of traffic. I noticed the Peugeot driver moving toward the exit, but it seemed like they didn't check their mirrors before shifting lanes. We bumped into each other at a low speed. It resulted in a dent and some scratches on their vehicle's bodywork. It was a simple case of poor visibility in the heavy morning traffic.

I was driving home from the pharmacy, and as I approached the traffic lights on Boavista, the vehicle in front of me stopped very suddenly. It was raining quite hard, and the road surface was slick. I stepped on my brakes, but I just couldn't stop in time and tapped their bumper. My front lamp is broken now and there is a dent on my hood. I feel quite shaken by the whole incident, to be perfectly honest, as I have been driving for years.

I was driving along the main road toward the hotel zone when I decided to shift into the left lane to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirror, but I suppose I didn't hold the gap long enough. The car behind me accelerated, and we scraped the sides of our vehicles. I stopped immediately to exchange information. There is a visible scratch running along the side of my door. I really should have been more patient with the lane change.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the hotel entrance when I observed the two vehicles. The Ford was moving into the left lane quite suddenly. The other driver didn't have much room to react. They collided, resulting in a scratch on the side of the Ford. Neither vehicle was going fast, and they both pulled over to the side of the road immediately afterward to handle the situation.

I had parked my car near the port for lunch. When I returned, I noticed that the vehicle that had been parked behind me must have hit my rear bumper while backing out. I saw a clear dent on the bumper. I waited around for a bit to see if anyone would return, but nobody appeared. It’s very frustrating to find your car damaged when you were nowhere near it, but I suppose that is just the reality of parking in such a crowded city center.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was entering the intersection near the square, and I thought I had the right of way. I was looking at the traffic light, which was turning yellow. The other driver entered from the side street at the same moment. It was a low-speed impact, but the force was enough to shatter the glass on my side mirror and break the indicator lamp on the front bumper. I am quite worried about the repair, as this car is my only way to get to work.

I was proceeding through the intersection when the Fiat pulled out. I think they might have been distracted by the light changing. My car hit their side, breaking their lamp and shattering the glass on their mirror. It happened so quickly, but we were both driving at perhaps 20 km/h. It was a genuine mistake by both of us regarding the timing of the lights at such a busy crossing.

I was driving in the right lane, and a large truck was in the lane to my left. As we were moving, the truck started to drift into my lane. I swerved to the right to avoid a major collision, but I still clipped the side barrier. This resulted in a long scratch along my passenger side doors. It was quite a stressful experience, and my hands were shaking for a while afterward, but I managed to keep the car under control.

I was standing near the metro exit when I saw the truck drift into the lane of the BMW. The BMW driver reacted well by moving to the right, but they were forced against the guardrail. I saw the side of the BMW get scratched by the barrier. It was clearly the truck's fault for drifting, but thankfully it was only a scratch and not a more serious accident.

My grandson and I were driving down the avenue, just enjoying the afternoon, when the car in front of us braked suddenly for a pedestrian. I pressed the brakes as hard as I could, but my foot slipped a bit, and I hit them. My car sustained a dent on the grille and some glass shattered from the headlight. It was a very upsetting moment for me, especially with my grandson in the car, but we are all safe and the other driver was very kind.

I stopped for a pedestrian crossing the street in front of the city hall. The Audi behind me wasn't able to stop in time and hit my bumper. It wasn't a massive impact, but it caused some damage to their headlight glass and a dent on their bumper. I checked on the driver and their grandson immediately, and we exchanged details once we were sure that everyone was feeling okay.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and traffic on Avenida da Liberdade was quite dense as usual. Suddenly, the car ahead of me braked very abruptly because a tourist stepped off the curb. I slammed on my brakes, but the road was a bit damp and I could not stop in time, so I tapped his bumper. It was a stupid mistake and I feel terrible about it. There is a small dent and a long scratch on my hood where I hit the rear of his car.

I was navigating the roundabout at Boavista in the outer lane when a van suddenly cut across me from the inside lane to exit toward the highway. I tried to swerve, but there was nowhere to go. We collided at a very low speed. I was honestly so shaken up, like, my hands were literally shaking. I'm worried about the repair costs, dude. The front left lamp is broken and there are several deep scratches along the side panel from the van's bumper.

I was heading home to Gaia and realized I had nearly missed my exit. I moved into the lane quickly but didn't notice the car in my blind spot. I hit the back of his front fender. It was entirely my fault as I was maneuvering too aggressively in the heavy afternoon traffic.

I was trying to parallel park my Fiat near the center of Braga this morning. The spot was quite narrow, and as I was reversing, I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar behind me. I heard a scraping sound, and I immediately knew I had hit it. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident, but I am reporting it immediately for insurance purposes. There is a significant, visible scratch across the rear bumper where it scraped against the stone edge of the pillar.

While driving on the N125 near Faro, the lane markings were a bit faded due to the bright sun glare. I signaled to change to the right lane, but another driver was moving up alongside me at the same time. We both tried to adjust, but our side doors made contact. I am a very careful driver, so this is quite frustrating. The door has a noticeable dent and a scratch running horizontally along the handle area where we made contact.

The sunlight was blinding me coming out of the tunnel. I saw a BMW changing lanes, but I was already positioned in the lane. We bumped sides. It was a minor incident, but we both sustained damage to our bodywork. I apologize for not checking my mirror more carefully.

It was quite early, around 8:00 AM, and traffic was crawling across the bridge. A vehicle three cars ahead stopped dead. Everyone jammed their brakes on. The lady behind me stopped, but then a delivery truck hit her, which pushed her into me. I heard the glass shatter immediately. My trunk has a huge dent, and the rear window glass shattered from the impact force. It has been a long morning and I just want to get my car to the shop.

I was in the car behind the delivery truck. I saw the whole sequence. The traffic came to a halt on the bridge, and the truck couldn't stop in time. It was a classic chain reaction due to the congestion on the bridge. The driver in the middle really didn't have a chance to avoid hitting the Seat.

Well, you see, I was just coming back from visiting my granddaughter in Benfica. It was a lovely day, but the traffic was simply horrendous. I was turning slowly into a parking spot and there was this young man on a bicycle who suddenly swerved toward my car to avoid a pothole. I stopped, but he clipped the passenger side door. There is a nasty scratch there, poor thing. It's not a large incident, but I felt I must report it correctly as the rules state.

I was cycling and didn't see the Mini pulling in because I was distracted by a pothole in the road. I swerved into the car and my handlebars caused a scratch on the side of the door. The driver was very kind and helped me up.

I was driving along the Avenida da Boavista at approximately 40 km/h. A car in the lane to my left started drifting into my lane while the driver was clearly distracted by his mobile phone. I honked, but he still grazed my side. The car has a series of scratches and a small dent on the rear passenger door. It's very frustrating because the car is practically new and I always park in a garage to avoid these things.

I admit I was looking at a notification on my phone. I drifted slightly out of my lane on the avenue. I felt a bump and realized I had sideswiped the Mercedes. I am fully responsible for the damage to the side of his vehicle.

I was stopped at a pedestrian crossing in Cascais waiting for a group of tourists to pass. I was just sitting there, calm, listening to the radio, when suddenly the car behind me failed to stop and hit my rear bumper. The force was quite significant. My rear hatch has a very large dent, and the rear window glass shattered completely across the road. It was quite a shock, but at least the pedestrians were safe and nobody was walking behind me at that exact moment.

I was driving along Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM yesterday when traffic suddenly came to a complete standstill. I tried to brake, but I wasn't fast enough and tapped the back of the car in front of me at about 10 km/h. It was completely my fault, man, I was just distracted for a second by the GPS. My bumper has a clear dent and some deep scratches on the right side. I feel terrible about this whole situation, you know, it's just my luck to have this happen during rush hour.

I was waiting in the traffic line heading toward the city center when I suddenly felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't stop in time. When I checked my car, I saw a dent on the lower part of my trunk and some light scratches from the impact. The other driver apologized immediately and was very cooperative.

location: Roundabout near Marina de Cascais, Cascais

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout near the Cascais marina, trying to exit toward the beach, when I misjudged the distance of the vehicle in the inner lane. As I moved over, I brushed against the side of the other car. It was just a low-speed contact, maybe 15 km/h. There are some long white scratches along my passenger door. I am honestly quite anxious about the insurance claim process because I really need my car for work tomorrow morning. I hope this can be sorted out quickly and without too much hassle.

I was trying to park in a very tight spot on Rua Augusta this morning. I thought I had enough room, but as I was reversing at walking speed, I bumped into the parked van behind me. I didn't see it until it was too late. There is a visible dent on my rear bumper. I am so worried about the repair costs, dude. It was such a silly mistake to make on a Tuesday, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork for the insurance company.

I was sitting at a nearby café terrace when I saw the white Fiat attempting to park. It was moving quite slowly, but the driver clearly miscalculated the proximity to the delivery van. There was a low-speed impact, resulting in a noticeable dent on the Fiat's rear bumper. No one was injured, and the driver stopped immediately.

I was driving home from the office around 7:00 PM. It was getting dark and the lights were already on. I signaled to change lanes on Avenida 24 de Julho, but I didn't see the motorcycle coming up in my blind spot. I clipped his handlebars, which caused him to wobble, and then he grazed my rear quarter panel. My tail lamp is broken and there are several scratches on the fender. I am so shaken up, honestly, I didn't mean to cut him off, I just truly didn't see him there.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: It was raining this morning in Porto, and the streets were quite slippery. As I approached the intersection at the Rotunda da Boavista, the lights turned yellow. I tried to stop, but my tires lost grip on the wet pavement. I skidded forward and collided with the back of a stationary taxi at roughly 20 km/h. The impact caused a deep dent on my hood and shattered my front headlight glass. I feel terrible for the taxi driver, as he was just doing his job and waiting for the signal.

I was stopped at the traffic light on the roundabout. I checked my mirror and saw the car behind me sliding on the wet road. He hit my rear bumper. My car has some cosmetic damage, but thankfully, nobody was hurt. It was clearly a result of the sudden rainfall making the road surface very dangerous for braking.

I was heading down the Estrada Monumental toward the city center. I had been driving for about twenty minutes, and I must admit I was a bit tired after my long shift at the hotel. The car in front of me slowed down abruptly for a bus that was pulling away from a stop, and I just didn't react quickly enough. I hit him at very low speed, but there is a clear dent on my front grille. I am very sorry about this, it was just a moment of poor judgment.

I had just finished my weekly grocery shopping. It was a very busy morning at the parking lot on Avenida da República. As I was pulling out of my space, I miscalculated the swing of my front bumper while turning, and I grazed the side of the parked SUV next to me. It created a long, unsightly scratch along my door. I immediately left a note with my contact details on the other windshield, as I believe that is the right thing to do in such an unfortunate situation.

I returned to my car after running errands and found a note on my windshield. The other driver admitted to scraping my side door while pulling out of their parking spot. There are visible white scratches on my passenger side door panel. I appreciate the honesty of the driver, as they provided all their insurance details right away.

Well, you see, I was driving down the Avenida dos Aliados, which is always so full of tourists and busy traffic. I was looking for a spot to drop off my granddaughter at the museum, and while I was turning, I didn't see the bollard on the edge of the pedestrian area. I bumped into it at about 5 km/h, very slowly really. It broke my rear tail lamp. I have been driving for over forty years, and I must say I feel quite embarrassed by this little mishap.

It was a narrow street in the Cedofeita neighborhood. I was trying to pass a delivery truck that was partially parked on the side of the road. I thought I had enough clearance, but there was a car coming in the opposite direction. I tried to pull back to my side, but I didn't have enough room and side-swiped the parked car. It resulted in a dent on my front fender and some nasty scratches along the trim. Man, I am so stressed, I really need this car for my commute every single day.

I was entering the roundabout near the airport, and honestly, the traffic was moving quite erratically. I was changing lanes to take the exit when I collided with a car that was accelerating hard from behind. The impact caused a dent on my rear quarter panel and broke my side-mounted indicator lamp. It happened so fast, like, I checked my mirrors, but they were in my blind spot. I am definitely going to be more careful at roundabouts from now on, it was a very scary experience.

I was driving around the roundabout toward the airport terminal. The car in front of me attempted to cut across lanes without signaling clearly. I tried to brake, but we made contact. My front bumper has a dent from the collision. It was a very confusing situation given how busy the roundabout was at that time of day.

I was driving home from work along Avenida da Boavista when traffic suddenly slowed down near the park. I braked, but the driver behind me didn't react in time. My car was pushed forward, and I felt the impact clearly. I got out and saw a dent on the rear bumper and some white paint scratches across the plastic trim. I am quite worried about the repair costs, as I have always tried to keep my car in perfect condition. The other driver was cooperative and we immediately filled out the European Accident Report.

I was navigating the roundabout at Entrecampos during the morning rush. As I was exiting towards the main avenue, a van coming from my left failed to yield and struck my passenger side. The impact was loud, and I realized my turn signal lamp broken and the passenger side window glass shatter immediately. I am truly shaken up by the whole experience. It happened so fast, and honestly, I just want to make sure the process is handled correctly because I need the car for my daily commute.

I was merging into the roundabout and simply did not see the Peugeot in my blind spot. I take full responsibility for the collision. When I hit the vehicle, I heard the glass break and saw the side light unit shatter on the ground. I have already provided my insurance details to the driver so we can process the claim as quickly as possible.

It was a busy Saturday afternoon in Setúbal. I was trying to park in a tight spot along Avenida Luísa Todi. I misjudged the distance while reversing into the space next to a parked sedan and ended up dragging my rear quarter panel against their bumper. I feel terrible about the mistake. There is a deep scratch along the side of my car. I waited for the other owner to return to the vehicle so we could exchange information properly. It was an honest error of judgment on my part.

I was moving slowly in heavy traffic near Avenida dos Aliados. The driver in the adjacent lane tried to squeeze into my gap without checking the mirrors properly. He swiped the side of my vehicle while merging. I have a long dent along the door and several deep scratches where the paint was removed. My main concern is getting this sorted out quickly, as this is a company car and I need to report this to my fleet manager without delay. It was a very frustrating afternoon in the city center.

I was walking along the sidewalk and saw the whole thing. The white car tried to change lanes too abruptly. There was no way the BMW could have avoided it. I saw the metal denting as they scraped together. I left my contact details because it was clear the driver of the BMW wasn't at fault.

I was pulling out of a parking spot in downtown Lisbon. I was being careful, but as I turned the wheel to exit, I clipped a bollard that I hadn't noticed. It was a very low-speed impact, maybe 5 km/h, but it was enough to cause my front lamp broken. I feel quite silly for missing that pole, honestly. It's just one of those days where everything feels a bit off. I'm reporting this to get the light replaced as soon as possible because I don't want to drive with a broken light at night.

It was a lovely day for a drive, and I was heading towards Cascais along the Marginal. Traffic came to a sudden halt near the beach parking areas. The vehicle behind me, a large delivery truck, bumped into my rear. It left a significant dent on the trunk door. I have been driving for over forty years, and this is the first time I have been involved in such an incident. My grandchildren were in the car, and we were all just startled by the sudden jolt of the collision, truly an unexpected afternoon.

The sun was quite bright, and when the traffic stopped, I was momentarily distracted by the glare. I hit the back of the Mercedes at a low speed. I apologize for the incident; I caused a dent to the trunk of the car. We have filled out the papers, and I am ready to cooperate with the insurance claim process.

I was traveling north on Avenida da República in the middle lane. The car to my right suddenly accelerated and swerved into my lane without signaling. I tried to steer left, but we made contact. There is a noticeable dent on my front fender and a long scratch along the wheel arch. I'm just so stressed about this, you know? I have an important meeting later, and now I have to deal with this mess. The other driver and I are currently waiting for the police to clear the scene.

I was crossing the intersection at Rua de Cedofeita when a taxi came through a red light. It hit my side door. I was quite scared because the impact shattered the glass of my rear window and my turn signal lamp broken. There is also a large dent in the door panel. I’ve never been in a crash before, and my heart is still pounding. I am just really hoping the insurance covers the repairs properly, as this is my only car and I rely on it for everything.

I was rushing to pick up a passenger and misread the traffic lights at the intersection. I am at fault for the collision. The impact damaged the door of the other vehicle, breaking the glass and the indicator light. I am very sorry for the inconvenience and have admitted my error to the other driver.

I was parking near Praça do Comércio, trying to find a spot. While I was maneuvering into a tight space between two cars, I accidentally misjudged the turn and scraped my bumper against a concrete pillar in the underground lot. It’s just a superficial scratch, but I wanted to report it immediately to maintain my insurance standing. I’ve been driving in these tight city streets for years, so it's frustrating to make such a basic mistake today. I will be bringing the car to the shop later this week to get it polished and repaired.

Driving along Avenida 24 de Julho is always chaotic, but today was worse than usual. I was keeping in my lane when the vehicle to my left suddenly swerved to avoid a cyclist. He clipped the side of my car, causing a dent and multiple scratches on the driver's side door. It happened so quickly that I didn't even have time to honk. I'm just thankful no one was hurt. I need to get an estimate for these bodywork repairs as soon as possible, as the damage is quite visible.

I saw the whole incident while waiting for the bus. The driver of the gray car swerved suddenly to miss a bicycle in the road, which pushed him into the Seat. It was definitely a side-swipe, and I saw the paint scratch and the metal dent immediately upon impact.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly stopped. It was quite heavy due to the rush hour, and I tried to brake, but I wasn't fast enough and hit the rear of the car in front of me. I am so incredibly stressed about this, like, I have never been in an accident before and I am really worried about how much this is going to cost to repair. There is a noticeable dent on my hood where I made contact with their bumper.

I was completely stopped in traffic when I suddenly felt a significant jolt from behind. When I got out to check the damage, the other driver seemed very anxious and upset. My rear bumper definitely has a dent, but fortunately, nothing else seems broken on my car.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música when another driver merged into my lane too quickly. I tried to steer away, but we made contact on the side. I am quite a cautious driver usually, so this is very frustrating. It was raining slightly, making the roads slick. The impact caused a long scratch along my passenger side door. I hope the insurance company understands that I really didn't have much room to maneuver away from the other vehicle in that moment.

I was attempting to parallel park on Avenida da Liberdade this morning. The spot was quite tight, and I misjudged the distance between my car and the concrete bollard on the sidewalk. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had made contact. I checked the area and saw both a scratch and a dent on my front right fender. It was a stupid mistake on my part, and I feel terrible about it, but I just want to get it fixed properly through the insurance process.

I was crossing the intersection at Rua Augusta when the other car didn't stop at the red light. I hit them on the side at low speed, maybe 15 km/h. I am still shaking from the impact, to be honest. My front lamp is completely broken and there is glass shatter all over the pavement. It all happened so fast, and I am worried that I'll be held responsible even though I had the green light. It’s just a really overwhelming situation for me right now.

I was standing on the corner waiting to cross when I saw the silver Toyota enter the intersection on a green light. The black sedan ignored the signal and drove right into the path of the Toyota. It was a clear collision; the front lamp of the Toyota shattered instantly on impact.

The traffic was moving slowly in the center lane of Avenida dos Aliados. I checked my mirrors before switching to the left lane, but I must have missed the other driver who was in my blind spot. We side-swiped each other at very low speed. There is a visible scratch on my rear quarter panel. I am a professional driver and I usually pride myself on my awareness, so this is quite embarrassing to report. I have provided the necessary details for our mutual insurance declaration.

I have been driving in this city for over forty years, and I usually take great care. I was driving down Rua do Ouro, going to visit my grandson for his birthday, when the car in front of me suddenly braked for a pedestrian. I pressed the brake pedal firmly, but I still tapped his bumper. It is a dent and a broken lamp on my side. I am quite shaken by this incident as I have not had a claim in a very long time, and I am anxious about the repair.

I stopped for a pedestrian crossing the street. The gentleman behind me clearly didn't stop in time. He was very apologetic and visibly nervous. My car sustained some damage, but he was helpful and we exchanged all insurance details immediately at the scene.

Traffic was dense on the bridge this afternoon. I was maintaining my lane when a heavy vehicle moved into my space, pushing me slightly toward the barrier. I tried to steer away but my side caught the metal guardrail, resulting in a deep scratch. It was a very claustrophobic situation and I am just glad there was no multi-car pileup. I have photographic evidence of the scratch and the location where it happened. I would appreciate it if the insurance claim could be processed efficiently.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was proceeding through the intersection at around 30 km/h when another vehicle approached from the right and failed to yield at the stop sign. I hit their rear side. It was a loud impact, and my front lamp is broken and there is a significant dent on my bumper. I am trying to stay calm about this whole process, but it is such a nuisance to deal with paperwork while I have so much work waiting for me. I just want this resolved as quickly as possible.

I was leaving a parking garage in Rua de Santa Catarina. The exit is very narrow and poorly lit. As I turned the corner, I miscalculated the swing of my car and scraped the side against a concrete pillar. It left a long scratch along the side panel. It is just a minor incident, but it is frustrating given that I only bought this car recently. I am reporting it honestly as it happened, and I hope the coverage will allow for a repair soon.

I was stopped in the middle lane on Avenida da República due to heavy traffic. I was looking at the traffic lights when I was hit from behind by a van. The force was enough to cause a dent in my rear and some glass shatter from the taillight. It was a very jarring experience, and I am still trying to process what happened. I’ve already taken down the details of the other driver, and we both agreed to file our respective reports immediately to avoid any further trouble.

I was distracted for a split second and failed to notice the traffic had come to a standstill. I hit the back of the Audi in front of me at low speed. The driver of the Audi was composed, and we exchanged details. My vehicle did not suffer major damage, but the Audi has a dent and broken rear glass.

I was driving around the roundabout at Boavista, trying to head towards the bridge, when things got a bit chaotic. I was in the outer lane, and I think I misjudged the distance of the car next to me. I was going really slow, maybe 20 km/h, because of the traffic density. Suddenly, I heard this grinding noise against the passenger side door. I am honestly so stressed about this, like, I have never had an accident before. There is just a long, visible scratch along the metal, but thank goodness it didn't dent anything.

I was attempting to parallel park near the main square in the city center. It was a tight space, and I was being super careful, checking my mirrors constantly. I thought I had enough clearance from the car parked in front of me, but I clearly miscalculated my distance by a few centimeters. As I reversed slowly, I felt a slight jolt. Upon inspection, I realized I had left a noticeable dent on my rear bumper. It was an honest mistake and I am feeling quite embarrassed about the whole situation.

I was sitting at the outdoor cafe nearby watching the street. The driver of the Peugeot was clearly trying to park carefully. The maneuver was very slow, but he just misjudged the distance to the stationary vehicle and tapped the bumper. I saw the dent occur immediately upon impact. It was just an unfortunate, low-speed parking error.

It was pouring rain this afternoon, and the visibility near the Baixa area was quite poor. I was moving at a very low speed because of the heavy pedestrian traffic. As I pulled forward, a delivery van suddenly stopped in front of me. I braked hard, but my car slid slightly on the wet cobblestones, and I hit the back of the van. The impact was really minor, but my front lamp is broken. I am worried about the repair costs, man, this car is my only way to get to university.

I stopped my van to check a delivery address. The Fiat behind me couldn't stop in time due to the slick road conditions. It was a very gentle tap, but their front lamp shattered upon contact with my rear step. We were both going very slowly.

I was heading home on the N125 after running errands in Faro. The traffic was bumper-to-bumper, as it often is during the late afternoon. I glanced at my GPS for a split second, and when I looked back, the car in front of me had stopped abruptly. I slammed on the brakes, but I still rear-ended them. I am very upset with myself for being distracted. There is a dent and a deep scratch on my hood, and I honestly just want to get this sorted as quickly as possible.

I was driving along the avenue when I decided to change lanes to turn right. I checked my side mirror, but I suppose the other vehicle was in my blind spot. As I shifted, I felt a slight scrape against the side of my car. I pulled over immediately to talk to the other driver. There is a long scratch running across the passenger door. I really pride myself on being a safe driver, so this is quite distressing for me to report to the insurance company today.

I was maintaining my lane when the driver in the BMW moved into my path without seeing me. I tried to swerve, but they still scraped the side of my vehicle. The contact resulted in a significant scratch on their door panel. We both stopped right away to exchange details.

Well, you see, I was trying to pull into this parking spot, and I have been driving for over forty years, but the sun was hitting my windshield at just the right angle to blind me momentarily. I turned the wheel a bit too early, I suppose, and the front corner of my car caught the side of the vehicle parked next to me. It created a dent and a rather nasty scratch on my bumper. My grandson always tells me to be more careful, and I really should have listened to him today.

I was waiting at a red light on the avenue, and I was completely stationary. Suddenly, I felt a hard jolt from behind. The vehicle behind me failed to stop in time, likely due to a moment of inattention. The impact was quite strong, and it caused the glass to shatter on my rear light assembly. I am feeling a bit shaken up, to be honest. I was just sitting there, waiting for the light to turn green so I could get to my meeting on time.

I am terribly sorry about this. I was looking down at my radio for just a second, and when I looked up, the traffic had stopped. I tried to brake, but I hit the Volvo in front of me. I heard the glass shatter immediately. I am fully prepared to take responsibility for this accident.

Everything happened so fast. I was circling the square to exit towards the river, and another car was coming in too quickly from the side. We both tried to merge, and we clipped each other. My front lamp is broken, and there is a dent on the fender. I am just really worried because this is my main car for work and I need it fixed. The other driver and I agreed that it was just a simple misunderstanding of the right-of-way in the roundabout.

I was entering the roundabout and thought I had the space to pull in. The Opel was also entering at the same time. We bumped into each other. I am sorry for the damage to the lamp and the dent on their car. It was just a mistake on both our parts.

It was a busy Saturday morning, and I was navigating the narrow streets of the city. I was trying to squeeze past a delivery truck that was double-parked. I was going very slowly, maybe 10 km/h, but I miscalculated how close the truck's side panel was. I heard a scraping sound against my side mirror and door. There is a long scratch along the side of my car now. It's so frustrating because the street is just too narrow for two vehicles to pass at the same time.

I was driving home from work during the peak rush hour on the Avenida da Republica. The car in front of me stopped suddenly, and despite my best efforts to brake firmly, I couldn't stop in time on the asphalt. I hit the rear of their vehicle, causing a dent on their bumper and some glass to shatter from their rear light. I feel terrible about the accident; I was paying attention, but the traffic flow was just incredibly erratic and stopped dead.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the crosswalk. I saw the traffic jam build up quickly. The Audi driver was traveling at a reasonable speed, but the car ahead stopped without warning. The impact was unavoidable. I saw the dent and the glass shatter on the ground immediately afterward.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM in heavy traffic. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because a pedestrian started crossing outside the crosswalk. I tried to press my brakes immediately, but I didn't have enough distance, and I ended up bumping into his rear bumper at a low speed. I am honestly quite worried about my insurance premiums now, I hope this doesn't cost me too much. There is a noticeable dent on my hood where I hit him, but thankfully nobody was hurt in the process.

It was raining this morning near the airport and everything was a bit chaotic with the traffic. As I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio to exit towards the highway, a white van merged into my lane too quickly. I swerved to the left to avoid a full impact, but I still grazed the side of his vehicle. I stopped immediately to check the damage, and I can see a long scratch along my passenger-side door. I am feeling quite stressed about the repair process, dude, this is my first time dealing with this.

I was entering the roundabout and moved to the outer lane. I didn't see the Seat Ibiza coming from behind as I made the turn. We made contact, and my side panel now has a clear scratch. It was a simple mistake due to the heavy rain and poor visibility, and we both pulled over safely to exchange our insurance details.

I was trying to park in a very narrow spot in Coimbra city center yesterday afternoon. I misjudged the distance from the stone pillar on my left while reversing. I heard a scraping sound and stopped right away. When I got out, I realized I had scraped against the pillar, causing a dent and a deep scratch on my rear bumper. I feel so embarrassed about it, honestly. I've been driving for years and I should have been much more careful with such a tight maneuver, but the street was quite dark.

I was cruising along Avenida 24 de Julho near the docks. The traffic was moving slowly, maybe at 30 km/h. A delivery scooter tried to squeeze between my car and the lane divider, but he hit my side mirror and the front bumper. It caused a broken lamp on the side and a series of scratches. I'm really frustrated because I was just driving normally and he appeared out of nowhere. I hope the repair is covered by my policy, as the damage looks quite bad when you see it up close.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the whole thing. The BMW was staying in its lane, but the scooter driver was driving aggressively between lanes. The scooter clipped the side of the car, causing the light to break and leaving visible marks on the car's paint. The BMW driver reacted correctly by braking immediately.

I was coming home from the grocery store in Funchal when a car suddenly pulled out from a side street without stopping at the intersection. I had the right of way, but I couldn't stop in time. We collided, and the impact shattered my side mirror glass and caused a dent in the driver's side door. It was such a shock, I am still shaking a bit, you know? It's just really overwhelming to deal with a broken car when you have to get back to work tomorrow morning.

I apologize, I was distracted by my GPS for a split second and didn't notice the stop sign until it was too late. I hit the side of the Toyota as I entered the junction. I accept full responsibility for the accident and the resulting damage to their vehicle, including the shattered glass and door dent.

I was heading to the beach in Faro, and I signaled to change into the left lane to turn. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the other driver who was speeding up. We scraped each other's paint at low speed. There is a long scratch on my rear door. It was honestly a lapse in my judgment, and I feel terrible about it. I am very concerned about the cost of the bodywork, as the car is fairly new and I have always kept it in perfect condition.

I was stopped at a red light on the main avenue in Braga. I was waiting quite a while, thinking about my afternoon appointments, when suddenly I felt a jolt from behind. Another driver had rear-ended me. The impact was quite strong, enough to break my rear tail lamp and push the bumper in, causing a significant dent. I am an elderly driver, and this whole situation has been quite a bother for me, especially having to wait for the police report in this heat with my health conditions.

While navigating the narrow streets near Aliados, I accidentally backed into a concrete post. I was moving at maybe 5 km/h, but the bumper hit the edge of the post. It resulted in a visible crack in the plastic molding of the bumper. It's so frustrating because I'm usually very careful in city driving. I will need to get this repaired as soon as possible because I don't want the damage to spread further. Man, I really wish I had paid more attention to the proximity sensors.

The traffic on the EN125 was moving, then suddenly stopped. I shifted my vehicle slightly to the right to see around a large truck, but I didn't see the cyclist lane merging. I grazed a stationary car in the process. It left a scratch and a small dent on the wheel arch. I am very apologetic, as I should have checked my blind spot more thoroughly. I am worried about how the insurance company will assess the damage, but I want to make sure the other driver is taken care of.

I was stopped in traffic when the Ford decided to change lanes without checking his surroundings. He side-swiped my rear left panel. I have a scratch and a small dent on my door. We exchanged details on the side of the road safely. It was an honest mistake, I believe, but the damage is certainly there.

I was driving around the roundabout near the city park. The driver in the inner lane tried to exit the roundabout from the wrong lane, crossing right into my path. I had to brake hard, but he still hit my front corner. The impact broke my front indicator lamp. I am very stressed because this is a new vehicle and I have a strict schedule today. The other driver seemed very confused about the roundabout rules, which caused a lot of unnecessary chaos during the morning commute for everyone else.
